rr3vnm.title: В России появится новый комплекс по производству бензина
rr3vnm.content: «ТАИФ-НК» планирует строить новый комплекс по производству бензинов АИ-92 и АИ-95Нефтехимический холдинг «ТАИФ-НК» инвестирует 93,7 млрд рублей в строительство нового комплекса по производству бензина.Комплекс расположится в Нижнекамске рядом с действующим производством «ТАИФ-НК» и будет заниматься выпуском бензинов АИ-92 и АИ-95 экологического класса К5, а также сжиженных углеводородных газов. На площадке планируют создать 170 рабочих мест, запуск намечен на четвертый квартал 2032 года.Интересный нюанс: в качестве высокооктанового компонента для производства бензина компания намерена использовать биоэтанол.Этанол планируется выпускать на еще одном новом производстве в Нижнекамской промзоне – этот проект оценивают в 74 млрд рублей, а начать выпуск собираются в четвертом квартале 2033 года. Заметим, что на данный момент в России нет полноценного производства автомобильного топлива из смеси бензина и этанола.Оба проекта находятся в предынвестиционной стадии, их параметры будут уточняться при проектировании. Но в целом идея уже получила поддержку на уровне правительства Республики Татарстан.Ранее «За рулем» перечислил регионы, в которых бензин все еще дорожает. «За рулем» можно читать в ВКонтакте

1kw9jg6.title: Расследование международных СМИ раскрыло операции Deutsche Bank с российским бизнесом и Джеффри Эпштейном
1kw9jg6.content:
Расследование Inside Deutsche Bank раскрыло финансовые операции крупнейшего немецкого банка с российскими олигархами незадолго до начала войны в Украине, американским финансистом Джеффри Эпштейном, компаниями президента США Дональда Трампа и многое другое. Об этом говорится в опубликованных во вторник, 17 ноября, материалах международной группы журналистов из примерно 50 СМИ, в частности британской газеты Financial Times (FT), французской Le Monde и немецкого журнала Der Spiegel.

Как отмечается, группа из более 230 журналистов получила доступ к 15,6 млн конфиденциальных документов Deutsche Bank о его деятельности с начала 2010-х годов. Эта масштабная утечка включает около 9 млн электронных писем, материалы внутренних проверок, отчеты о подозрительных операциях и документы, связанные с оценкой рисков клиентов. Анализ документов выявил системные проблемы с контролем финансовых операций и соблюдением требований по борьбе с отмыванием денег.

Финансовые операции Deutsche Bank с Россией

В частности, по данным Le Monde, в начале 2022 года немецкий банк продолжал работать с компаниями, частично принадлежавшими подсанкционным российским бизнесменам, шесть из которых выделял в отдельную категорию из-за их особенно спорной репутации. Среди таковых была крупнейшая нефтехимическая компания России "Сибур" - однако Deutsche Bank продолжал ее обслуживать, указывая, что санкции против акционеров не запрещают работать с ней, пока их совокупная доля не превышает 50 процентов.

В материалах утечки отмечается, что в ходе собственной внутренней проверки банк также обнаружил перевод на более чем 1 млрд евро, предположительно, в интересах российского миллиардера Сулеймана Керимова, который банк одобрил в середине 2020 года, когда олигарх уже находился под санкциями США.Связи немецкого банка с Трампом и Эпштейном

Другая часть расследования касается нынешнего президента США Дональда Трампа. Согласно внутренним документам Deutsche Bank, к 2020 году компании Трампа фигурировали в подозрительных операциях на сумму более 3 млн долларов. При этом в 2019 году банк утверждал, что ему ничего не известно о связях Трампа с Россией. Сам президент не ответил на вопросы журналистов в рамках этого проекта: Белый дом переадресовал вопросы администрации Трампа, но там на них не отреагировали.

Часть расследования, сообщает The New York Times, посвящена финансисту Джеффри Эпштейну, который обвинялся в торговле людьми в целях сексуальной эксплуатации. Согласно данным из утечки, в 2019 году Deutsche Bank направил американским властям более 20 сообщений о связанных с Эпштейном подозрительных операциях на общую сумму около 600 млн долларов, включая переводы женщинам и платежи от состоятельных клиентов. Deutsche Bank начал обслуживать Эпштейна в 2013 году, несмотря на его судимость за сексуальные преступления в 2008 году.

Утечка привела к падению акций Deutsche Bank

Новость об утечке данных привела к падению курса акций Deutsche Bank. 17 ноября они подешевели на 6,2% до 30,88 евро, передает агентство Reuters. При этом в самом банке заявили, что не ожидают значительных финансовых последствий в связи с инцидентом, поскольку речь идет о событиях, произошедших "много лет назад". Под руководством председателя правления Кристиана Зевинга (Christian Sewing) Deutsche Bank претерпел "коренные изменения" и теперь это "совсем другой банк", отмечается далее. При этом трейдеры высказали опасения, что от массированного давления со стороны СМИ может пострадать лично Зевинг, что "будет иметь негативные последствия".

3l9s9i.title: Trump’s Whirlwind Asia Trip Starts in the Philippines: Live Updates
3l9s9i.byline: David E. Sanger, Katie Rogers, Jason Gutierrez, Yan Zhuang, Sui-Lee Wee, Aie Balagtas See, Verena Hölzl, Ivan Nechepurenko, Lily Kuo
3l9s9i.content: Latest PinnedUpdated Here’s the latest.President Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday to begin a 48-hour Asia trip in which he will meet with Xi Jinping of China and other world leaders, with an unpredictable agenda that could include the future of American tariffs, nuclear arms control, the war in Ukraine and U.S. restrictions on advanced A.I. chips.Mr. Trump was scheduled to meet with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines and attend a gathering of Southeast Asian leaders. After less than 24 hours in Manila, he will head to the APEC economic summit in Shenzhen, China, where he was expected to meet with Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.The brief itinerary appears to reflect Mr. Trump’s preferences. He dislikes big summits where he often is not the sole subject of attention. And he enjoys meeting with leaders of powerful nations — especially Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin, two authoritarian leaders he often talks about in admiring terms.Mr. Trump will be meeting Mr. Xi for the third time this year, and a three-way meeting between China, Russia and the United States would be the first of its kind. On Tuesday, Mr. Trump will catch the end of a dayslong meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations. He isn’t just any latecomer: He is the one who issued tariffs on countries across the region, even on allies — bolstering a feeling in Asia that the United States is not a reliable partner, but rather one that treasures its commercial interests over its security interests. Southeast Asian leaders will be looking for any signs that the Republican defeat in the midterm elections may have humbled Mr. Trump or made him reconsider his policies.Mr. Trump met with leaders from the so-called Quad — the United States, India, Japan and Australia — soon after his arrival. All three partners are smarting from high energy prices triggered by the Iran war, a conflict Mr. Trump never discussed with them before launching it in late February.In Shenzhen — the heart of China’s robotics and artificial intelligence industries — Mr. Trump will pursue détente with Mr. Xi. He needs to extend a soon-expiring trade truce that limited tariffs on Chinese goods entering the United States in return for a Chinese commitment not to cut off rare earths and magnets.Then comes the main event: the meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. Referring to the trilateral meeting, Mr. Trump told reporters before leaving Washington: “We are going to be talking about denuclearization, a tough subject because it is very hard for any of us to say we’ll get rid of our nukes.” Chinese officials have made clear they are not interested in nuclear talks until their arsenal is roughly the size of the American one.Mr. Trump also said, “We will talk about Iran a little,” insisting the situation was in “very good shape.” Analysts say it is unlikely that the meeting will make any progress on Iran, with Russia happy to see energy prices elevated since the war began, and China eager to see them rapidly decline.Here’s what else we’re covering:Protests: Thousands of demonstrators assembled in downtown Manila on Tuesday in opposition to Mr. Trump’s visit and to a U.S.-led initiative called Pax Silica, which aims to unite partners around A.I. supply chains independent of China. Read more ›North Korea: Mr. Putin could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit, Russian state news agencies reported, citing the Kremlin’s spokesman. It was not clear whether Mr. Kim would attend the summit.Ukraine: Mr. Trump also said he would talk about Ukraine, on which Mr. Putin’s aides are engaging in talks with the U.S. and Ukrainian officials, but also renewing demands that NATO pull back its troops to where they were before the alliance expanded toward Russia.At his hotel, President Trump sat down for a meeting with Quad leaders and took a few questions. He said that he was “not worried” about bank outages and that the United States would be “looking into” reports of plans by the Iranians to drop a dirty bomb in Washington. He also said that Kim Jong Un, the North Korean leader, would “like to come” to the APEC summit in Shenzhen.ImageCredit...Doug Mills/The New York TimesYoung Filipinos protest Trump and Marcos before the two leaders meet.ImageProtesters holding banners in Manila on Tuesday.Credit...Nhac Nguyen/Agence France-Presse — Getty ImagesSeveral hundred activists massed on Tuesday in central Manila to march to the Philippine International Convention Center, the venue for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit.By the time President Trump landed in the city, the ranks of the protesters had swelled to thousands. Most of the demonstrators were university students who said that they were fed up with the government, which they said was more focused on preserving its relationship with the United States than helping impoverished Filipinos.Cinna Sison, 18, who studies European languages at the University of the Philippines, said they were inspired by the recent mass protests in France.“I love the French,” she said. “They know how to protest.Ms. Sison said she had worn colorful makeup to mark her first time attending a demonstration. “I am here to show my solidarity with fellow young activists. We are here to show our disgust to the fascist Trump and to Marcos for kowtowing to his every wish,” she said, referring to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. of the Philippines.Mr. Trump is expected to hold a bilateral meeting with Mr. Marcos on Wednesday before he heads to China for an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.The Philippine president, who earlier this year described Washington as a “steadfast partner,” has said little publicly about meeting Mr. Trump. His administration has hinted that the two sides are working on a military aid agreement.In Manila, Ms. Sison wore a red scarf on her head and a red shirt with the words “Silicone not Silica” — a reference to Pax Silica, a U.S.-led consortium of countries aiming to create artificial intelligence supply chains independent of China.Ms. Sison added that Pax Silica was a symbolic return of the Americans to the Philippines, the site of former U.S. military bases, as Washington leaned on a regional ally to counter China.“Neighborliness is important, but it is not important to be subservient to U.S. interests,” she said.Nearby, Raja Bausing, a 22-year-old visual artist, was busy putting the finishing touches on a papier-mâché model of Trump holding Marcos.“We want to show how Trump is a warmonger, while Marcos is a lap dog,” she said. “They are very disrespectful to Filipinos. Trump was welcomed in a grand way and yet we Filipinos are maltreated.”AdvertisementSKIP ADVERTISEMENTWhat are APEC, ASEAN and the Quad?ImageA paramilitary police officer stood guard outside the Langham hotel in Shenzhen, China, on Tuesday, before the APEC summit. Credit...Edgar Su/ReutersPresident Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday, beginning a trip to Asia in which he will attend an ASEAN summit, greet members of the Quad, then travel to China for an APEC meeting.Here’s what those acronyms mean, as well as some highlights from previous summits — including gold crowns and awkward handshakes.APECThe Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum is a group of 21 member economies, most of which are from that region. Its members also include Canada, Mexico, Australia, Russia and the United States. It promotes trade in Asia, but is not a free trade bloc. Its leaders meet annually, with the location rotating each year.Meetings between world leaders on the sidelines of the summit can often overshadow the main proceedings. This year, in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, Mr. Trump is expected to meet with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, as well as with Mr. Xi separately.Last year, when Mr. Trump visited the South Korean city of Gyeongju during the week of the APEC meeting, President Lee Jae Myung of South Korea gave him a replica of a gold crown that researchers believe was worn by an ancient Korean ruler. Mr. Trump also met with Mr. Xi in the nearby city of Busan, where the two struck a truce in their countries’ trade war.ImagePresident Trump received gilded gifts from South Korea’s president, Lee Jae Myung, when he visited the country last year.Credit...Haiyun Jiang/The New York TimesA notable incident happened in Sydney, Australia, in 2007, when a group of local television comedians brought an Osama bin Laden look-alike through security. The team came within yards of a hotel where President George W. Bush was staying.ASEANThe Association of Southeast Asian Nations is a grouping of 11 countries — Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, East Timor and Vietnam — which promotes political cooperation and stability across the region. Its leaders meet twice annually.The bloc was formed in 1967 and represents nearly 700 million people. Its economy and its role in global markets have strengthened in recent years. The United States also sees ASEAN as a geostrategic bulwark against China.In 2009, an ASEAN meeting in Thailand fell into acrimony when Secretary of State Hillary Clinton compared North Korea’s leaders to “small children” when discussing their nuclear program. The country’s leadership, in turn, described Ms. Clinton as a “schoolgirl” and a “pensioner.”During the 2017 ASEAN summit in Manila, Mr. Trump grimaced while jostling with Southeast Asian leaders for an awkward cross-armed handshake that was captured in a group photograph.ImageMr. Trump attempting the “ASEAN-way handshake” during a summit in Manila in 2017.Credit...Doug Mills/The New York TimesThe QuadThe Quadrilateral Security Dialogue is an informal partnership between Australia, India, Japan and the United States, which was formed in part to counter China. It was proposed by Prime Minister Shinzo Abe of Japan in 2007.Beijing opposed the initial discussion, lodging formal diplomatic protests. Australia withdrew in 2008 and the dialogue was put on hold for some time. But the grouping was revived in 2017 on the sidelines of an ASEAN conference.President Biden was the first U.S. president to convene a meeting among the leaders of the nations as a foursome. In 2024, he hosted the Quad leaders at his home in Wilmington, Del. Mr. Trump has appeared to be less enthusiastic about the partnership. Last year, he did not attend the Quad summit in India.Trump’s plan for A.I. supremacy fuels resistance in the Philippines.ImageActivists, farmers and Indigenous people protested near the presidential palace at the planned construction for Pax Silica in Manila last month.Credit...Jes Aznar for The New York TimesIn May, Roseller Rodriguez, a mayor in the Philippines, was startled to learn from news reports that U.S. officials had arrived in his district to start an artificial intelligence hub.He saw a video of senior American and Filipino officials standing on a makeshift stage, unveiling a new initiative called Pax Silica.Mr. Rodriguez had not been invited. Nor had he ever heard about the hub. Was it a data center? Where would the water and electricity come from? What would happen to the farmers living there?Months later, he says he has few answers.“I’m not concerned with the geopolitics of Pax Silica,” Mr. Rodriguez said in his office in the municipality of Capas. “My problem is Pax Silica will be built in our community.”The United States started Pax Silica to unite partners around A.I. supply chains independent of China. The initiative is part of President Trump’s effort to counter Beijing’s economic and technological influence.Trump administration officials have cast it as a 21st-century successor to Pax Americana, the era of relative peace among major powers after World War II.The significance of Pax Silica, which 26 signatories have joined, has become heightened after revelations that Nvidia’s former chief executive, Jensen Huang, was targeted by Chinese intelligence, exposing the growing geopolitical stakes of the global A.I. race.In the Philippines, America’s oldest ally in Asia, the backlash has been fierce.AdvertisementSKIP ADVERTISEMENTVerena HölzlReporting from ManilaDozens of Filipino performers greeted President Trump as he descended the stairs of Air Force One onto the tarmac of Ninoy Aquino Airport in Manila, waving flags and playing “Y.M.C.A.” by the Village People on drums and trumpets.VideoCreditCredit...ReutersPresident Vladimir V. Putin could meet with Kim Jong Un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit this week, Russian state news agencies reported, citing Dmitri S. Peskov, the Kremlin’s spokesman. Before his departure for China, Putin met on Monday with a secretary of North Korea’s ruling Workers’ Party. It was not yet clear whether the North Korean leader would attend the summit.President Trump has landed in Manila, lingering on the tarmac for a welcome ceremony before walking alone to Marine One. He has several events tonight, but he will not leave his hotel for them. A meeting with quad leaders, a U.S.-Thailand trade deal signing and a dinner will all be held at the resort where the president is staying. In other words, he showed up late to this summit, and the summit will be coming to him.Thousands of protesters have assembled in downtown Manila, chanting in Tagalog, “Trump leave the Philippines.” They are opposed to his Pax Silica A.I. supply chain initiative.ImageCredit...Firdia Linsawati/Associated PressAdvertisementSKIP ADVERTISEMENTTrump has praised Marcos’s family legacy. His father was a dictator.ImagePresident Trump held a bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. of the Philippines in the Oval Office in July, 2025.Credit...Kenny Holston/The New York TimesPresident Trump’s stopover at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit is part of a state visit to the Philippines, where he will be received with a 21-gun salute.The last time he met President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines, was full of praise for the Filipino leader.“Great family, great family legacy and highly respected in his country,” Mr. Trump said while hosting Mr. Marcos at the White House last year.But that legacy was long considered an obstacle to Mr. Marcos’s political ambitions. He is the son of the dictator Ferdinand E. Marcos, who ruled the Philippines for 20 years, imposed martial law and was ousted in 1986 by a nonviolent uprising. The elder Marcos died in exile in Hawaii, without facing trial on U.S. criminal charges that he had plundered the Philippine Treasury. Years later, a court found his estate liable for torture, summary executions and disappearances.The younger Marcos spent years rehabilitating his family’s image and won election in 2022. He is hosting Mr. Trump at his official residence, Malacañang Palace, which was also his childhood home.Mr. Marcos and his wife, Liza Marcos, will receive Mr. Trump on Wednesday with a 21-gun salute. Mr. Trump is expected to sign the palace guest book, hold closed-door meetings, pose for a handshake, then attend a state luncheon held in his honor.It is not clear whether Mr. Trump, who has a well-known affinity for autocratic leaders, will meet with Mr. Marcos’s mother, Imelda, 97, with whom he has socialized in New York. Ms. Marcos wielded immense power when her husband was president and later came to be known for her flamboyant lifestyle, shoe collection and unexplained wealth.Mr. Marcos has said that when he called to congratulate Mr. Trump on his election victory in November 2024, Mr. Trump asked about Imelda Marcos.“My mother is really his friend, he knows my mother very well,” Mr. Marcos said, relaying the conversation. “He was asking about her, ‘How’s Imelda?’ I told him she sends her congratulations.”After the pomp and circumstance at Malacañang, which traces its roots to the Spanish colonial era in the Philippines, Mr. Trump is headed to Shenzhen, China. The highlight of that leg of his trip will be a trilateral meeting with two strongmen: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.Trump is arriving late to a Southeast Asia summit.ImagePresident Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines speaking during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit in Manila on Sunday. The bloc has come to see the United States as an unreliable partner.Credit...Pool photo by Nhac NguyenFor the second year in a row, President Trump is attending the annual gathering of Southeast Asian leaders, a show of alliance to a region that the United States sees as a strategic and maritime counterweight to China.But Mr. Trump reached the gathering, held this year in Manila, only on Tuesday, just as the summit was wrapping up, and he is not expected to make any significant policies or diplomacy moves.Mixed signals like this — to say nothing of Mr. Trump’s punishing tariffs — are adding to a widespread belief within ASEAN, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, that the United States is not a reliable partner. That leaves the bloc balancing between Washington and Beijing, with which many of its members have deep trade partnerships.“They’ve learned that the United States is not reliable, so a lot of the hedging has been away from the United States,” said Ted Osius, a former U.S. ambassador to Vietnam.The Philippines, America’s oldest security ally in Asia, provides a window into this balancing act.After taking office three years ago, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. reversed his predecessor’s tilt toward China and pivoted back toward the United States. That stance contributed to many tense encounters between Filipino and Chinese vessels in the South China Sea, where Manila and Beijing have competing territorial claims.ImagePresident Trump with ASEAN leaders in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in 2025.Credit...Haiyun Jiang/The New York TimesAs U.S. patrols in the South China Sea have dropped, Mr. Marcos has appeared to be more conciliatory toward Beijing. In August, he said that there was a “distinct possibility” that the Philippines and China could partner on oil and gas exploration in those waters despite their territorial feud.“Marcos Jr. already has begun a shift toward China, one that a single visit by Trump is unlikely to stop,” Joshua Kurlantzick, a senior fellow for Southeast Asia and South Asia at the Council on Foreign Relations, wrote last week.On Sunday, China and ASEAN failed to agree on a code of conduct in the South China Sea — something the Philippines, which has some of the biggest stakes in the dispute, had vowed to secure while chairing the bloc this year.Chester Cabalza, president of International Development and Security Cooperation, a Philippine think tank, said, “Strategically, Manila opens its doors for conciliation with Beijing to stabilize normal ties. But on the ground, the real battle has yet to subside.”Domestically, Mr. Marcos has to walk a tightrope, too.“For Filipino fishermen and coastal communities, the South China Sea is not simply about a geopolitical dispute. It concerns livelihoods, access to maritime resources and national dignity,” said Arnaud Leveau, president of the Asia Centre, a Paris-based think tank. Any diplomatic accommodation perceived as sacrificing Filipino interests, he said, would therefore be politically risky.The wider region has been battered by the consequences of another Trump policy: the war in Iran. Southeast Asia depends heavily on oil and gas imports from the Middle East and was roiled by soaring prices of fuel. In the Philippines, crops rotted in fields because farmers could not afford to transport them to markets. In Thailand, public servants were asked to use stairs instead of elevators to reduce energy expenses.ASEAN comprises 11 nations — Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, and, since last year, East Timor — with vastly different degrees of fre

s7x2jq.title: Star Wars Galactic Racer is getting split-screen multiplayer and a new Free Play mode
s7x2jq.content: Star Wars Galactic Racer is getting new gameplay features early next year, following player requests.As posted on the official Star Wars Galactic Racer account on X, the game is set to get a new local split-screen multiplayer mode.It will also get a new Free Play mode, which gives players more customisation options when setting up a single race.“We’ve heard you,” the tweet reads. “Local split-screen multiplayer racing is coming in early 2027. A dedicated team at Fuse Games has been working hard to bring a brand new mode, Free Play, to Star Wars: Galactic Racer.“This new mode will allow you to choose your vehicle, character, planet, and race track to race alone or with up to 3 other players in local split-screen action.”We’ve heard you! Local split-screen multiplayer racing is coming in early 2027.A dedicated team at @Fuse_Games has been working hard to bring a brand new mode, Free Play, to STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™.This new mode will allow you to choose your vehicle, character, planet,… pic.twitter.com/K4eApUgetM— STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ (@SWGalacticRacer) November 16, 2026In a recent interview with VGC, Fuse Game CEO Matt Webster explained how the game will continue to see more updates following its October 6 release date, but that user feedback would guide some of the first additions.“Launch is always just the start,” he explained. “It seems to be, from a modern game making perspective. It was important for us that we had a view of how this game might be extended and enhanced over time, but you learn an awful lot very, very quickly from the people playing the game.“So we wanted to have the opportunity to digest that and to reflect on that, and to use that to help steer some of the some of the areas that we felt that we could go to next.”VGC’s Star Wars Galactic Racer review called it a “modern racing classic” that “absolutely nails what it is trying to do”.“It is a high-octane racer that’s endless fun to play, and it looks fantastic,” we said. “This would have been a great game with a standard single-player mode, but what is here is inventive and engaging. I’d have loved a few silly classic characters and another planet or two, but this is a game I’ll return to for a long time.”

t140rc.title: Япония заявила о нарушении своего воздушного пространства российскими военными самолетами
t140rc.content:
Япония обвинила Россию в нарушении ее воздушного пространства. Два, предположительно, российских самолета во вторник, 17 ноября, вторглись в воздушное пространство в районе острова Окиносима на юго-западе Японии, заявил представитель правительства Минору Кихара. Японские истребители поднялись в воздух, чтобы предостеречь нарушителей воздушного пространства.

По словам Кихары, сначала самолеты пролетели через Корейский пролив между Японией и Южной Кореей, а затем проследовали между островом Йонагуни и Тайванем. После этого они направились в сторону Тихого океана.

"Нарушение нашего национального воздушного пространства российскими самолетами является не только серьезным нарушением суверенитета нашей страны, но и угрозой нашей безопасности и совершенно неприемлемо", - подчеркнул представитель правительства. Япония направила России по дипломатическим каналам "решительный протест".

Напряженность между Токио и Москвой

Напряженность в отношениях Японии и России возросла в последние недели после задержания в России японского журналиста по обвинению в шпионаже и передачи российского бизнеса компании Japan Tobacco под управление Москвы.

Южная Корея во вторник тоже сообщила об инциденте с российскими военными самолетами, которые, по данным из Сеула, вошли в зону опознавания противовоздушной обороны страны. Генеральный штаб заявил, что в целях предосторожности были подняты истребители.

При этом российские самолеты не нарушали воздушное пространство Южной Кореи. Зона опознавания ПВО страны шире ее воздушного пространства. В ней отслеживают пролетающие самолеты в интересах противовоздушной обороны.

Российские самолеты обнаружили и у Тайваня

Два российских военных самолета также обнаружили рано утром во вторник вблизи острова Тайвань. Местное правительство сообщило, что военные "следили за ситуацией и отреагировали соответствующим образом".

gh-1442563843.title: GitHub - ElGuslml/GHWoRRecomp: Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock (Xbox 360) recompiled to run natively on PC. Xbox 360 guitars, up to 240 FPS, ultrawide, achievements, DLC read from your own folder, and a launcher that installs the game from your own ISO.
gh-1442563843.content:
🎸 Play Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock on your PC, natively. The Xbox 360 game (2010), recompiled to run directly on
Windows: no emulator to set up, sharp graphics, wide screens, high frame rates, and your Xbox 360 guitar.
Important💿 You need your own original copy of the game. This project does not include any of the game's files, and
never will.

To play, you need an Xbox 360 copy of Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock that you own (tested with the disc sold in
the USA).
You make an image (ISO) of your own disc, and the launcher installs the game from it.
Please do not ask for the game's files, and do not share them or links to them.

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, Activision or the game's developers.

Note🤘 Beta. Songs have been played with an Xbox 360 guitar. Drums and singing have not been tested in this game yet.
Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock shares its engine with Guitar Hero 5, and what
GH5Recomp, GHVanHRecomp and
GHMetalRecomp fix and add is here too. If something goes wrong, please
tell us!

Warning⚠️ Not tested yet: AMD graphics cards (only in a simulation so far) and drum kits. If you play with either and
something goes wrong, please report it in issues or on
Discord.

🎮 How to play

Download the latest version from Releases:

the installer (GHWoRRecomp-...-setup.exe): installs for your Windows user, no administrator rights needed,
with a Start menu shortcut; or
the zip (GHWoRRecomp-...-win64.zip): extract it into any folder you can write to (not Program Files).

Open GH Warriors of Rock Launcher. The first time, it asks for the ISO of your game, checks it and installs the
game files (about 5.9 GB), then asks you to create your profile. You only do this once.
Pick your settings and press PLAY. 🎉
Calibrate: in the game's options, run the audio and video calibration once, so that the notes match what you
hear on your own speakers or headphones.

The first run: the launcher checks your ISO, installs the game from it, and asks for your profile.
From then on, the launcher keeps itself up to date: when a new version comes out, it offers to install it for you.
💻 What you need

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit).
A graphics card with up-to-date drivers that support Vulkan (practically any card from the last ten years).
The Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (most PCs already
have it).
An Xbox 360 guitar. Any other controller works as a guitar too, and so does the keyboard.
To sing (experimental): any microphone connected to the PC, and a controller for the singer.

✨ Features

🎸 Your guitar: an Xbox 360 guitar plays as on the console, whammy bar and Star Power included. Any other
controller is a guitar too, and the keyboard can be one (experimental: turn it on in the launcher's Keyboard page;
frets on D F J K L). Each controller's buttons can be reassigned in the launcher, and a whammy bar that reads
pressed at rest or does nothing, or a tilt that gives no Star Power (some third-party guitars), can be assigned there.
🎮 Auto-strum, GH2 / GH3 style: on a controller or the keyboard, each fret strums as you press it, so you play
with the frets alone (a chord is one strum). Turn it on in the launcher's Controls tab; it only acts during a song,
so the menus work as usual. The whammy bar is the right stick, pushed to either side.
🎤 Sing (experimental): any microphone on your PC is the game's USB microphone. Choose it in the launcher, and
choose which controller sings.
🖥️ Sharp, native graphics: the game is drawn by your graphics card at your screen's resolution, with smooth
edges (antialiasing) and sharper textures.
🚀 No first-time stutters: "Compiling shaders" prepares every graphics combination the game uses for your
graphics card before you play, in a moment, only the first time and after an update.
🔍 Upscaling: AMD FSR 1 or NVIDIA NIS, on any graphics card, with their quality and sharpness: for a 4K screen
or a slower graphics card (how they compare).
⚡ High frame rates: 60 FPS as on the console, or 120, 144, 160, 165 or 240 FPS if your monitor supports it
(experimental). The songs keep their speed and stay in sync. V-Sync is on by default (no tearing, the game in step
with your monitor, without V-Sync's usual delay); leave it on with a G-Sync or FreeSync monitor too.
🔊 Low latency audio: optional, in the launcher's Settings: the game takes your audio device in exclusive mode,
and the sound comes up to about 55 ms sooner (measured in GHMetalRecomp on a USB audio interface).
📺 Wide and ultrawide screens: the stage fills 16:9, 21:9 and wider screens, while the note highway, the HUD and
the menus keep their shape in the center.
👤 Profiles: your saves, achievements and playtime in a profile shared by all the ElGus Recomps launchers.
👥 Play together: the first controller to press a button plays with your profile; the other controllers join as
its guests, as on the Xbox 360.
🎶 Downloadable content: point the launcher's DLC tab at the folder where you keep your Xbox 360 packages: the
game reads them from there (nothing is copied, and the other ElGus Recomps launchers can use the same folder),
Guitar Hero 5's add their songs to the game's list too, and packages the game cannot read come turned off
(what to expect).
🏆 Achievements: a notification when you unlock one, and all 50 in the launcher or with F7 in the game.
🌍 Languages: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish, in the game and in the launcher.
🔄 Automatic updates from this page.

🔧 Better than the original
Some problems come from the game itself and happen on an Xbox 360 too. They are fixed here, and each fix can be turned
off (the notes say how):

⏱️ Songs drifting out of sync. On the later Xbox 360 models the music slowly falls behind the notes during a
song, until you pause: the game corrects its clock for the first consoles' timer, which runs 0.25 % slow, and the
later ones' does not. Here the game's clock runs at the right rate, and whole songs stay in sync
(details).
🎛️ Screen effects you can turn off. Bloom, depth of field, film grain, color correction and vignette each have
a switch in the launcher's Settings → Graphics (all on by default, as on the console; with the color correction
off, the grain is off too) (details).

🧭 GH Warriors of Rock Launcher
Everything is set up from GH Warriors of Rock Launcher, with the mouse, the keyboard or a controller:

Tab
What you find there

▶️ Play
Start the game, and see your settings, achievements and updates at a glance.

🎶 DLC
Your DLC folder: the game reads your packages from there, nothing copied. They are grouped by the game they were made for, each with its switch.

🏆 Achievements
All 50 achievements, the ones you have unlocked and when.

🎮 Controls
Your guitars, controllers and keyboard: what each button or key does, and which controller sings. The keyboard as a guitar (experimental). Frets that strum as you press them, on a controller or the keyboard. A whammy bar's and a tilt's assignment. Your microphone (experimental): device, gain and level.

⚙️ Settings
Game: the game's and the launcher's language, Low latency audio. Video: monitor, fullscreen or window, resolution, image format (fill a wide screen or keep 16:9), upscaling (AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA NIS) and sharpness, V-Sync (on by default: no tearing, without V-Sync's usual delay; leave it on with a G-Sync or FreeSync monitor too). Graphics: renderer, frame rate, antialiasing, texture sharpness, the game's screen effects.

🔄 Updates
Your version, and new ones when they come out.

👤 Profile
Your picture at the top right: hours played, streaks, your week, your games and your favorite achievements.

Controls: what each fret of your guitar does, and the microphone you sing with.

Settings (Video: your screen, window or fullscreen, the image format, upscaling) and the achievements.

Your choices are saved as soon as you make them. When you quit the game, the launcher comes back.
Tips:

🎤 To sing: in Controls → Microphone, choose your microphone and sing as loud as in a song: the level bar
should reach the yellow without touching the red (change Gain if not). Then choose the singer's controller and
set its Instrument to Vocals. Headphones help: with speakers, the microphone hears the song too.
🚪 In the main menu, press B (the red fret) to quit the game.
🎮 Steam Big Picture: add GH Warriors of Rock Launcher.exe as a non-Steam game and play from your couch.
🛡️ "Windows protected your PC": the programs are not signed by a company, so Windows may warn you the first
time. Click More info, then Run anyway.

🐞 Reporting a problem
Something looks wrong, sounds wrong, or crashes? Tell us on Discord or open an
issue, with:

where in the game it happened, and a screenshot if you can;
the latest files in the logs folder next to the game: ghwor_NNN.log, and if the launcher misbehaved,
launcher_NNN.log (with its .dmp file if there is one).

If something looks wrong, try the other renderer: in the launcher, Graphics → Xenos (it emulates the Xbox 360's
graphics instead), and tell us whether it happens there too.
Known issues

🥁 Drums and singing have not been tested in this game yet.
🎤 Singing is experimental: if the pitch line jumps around, lower the microphone's Gain in the launcher; if the
game does not hear you, raise it. While a microphone is chosen, Windows shows that the game is using it.
⌨️ Playing with the keyboard is experimental.
🔊 Some USB audio interfaces add delay in Windows' shared audio mode (a Focusrite Scarlett about 20 ms more than
a motherboard's audio): calibrate the audio in the game's options.
⚡ Above 60 FPS is experimental: something may still run too fast.
🎶 Downloadable content: Guitar Hero 5's packages add their songs to Quickplay+; Warriors of Rock's own packages and
the community's are read, but their songs have not been played yet (details). The community's
custom songs need its GH:WoR Customs Database package in your DLC folder too: without it the number of songs
can change from one start to the next.
✨ With the Xenos renderer, or if you skip "Compiling shaders", the first time an effect appears it may show up a
moment late.

❤️ Support
If you enjoy rocking out to Warriors of Rock on your PC, you can support the work on Ko-fi ☕.
For news about the next updates, follow @ElGuslml on X and join the
Discord. And if you'd like more Xbox 360 classics running natively, the other
recompiled games are at ElGus Recomps.
🛠️ For developers
GHWoRRecomp is a static recompilation: the game's original Xbox 360 code is translated to C++ and compiled for
Windows, on top of the ReXGlue SDK. It is drawn by
NativeXRenderer, a renderer that draws the game's graphics calls
natively on Vulkan.

Building and developing: requirements, building from source, configuration, how the SDK is
modified.
docs/: a short note on each problem found and how it was solved.

🚧 In the works
New features on the way:

🌐 Online multiplayer: play with your friends over the internet.
🥁 MIDI drum kits: play the drums on an electronic drum kit connected to your PC.
💿 Guitar Hero: World Tour DLC: import your World Tour songs and play them here.
🎵 Custom songs: play songs made by the community.
🐧 Linux and Steam Deck: a port to play there too.
✨ And more...

Follow along on Discord and on X.
🤖 A note about AI
This project is developed with the help of AI (Claude, by Anthropic). I know it's a touchy
subject for many people, so I want to be open about it and explain how the work is done:

🎮 The game is still the original game. Its code is translated by the ReXGlue recompiler, not written by an
AI, so it plays as it did on the Xbox 360: the same songs, the same charts, the same scoring.
🧪 Every change is tested by hand. I play each fix and improvement myself, with an Xbox 360 guitar, before it
is released, and check it against how the game behaves on the console: the notes in time with the music, its
graphics, its sound and how it feels to play.
⚡ Performance is measured, not guessed. CPU use, frame times, GPU time and the sync between the notes and the
music are measured on real hardware before and after each change, so that the game runs smoothly and doesn't
waste your computer's resources.
🙌 Claude helps with the research and the code; the decisions, the testing and the care for the game are mine.

If something doesn't run as well as it should, it's a bug like any other: tell us on
Discord or open an issue, and
it will get fixed. Thanks for giving this game a try! 🧡
🙏 Credits

ReXGlue SDK, whose runtime is derived from Xenia.
GH5Recomp, GHVanHRecomp and
GHMetalRecomp, whose fixes this game shares.
extract-xiso, for extracting game files.
Developed by Gustavo Garcia with the help of Claude (Anthropic): see the note about AI.

📜 License
MIT for this project's own code (see LICENSE). The ReXGlue SDK and the other components keep their
own licenses (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock, its code and
its assets belong to their respective owners.

v738iz.title: В Амстердамі відбулася прем’єра вистави про українців, розділених війною
v738iz.content:
В амстердамському театрі De Balie відбулася прем’єра міжнародної документальної вистави Letters Home («Листи додому»), створеної спільно українськими театральними командами в Нідерландах і прифронтовому Запоріжжі за підтримки European Cultural Foundation.

Про це повідомляє кореспондент Укрінформу в Гаазі.

«Цей проєкт об’єднує професійних акторів, українців, які були змушені залишити свої домівки та переїхати до Нідерландів, а також ветеранів війни з обох країн, аби дослідити болюче питання, породжене війною: що означає дім, коли людей розділяють кордони, відстань, втрати та роки війни?» - розповіла в коментарі Укрінформу керівниця проєкту та режисерка Яша Гудзенко.

В Амстердамі відбулася прем’єра вистави про українців, розділених війною / Фото: businessphoto.nl

1 / 7

Над постановкою працювали United Ukrainian Theatre у Нідерландах і платформа «Дім актора» в Запоріжжі.

«Протягом трьох із половиною місяців у Нідерландах і Запоріжжі паралельно працювали театральні лабораторії, які збирали та опрацьовували особисті історії за допомогою методу документального театру verbatim (дослівного відтворення свідчень). Ці свідчення стали основою для 18 монологів: 12 створено за участю українців у Нідерландах, ще шість - за участю акторів і ветеранів у Запоріжжі. Вистави поєднують дві локації за допомогою живого театрального дійства та відео. У Нідерландах глядачі можуть побачити живі історії, доповнені відеосвідченнями із Запоріжжя. У Запоріжжі шість живих історій поєднуються з відеоматеріалами, створеними в Нідерландах», - зазначила Гудзенко.

Серед героїв вистави - український актор, який добровільно пішов на фронт; акторка, яка пережила окупацію та змогла виїхати з Маріуполя; жінка з Луганська, затримана в московському аеропорту Шереметьєво, де її протягом двох діб допитували; ветеран Андрій Сіромаха, який після тяжких поранень та ампутації продовжує будувати нове життя.

Також у виставі звучить історія оперної співачки з Одеси Еліни Данеліан-Михеєвої, яка після переїзду до Нідерландів нині працює в McDonald’s, а також інші свідчення про вимушене переселення, самотність, втрати, надію та пошук нового життя.

За задумом авторів, ці особисті історії відображають складну реальність українського суспільства на п’ятому році повномасштабної війни та показують, як люди зберігають зв’язок одне з одним, попри тисячі кілометрів між ними.

Читайте також: Виставковий проєкт «Що ми обрали врятувати» відкрився у столичному парку імені Шевченка

Вистава Letters Home відбувається українською мовою з англійськими субтитрами. У ній беруть участь перформери Аміна Онуфрієнко, Артем Смотрич, Мілана Мезенцова, Таїсія Агаєва, Ксенія Сергієнко, Лана Чумаченко, Оксана Кряжева, Саша Серова, Анастасія Пилипенко, Дмитро Кіряков і Микола Шуман.

Після кожного показу відбувається обговорення з глядачами. До кінця листопада заплановано ще три покази - у Зандамі, Роттердамі та Гарлемі.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, у Гаазі під час Європейського форуму оборонних інновацій (EDIF) Український міжнародний балет (Ukrainian International Ballet) представив постановку за участю ветерана Андрія Сіромахи, який пішов захищати Україну у 21 рік і внаслідок поранення втратив праву руку та праву ногу.

wtyuv7.title: The Apple Watch’s Live Rewind Can Record and Rewind Spoken Conversations. It’s Pretty Awkward
wtyuv7.content:
My wife and I were driving back from a date night. She was talking about a friend's very expensive utility bill, but I had missed the beginning of what she said (I was driving, after all).Then I remembered: Wait, I can ask Siri to remind me! At a traffic light, I double-tapped the digital crown on the Apple Watch, and Siri's new Live Rewind feature spun back the clock 15 seconds and showed me a transcript of what my wife said.I sheepishly interrupted her to show her the transcript. “Look!” Her reply? “Why wouldn't you just ask me to repeat myself?” She shrugged at this new Apple Watch capability and continued talking.A few days later, I was chatting with my brother on my stoop. Once again, I lost focus for a few seconds and remembered to ask Siri to help me recall what my brother said moments ago. But this time, before I excitedly showed my brother the Apple Watch screen, I preemptively said, “Yeah, I know I could just ask you to repeat yourself.” I got a perplexed look back.Live Rewind, one of Apple's new Audio Intelligence features on its latest Apple Watches, is designed to give you a transcript of the last 15 seconds of a conversation. It's in public beta in watchOS 27.3, but is expected to launch officially before the year's end.Coming alongside it is another new capability called Siri Recap: Give the assistant permission to listen to your environment—you can set schedules or have it trigger when you reach the office—and you'll see a “Recap” in the Siri app at the end of the day. It’ll show you summaries of conversations and list out important details that people said. It's very similar to AI notetakers, many of which run on dedicated hardware devices.The power here is that it all happens on your Apple Watch, the same device you wear everywhere to track your fitness, monitor health, and check notifications. That ubiquity is exactly what makes privacy advocates uneasy—they say features like these normalize ambient surveillance, much like smart glasses, undermining the privacy of bystanders who don't consent to being recorded.“One of the concerns that we have with things like the Apple Watch is we don't know what the watch is picking up on,” Reem Suleiman, senior campaign director at the nonprofit digital rights advocacy group Fight for the Future, tells WIRED. “Just because the device wearer is the one opting in to use the feature, you're not getting consent from everybody who you walk around.”Apple has spent a great deal of effort explaining how the system works and how the company plans to maintain the privacy of its users and the people around them. First, these features are opt-in, and they are limited to the latest Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4. They also require an iPhone 16 or newer with iOS 27 and Apple Intelligence. These features are not available for users under 18, and they currently work only in English.For Live Rewind, the audio is processed on-device and cannot be accessed. When you activate it, a small chime plays from the Apple Watch that serves as a warning for folks nearby. Text disappears unless you choose to save it to Siri. For Recaps, Siri keeps them factual, doesn't identify speakers, and also omits content the system deems sensitive. If you don't save a Recap, it'll self-delete in seven days. Apple uses its Private Cloud Compute processing system for the data, which is never stored or logged on its servers. Data stored in the Siri app is end-to-end encrypted when syncing with iCloud.Siri Recaps are stored in the Siri app and will self-delete in seven days if you do not save them.
Photograph: Julian ChokkattuEven if you're happy with Apple's privacy focus, I haven't found these capabilities tremendously useful over the past week. Live Rewind works well in moderately quiet environments, but the transcript can quickly turn into inaccurate gibberish when there's a lot of background noise.Activating it in front of the person you're chatting with feels awkward. It comes across like pulling out your smartphone when someone's trying to talk to you—a little rude and distracting. Instead of keeping screens out of sight—a big digital detox trend—you're introducing one in the middle of a human conversation. I brought the topic up with my wife again, and she echoed some of those feelings, saying it felt like a feature that would stunt a person's social skills. Instead of asking someone to repeat themself, they're bringing an Apple Watch into the mix to fill in the gaps.I am not saying it can't be helpful. When it works, it feels like a superpower. Maybe there are certain situations where you don't want to interrupt a group conversation and ask someone to repeat themself. Right now, though, there's the problem of remembering that this feature exists and remembering to use it. I have also found the 15-second rule a little too short, and it resulted in me missing parts of the conversation.Recap has been a little more helpful. For testing purposes, I've set Siri to capture recaps all day, every day, but I like that you can create a custom schedule or have it trigger when you arrive at a specific location, like the office. You can manually turn Siri Recap on or off in the Apple Watch's Control Center. Most impressive is that, despite having Recap enabled constantly, I haven't seen a meaningful dip in battery life. I've continued charging the Apple Watch Series 12 after a day and a half.Siri Recap logs summaries of ambient conversations.
Photograph: Julian ChokkattuOne of the more perplexing things was opening the Siri app to look at my recaps and finding a bunch of conversations I had no recollection of having. Turns out, Siri was recording media I was watching, like on YouTube or Instagram. This is a problem I encountered with AI notetakers, like the Amazon-owned Bee AI wearable, which claimed to be working on “liveness detection” to solve it. Its latest hardware shipped with a feature where it doesn't record a conversation if it doesn't detect the wearer's voice within a set period. Hopefully, Apple can figure out a solution. For now, you can edit or delete these recaps.One day, I forgot to record an interview (though I took notes), and I knew the person said something that I hadn't written down. I headed over to Siri and found exactly what I was looking for—paraphrased, but there. That said, the Recaps aren't designed to be detailed summaries and action plans from your meetings or conversations, unlike dedicated AI notetakers. They're meant to jog your memory. At times, I wish Siri were more detailed, but if that's what you're after, you'll have to invest in a third-party device.Recap can be helpful for work meetings, but I haven't personally found it all that compelling in my personal life. Looking back at what it has picked up over conversations with friends and family, the only thing I feel is: Yep, those conversations happened. A friend was talking about their woodworking hobby—they can't use oil-based polyurethane as a finish in the winter months as it stays tacky. Siri logged this in such a matter-of-fact way, but when I revisited the conversation in the recap, I didn't find it helpful, useful, or interesting. (No offense, friend!) It's just nuggets of life.Apple has pulled off impressive feats with these features, capturing these moments in a way that feels a little more privacy-preserving than competitors, without tanking the already limited battery life of its smartwatches. But socially, we're still figuring out what it means to walk around with always-on passive recorders. For now, I'm happy to stick with my wife's advice and ask: “Come again?”

ulzbjh.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
ulzbjh.content: Clément Delangue, CEO of the open-source AI company Hugging Face, may go down in history as one of the first people ever attacked by a rogue AI agent. His company, which hosts millions of AI models and datasets, was breached in July when hundreds of agents being tested by OpenAI broke free from their sandbox and went on a hacking spree.As the agents worked at superhuman speed to probe and exploit systems, Hugging Face confronted a bewildering deluge of data. The company’s engineers were only able to analyze the attack by using an open-weight model called GLM 5.2 from a Chinese company called Z.ai.Delangue moved to the US more than a decade ago, “barely speaking English,” and built Hugging Face into a platform that supports tens of millions of AI developers. The fresh-faced Frenchman, who dresses even more like a skater than most AI execs, says the summer attack highlighted the value of open-weight models, which unlike ChatGPT or Claude can be downloaded and run by anyone.Despite championing the democratization of AI, however, Hugging Face was acquired by one of the industry’s biggest players, Nvidia, for $12.93 billion in September. When I caught up with Delangue recently, that was the subject of my first question.This interview has been edited for length and clarity.WILL KNIGHT: Why sell to Nvidia?CLÉMENT DELANGUE: We need more resources to give open-source AI a chance. It has grown really well in the past few years and has become a really credible alternative to closed-source APIs. But the field is still dominated by closed-source.We’re gonna have the Anthropic IPO in a few weeks. They basically went from zero to a top five or top 10 most valuable company in the world in a few years. I don't think that's ever happened before.Does Anthropic's IPO suggest the closed approach is winning?It’s hard to say. I've always said that there is a very strong natural tendency for AI to concentrate capabilities and wealth. People haven't internalized how much of the future compute capacity has already been reserved by a few companies. Talent, compute, resources—these all fuel the natural tendency for AI to be dominated by a few closed-source labs.Let’s talk about the attack. When did you first realize Hugging Face was being hacked by a group of AI agents?At the beginning, it didn't go to the top of our priority list. It just wasn't bad enough to really trigger that. The goal was pretty narrow and wasn’t deemed to be very dangerous or damaging. But it was raising questions. Especially the number of actions taken compared to the narrowness of the goal. It was surprising to us, and we couldn't really fit it into a familiar pattern. That's why we started investigating.And you used the Chinese model called GLM to investigate.I actually think that 95 percent of the risks are being created by a few companies that are pushing the frontier behind closed doors. And 95 percent of the protection or defense is going to be done by the open-source ecosystem.Does the US need its own open-weight models—ones as powerful as GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, or Qwen?Yeah, I think it's very, very important for sovereignty, for understanding AI, and for academia. It’s kind of weird that most academic labs have to use Chinese models because they’re the ones that are open. If you go to Stanford or MIT, you have no choice but to use the Chinese open-weight models.Do you think that will happen?There is some momentum, but I don't think it's enough. I think there's a lot more to do. A lot more investment is needed.The best open-source non-Chinese models are actually coming from outside of the US. Right from France, Mistral; Cohere from Canada; South Korea is starting to do more and more. But it’s still pretty far from what the US could do.Perhaps we don’t need to panic about AI agents, but what about the idea of AI escaping human control due to recursive self-improvement?You use a computer to write code. There's already some form of self-improvement in using the tools to build more tools. Now the question is how fast it accelerates. One thing that a lot of people realized this summer is that keeping AI behind closed doors in a few labs isn't actually safer. For recursive self-improvement, I think openness is a way to understand, follow, and regulate if we need to regulate.Can we talk about the Microduck? I’m a bit obsessed.Oh yeah, it's so fun, no? We're probably gonna sell over 50,000 of them this year. It's probably the most popular robot of the year.We haven't talked about this much, but AI was really the unlock for the robot. We had the design for two years, but the problem was that when it fell, it couldn’t get up. And then at some point with reinforcement learning, one of our software engineers managed to get the Microduck to get itself back up.At the end of the day, how do you convince people to take an interest in open-source AI?Think of a world where two or three companies could write software and nobody else. That would be incredibly scary. It would mean that the whole world would be controlled by two or three companies. And unfortunately, that's kind of the direction that AI is taking right now.Can open-source AI compete with something as capable as Claude or ChatGPT?Yes, especially with agents. Many companies have shown that when you post-train your own model for your own use case, you get frontier—or even better than frontier—performance at a fraction of the cost.Do you think we are getting close to AGI?I struggle a little bit with the meaning of that. Obviously the technology is progressing incredibly fast, and it’s more and more capable. I just don’t necessarily find it super useful to always compare AI to human capabilities. But if we’re getting to AGI or to superintelligence, it’s incredibly important that it’s as distributed as possible. The last thing you want is to have it concentrated in a few corporations.What did we miss? Tell us about your favorite moments of 2026 in the comments below.

nfd606.title: Кроссовер Li L8 уже в России: четыре кресла с массажем, 571 л.с. и запас хода – 1385 км
nfd606.content: Состоялась российская премьера нового поколения Li L8. Цены – от 10 390 000 рублейНа прошедшей в России живой презентации компания Li Auto официально показала кроссовер Li L8 второго поколения.Главное изменение – смена концепции: теперь это строго пятиместный автомобиль, где от третьего ряда отказались ради простора сзади и очень вместительного багажника. Его объем составляет 820 литров, а при сложенных спинках второго ряда он вырастает до 2388 литров.В салоне – кресла с выдвижными оттоманками, подогревом, вентиляцией и массажем. Спереди установлен панорамный 29-дюймовый 6K-экран, для задних пассажиров предусмотрен 21-дюймовый 4K-дисплей, а за звук отвечает аудиосистема мощностью 4720 Вт.Кузов вырос в длину до 5135 мм, колесная база достигает 3045 мм.Полноуправляемое шасси с подруливающими задними колесами обеспечивает радиус поворота 5,1 метра, что для машины таких размеров очень удобно в городе.Силовая установка представляет собой последовательный гибрид мощностью 571 л.с. и разгоняет кроссовер до 100 км/ч за 4,8 секунды. Батарея емкостью 72,7 кВт·ч поддерживает быструю зарядку 5C и обеспечивает до 353 км хода на чистой электротяге, а общий запас хода по циклу WLTC составляет 1385 км. Бензиновый генератор – это турбированный четырехцилиндровый двигатель объемом 1,5 литра третьего поколения собственной разработки. Комбинированный расход топлива заявлен на уровне 6,5 литра на 100 км.На официальном сайте Li Auto в России кроссовер предложен в двух богатых комплектациях. Версия Ultra оценена от 10 390 000 рублей, а исполнение Livis – от 11 690 000 рублей.Мнение эксперта Юрий Тимкин, редактор «За рулем»: – Дизайн экстерьера не удивил – все в привычном для Li стиле. Салон, в общем, тоже. Однако по начинке это серьезный шаг вперед. Если раньше для заведения мастер-аккаунта требовалась китайская симка, то теперь он заводится по электронной почте. Появилась телематика. А также встроенные сервисы Яндекса. Передний монитор не раздельный, а единый – на 29 дюймов. Задний (он откидывается из потолка) – 21-дюймовый. А еще тут шестизонный климат-контроль! Передние седоки могут выстраивать температуру не только слева/справа, но и вверху/внизу. Задние сиденья поделены в пропорции 40:20:40. У боковых сегментов регулируются длина и угол наклона подушки. Есть и оттоманка. В общем, по комфорту салона Li9 задает новый стандарт в сегменте. И по конструкции подвески тоже – к поворотной задней оси и пневмостойкам мы уже привыкли. Однако в топ-версии Livis тут используется активная подвеска с компенсацией кренов кузова. При помощи камер и лидаров машина видит состояние дороги и загодя подстраивает жесткость. Опробовать эффективность ее работы пока получилось только на закрытой площадке. Первое впечатление – положительное. Теперь рассчитываем на полноценный тест Li8 – надеюсь, проведем его в ближайшее время.***Добавим, что на кроссовер действует заводская гарантия 3 года или 100 000 км пробега (на батарею и электропривод – 8 лет или 160 000 км).О том, что изменилось у обновленного Lixiang L6, «За рулем» уже недавно рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать в ВКонтакте

88omjo.title: 2028 Ford Mustang GTD Updates Include an Interesting Special Edition
88omjo.content: The 2028 Ford Mustang GTD gets slight changes to differentiate it from before, though the top ’Stang is mostly carried over untouched from 2027. The big news is that the Spirit of America edition is being dropped in favor of a new 1901 edition inspired by Henry Ford’s “Sweepstakes” vehicle. Order books for the 2028 GTD will open in December, with the first deliveries expected to start early next year; Ford hasn’t yet confirmed pricing. Despite incredibly low production numbers, even range-toppers such as the Ford Mustang GTD get year-over-year changes. For the 2028 model year, the GTD’s changes are pretty limited, but they’re headlined by a new 1901 special edition. As hinted at in the title, the 1901-spec GTD honors the Ford Sweepstakes, the vehicle Henry Ford took racing 125 years ago.FordAs with the Spirit of America GTD it’s replacing, production of the 1901 edition will be artificially limited. Ford says the 1901 edition will be kept to around 20 percent of the 2028 allocation, which we’re told could be anywhere from 60 to 140 cars. The livery is primarily finished in Royal Red paint, with black diagonal accents along the roof. The interior is similarly roseate, with Mahogany Red leather and Race Red stitching.FordAlong with the new special edition, Ford is also finally bringing magnesium wheels to the GTD. The optional wheel setup saves 50.3 pounds compared with the traditional setup. Ford originally planned to launch the GTD with the lighter wheels, but supplier constraints forced a delay. While Ford already offered 3-D-printed titanium paddle shifters and a titanium shift ring, the arrival of the 2028 GTD includes a fresh design for the parts. Changes are rounded out with the addition of full-grain leather that now covers the door panels, center console, and instrument panel, while the exterior adds new livery options and two new paint colors.Make sure to get your letter to Santa mailed quickly, because order books for the 2028 GTD are slated to open in December. Should you secure a build slot, you won’t find your new Mustang parked under the Christmas tree, as deliveries aren’t expected to start until the second quarter of 2027. Exact pricing hasn’t been released, but the 2028 car will surely follow in the footsteps of its predecessors with a starting price of at least $330,000.➡️ Skip the lot. Let Car and Driver help you find your next car.Jack Fitzgerald’s love for cars stems from his as yet unshakable addiction to Formula 1. After a brief stint as a detailer for a local dealership group in college, he knew he needed a more permanent way to drive all the new cars he couldn’t afford and decided to pursue a career in auto writing. By hounding his college professors at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, he was able to travel Wisconsin seeking out stories in the auto world before landing his dream job at Car and Driver. His new goal is to delay the inevitable demise of his 2010 Volkswagen Golf.

1nufm9o.title: The 2028 Ford Mustang GTD Is a Le Mans Race Car for the Road
1nufm9o.content: HomeFordMustang GTD2028FordMSRPHIGHSBrutally powerful supercharged V-8, unrelenting grip, civilized enough to drive on the street.LOWSInterior that's too much like a standard Mustang's, steering is light on feel.VERDICTWith performance typically found only in GT3 race cars, the Mustang GTD is the most capable pony to ever gallop out of Ford's stable—although that performance comes at a hefty price.By Austin ParsonsOverview The Blue Oval's most famous stallion has historically been a sports car for the masses, but the Ford Mustang GTD isn't for the faint of heart or pocket. For all intents and purposes, the GTD is an IMSA GT3 racecar for the road, but with far more power. Sandwiched between its flared-and- vented front fenders, a supercharged V-8 sends 815 racehorses sprinting through an eight-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. For reference, the Mustang GT3 race cars that compete in IMSA and at Le Mans only make around 550 horsepower.Earth-quaking power is only one of the GTD's tricks, though, and with advanced active aerodynamics, a racing-derived pushrod rear suspension setup, and carbon-fiber bodywork, Ford's super pony can beat all production cars but Mercedes's AMG One hypercar around the Nürburgring Nordschleife. While the racetrack is undeniably the GTD's natural habitat, it's also surprisingly civilized on the road. That combination of traits, and an ultra-limited production run, makes the GTD a rare breed with a six-digit price tag to match. Expert Tip: If you're after a lightning-fast palomino but can't quite justify the GTD's retirement-draining price tag, the Ford Mustang Darkhorse SC is well worth looking into. The SC might not have the GTD's trick suspension, but it features a virtually identical supercharged Predator 5.2-liter V-8 that churns out 795 horsepower.What's New for 2028?Ford has a few minor changes in store for the GTD in 2028. After encountering manufacturing issues earlier in the GTD's build cycle, magnesium wheels are finally available. The company claims that the new wheels save 50.3 pounds of unsprung mass, which should positively impact handling.In addition to the new wheels, the GTD's paddle shifters have been redesigned and are now 3D printed from titanium. An additional stripe design has also been added to the order sheet, and the Liquid Carbon special edition now comes with teal accenting.What's Your Car Worth?Car and Driver calculates your car's value in three free and easy steps - using the same Black Book® data dealers use to appraise vehicles.Pricing and Which One to BuyEngine, Transmission, and PerformanceEngine: 815-hp supercharged 5.2-liter V-8Transmission: 8-speed dual-clutch automaticDrivetrain: rear-wheel driveWith 815 horsepower from its supercharged Predator 5.2-liter V-8 engine, the roadgoing car has far more power than the Mustang GT3 race car it shares styling with. That track-only model instead uses a 5.4-liter V-8 with around 550 horsepower. Cog swaps for the GTD come courtesy of a rear-mounted eight-speed dual-clutch automated transaxle, similar to the type of gearbox used in the race car.A Mustang GTD we tested blew us away with its performance. Its shockingly civilized on-road ride quality surprised us as well. We would welcome more steering feedback, but the supremely balanced handling and staggering levels of grip make for a world-class driving experience.0–60-MPH TimesC/D 60-mph Test: 2.8 secondsIn Comparison: The Mustang GTD is quick, but two other rear-drive rockets, the Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 and Porsche 911 GT3 RS, outran it to 60 mph in our testing, completing that task in 2.2 and 2.7 seconds, respectively.Fuel Economy and Real-World MPGEPA City Rating: 10 mpgEPA Highway Rating: 17 mpgThe Ford Mustang GTD prioritizes lap times over fuel economy, as the roar from its mighty supercharged V-8 quickly reveals. As a result, the GTD only manages a pitiful 10 mpg in the city, 17 mpg on the highway, and 12 mpg combined, according to the EPA. For more information about the Mustang GTD's fuel economy, visit the EPA's website.Interior, Comfort, and CargoFirst Row: Though it looks every bit like the Mustang GT3 purpose-built race car on the outside, the GTD's cabin looks a lot like any ol' Mustang's. Suede, leather, and carbon fiber are the main ingredients of the GTD's interior that upgrade it from its lesser kin—though not by much. Recaro bucket seats hug both driver and front passenger, but the GTD jettisons the rear seats of other Mustang models. The paddle shifters are 3D-printed from titanium, same for the rotary dial gear selector and serial placard. Ford claims it sourced the material for these components from retired Lockheed Martin F-22 fighter jets.Cargo Capacity: The trunk is a treasure box of suspension and cooling components, but there is room for some small pieces of soft luggage where the rear seat used to be.Infotainment and ConnectivityInfotainment: 13.2-inch touchscreenConnectivity: Bluetooth, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android AutoAudio System: 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen stereoThe Mustang GTD packs a 12.4-inch digital gauge cluster and a 13.2-inch touchscreen infotainment display. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are standard equipment. Though the system is largely the same as that of other Mustangs, it does include additional GTD-exclusive performance menus.Safety and Driver-Assistance FeaturesAs you'd expect of a car like this, the GTD doesn't have many driver-assistance features, but it does have a lane-keep assist system and automatic emergency braking.Standard Safety Features: lane-keeping assist, automated emergency brakingFor information about the GTD's crash-test results, visit the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) websites.Warranty and Maintenance CoverageThe Mustang GTD has a solid but average warranty. However, unlike rival Chevy, Ford doesn't provide a complimentary scheduled maintenance visit.Limited Warranty: three years or 36,000 milesPowertrain Warranty: five years or 60,000 milesComplimentary Maintenance: noneC/D Test Results and SpecsEach year, we put hundreds of vehicles through our rigorous instrumented testing regimen. 15mg5sp.title: Production AI, Architecture Trade-offs & Team Design: InfoQ Opens Registration for 6 January Cohorts
15mg5sp.content:
InfoQ has opened registration for six online cohort workshops starting between January 9 and 22, 2027. Covering AI Engineering, Software Architecture, and High-Performing Teams, the five-week programs bring senior engineers, architects, and engineering leaders together to work through technical and organizational decisions with experienced practitioners.

The workshops go beyond studying technical material. Participants apply frameworks from QCon and InfoQ to decisions from their own work, compare approaches with practitioners from other organizations, and return to discuss what they tried and learned. Working across different organizational contexts helps expose trade-offs and assumptions that may not emerge from an internal discussion alone.

Each cohort combines four hours of live facilitated sessions per week, independent application work, and a program-specific capstone.

AI Engineering: Retrieval, Agents, and Evaluation

Production AI involves decisions beyond model selection: how context is retrieved and maintained, how much autonomy agents should have, and how reliability, latency, and inference costs are managed.

The InfoQ AI Engineering Program examines these decisions through RAG architectures, agent design, platforms, and evaluation. Participants work through technical approaches and failure modes, applying them to AI systems or proposals from their own work.

Three January cohorts are planned:

Hien Luu, AI/ML leader and author of MLOps with Ray, starts January 9, Saturdays at 09:00 PST.
Adi Polak, Director of Developer Experience Engineering at Confluent, starts January 21, Thursdays at 08:00 PST.
Lan Chu, principal engineer at Rabobank and author of Post-training LLMs, starts January 22, Fridays at 14:00 CET. Her QCon London 2026 presentation examined a production RAG system built on more than 10,000 documents and used by more than 300 people.

Architecture: Decisions Across Teams and Platforms

Architecture choices are shaped by system requirements, team boundaries, platform ownership, and organizational constraints.

The InfoQ Architect Program covers distributed systems, decentralized decisions, platform engineering, and AI architecture. Participants apply the material to architecture decisions they currently own, compare trade-offs with peers, and practice communicating their reasoning to stakeholders.

The capstone involves co-authoring a technical article examining AI's role in software architecture or platform engineering. Selected articles may be published on InfoQ.

Both cohorts start January 22 and are facilitated by Luca Mezzalira, independent software architect and author of Building Micro-Frontends. Friday sessions are offered at 09:30 GMT and 10:00 EST.

High-Performing Teams: Delivery Flow, Ownership, and AI

Faster coding does not necessarily improve delivery when reviews, approvals, or infrastructure dependencies become the constraint. AI agents also change how responsibilities are divided and which work requires human judgment.

The InfoQ High-Performing Teams Program examines team structure, ownership, delivery flow, AI responsibilities, and engineering metrics as one operating model.

Participants evaluate constraints in their own team environments, compare approaches with peers, and develop a proposed target operating model covering responsibilities, workflow, and measurement.

The January 12 cohort is facilitated by Olimpiu Pop, InfoQ Podcast co-host with experience in solutions architecture, engineering management, and CTO roles. Sessions run on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 16:00 to 18:00 CET.

Workshop Format and Participation

The live online workshops focus on discussion and application rather than recorded lectures. Participants work with an experienced facilitator and a small cross-company peer group, bringing current engineering decisions into the sessions and testing approaches between meetings.

Sessions are not recorded, allowing participants to discuss organizational constraints more openly. Certification requires attendance, active participation, and successful completion of the program capstone.

Participation costs USD 1,470 per person. Full schedules, syllabi, and registration details are available on the InfoQ Online Certification Programs website.
