gh-1321785975.title: GitHub - portemon-nitro/portemon: Getting HeartGold/SoulSilver out of the DS
gh-1321785975.content:
Portémon Nitro

Portémon Nitro is an unofficial way to play your Pokémon HeartGold/SoulSilver
copy on PC, mobile, and potentially many other devices. It's a port of the game
engine build with LÖVE that reads your ROM directly, then uses it to run the game.
This project is not an emulator and does not ship copyrighted ROM data,
dialogue, graphics, models, or audio. You must provide your own compatible ROM;
the importer recognizes only the supported canonical US dumps. The game stores
the location of your ROM and continuously references it when it needs more
data. This means you should NOT move your ROM file after importing it.
Contributing
Run commands from the repository root (assumes UNIX-like system for most things):
scripts/run.sh (run.bat on Windows)
scripts/test.sh [--filter <substring>] [--rom-source <path-to-nds-or-zip-file>]
All the extracted data and save files stay under .cache/ in the checkout.
Acknowledgements
Portémon Nitro was heavily inspired by the
G1R Deluxe, and owes a lot to the
incredible work done by the pret folks in the HGSS Decomp, as well as the MelonDS Emulator which were used for research.
We are not in any way affiliated or associated with any of these projects,
nor with the Pokémon Company or GameFreak.

1lvvds2.title: Global Biodiversity Framework at risk of becoming an empty promise
1lvvds2.content:
Professor Carolyn Hogg with a Tasmanian devil. Credit: University of Sydney

The landmark Global Biodiversity Framework, agreed upon in 2022, was a major step forward in tackling global biodiversity loss. But without consistent, scientifically robust measures of progress, its ambitions risk going unrealized, a global collaboration of scientists has argued.

In a new Comment published in the journal Nature , University of Sydney conservation scientist Carolyn Hogg and international colleagues warn that governments, businesses and investors need reliable, independently tested measures to determine whether nature is genuinely recovering in order to give meaning to the framework.
Hogg said, "The Global Biodiversity Framework was a huge step forward, but agreeing to protect nature is not the same as doing it. Without consistent, credible ways to measure progress, we risk having ambitious targets on paper while biodiversity continues to decline."
The authors recommend using the State of Nature metrics developed by the Nature Positive Initiative. The metrics aim to provide a globally consistent minimal framework—a simple common language—for tracking changes in nature across countries and sectors.
As explained in the Comment, many of the challenges raised by the article can be resolved through empirical testing. To that end, in May 2025 the authors launched the Universitas 21 Nature Positive Coalition, a global alliance of research-intensive universities. In collaboration with the Nature Positive Initiative, the U21 coalition is seeking to address the challenges around the state of nature metrics.
The aim is to develop a "matrix beyond the metrics," the authors argue. This would provide a dashboard to be used by investors that accounts for all factors (financial, legal, social and ecological) to ensure that the metrics work for ecosystems, nature stewards, decision-makers and investors.
The coalition has started asking the questions posed by the authors' article at two pilot project sites—one in Scotland and the other in New Zealand—while seeking funding to expand the project to 10 global locations across different bioregions and financial and legal systems.
Crucially, the authors argue, the metrics need to be used beyond the finance and business sectors and be applied across diverse landscapes, seascapes, biomes and socioeconomic and governance contexts.

Publication details
Carolyn J. Hogg et al., How measuring the state of nature can reverse biodiversity loss, Nature (2026). DOI: 10.1038/d41586-026-03714-8

1s3dj7x.title: Physicists send an unblockable message using gravity
1s3dj7x.content:
Matthew Davis, Charles Woffinden and Andrew White inside the elevator they used to send a message. Credit: The University of Queensland

University of Queensland researchers have used gravity to transmit a message through a brick wall using an elevator and a sensitive gravimeter. The unusual experiment took place in UQ's Parnell Building, where the team of physicists sent the elevator back and forth between two levels, moving its 1.8 metric ton (4,000 pound) counterweight between positions representing binary 0 and 1.

A gravimeter in an adjacent bathroom detected the changes in the gravitational field and translated the message into a single word, "Gravity."
A signal ordinary barriers cannot block
Dr. Charles Woffinden from the School of Mathematics and Physics said gravitational communication had an intriguing advantage. The research has been published in Science Advances.
"Unlike the electromagnetic signals used in modern wireless communication, a gravitational signal cannot simply be screened out by placing ordinary material in its path," Woffinden said.
"Anyone who has lost phone reception in a tunnel or struggled with Wi-Fi through a solid wall will understand the appeal.
"While the present system is far from practical, it demonstrates the possibility of communicating using a method that ordinary physical barriers cannot block."
From weighing trucks to transmitting information
Dr. Andrew Groszek said the idea came from a project to develop a contactless truck scale.
"We were aiming to determine the mass of trucks and other large vehicles by measuring their tiny gravitational pull," Groszek said.
"Once we had shown that the idea worked, we realized the same physics could be used to encode and transmit information."
One bit per minute
Professor Andrew White said the biggest limitation to future gravity-based communication was its slow speed.
"Our elevator was snail-paced—it's from the 1950s—so our experiment transmitted just 1 bit per minute, meaning it took an hour to send a single word," White said.
"The speed of gravity communication would come down to how big the mass is, how fast you can move it and the sensitivity of the detector.
"It took more than 100 years to go from the first telegraph system to the mobile phone, so while gravity communication is not practical today, it could be in the future."
Quantum sensors could extend the range
Professor Matthew Davis said the UQ team had established an important underlying principle.
"It's not often that you get to demonstrate an entirely new way of communicating," Davis said.
"We have shown experimentally that information can be encoded in the gravitational field and recovered at the other end.
"Our experiment used a classical gravity sensor, but our modeling indicates that quantum sensors could, with rather ambitious assumptions, support ranges of up to about 500 meters (1,640 feet) and data rates of around 15 bits per minute."
Such sensors could eventually support communication in environments where radio waves, light and other conventional signals cannot penetrate.

Publication details
Andrew Groszek et al., Unblockable communication with gravity, Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aee0802. www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.aee0802

vsqubm.title: Damaged rocks may help explain why small earthquakes outnumber large ones
vsqubm.content:
Credit: CC0 Public Domain

University of Michigan researchers have developed a better way to understand why earthquakes occur and what size they might be. Currently, models that predict earthquakes only account for slipping that occurs along a main fault, activity that usually generates large earthquakes. Instead, the U-M researchers have built a model that considers not only the main fault action but also the activity of rocks that lie adjacent to the fault and become damaged during earthquake events.

By considering both the fault and outlying rocks, the researchers' model is able to explain earthquake activity, including why small earthquakes occur much more frequently than larger earthquakes.
"If we can better understand the small earthquakes, we can understand the link between earthquakes of different sizes. It has implications for the mechanism of large earthquakes," said Peng Zhai, who built the model during his doctoral work at U-M. "To better understand and forecast earthquakes, we need to fully understand the stress conditions on the fault and the off-fault damage."
Their study is published in Science Advances.
Modeling damage beyond the main fault
To build the model, the researchers included the full cycle of an earthquake, including how stress builds up in the fault zone, the earthquake "nucleation"—or the moment the fault starts to slip—and the earthquake rupture. They also considered how damaged rock would settle and heal after an earthquake. Additionally, the model simulates seismic activity that occurs on time scales that range from seconds to centuries.
"If you look at something like the San Andreas Fault from the air, you can see that the fault is actually a whole field of rocks that have fractures and damage that extend out hundreds of meters or kilometers from the main fault," said senior author Yihe Huang, professor of earth and environmental sciences.
"Even though earthquakes occur on that main fault plane, you actually have a lot of damage going on close to that fault. We can see that from the surface all the time, but we rarely consider that in the models because that would introduce another complexity you have to solve."

Linking earthquake size, stress and energy
Zhai says their holistic model can explain why smaller earthquakes occur much more frequently. The model can also explain why earthquakes of different sizes release about the same amount of stress: larger earthquakes may rupture a larger fault area, but the stress relieved over the whole ruptured area is about the same as that relieved by a smaller earthquake.
Finally, the model shows that the energy needed for an earthquake to rupture a unit fault area increases with the size of the earthquake. For the first time, the three general features of earthquakes can be explained within a unified physical framework.
Weaker rocks absorb rupture energy
"One interesting point is that these results are consistent with a long-standing hypothesis called the weak-fault zone hypothesis. Our results suggest that the fault zone strength can be very low, so that we have multiscale seismicity, or both large and small earthquakes," said Zhai, now a postdoctoral researcher at Utah State University.
Huang says the weak zone hypothesis might also explain why there are more smaller earthquakes. Because the rocks surrounding the fault zone deform so easily, they actually absorb energy from the main rupture, deadening the force of a larger earthquake and instead producing a smaller one. But this may also help generate a larger earthquake down the line.
"We have to incorporate these fault zone effects into our earthquake models to better understand earthquakes and capture more realistic scenarios," Zhai said. "The reason traditional earthquake models only consider elastic deformation of the fault zone is because it's more simple. It's easier to compute. But if you introduce inelastic deformation, or the energy into the surrounding rocks, it's more realistic."
"This is the result of years of effort and multiple researchers, to be able to construct this final model that can capture very interesting phenomena," she said.

Publication details
Small and Large Earthquakes Driven by Inelastic Deformation in Weak Fault Zones, Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aef7106

b4kynz.title: Україна зможе оплачувати американську зброю через PURL коштами кредиту ЄС
b4kynz.content:
Кабінет міністрів схвалив підписання Загальної рамкової домовленості з НАТО, яка створює правову та фінансову основу для спрямування коштів Позики на підтримку України (Ukraine Support Loan) на фінансування пакетів PURL.

Про це повідомляє Міністерство оборони України, передає Укрінформ.

Як зазначили у Міноборони, це дозволить Україні використовувати частину коштів, наданих у межах кредиту Європейського Союзу, для закупівлі через механізм PURL критично необхідних оборонних товарів і послуг США.

Україна зможе здійснювати внески до PURL через рахунок НАТО. Кожен внесок оформлюватиметься окремим листом із зазначенням конкретного пакета PURL і суми фінансування.

Внесок буде прив’язаний до визначеного пакета та переліку продукції, який Україна подає Європейській Комісії в межах Ukraine Support Loan на 2026–2027 роки.

Кошти залишатимуться коштами України до моменту оформлення НАТО відповідного документа з Міністерством війни США та підтвердження американською стороною можливості реалізації конкретного пакета.

НАТО діятиме виключно як уповноважений фінансовий посередник та утримувач внесків України. Альянс не виступатиме покупцем, продавцем, постачальником або гарантом американських оборонних товарів і послуг.

Читайте також: Німеччина розраховує, що США залишаться надійним партнером у постачанні зброї Україні через PURL

НАТО також щоквартально звітуватиме про стан і використання коштів, залишки, нараховані відсотки, витрати, валютні курси та здійснені перекази.

Міноборони України визначено компетентним органом, уповноваженим реалізовувати від імені уряду права за домовленістю.

Міноборони готуватиме, підписуватиме та подаватиме листи про внески, надаватиме інші письмові інструкції, запити й повідомлення та отримуватиме звіти щодо використання коштів.

Домовленість не створює для України обов’язку здійснювати внески. Невикористані кошти можна буде повернути або спрямувати на інший пакет PURL.

Prioritized Ukraine Requirements List (PURL) – ініціатива США та НАТО, яка дозволяє країнам-членам і партнерам Альянсу фінансувати постачання Україні критично важливого озброєння та обладнання американського виробництва.

Читайте також: Рішення щодо фінансування Польщею цьогоріч ініціативи PURL ще не ухвалене - Сікорський

Механізм стартував у липні 2025 року, він працює на основі пріоритетного списку потреб, визначеного Україною та погодженого зі США і НАТО. Йдеться про озброєння, яке критично потрібне фронту і яке не завжди можна швидко замінити європейськими аналогами.

За перший рік роботи механізму PURL загальний обсяг внесків сягнув майже 7 млрд доларів. Близько 95% перехоплювачів для Patriot, таких як PAC-3, Україна отримує саме через PURL.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, за словами міністра оборони України Євгенія Хмари, оголошені 17 листопада на «Рамштайні» внески від партнерів дадуть змогу посилити ППО, зокрема завдяки закупівлі ракет за ініціативою PURL.

h7m2lk.title: Глава Amazon Джефф Безос заявил, что во время кастинга на роль Джеймса Бонда к Роберту Паттинсону относились предвзято из-за его популярности — Кино и сериалы на DTF
h7m2lk.content: Но после проб все сомнения отпали.Глава Amazon Джефф Безос посетил конференцию Semafor Silicon Valley & The World, и в ходе одного из интервью поделился подробностями о кастинге на роль Джеймса Бонда в будущем фильме Дени Вильнёва.Безос заявил, что изначально команда относилась к Роберту Паттинсону несколько предвзято. Во многом это было связано с тем, что роль Джеймса Бонда «традиционно делает малоизвестных актёров звёздами».Мы следовали очень чёткому процессу, и приняли окончательное решение в пятницу. Сначала была большая группа людей, но мы сократили её до пяти финалистов. Мы провели настоящие, старомодные кинопробы с этими актёрами. Это был интересный опыт: реальные костюмы, настоящие декорации и другие артисты, находившиеся рядом. Мы сняли по три сцены с каждым из финалистов, и в пятницу потратили несколько часов на их просмотр и обсуждения.Джефф Безос, глава AmazonРуководитель не уточнил имена конкурентов Паттинсона. По данным СМИ, ими стали Николас Холт, Джош О’Коннор, Джек Лауден и Каллум Тёрнер.Сомнения в утверждении на роль именно Паттинсона отпали, когда список кандидатов сократили до пяти артистов. По словам Безоса, решение было очевидным.Все, кто вошёл в финальный список, — потрясающие актёры. Но в Роберте и его актёрской игре было что-то особенное. Мы приняли решение сразу и безоговорочно. Изначально мы были слегка предвзяты по отношению к нему, потому что он уже и так популярен. Думали, что стоит взять кого-то менее известного, но после проб стало очевидно, что он и есть Джеймс Бонд.Джефф Безос, глава AmazonСам Паттинсон узнал о назначении на роль агента 007 в воскресенье — за сутки до официального анонса. В момент публикации самой новости актёр смотрел «Оборотня» Роберта Эггерса, о чём режиссёр рассказал в интервью IGN.Когда начнутся съёмки фильма про Джеймса Бонда от Дени Вильнёва, неизвестно. Следующим фильмом постановщика станет «Дюна 3»: лента выйдет в прокат 18 декабря, и в её актёрский состав также вошёл Паттинсон.Роберт Паттинсон стал новым Джеймсом Бондом в кино Появились первые промо.

gh-1430294447.title: GitHub - TheBozos/TMB_Recomp: Twisted Metal: Black (USA, SCUS-97101) as a native PC port: static recompilation with PS2Recomp (no game data)
gh-1430294447.content:
A native Linux and Windows port of Twisted Metal: Black (USA SCUS-97101), made by statically recompiling the game's PlayStation 2 code to C++ on BozoEngine.
The game's own MIPS R5900 code runs as a PC program. Its meshes, textures, menus, effects, sound and movies use native
PC services. BozoEngine replaces the PS2Recomp fork completely; the player build has no IOP, SPU2, GS, VIF or VU interpreter.

ImportantNo game files are included: no ELF, IRX modules, data archives, or code generated from them.
You need your own copy of the game: the USA release, PS2 ID SCUS-97101. The port is built against its
executable:

File
SHA-1

SCUS_971.01
3ff17f4897552e355d0bb8c3abfa5125fe3ff2ef

For players (Windows)
You build the game yourself, on your PC, from your own disc: nothing of the game is in the download.
Download: v0.4.0 is the BozoEngine migration release.
This repository now builds on BozoEngine only. The previous v0.3.2
remains available for comparison. The steps below describe the native packages.

Download TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo.zip and its .sha256 for a new/separate installation. Check its SHA-256 before
running anything (Get-FileHash .\TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo.zip in PowerShell).
Unzip it anywhere with about 10 GB free (into D:\Games, say: the ZIP holds a TMB_Recomp_Bozo folder), but not in
Program Files. Keep its folders together: TMB Launcher.exe, source\ (our code), kit\ (the compiler and tools),
README.txt (these steps, English and French), CHANGELOG.md, LICENSES\.
Double-click TMB Launcher.exe. It is not signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC":
click More info, then Run anyway.
Click Select your disc image… and pick your USA disc image: a .iso, or a .bin with its .cue.
The European disc and other games are refused with an explanation.
Click Prepare the game. The included tools build it locally, without downloads. It takes a few minutes the
first time; you can stop it and resume where it left off.
Click Play. F2 opens controls, video and cheats. Memory cards, settings and logs live in
%APPDATA%\TMB_Recomp (the launcher's Maintenance tab opens it).
Optional: Settings → Make enhanced textures upscales every arena's and car's textures with Real-ESRGAN (included
in kit\), on your PC from your own disc: about 15 minutes with a recent graphics card, about 700 MB, and a Vulkan
graphics driver is needed. The game then uses them; turn them off there or in F2 → Video → Texture pack. Nothing is
downloaded or sent, and the result is yours alone: do not share it.

Requires Windows 10 version 1903 or newer / Windows 11, an AVX2 and FMA capable CPU, and OpenGL 3.3.
Original heat haze around fire and explosions is enabled by default. BOZO_HEAT_HAZE=0 disables it for comparisons
with the older PC port. Menus and movies use their native timing, independently of the presentation frame rate.
For an existing v0.3.2 installation, use its Update button or extract the unsuffixed TMB_Recomp-<version>.zip
over its TMB_Recomp/ folder. That migration ZIP contains the same BozoEngine build, not the old runtime.
After an update, Rebuild now prepares the new code; removed release files are cleaned up, while saves stay.
Subsequent native updates use -bozo.zip regardless of the installation folder's name.
The launcher checks for updates at start unless disabled in Settings. Update verifies the ZIP's SHA-256, installs
the new source/tools and restarts. Manual extraction over the matching folder works too. Delete the installation
folder to uninstall; delete %APPDATA%\TMB_Recomp separately to remove saves/settings. The two layouts and previous
release share that user folder by default; use a scratch PS2X_USER_DIR for comparisons.
Status
Picking the work up elsewhere: docs/HANDOFF.md (current state, measurements and remaining checks).
Playable, at full speed, as a native port targeting NTSC's 60 updates per second. The BozoEngine build boots,
plays movies with sound, runs menus and level loading, and plays one-player, story and four-player split-screen
matches: driving, weapons, bots, HUD, music and effects. Native card writes and a restart with those cards pass.
The latest measured gameplay holds about 60 updates/presents per second on the development PC; game-thread work
averages 3.8 ms in 1P, 4.5 ms in four-player and 2.7 ms on the effects-heavy stage 20. These are local measurements,
not hardware-independent performance guarantees.
Menu/movie checks measure a 1.0000× game clock, about 576,000 menu timer ticks/s and 29.94–30.00 decoded movie
pictures/s. The legacy TMB_NATIVE_FRAMES=0 setting can no longer bypass native pacing. The previous match-start
sound freeze and lens-flare presentation stall are fixed. Occasional shorter presentation hitches remain.
Still being checked: full story endings, every arena on the new runtime, some effects against the original picture,
and fresh-OS / physical-controller acceptance. The older pinned save-cheat recording and exact native sound-model
equality remain diagnostic limitations; the player build never uses recorded sound replies. The handoff distinguishes
those comparisons from actual native play. docs/RECOMP_NOTES.md retains the port's bring-up history.

The USA native PC port at twice the PS2's resolution. These repository screenshots predate the BozoEngine migration; current validation is in docs/HANDOFF.md.

Milestone

Map the USA ELF's own symbols and recompile its functions to C++
✅

Link the generated code with BozoEngine; remove the PS2Recomp submodule and build dependency
✅

Boot: native scheduler, Sony SDK services and reads from the owner's disc
✅

USA release (SCUS-97101, NTSC 60 Hz)
✅

Controller input; buttons and stick directions rebindable to keys, controllers and mouse (F2, input.ini)
✅

Movies (PSS, MPEG-2 decoded with FFmpeg) and movie sound
✅

Title screen, menus, level select and loading
✅

Native memory-card writes and restart/readback (mc0, mc1 in the user folder)
✅

Matches: HUD, cars, textured 3D, driving, weapons and bots
✅

Deaths, respawns, game over and replay
✅

Story progression and card writes without a reference recording
✅

Full speed: native rendering and frame pacing on the PC's clock
✅

Native 989SND driver/mixer; music, effects and movie audio
✅

Game geometry/effects drawn from the game's own data; no GS or VIF/GIF decoder in play
✅

VU work translated to native C++; no VU interpreter or sandbox
✅

Original heat haze enabled by default
✅

Multi-player split-screen, 2 to 4 players; frame-keyed scripts for unattended checks
✅

Settings (F2): controls, video, cheats; windowed / fullscreen / borderless
✅

Save states (F5 save, F7 load, ten slots; --save-state / --load-state for scripted runs)
✅

Higher internal resolution (2× by default; Video's render scale)
✅

Interpolated presentation above 60 Hz; rain, snow, flares and some trails still update at game rate
🧪

Every Challenge arena rechecked on BozoEngine
🔧

Every story level to the endings
🔧

Fresh standard-user Windows installation and four physical controllers
🔧

Linux player build validated on the new runtime
⏳

Widescreen
⏳

Native port: the shared goal of The Bozos' ports is to draw and play sound directly from the game's own data,
with PC timing and services. In this project BozoEngine now supplies the runtime, without the PS2Recomp fork.

Layer

✅

IOP-facing services handled by native drivers; no IOP interpreter or recompiled IRX dependency in the player
✅

989SND sound banks played by the native mixer; no SPU2 emulator
✅

Frame loop and sound on the PC's clock
✅

OpenGL renderer on the GPU; no paraLLEl-GS or GS renderer
✅

No GS memory, GIF packet decoder or VIF front end in the player build
✅

VU0 calculations and VU1 shading/effects implemented as native code
✅

Textures and meshes converted offline into native packs
✅

3D objects drawn at the game's hooks, using its state and order
✅

Particles, lens flares, rain and other effects drawn from the game's lists
✅

Font, HUD, overlays, loading and movies drawn natively
✅

Existing memory-card and settings file formats retained
✅

✅ works · 🧪 experimental · 🔧 in progress · ⏳ not reached yet
docs/HANDOFF.md records current evidence and limits. docs/RECOMP_NOTES.md
records the earlier bring-up and fixes; its historical fork diagnostics are not build instructions for this tree.
Goal
A fully playable Twisted Metal: Black as a true PC program, from the intro to the endings: no PS2 hardware simulated
where the PC can do the job itself. Accuracy first; then widescreen and frame rates above the PS2's.
How it works
The game's R5900 functions become C++ and run on the host CPU. BozoEngine supplies native scheduling, library
services, rendering, input and sound; TMB's hooks supply the game-specific data and behavior.

Part of the game
On the PS2
In the port

Frame timing
vblank fields and hardware timers
native frame pacing and field counts from the PC clock; presentation can interpolate between game updates

Game code (EE, MIPS R5900)
the EE CPU
bozo-recomp generates C++ and an address-indexed function table from the owner's ELF

Kernel and Sony libraries
EE software and IOP services
BozoEngine's native scheduler and library implementations

Sound driver and mixing
989SND, LIBSD and SPU2
native 989SND bank/voice handling and mixer; no IOP or SPU2 emulator

3D meshes
VU1 programs, then GS draws
offline native mesh packs, submitted at the game's per-object hooks in its own order (runtime/tmb_meshes.cpp)

Shading, skinning and clipping
VU calculations
native C++ calculations and OpenGL rendering

Particles, rain, flares, trails and heat haze
VU1 / GS effects
the game's particle/flare lists and native rendering (runtime/tmb_particles.cpp); heat haze defaults on

Textures
GS texture memory
offline packs keyed by the game's texture IDs (tools/tmb_texture_pack.py, runtime/tmb_textures.cpp)

Font, HUD, overlays and loading
game packet builders, GS
native builders reading the game's variables (runtime/tmb_2d.cpp)

Movies
IPU / GS plus sound stream
FFmpeg decoding, native picture presentation and audio

Controllers and cards
libpad / libmc, IOP devices
SDL3 input and native card files, preserving the port's settings/save formats

Your USA disc
├─ SCUS_971.01 ── bozo-recomp ── generated C++ ─┐
└─ textures/models ── native asset packs ────────┤
▼
TMB's native hooks + BozoEngine
OpenGL · SDL3 · native mixer · FFmpeg
│
tmb.exe

The executable retains its symbols, so this port does not need a Ghidra function-map pass.
runtime/tmb_overrides.cpp contains game-specific bindings; bozo/ contains the real-time host, headless host and
checker. Generic recompiler/runtime work lives in the BozoEngine submodule.
Its clean-room specifications and validation describe the engine.
PS2Recomp remains credited in the project's history and available in the v0.3.2 release, but is no longer a dependency.
Requirements
The player package brings its own build tools. To build from the repository:

Windows 10 version 1903 or newer / Windows 11; Windows is the validated player target. Linux portability is not yet
validated for this migration.
An AVX2 and FMA capable CPU, OpenGL 3.3, about 10 GB free for preparation, and your own USA disc.
CMake 3.21+, Ninja, Python 3 and a C++20 compiler. The matching kit's GCC is the validated Windows configuration;
MSVC is not supported for this port.
SDL3 and Dear ImGui (fetched at pinned hashes, or supplied by the kit), plus FFmpeg development libraries
(libavcodec, libavutil; BOZO_FFMPEG_ROOT for the static kit).
Optional zlib for BozoEngine's recording/checking tools. Player builds use BOZO_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF.

Build and run
One command, from your disc (Windows)
Clone the repository with its BozoEngine submodule, then use the same pipeline as the launcher:
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/TheBozos/TMB_Recomp.git
cd TMB_Recomp
python tools\tmb_build.py --disc "D:\Discs\Twisted Metal - Black (USA).iso" --out D:\TMB-build --kit D:\tmb_kit_bozo\kit
"D:\TMB-build\TMB\Play TMB.cmd"

The pipeline is verify → extract → configure → tools → recompile → packs → compile → stage. It checks the USA ELF's
SHA-1 and handles ISO or BIN/CUE without a separate disc-extraction program.
The staged folder is <out>/TMB: tmb.exe, SCUS_971.01, the native packs, disc.iso and Play TMB.cmd.
A same-drive ISO is hard-linked; another drive or a raw BIN/CUE is copied/converted. The original image is never modified.
--game <dir> stages elsewhere; --check only verifies the disc. --stop-after <step> stops at a step;
--redo <step> repeats it and the steps after it. Finished steps with matching inputs are skipped.
--toolchain <dir> chooses the compiler/tools; --engine <dir> selects another BozoEngine tree. --no-kit
uses installed tools instead of an automatically discovered kit. --fetch-cache <dir> supplies cached SDL3/ImGui sources.
Python tools use the standard library. The build reports PROGRESS, PERCENT, SKIP, DONE, ERROR and RESULT
lines to the launcher; detailed step output lives in <out>/logs/.
Spaces and accented paths are supported. On Windows the builder uses temporary ASCII junctions for compiler paths
and reports real paths back to the launcher. A changed toolchain clears stale configure checks before retrying.

The build kit: nothing installed (Windows)
Use the matching BozoEngine kit (v2). The published v0.3.2 kit contains the earlier runtime's tools and is incompatible.
The package includes its kit; maintainers can assemble one from the pinned source/tool versions:
python tools\make_build_kit.py --out D:\tmb_kit_bozo\kit --zip D:\tmb_kit_bozo\kit.zip
rem with this repository in TMB_Recomp and the kit next to it:
kit\python\python.exe -I -X utf8 TMB_Recomp\tools\tmb_build.py --disc "D:\Discs\Twisted Metal - Black (USA).iso" --out D:\TMB-build --kit kit

Kit folder
Contents

ucrt64/
pinned MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC, binutils, mingw-w64 headers/CRT, CMake, Ninja, and their required DLLs

ffmpeg/
pinned FFmpeg MPEG-2 decoding libraries, built static (LGPL)

deps/
pinned SDL3 and Dear ImGui sources, without .git

python/
pinned Windows embeddable Python

sources/, licenses/, kit_manifest.json
source archives, licences, component versions/origins/hashes

The builder finds kit/ in the installation or beside the source folder; --kit overrides that.
The validated packaged build works offline with only this kit, including an accented/spaced installation path.
The staged player is statically linked and needs no compiler DLLs beside it. The kit itself is build output, never
committed; release archives include third-party licences and the corresponding-source offer.
The launcher (Windows)
launcher/ is TMB Launcher.exe, a separate CMake project using SDL3, Dear ImGui and OpenGL. It is linked static
and uses only Windows system DLLs. English and French are supported.
cmake -S launcher -B D:\TMB-launcher-build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build D:\TMB-launcher-build
rem offline: -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_SDL3=<kit>/deps/sdl3-src
rem -DFETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_IMGUI=<kit>/deps/imgui-src
rem -DLAUNCHER_FONT_DIR=<folder containing Exo2[wght].ttf and OFL.txt>

It expects the release layout: TMB Launcher.exe, source/, kit/. It creates build/ for preparation and game/
for the staged game. --release <dir> points at another installation.
Preparation uses bundled Python and source/tools/tmb_build.py, in a Windows job object. Stop ends that build tree;
the next preparation resumes it. Errors show the step's log and a Copy details button.
Play starts game/tmb.exe with the staged ELF and disc, hides the launcher, then returns when the game exits.
A crash report is offered if one appeared in the user folder.
Window settings live in video.ini; disc choice, language, background motion and build state live in launcher.ini
in the user folder. The launcher's Settings tab controls the starting window; F2 in the game controls the game settings.
The launcher keeps video.ini's other keys (frame rate, texture upscaling, texture pack) when it writes the window.
Enhanced textures (Settings): source/tools/tmb_texture_enhance.py with the kit's Python dumps the textures with
game/tmb-headless.exe, then game/tmb-texture-pack.exe upscales them with kit/realesrgan into
%APPDATA%\TMB_Recomp\texture_pack (resumed when stopped; Remove deletes it).
The team's RecompWatcher styling remains: PS2 BIOS blue, glowing boot towers, glass cards, Exo 2 (SIL OFL), and TMB's
flaming-clown icon (launcher/tmb.ico, runtime/app/tmb.ico). No game art is used for the icon.
Update checks use GitHub's latest-release API. The native updater fetches TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo.zip and its
SHA-256, verifies names/version, stages the full archive and installs it. Loaded files are set aside as *.tmb-old.
The old launcher's unsuffixed download is provided separately as the migration ZIP. Both layouts retain their user data.
--selftest <iso> --shots <dir> [--wrong <image>] [--cancel] [--play-seconds s] [--crash-seconds s] exercises the flow
and records screenshots/logs; a failed build or game start fails the test. Always set a scratch PS2X_USER_DIR.
--screens, --ui-scale, --update-url, --download-prefix and --update-now support UI/update test scenarios.

The release (maintainers)
tools/make_release.py exports committed files, builds the launcher with the kit, audits the payload and writes hashes:
python tools\make_release.py --version <version> --kit D:\tmb_kit_bozo\kit --out D:\TMB-release --with-sources
python tools\make_release.py --verify-zip D:\TMB-release\TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo.zip

Output (in --out)
Contents

TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo.zip
TMB_Recomp_Bozo/: launcher, TMB/BozoEngine source, matching kit, player README, changelog and licences

TMB_Recomp-<version>.zip
the identical BozoEngine payload under TMB_Recomp/, for the previous launcher's Update path

<zip>.sha256
SHA-256 in sha256sum format

TMB_Recomp-<version>-bozo-sources.zip
--with-sources: the kit's MSYS2 source packages and FFmpeg source, attached to a published release

RELEASE_NOTES.md
the version's changelog section, download/migration instructions, hashes, sizes, component versions and source offer

The version comes from a tag or --version. A real release requires its ## [x.y.z] changelog section;
--allow-missing-changelog is for test builds only. Source/export/archive audits reject the retired runtime and
game-derived files. --publish creates a draft with gh; --dry-run prints the command. --publish-only uses
existing output. The commit must already be on GitHub; the script never pushes code or publishes the draft itself.
Follow docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md and include the corresponding sources and licences.
Making a release
Releases are built by .github/workflows/release.yml when the owner asks. An ordinary push does not publish one.

Move CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased entries into ## [<version>] - <date>, update its links, and merge through a PR
with green checks. Engine changes must already be public before updating the submodule pin.
Tag that merged commit (v<version>) and push the tag, or run the workflow against the already pushed tag.
The workflow checks the changelog, assembles the pinned kit, makes both player ZIPs and corresponding sources,
verifies hashes/contents and runs the bundled-toolchain/launcher checks, then creates a draft release.
Download and test the draft using the release checklist, including migration and fresh-Windows/player acceptance.
Publish the reviewed draft on GitHub. Publication can notify RecompWatcher when its dispatch secret is configured.

A manual workflow without a tag produces test artifacts, not a release. The kit's MSYS2 packages are pinned in
tools/build_kit_packages.json; make_build_kit.py --install-packages installs them. When upgrading the kit, update
the pins, rebuild and test before committing. No game files or generated game code belong in the archives.
Step by step (development)
All retained shortcuts use the same BozoEngine pi

6p17be.title: По мотивам «Бегущего по лезвию» хотят выпустить AAA-игру
6p17be.content:
Компания Alcon Entertainment, владеющая правами на франшизу «Бегущий по лезвию», ищет команду для создания AAA-игроизации. c55dxd.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
c55dxd.byline: Bruno Duarte, Gabriel Pimenta de Freitas Cardoso, Isis F Carvalho, Breno de Almeida Beleza, Felipe Lima
c55dxd.content:
Predicting end-to-end fine-tuning time on shared GPU clusters, from 272 production runs.
A preview of our upcoming paper, Predicting End-to-End Fine-Tuning Time for Generative Language Models. The full version will be on arXiv soon.
GPUs are among the most expensive and scarcest resources in AI today. Anyone running a shared cluster has to decide, every day, which jobs go on which GPUs and in what order. That plan is only as good as the estimate of how long each job will take. When a job finishes hours early, GPUs sit idle until the next one is dispatched. When it runs hours late, everything queued behind it slips, experiments wait and delivery dates move.
Better duration estimates turn this into planning instead of guesswork: what runs, when, and on how many GPUs, with less idle capacity in between. Yet the estimate most teams use is a back-of-the-envelope FLOP calculation. It says nine hours, and the job finishes the next afternoon.
We wanted to know how far off that math really is, and whether we could do better before a job is even dispatched. So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h). A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation. The gap comes from two things a closed-form estimate cannot do. The regressor sees more training-specific signals, such as evaluation cadence, checkpoint policy, per-GPU load and fine-tuning regime, and it learns the nonlinear interactions between them from past runs.

The estimate everyone uses is compute-only

For a dense Transformer, training costs roughly 6·P·D floating-point operations, where P is the parameter count and D the number of training tokens. Divide that by what your GPUs can deliver and you get a training-loop time:
T_theoretical = (6 · P · D) / (N_GPU · FLOPS_peak · MFU)

Here N_GPU is the number of GPUs, FLOPS_peak is the peak throughput of one GPU from its spec sheet, and MFU (Model FLOPs Utilization) is the fraction of that peak the training actually achieves. Real jobs never run at peak because of memory traffic, communication and kernel inefficiencies, so MFU typically sits somewhere between 30% and 60%, and the right value for a given job is not known in advance.
This is a good description of the optimization loop. A job is more than its loop, though. Before the first step there is environment setup, model download and loading, and tokenization. During training there are periodic evaluations and checkpoint uploads. At the end, the final model goes to object storage. On a multi-tenant cluster, all of it competes with other jobs for network and storage I/O.
These overheads depend on configuration, and they do not scale neatly with workload or GPU count. Two jobs with the same nominal compute can finish hours apart.
To keep the comparison fair, the FLOP baseline we test counts the scheduled evaluation tokens as well as the training tokens, and we sweep MFU over a wide range.

What we built

We treat end-to-end duration as a supervised regression problem. Given a feature vector built from the job configuration and model metadata, predict the wall-clock time between the moment the job gets its GPUs and the moment it is done. Queue time is excluded.
Two design choices shaped the work:

Everything is known before dispatch. Every input comes from the submitted configuration: hyperparameters, dataset sizes, model identifiers, GPU allocation. No runtime logs, no partial progress. That is what makes the prediction usable for scheduling.
Features that expose the overheads. On top of the raw configuration we derive quantities such as num_eval_data (samples processed across all evaluation cycles), num_saves and num_params_saved (checkpoint I/O), and per-GPU token volumes. The FLOP estimate itself, with MFU fixed at 0.45, goes in as one more feature (baseline_time), so the model starts from the compute-only number and learns the corrections.

We compared Linear Regression, Ridge, XGBoost and CatBoost. Feature selection combined correlation filtering, mutual information and permutation importance across 18 candidate feature sets, followed by a grid search with MAE as the criterion. The final CatBoost model uses 24 features.

The data

272 SFT runs from the operational logs of a corporate production environment, covering several model families up to 15 billion parameters, both LoRA and full fine-tuning, and a wide range of dataset sizes and hyperparameters.
Shared infrastructure. Jobs ran on 1, 2 or 4 GPUs drawn from a pool of 8 to 32 H200s across 1 to 4 nodes, alongside other training and inference workloads. The measured times include real contention.
Durations from 1.6 to 172.4 hours, with a mean of 23.43 h and a median of 15.29 h.
Stack: Hugging Face Transformers and Unsloth. We model the stack as a categorical feature and make no assumption about a fixed speedup between the two.

Distribution of end-to-end duration across the 272 runs. Mean 23.43 h, median 15.29 h.

All numbers come from stratified 5-fold cross-validation. The first four rows are analytical and involve no fitting.

A few things stand out.
No single MFU value fixes the FLOP baseline. We swept MFU from 0.25 to 0.65. The best setting, 30%, still leaves a mean error above 12 hours on jobs that last 23 hours on average.
A more detailed analytical model does not close the gap. As a second baseline we took Calculon (Isaev et al., SC '23), an analytical performance model for LLM training from prior work. It builds an explicit layer graph and accounts for compute, memory traffic and inter-device communication. We extended the public implementation to cover LoRA, grouped-query attention, fused attention, bfloat16 and SwiGLU. Its estimates still correspond to a median of only 11% of the observed wall-clock time. That says nothing against Calculon as a step-level tool, which is what it was designed for. It shows how much of a production job happens outside the optimization step.
Linear models help, and then stall. Ridge brings MAE down to 7.23 h. The relationship between configuration and duration is not well captured by a purely linear model.
Gradient boosting does the heavy lifting. CatBoost and XGBoost land within one standard deviation of each other on every metric. We carry CatBoost forward because it has the lowest mean error across the board.

What the predictor relies on

CatBoost's feature importance concentrates in a handful of features. Model and workload variables are there, as expected, but so are evaluation and checkpoint variables. num_eval_data, the total number of samples processed in evaluation over the life of the job, ranks first, followed by num_trainable_params, batch_eval_size_percent, num_all_params and num_gpus*batch_train_percent, with num_params_saved close behind. SHAP values tell the same story: high evaluation volume consistently pushes the predicted time up, while trainable parameter count has a nonlinear effect that only becomes large for the biggest models.

Mean feature importance of the CatBoost model across folds (PredictionValuesChange).
Feature importance is not a causal claim. Still, the pattern lines up with how a job is actually spent. How often you evaluate, how large the evaluation set is and how many checkpoints you persist all shape the wall-clock time, alongside model and dataset scale. These are choices people often make by habit when writing a training config.
One caveat on reading the plots: larger GPU allocations show positive contributions to predicted time. In our data, bigger allocations go with bigger jobs, so num_gpus acts partly as a proxy for job scale. It does not mean adding GPUs makes a job slower.

How wrong is it, and where

Looking at all 272 out-of-fold predictions, the median absolute error is 0.51 h. 80% of predictions are within 2.20 h and 90% are within 4.31 h. Broken down by job duration:

Up to 60 hours, the median error stays at about one hour or less. The long tail is where the model struggles, and with only 13 runs above 60 hours we read that as a data limitation.

Out-of-fold absolute error against real duration, colored by duration range. Errors stay low up to 60 h and widen in the sparse tail.
More data should still help. On a fixed 20% holdout, MAE drops from 1.63 h to 1.50 h when going from 85% to 100% of the training partition, with no clear plateau.

What it is good for

In practice, the predictor gives a scheduler a duration it can plan around before a job starts: which jobs to run together, when GPUs will free up, and whether a run will finish in time for its deadline.

Limitations

SFT only. We did not include other training and alignment strategies such as RLHF, DPO or RLVR.
One GPU type. Every run used H200s. The fitted model is calibrated to that infrastructure and should not be expected to transfer numerically to other GPU generations without retraining. A predictor for mixed pools would also need hardware descriptors such as compute throughput, memory capacity and bandwidth, and interconnect topology.
Few very long runs. Errors widen above 60 hours.

What does transfer is the method: overhead-aware features, multicollinearity-aware selection and the comparison protocol. The full paper will report the feature formulas, the selection procedure, the search spaces and the final hyperparameters in full, so the pipeline can be rebuilt on any execution-log dataset with a similar structure.
Next on our list: hardware-specific descriptors and validation on other GPU types, transfer learning for configurations with few observations, other training objectives, and more data on long runs.

What's next

The full paper is coming to arXiv soon. Follow the Dharma-AI organization on Hugging Face to be notified when it is out, and leave your questions in the comments below. We would like to hear how you estimate job duration on your own clusters.

1dbejgk.title: В Counter-Strike 2 вернулась карта Cobblestone
1dbejgk.content:
Valve выпустила обновление для  Counter-Strike 2, которое добавило в игру одну из самых известных карт в серии — Cobblestone. Локация уже доступна в режимах «Обычный», «Соревновательный», «Напарники», «Бой насмерть» и «Зачистка». Вместе с ней в шутере появился специальный раздел, посвящённый турниру PGL Singapore Major 2026.Разработчики сохранили знакомые ветеранам места, но при этом внесли в карту немало изменений. Появились новые проходы и позиции, а некоторые участки стали просторнее. Знаменитый грузовик возле точки B немного переместили, из-за чего изменились привычные прострелы.Действие обновлённой Cobblestone разворачивается зимой. На открытых участках лежит тонкий слой снега, который хрустит под ногами. Следов персонажи не оставляют, зато огонь от коктейлей Молотова растапливает снег в месте попадания.Уже скоро — с 24 ноября по 13 декабря — пройдёт очередной мейджор по Counter-Strike 2, так что Valve подсуетилась и добавила раздел PGL Singapore 2026 Major Hub. В специальном магазине игроки могут приобрести пропуски зрителя и наклейки с автографами киберспортсменов. Компания учла пожелания сообщества и установила фиксированные цены на наклейки независимо от их типа: бумажные, фольгированные, голографические и золотые. Сувенирные наборы также можно будет создавать за фиксированную стоимость, которая зависит от редкости выбранного оружия.Обновление также исправляет несколько игровых ошибок. Теперь головы персонажей не должны слишком сильно опускаться при прицеливании под определённым углом. Кроме того, авторы устранили проблему с выдачей наборов сапёра в режиме «Зачистка». Боты за террористов теперь должны атаковать спецназовцев, которые пытаются обезвредить бомбу.Наконец, в CS2 добавили восемь новых музыкальных наборов от Monstercat. Одновременно с выходом патча из официального соревновательного пула временно убрали карты Boulder, Fachwerk и Shelter.Давить хрустящий снежок на легендарной Cobblestone в Counter-Strike 2 уже можно на ПК в Steam. Игра снабжена текстовым переводом на русский язык.

gn7qyg.title: В GTA 6 нельзя использовать читы до завершения основного сюжета - их активация блокирует дальнейший прогресс в игре
gn7qyg.content:
В Grand Theft Auto 6 чит-коды нельзя будет использовать до полного прохождения основной сюжетной кампании. Об этом стало известно после тестирования игры на сохранениях с разных этапов прохождения.
Это нововведение отличает шестую часть не только от предыдущих игр серии, но и от Red Dead Redemption 2. В последней примерно половина чит-кодов была доступна с самого начала, а остальные открывались после обнаружения определённых газет в игровом мире.
В GTA 6 разработчики пошли дальше: для получения доступа ко всем читам потребуется завершить сюжет, а затем выполнить дополнительные задания и испытания. Только после этого в меню появится ранее скрытая вкладка Читы. Она находится в конце списка и содержит несколько категорий, в каждой из которых собрано около десяти чит-кодов.

Для каждого из них предусмотрено описание эффекта, условия разблокировки и инструкция по активации. Как и в GTA 5, вводить коды предстоит через внутриигровой телефон, используя комбинации кнопок на геймпаде.
Однако есть ещё одно ограничение: активация любого чита отключает возможность сохранения игры, а также получение трофеев и достижений до завершения текущей игровой сессии.
Такое решение объясняется особенностями сюжетной кампании. Например, среди читов есть возможность получить крупную сумму денег — подобной популярной функции не было в GTA 5. Если бы игроки могли пользоваться ею во время прохождения, это могло бы нарушить баланс и последовательность развития истории, в которой для продвижения по сюжету требуется определённое количество средств.

lul9tw.title: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell с 84 ГБ памяти дебютировала в Японии, а в США стоит более $20 000 - дороже RTX PRO 6000
lul9tw.content:
Профессиональная видеокарта NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell Workstation Edition официально поступила на японский рынок. Авторизованный дистрибьютор Ryosan Ryoyo объявил о начале продаж 18 ноября, после того как информация о новинке появилась на его сайте ещё 30 октября. Для приобретения ускорителя покупателям необходимо связаться с отделом продаж компании.
RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell оснащена 21 760 ядрами CUDA и 84 ГБ памяти GDDR7 с поддержкой коррекции ошибок ECC. Для сравнения, старшая RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition располагает 24 064 ядрами CUDA и 96 ГБ GDDR7 ECC. Предельная мощность обеих моделей составляет 600 Вт.
В США RTX PRO 5500 может стоить дороже старшей RTX PRO 6000.
Ранее сообщалось, что компания SHI Government Solutions указывала рекомендованную цену видеокарты PNY RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell на уровне 17 999 долларов. Сейчас ускоритель представлен за 17 408,63 доллара с необходимостью уточнения наличия. При этом коммерческое подразделение SHI предлагает ту же модель за 20 238 долларов под заказ.

NVIDIA не указывает официальную рекомендованную цену RTX PRO 5500 на американском сайте, направляя покупателей к производителям готовых систем и дистрибьюторам.
Для сравнения, NVIDIA предлагает RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition за 16 000 долларов, что на 87% выше стоимости в 8 565 долларов, встречавшейся в первых американских розничных предложениях 2025 года. Официальная стартовая рекомендованная цена этой модели также не объявлялась.

В магазине Central Computers RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell производства PNY доступна за 14 999,99 доллара при условии одобрения покупки. Это примерно на 2 409 долларов дешевле государственного предложения SHI на RTX PRO 5500 и на 5 238 долларов ниже коммерческой цены модели с 84 ГБ памяти.
В Европе ситуация несколько отличается. Французский ретейлер LDLC предлагает OEM-версии RTX PRO 5500 и RTX PRO 6000 за 18 169,95 и 19 369,94 евро соответственно. Таким образом, младшая модель примерно на 1 200 евро дешевле старшей. Ожидаемый срок поступления обеих видеокарт превышает 15 дней.

fcfd1q.title: GTA 6 won't let you use cheats until you complete the main story, and locks progression when you do
fcfd1q.content:
Code red.

Image credit: Rockstar Games

Here's a twist: you can't use cheats in Grand Theft Auto 6 until you complete the entire game's main story.
That's what we discovered from our tests at least, after loading in saves at various points through the game to be sure, and it's also both a first for the series and a departure even from how developer Rockstar handled cheats in Red Dead Redemption 2. In that game,approximately half of the cheats were available from the off, and the other half required discovering specific newspapers from around the game's world to unlock.
In GTA 6, you'll again need to do some legwork. This time it appears that all of the game's cheats not only require you to finish the story, but also complete various tasks or challenges to unlock them.
The way it works is simple enough. Once you finish the main story, the "Cheats" tab - previously hidden - quietly appears at the far end of the Progress menu, accessible when you open the in-game map and scroll with the bumper buttons. From there, you can view various sub-sections of cheats, sorted by category, and a list of 10 or so cheats for each.With each cheat there'll be a short explanation of what it does, and what's required to unlock it and, once unlocked, guidance on how to perform it. This is done via whipping out your phone, holding down the shoulder buttons and using various D-Pad inputs - much the same as GTA 5.
There's also another caveat to bear in mind: when you use a cheat, you'll see a notification warning you that the game can't be saved while it's active, and that Trophies and Achievements are also disabled until you end that session. This makes sense, once you understand the nature of GTA 6's story - there is a cheat for giving yourself a load of money, for instance; another departure from GTA 5 where that popular cheat was removed - but given you'll need certain amounts of cash at various points of the story, enabling you to shortcut that would disrupt the way the narrative unfolds.
We'll have a guide from yours truly to all the game's cheats live on Eurogamer in the very near future, as the game releases here in the UK. In the meantime, if you find yourself on the fence about this one, be sure to give our GTA 6 review a look. As I put it there, giving the game five stars: it is "the most believable and unbelievable video game world ever made".

8emgzw.title: Water purification method turns old batteries into magnetic pollutant traps
8emgzw.content:
Waste-derived sustainable synthesis of ZnF-Ni magnetic nanoadsorbents. Credit: Advanced Sustainable Systems (2026). DOI: 10.1002/adsu.70704

How can harmful substances be removed from water? When it comes to dyes that cannot simply be filtered out, this is usually very laborious: You need substances to which the dyes attach, and then the water often has to be painstakingly centrifuged.

A method has now been developed at TU Wien that makes this much easier: The dyes are bound to magnetic materials and can then simply be removed with magnets. The particular highlight of the method is that the magnetic materials themselves come from waste that would otherwise require costly disposal—namely electronic waste and battery waste. The work is published in the journal Advanced Sustainable Systems.
Turning waste into a waste-removal technology
"The idea is to turn materials that are considered waste into something valuable," says professor Günther Rupprechter from the Institute of Materials Chemistry at TU Wien. "Spent batteries contain metals that are potentially harmful if disposed of improperly, but that can also be useful as building blocks for functional materials."
Zinc was recovered from spent alkaline batteries, nickel from spent nickel-metal hydride (Ni-MH) batteries and iron from rusty scrap iron. These metals were used to synthesize nanoparticles consisting either of pure zinc ferrite or of zinc ferrite combined with nickel-doped iron oxide.
These nanoparticles were then tested with Congo red, a synthetic organic dye that is frequently used as a model pollutant in wastewater research. Such dyes are difficult to remove because they have a stable molecular structure and are highly persistent in bodies of water.
The nanoparticles bind the dye molecules to their surface. The nickel-modified material ZnF-Ni showed a particular advantage: Thanks to its stronger magnetic properties, the pollutant-laden nanoparticles could be separated from the water much more quickly.
"For practical water treatment, the magnetic properties of the nanoparticles are just as important as their ability to bind pollutants," says Dr. Qaisar Maqbool, first author of the study. "By modifying the zinc ferrite with nickel, we obtained a material with significantly better magnetic properties. This allows us to recover the nanoparticles much faster—simply with magnets, without having to rely on centrifugation."

From laboratory experiment to practical application
In the laboratory at TU Wien, the entire removal and separation process took only about 5 to 15 minutes. The team also demonstrated the approach in a flow-through prototype: Contaminated water was pumped through a glass tube surrounded by an external neodymium magnet. This magnet held the magnetic nanoadsorbents against the tube wall while the purified water flowed on. Within 25 minutes, the water was visibly clarified, and the nanoparticles could be almost completely recovered.
"If the adsorbent is captured directly from the flowing suspension, complex separation procedures are no longer needed—this enables continuous water treatment," explains professor Michael Stöger-Pollach from TU Wien's electron microscopy center (USTEM), who investigated the local magnetic properties of the materials using electron magnetic circular dichroism (EMCD). Even the pollutant itself can be recovered and reused.
Future work will aim to improve the process further in order to increase the proportion of recovered materials. It is also important to ensure that the nanoparticles do not themselves release pollutants into the water. The method is to be tested with larger volumes of wastewater under realistic wastewater treatment conditions.

Publication details
Qaisar Maqbool et al., E‐Waste Derived Magnetic Nanoadsorbents for Sustainable Water Purification, Advanced Sustainable Systems (2026). DOI: 10.1002/adsu.70704

ry1bdb.title: How cells use alternative genetic instructions to produce 'shadowing proteins'
ry1bdb.content:
Predicted complex of the human ACG-initiated isoform (green) with out-of-frame products O (purple) and Q (orange). Credit: Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aek4290

The human genome contains tens of thousands of genes that provide instructions for making the proteins responsible for carrying out essential functions throughout the body. But those instructions may be more versatile than scientists once understood.

Katsura Asano, professor of biology at Kansas State University's Division of Biology, is studying how cells use alternative starting points within genetic instructions to produce additional proteins, as well as how those proteins can influence the activity of others.
His research team's latest work reveals another layer of regulation in how cells produce and use proteins, offering new insights into processes associated with cancer and neurodegenerative diseases. The findings are published in Science Advances.
Shadowing proteins
Typically, cells begin translating messenger RNA, which carries genetic instructions from DNA, at a specific three-letter sequence called a start codon. The most common start codon is AUG, which signals the cell's protein-making machinery where to begin.
However, translation can also begin at alternative locations using non-AUG start codons. This process, known as noncanonical translation, allows cells to produce additional proteins from the same messenger RNA molecule.
Asano's research examines how these additional proteins function and influence the proteins produced by conventional translation. Asano uses the term "shadowing proteins" to describe some of the additional proteins cells can produce through alternative translation.
Depending on where translation begins, these proteins can interact with conventional proteins and influence their activity, providing another layer of regulation within the cell.

A molecular balancing act
The team's latest research identified a sequence motif, a recurring pattern of genetic material, that helps promote translation at non-AUG start codons.
The motif, called NAT1, is a short, GC-rich sequence found near alternative starting points in messenger RNA. It helps the cell's protein-making machinery recognize these alternative starting points, allowing translation to begin where it otherwise might not.
The researchers also examined the role of a protein called 5MP, which helps regulate the accuracy of protein production by suppressing translation that begins at non-AUG start codons. Working alongside another regulatory factor, eIF1, 5MP helps keep this alternative translation in check, limiting the production of additional proteins that could influence conventional protein activity.
When that regulation is disrupted, proteins associated with cell growth and migration can become more active. Left uncontrolled, these processes often become important characteristics of cancer development and progression.
Understanding this relationship could help researchers better understand how changes in protein production contribute to cancer.
Asano and his team also found evidence that evolution has helped shape where this alternative translation occurs. Their analysis suggests that strong non-AUG translation sites have been selected against over time in mammals, limiting their presence in the human genome while preserving a smaller number of sites that may serve important biological functions.
The findings also could have implications beyond cancer biology. Asano pointed to repeat-associated non-AUG translation, a process in which unusually long stretches of repeated genetic sequences can lead to the production of abnormal proteins. This process has been associated with several neurodegenerative diseases, including certain forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS.
Asano's previous research has examined how 5MP can suppress alternative translation, raising questions about whether similar regulatory mechanisms could help scientists better understand repeat-associated protein production. Further research could shed light on the molecular processes involved in these diseases.

Pioneering research made possible through collaboration
The findings represent an international collaboration involving scientists in the United States, Japan and France, Asano said.
K‑State authors on the paper include postdoctoral researcher Susumu Ishiguro; doctoral candidates Grant Brooke and Abhineet Banerjee; and undergraduate students William Finane and Payton Henderson. Former lab members include research faculty member Chingakham Singh, exchange student Hitomi Yahi and undergraduate alumni Kinsley Ochsner, Keat Robinson, Hailey Casey, Grace Sakai, Megan Freeman and Anastasia Meyer.
Asano said the findings are part of a broader effort to understand a relatively unexplored area of biology. By studying how cells use alternative starting points to produce proteins, his team hopes to uncover additional mechanisms that influence cellular behavior.
"Noncanonical translation is not a major field yet, but this is going to be kind of a pioneering concept," he said.

Publication details
Haruyuki Furukawa et al., Evolutionarily reinforced GC-rich motif enables non-AUG translation in mammals under eIF1/5MP-mediated fidelity control, Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aek4290

xn9yos.title: Ubisoft начинает тестирование ремейка Heroes of Might and Magic 3
xn9yos.content:
Издательство Ubisoft сообщило о старте первого закрытого тестирования ремейка знаменитой пошаговой стратегии Heroes of Might and Magic 3. Проверить игру можно будет уже 18 ноября 2026 года на ПК,.
Авторы проекта намерены изучить реакцию аудитории, чтобы довести игру до ума перед релизом. В рамках тестирования специалисты проверят производительность игры и соберут пожелания по правкам баланса и геймплейных систем. Чтобы претендовать на инвайт, необходимо иметь профиль Ubisoft и клиент Ubisoft Connect, но сама по себе заявка не обеспечивает гарантированный доступ.
Также были опубликованы системные требования для тестовой сборки. Эти параметры позволят запустить игру со средним пресетом графики при разрешении 1080p и стабильных 60 FPS:

Операционная система: Windows 11 (64-разрядная)
Процессор: Intel Core i5-10600K или AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
Видеокарта: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 ГБ) или AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 ГБ)
Оперативная память: 16 ГБ
Место на диске: 45 ГБ на твердотельном накопителе (SSD)

Напомним, что после презентации в августе 2026 года ремейк Heroes of Might and Magic III вызвал бурное негодование среди преданных фанатов. Сообщество раскритиковало переход от привычной изометрии к трехмерной графике, спорный арт-дизайн, а также заподозрило авторов в использовании генеративного ИИ. Многие игроки уверены, что в Ubisoft не осознают истинной ценности оригинала 1999 года и своими экспериментами лишь навредят культовой классике.
Релиз Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake запланирован на 2027 год для ПК (Steam, Ubisoft Store и Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X|S.

19tex9t.title: «Уже знаю, во что буду играть завтра»: Devolver устроила бесплатную раздачу конкурента GTA VI для тех, кто удалит GTA VI
19tex9t.content:
Опрос

3DNews Новости Software Платформер «Уже знаю, во что буду играть завтра»: D...

реклама

Новости Software

Самое интересное в обзорах

18.11.2026 [21:40],

Олдскульный экшен-платформер Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed выйдет уже завтра, и разработчики из doinksoft (Gato Roboto, Dark Scrolls) при поддержке издателя Devolver Digital подготовили к релизу особый трейлер и не менее особую акцию.
Источник изображения: Devolver Digital

Напомним, Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed позиционируется Devolver Digital как конкурент горячо ожидаемого криминального боевика GTA VI от Rockstar Games, поэтому и выходит с ним в один день (хоть и на разных платформах).
На фоне этого нет ничего удивительного в том, что релизный трейлер Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed является откровенной пародией (и воспроизведением кадр в кадр) релизного трейлера GTA VI, вышедшего в середине октября.

Что касается акции, то Devolver предложила поучаствовать в раздаче бесплатной копии Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed. От желающих требуется прислать издателю видео с удалением предзагруженной версии GTA VI со своей консоли.
Пользователи оценили как возможность получить самый громкий ноябрьский релиз без дополнительной платы, так и пародию на трейлер GTA VI. «Уже знаю, во что буду играть завтра. Может, даже отпрошусь с работы», — поделился D4rkNRG.
Желающие получить Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed бесплатно не заставили себя долго ждать (источник изображения: linus в X)

Игрокам в роли придуманного Devolver в 2023 году крысёныша Вольви с огромной правой рукой предстоит пробиться через четыре мира и дать бой грозным боссам. Заявлена поддержка русского языка.

Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed поступит в продажу 19 ноября эксклюзивно для Steam (180 рублей в российском сегменте с учётом релизной скидки), тогда как GTA VI в тот же день стартует на PS5, Xbox Series X и S по цене от $80.

1q0ph6z.title: GTA 6 Clear Skies Mission Walkthrough
1q0ph6z.content: Clear Skies is the fifteenth mission of this GTA 6 walkthrough. In this guide, we’ll explain everything you need to know about the Clear Skies mission, highlight any collectables, and explain any choices that can be made as part of the mission.Clear Skies sees Jason and Donnie meet with The Final Chapter to broker a deal for some of Donnie’s preferred substances.If you’re playing through GTA 6, and you’re keen to find out more, check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub. Here you’ll find a walkthrough-in-progress, which covers the entire game, and much more.While we’ll eventually add every mission to our complete walkthrough of GTA 6, we’re striving to avoid spoilers as much as possible. As such, we’ll be describing the playable elements of these missions, while totally avoiding (where possible) any cutscene spoilers that we can.Once Lucia has been released from jail and you have access to both playable characters, many missions in GTA 6 can be accessed at the same time. For the sake of this GTA 6 walkthrough, we’ve listed the missions in the order that they appear in the in-game story recap.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Clear Skies WalkthroughTo start the Clear Skies mission, chat to Donnie, who will tell you to go speak to Brian at the bar. After that, you’ll go back to Donnie’s plane and taxi it into the river.Fly to the intercept point, at which point Pilot Pete will appear. Catch up with Pilot Pete, who will be flying close to the ground. At this point, you’ll escort Pete to the landing strip with Donnie. Once you’ve done this, you’ll fly to the next airstrip and land there. There’s a failstate here if you destroy the plane, so be careful when landing.Once you’ve landed, you’ll be told to taxi the plane, and then follow Donnie towards a drug deal with The Final Chapter. As you could probably tell from the vibe of the deal, it’s about to go wrong. Donnie is kidnapped, and it’s your mission to find him.The Final Chapter will swarm you, and attempt to flank round the ride of your cover, so take them out quickly. Once they’re dead, head to the left and bash through the door to find Donnie. Work your way through the buildings that are on the landing strip, many of which have Final Chapter members lurking in them.Your job is now to Rescue Donnie Again. He’ll be held by some Final Chapter members in the hanger, make sure to kill the ones attacking Donnie before he is killed, or this will fail the mission.Rescue Donnie, and escape. As you leave the airstrip you’ll be tasked with holding off The Final Chapter, as more and more members appear. Grab a bike and catch up to Donnie, who will escape on the plane. Race away from the airstrip, and take down the Final Chapter members that chase you. Eventually you’ll meet Donnie at a riverbank.After you finish this segment of the mission, you’ll be taken back home. Once you’re home, speak to Lucia, and you’ll help her build a coffee table. This segment involves a short QTE, after which the mission will end.That’s the complete walkthrough of Clear Skies in GTA 6.

1haxqe1.title: Дженсен Хуанг: «Я могу вернуться в NVIDIA, если меня позовут обратно»
1haxqe1.content:
На прошлой неделе игровую индустрию потрясла новость об отставке Дженсена Хуанга (Jensen Huang) с поста генерального директора NVIDIA, на котором тот находился на протяжении 33 лет. Спустя несколько дней после произошедшего Хуанг опубликовал официальное обращение в социальных сетях и заявил, что может вернуться в компанию, если совет директоров посчитает его достойным.В своём письме Хуанг выразил благодарность друзьям и коллегам за поддержку, в очередной раз признался в любви к основанной им компании и принёс извинения за свои оплошности, которые и повлекли за собой его увольнение. В настоящее время Хуанг продолжает сотрудничать с внутренним расследованием NVIDIA, инициированным советом директоров с целью убедиться, что их корпоративным тайнам ничего не угрожает.
За последнюю неделю я был поражён любовью и поддержкой со стороны друзей, коллег по индустрии и людей, которых я даже никогда не встречал. Спасибо всем, кто проявил доброту по отношению ко мне и моей семье. Для меня это очень важно.Я приехал в Соединённые Штаты 53 года назад, и получение американского гражданства стало для меня одним из величайших подарков и моментов гордости. NVIDIA — дело всей моей жизни. Для меня было честью и привилегией вместе с коллегами превратить компанию в то, чем она является сегодня. Нигде, кроме Америки, не могла бы появиться такая компания, как NVIDIA. Я люблю нашу страну и люблю NVIDIA.Я не соответствовал стандартам, которые предъявляются ко всем сотрудникам NVIDIA, совершил серьёзные ошибки в личной жизни и создал проблемы для всего совета директоров, о чём глубоко сожалею. Я полностью признаю свои проступки и готов сотрудничать с советом в рамках независимого расследования.После моего ухода я получил множество звонков от сотрудников, инвесторов, деловых партнёров и клиентов NVIDIA с просьбой вернуться на пост генерального директора. Многие продолжают обращаться ко мне напрямую, пока компания преодолевает трудности, связанные с технологиями, рынком, конкуренцией и геополитической ситуацией. NVIDIA — компания, которая появляется раз в поколение. Если совет директоров решит, что моё возвращение отвечает интересам наших акционеров, сотрудников, самой компании и Америки, то я с радостью отвечу на их зов и вернусь на пост генерального директора.Ещё раз спасибо всем, кто поделился своими добрыми пожеланиями. Я глубоко признателен вам за поддержку. Моей семье: я люблю вас и всю оставшуюся жизнь буду стараться быть достойным вас.Дженсен Хуанг
Заявление Хуанга прозвучало после того, как стало известно, что 1 декабря он выступит перед Конгрессом США в связи с его романом с подозреваемой в шпионаже Элис Хуанг (Alice Huang). Что касается самой NVIDIA, то сейчас компанией временно руководит вице-президент и финансовый директор Колетт Кресс (Colette Kress). Её ответ не заставил себя долго ждать — в ходе интервью Джиму Крамеру (Jim Cramer) на канале CNBC Кресс заявила, что компания не намерена возвращать Хуанга.

1pjk9xk.title: Стриптиз-клубы в GTA 6 показали в свежих роликах — с эротическими танцами и полуголыми девушками
1pjk9xk.content:
Обложка: GTA 6Первые игроки Grand Theft Auto VI, прошедшие первые миссии и получившие возможность изучать открытый мир, направились в том числе… да, в бары и стриптиз-клубы.
И в сети уже появились первые ролики, демонстрирующие контент подобных заведений. Например, небольшие ролики снизу демонстрируют, где именно на карте находятся места для любителей поразвлечься.
В видео ниже показан интерьер роскошного стрип-клуба Nine1Nine.А в этом ролике показано положение на карте трёх стриптиз-клубов Вайс-Сити:

уже известный нам Nine1Nine (или 919);
Jack of Hearts («Червовый валет») с фокусом на хип-хопе;
небольшой и бюджетный клуб Delights Cabaret.

Если же вам хочется внимательнее оценить убранство стрип-клуба, предлагаем продолжительное видео изнутри Nine1Nine (при этом само заведение показано в течение первых 10 минут).
Ниже ролик с полуголым Джейсоном и ещё более обнажёнными красавицами, готовыми задорно танцевать — в том числе наедине — под зажигательную музыку.
GTA 6 уже доступна в Новой Зеландии и других восточных регионах (где уже наступила полночь 19 ноября) на PS5 и Xbox Series. Версия для PC, по старым слухам, ожидается не раньше начала 2027 года. Впрочем, вряд ли это произойдёт в ближайшие месяцы.
При этом GTA 6 претендует на 8 наград на The Game Awards 2026 — в том числе на награду «Игра года».
