Для каждого инцидента укажи: вероятная причина, затронутый модуль, критичность (Critical/High/Medium/Low).Лог: [вставить лог]Метрики эффективностиСокращение ложных срабатываний на 60–70% (фильтрация микроизменений и временных ошибок).Ускорение анализа журналов на 30–50% (группирование схожих ошибок, автоматический отчёт по критичным сценариям).Повышение точности выявления дефектов API с 76% до 90% (семантический анализ вместо поверхностного сравнения строк).Снижение длительности визуального тестирования на 30–40% (компьютерное зрение вместо ручного сравнения скриншотов).ИИ, подобно тройному стражу Империума, защищает системы от трёх типов угроз: ложные тревоги (отсеивает шумы в журналах), скрытые дефе

8vxl0x.title: RTX-ремастер Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines Alpha 0.0.3 обновил восемь локаций, включая легендарный Ocean House
8vxl0x.content:
Ранее на этой неделе, в день 22-й годовщины выхода оригинальной игры, моддер Safemilk выпустил новое обновление и трейлер проекта Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines – RTX Remaster.

Проект, созданный на базе технологии NVIDIA RTX Remix, представляет собой попытку провести «поэлементный ремастер Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines с полностью переработанными моделями, текстурами и освещением». Это подразумевает использование полноценной трассировки путей (Path Tracing), поддержку практически всех технологий NVIDIA DLSS и многое другое.
По теме: NVIDIA RTX Remix изначально создавалась для старых игр с фиксированным графическим конвейером, однако моддеры уже смогли добавить трассировку путей в Dark Souls и Fallout 4.
Впервые проект был анонсирован в марте 2024 года, вскоре после выхода открытой бета-версии RTX Remix. Как это часто бывает с подобными модификациями, разработка продвигается довольно медленно, однако представленные кадры показывают, что ремастер постепенно приобретает законченный вид. В альфа-версии 0.0.3 были переработаны следующие локации:
Спойлер

sm_oceanhouse_1 — практически всё, за исключением нескольких объектов окружения.
sm_oceanhouse_2 — практически всё, за исключением нескольких объектов окружения и текстур.
sm_tatoo_1 — набор текстур для стен, пола и потолка верхнего этажа.
sm_basement_1 — тестовые варианты стен и пола, а также этап переработки освещения.
sm_pier_1 — множество объектов окружения и текстур снаружи игровых автоматов и ипподрома.
sm_hub_1 — множество небольших элементов центральной локации, включая вывески и тестовые варианты фасадов некоторых зданий.
la_hub_1 — различные тестовые варианты фасадов зданий, несколько объектов окружения и отдельные этапы настройки освещения.
la_crackhouse_1 — стены, пол, потолок и переработанное освещение. Объекты окружения пока отсутствуют.

Особенно впечатляюще выглядит отель Ocean House — пожалуй, самая знаковая локация во всей Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines. Благодаря технологии RTX Remix он выглядит лучше, чем когда-либо прежде.
Vampire the Masquerade: Bloodlines – RTX Remaster — The Dead of Autumn 0.0.3 Update
К сожалению, прежде чем моддер сможет приступить к ремастерингу остальных областей игры, ему необходимо решить проблему постоянно увеличивающегося размера файлов проекта и создать полноценный установщик. Это может привести к некоторому замедлению разработки в ближайшее время.
Тем не менее Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines – RTX Remaster стал ещё одним примером процветающего сообщества моддеров RTX Remix. Всего несколькими днями ранее состоялись первые публичные релизы RTX-ремастеров Dark Souls и Fallout 4. Пожалуй, лучшего времени для возвращения к старым играм ещё не было.

kxusn1.title: Роджер Крейг Смит предупредил актёров GTA 6 о внезапной славе: к мировой известности нужно быть готовыми
kxusn1.content:
Роджер Крейг Смит, известный по озвучке Соника, Эцио из Assassin’s Creed и Криса Редфилда из Resident Evil, поделился советом с актёрами, которым предстоит исполнить главные роли в Grand Theft Auto 6. По его мнению, им стоит приготовиться к совершенно новому уровню внимания со стороны публики: после официального объявления их имена моментально станут известны миллионам игроков.
В интервью PCGamesN актёр рассказал, что популярность крупной игровой серии способна кардинально изменить жизнь исполнителей. Поклонники начнут следить за их социальными сетями, интересоваться личными увлечениями и искать возможности встретиться лично. Некоторые будут приносить копии игры, чтобы получить автограф. Сам Смит хорошо знаком с подобным вниманием, хотя признаётся, что когда-то даже не мог представить, насколько необычным окажется этот опыт.
В качестве примера он вспомнил реакцию поклонников на первый трейлер GTA 6. Некоторые зрители решили, что узнали его голос или внешность, и спрашивали, действительно ли он участвует в проекте. Смиту приходилось объяснять, что к игре Rockstar он отношения не имеет.
Главный совет, который актёр хотел бы дать своим коллегам, довольно прост: наслаждаться происходящим. По его словам, индустрия развлечений устроена так, что публика быстро переключается с уже достигнутого успеха на вопрос о следующих проектах. Поэтому важно не забывать ценить момент, пока внимание приковано именно к тебе.
При этом Смит не считает себя человеком, который знает универсальный рецепт успеха. Несмотря на внушительный список ролей, он подчеркнул, что сам до сих пор не всегда понимает, как оказался там, где находится сейчас, и каждый актёр проходит собственный путь.
Личности исполнителей главных ролей GTA 6 пока раскрыты не полностью. Однако Манни Л. Перес, которой приписывают роль Люсии, уже получила номинацию на The Game Awards в категории за лучшую актёрскую работу. С выходом игры внимание к ней и другим участникам проекта наверняка возрастёт, а советы Смита могут оказаться особенно актуальными для тех, кому предстоит впервые столкнуться с мировой известностью.

1m9n7z7.title: «Ъ»: МТС и VisionLabs столкнулись с прекращением услуг по разметке данных от «Яндекса»
1m9n7z7.content: Время чтения2 минОхват и читатели2.1KПост«Яндекс» объявил о приостановке оказания услуг «Яндекс Заданий» по разметке данных под ключ для внешних заказчиков. С этим столкнулись «дочки» МТС MWS AI и VisionLabs. Об этом пишет «Ъ» со ссылкой на источник, знакомый с официальным уведомлением, которое «Яндекс» направил партнёрам. В уведомлении компания ссылается на переориентацию на «внутренние потребности».О расторжении договоров по предоставлению услуг по разметке данных «Яндексом» сообщила и руководительница центра работы с данными MWS AI (МТС) Анна Дружкина. Она заявила, что на их бизнес‑процессы это событие никак не повлияет. «У нас настроена разметка ключевых проектов внутри компании», — добавила она.«Яндекс Крауд» прекратил предоставлять услуги по разметке данных под ключ, также рассказал гендиректор VisionLabs Дмитрий Марков. По его словам, прямой доступ к самозанятым на площадке у его компании остаётся, однако задачи по подготовке проекта, обучению разметчиков, созданию ловушек для проверки самозанятых, контролю качества, которые раньше «Яндекс Крауд» брал на себя по договору, теперь заказчикам придётся решать самостоятельно.Пресс‑служба «Яндекса» заявила, что не приостанавливает разметку данных для внешних заказчиков и продолжает развивать это направления. «За последние несколько лет объёмы разметки ежегодно удваивались, росли бюджеты и количество задач. Также автоматизируются рутинные процессы, развивается экспертная работа в поддержке, тестировании, дизайне и локализации», — добавили в компании.Договоры с конкретными компаниями могли приостановить из‑за дефицита вычислительных мощностей и инженерных ресурсов, которые перенаправляют на более приоритетные направления, считают собеседники «Ъ». Также это может быть связано с постепенным замещением ручной разметки данных алгоритмами.Ситуация, вероятно, связана с нехваткой промышленных мощностей для выпуска качественных данных, отмечает независимый эксперт в сфере ИИ и IT Алексей Лерон. «Яндексу» выгоднее направить ресурсы на развитие собственных моделей, для которых потребность в разметке данных растёт, добавил старший инвестиционный менеджер Kama Flow Илья Меркулов. Рынок таких услуг для внешних заказчиков, вероятно, слишком мал в масштабах «Яндекса», предположил эксперт.Так как российские разработчики LLM пока догоняют мировых лидеров, им экономически выгоднее делать ставку на синтетические данные, а не на массовую ручную разметку, считает гендиректор и основатель Nodul Александр Данилов. По его словам, всё больше ценятся не тысячи разметчиков, а небольшие команды экспертов по оценке качества.

1n8805v.title: Фанаты GTA 6 раскритиковали Rockstar за привязку части сюжетного контента к подписке GTA Plus
1n8805v.content:
Rockstar Games распространила действие платной подписки GTA Plus на одиночную кампанию Grand Theft Auto 6. Решение закрыть часть внутриигрового контента за ежемесячным платежом ($7,99 в США) уже вызвало волну критики в сообществе.
После прохождения третьей главы активным подписчикам, часть из которых получила первый месяц бесплатно за предзаказ, открываются эксклюзивные награды. В их числе спорткар 90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy в уникальном обвесе Widebody и частный гараж в районе Кростаун (Crosstown), оборудованный оружейным сейфом и точкой сбыта краденого.
Кроме того, подписка дает бонусы в сервисах Scooter Bros и RydeMe, бесплатный проезд на общественном транспорте по штату Леонида, а также свободную аренду велосипедов, скутеров и гидроциклов Seashark. Дополнительно игроки получают 10-процентную скидку в оружейных, магазинах одежды, барбершопах, тату-салонах и автомастерских, а также наценку в 10% при продаже некоторых личных авто.
Доступ к привилегиям жестко привязан к активной подписке: при ее отмене игрок теряет и гараж, и машину, и все остальные бонусы. При необходимости их можно отключить вручную в меню паузы, перейдя во вкладку аккаунта и выбрав пункт GTA Plus Boosts.
На Reddit решение спрятать транспорт и недвижимость в сюжетной кампании за ежемесячным пейволлом встретили жесткой критикой — тем более что подписку придется оплачивать даже покупателям самых дорогих изданий GTA 6. Кроме того, фанаты опасаются, что после релиза новой GTA Online монетизация станет еще агрессивнее.

14atswe.title: Владимир Пресняков поздравил свою маму с помощью Басты
14atswe.content: 2026, «Спасибо, послушаю».Андрей Васильев вместе с соавтором сценария Петром Полещуком в этом выпуске не только вспоминают историю «Мумий Тролля», но и пытаются объяснить его феномен. Местами, как утверждение в заголовке, это звучит спорно, но в целом довольно любопытно. Ведущий «Спасибо, послушаю» сначала цитирует негативные отклики Егора Летова и Юрия Шевчука на творчество Ильи Лагутенко, а потом напоминает, откуда на 2-тысячной купюре взялся Владивосток. Заодно, для совсем уж далёких от контекста зрителей, он углубляется в доисторическую биографию «МТ», которого в родном городе узнали лет на 14 раньше, чем в остальной стране.Уже тогда песни Ильи Лагутенко отличались лёгкостью и беспафосностью (что нехарактерно для подростков) и уже тогда в нём можно было разглядеть прирождённого шоумена. Самое удивительное – что этот вальяжный и вместе с тем жизнерадостный подход Илья Игоревич сохранил, когда уже взрослым человеком (ему было под 30) записывал в Лондоне альбом «Морская» - тот самый, что изменил русский рок и всё такое. Песни «МТ» звучали странно и ни на что не похоже. Нет, ну отчасти они были вдохновлены группами Suede, Pulp и прочим брит-попом, но списано было не точь-в-точь. И такой музыки на русском языке почти не было: здесь привыкли к тяжеловесным рок-страданиям, а не к витальным кривляниям, отчего андрогинный фронтмен с улыбкой Чеширского кота и удостоился критики от титанов русского рока. Вместо кальки с брит-попа «Мумий Тролль» предложил манящую адаптацию: по мнению «Спасибо, послушаю», зритель получал удовольствие не от смысла песен, а от сокрытия такового за затейливыми абстрактными образами. Лагутенко смущал внешним видом, стилистикой, текстами, интонацией – но всё это оказалось невероятно притягательным для публики. Чтобы люди не мучились над вопросом, это рок или поп, Илья играючи вбросил термин «рокапопс», открыв, кстати, дорогу десяткам подражателей. (Никто из них успеха «Мумий Тролля» не повторил.)«МТ» ещё в конце 90-х играл музыку для «верхнего среднего класса», которого в стране тогда почти не было. Он появился лет через десять, но Лагутенко, создав ещё несколько гиперхитов, по обыкновению не стал подстраиваться под ожидания публики, а ушёл в экспериментальную электронику, создание сайд-проектов и организацию фестивалей во Владивостоке. После 2020 года «Мумий Тролль» альбомов не выпускал: Илья адекватно воспринимает невозможность повторить «мумийтроллеманию», к тому же минимальная активность музыканта представляется довольно точной реакцией на нынешнее трагическое время.Алексей Мажаев, ИнтерМедиа

m31cnu.title: Rockstar: 60 fps в GTA VI невозможны из-за количества симуляций и нагрузки на процессор — Железо на DTF
m31cnu.content: Разработчики подтвердили выводы Digital Foundry. GTA VI работает в 30 fps на всех консолях — в том числе с просадками, которых меньше всего на PS5 Pro.В техническом обзоре специалисты Digital Foundry выразили мнение, что режим 60 fps был бы невозможен без компромиссов. Например, вряд ли Rockstar смогла бы реализовать физику волос всех NPC и такие детальные цепные реакции персонажей.В разговоре с Kotaku директор по производству технологий Марк Чемберс подтвердил, что Rockstar использует максимум из возможностей существующих консолей.На базовых консолях мы используем глобальное освещение и отражения на основе рейтрейсинга. На PS5 Pro также добавлены RT-тени и картинка на основе PSSR. Мы задействуем более мощный графический процессор консоли для улучшенной картинки, но поскольку центральный процессор PS5 Pro немногим мощнее, чем в PS5, его недостаточно для сложных симуляций с высоким fps. Марк Чемберс, директор по производству технологийКоманда Digital Foundry ещё до релиза предположила, что для 60 fps в GTA VI на ПК также потребуется достаточно мощный процессор. Частота кадров в такой системно сложной игре явно будет определена им, а не видеочипом.Лучшая версия игры — на PS5 Pro: технические подробности GTA VI на PlayStation от Digital Foundry Режим производительности был бы невозможен, считают эксперты.

xu68bm.title: 'The Altruists' Review: Netflix Sam Bankman-Fried Series Disappoints
xu68bm.content:
The collapse of cryptocurrency exchange FTX in 2022 — a spectacular implosion that saw the company evaporate and sent founder Sam Bankman-Fried to prison, along with much of his inner circle — felt epic in the moment. But compared to the frenzy around artificial intelligence that was soon to come, even the Shakespearean downfall of a corporation that could once casually spend nine figures on stadium naming rights feels like a footnote in the intertwined history of technology and finance. The crypto boom now occupies an awkward middle space in the recent arc of the tech industry: After the Obama-era idealism of Facebook, Twitter and other companies that promised to connect the world for the better and before the full-on dystopian rhetoric of post-human labor and a “permanent underclass.”

The Netflix limited series “The Altruists,” created by Graham Moore (the Oscar-winning screenwriter of “The Imitation Game”) and produced by the Obamas’ shingle Higher Ground, is aware of this gap. “AI is hotter than crypto’s ever been right now,” one character observes in the finale as FTX’s house of cards starts to fall. (Marquee frontier lab and FTX investee Anthropic even makes a cameo.) “The Altruists” could theoretically use our rapidly fading cultural memory to its advantage, dusting off the Bankman-Fried story to deliver a character study that pushes past tabloid headlines about polycules and party mansions to make sense of what happened and a case for why it mattered.

Instead, “The Altruists” opts for the most conventional, least persuasive lens through which to explain the significance of FTX as well as what went wrong: the on-and-off romance between Bankman-Fried (Irish actor Anthony Boyle) and Caroline Ellison (Julia Garner, also an executive producer), the former head of FTX-affiliated hedge fund Alameda Research. The action toggles back and forth between two timelines: the early days of Sam, Caroline and their companies and their swift demise five years later, forecasted in a standard flash-forward to the FBI storming the office.

The erstwhile couple make a certain sense as the show’s focus. They’re a handy metaphor for the messy, inappropriate relationship between their two companies, which culminated in FTX’s use of billions in customer money to cover for Alameda’s trading losses. And, of course, there are salacious details like Ellison’s X-rated “Harry Potter” fanfiction — the kind of low-hanging fruit a writer would have to be foolish to leave on the vine. Sex still sells, even when the sex in question is between socially awkward math geeks whose idea of foreplay is strategic board games.

But “The Altruists,” which works from a series of New York magazine articles by Kevin T. Dugan and Jen Wieczner as its source material, makes Sam and Caroline strangely simplistic, both as individual personalities and larger cultural forces. It starts with the casting: Boyle is a strong actor with a bright future ahead of him; the onetime face of a brash IRA revolutionary in “Say Nothing” is nonetheless an awkward fit for a noted oddball like Bankman-Fried, and Boyle never disappears into the role. His SBF — the boy billionaire’s popular nickname — is motormouthed and visibly anxious, yet the scripts elide some of his strangest tics, like taking interviews while playing video games or sleeping on the office floor. (The bean bag habit is alluded to in dialogue, yet never shown. An odd choice for a visual medium!) Boyle’s performance comes off more like the Mark Zuckerberg of “The Social Network,” a disaffected yet basically relatable nerd who craves validation, than the Mark Zuckerberg of “The Social Reckoning,” a space alien whose inability to grasp human nature has warped the world in his image.

Garner, for her part, dials up Ellison’s tics into a near-caricature of a four-eyed poindexter. Pre-arrest footage of Ellison, who would go on to cooperate extensively with SBF’s prosecutors, shows the same nervous laughter that Garner accurately mimics, but a much more calm and even speaking voice. Amping up an accent and donning a wig are old hat for the star of “Inventing Anna,” another frustrating Netflix project that captured its subject’s eccentricity without delving into their deeper psychology. Were “The Altruists” more of a straight-up satire in tone, Garner’s caricature might work in context. Instead, isolated moments of humor — upon finding out about the fraud, one FTX employee is mad because he’s been urging them to break the law for years and feels excluded — are left to float in an otherwise sincere story of misguided puppy love. (In a striking detail seemingly invented for the show, Caroline is the first woman Sam ever sleeps with.) Perhaps Moore and co-showrunner Jacqueline Hoyt were worried about crossing over into gleeful cruelty. But if perpetrators of a multibillion dollar fraud don’t deserve some mockery, who does?

Sam and Caroline are initially drawn together as young analysts at the Wall Street firm Jane Street Capital by their mutual interest in effective altruism, the “earn to give” movement that gives “The Altruists” its name. (Characters affiliated with EA are frequently identified by their branded T-shirts.) The two encourage each other’s most dangerous instincts, like going all in on every bet because it’s “mathematically optimal” or refusing to communicate discomfort around Sam’s autocratic tendencies or Caroline’s polyamory. The plot frames Sam and Caroline’s slide into criminality as the slow corruption of self-identified “good guys,” though the show is strangely uncritical of the starting premise that the best way to make positive change in the world is by amassing a personal fortune.

For all EA comes into focus, cryptocurrency itself remains stubbornly obscure. It’s not easy to mine drama from complex financial instruments, but “The Altruists” puts frustratingly little effort into explaining the water these crazy kids are swimming in. Without a more defined sense of what makes crypto unique, “The Altruists” is left with a faint rehash of the techno-optimism-gone-awry narrative already explored in series like “The Dropout,” “Super Pumped” and “WeCrashed,” which tellingly dropped within weeks of each other in 2022 (and just a few months before FTX flamed out). Those three titles collectively worked to capture a specific time and place; with its personal focus, “The Altruists” never does the same.

“The Altruists” even gestures at more productive angles on the whole FTX affair than the folie a deux of Sam and Caroline. Potential framing devices, like a Bloomberg reporter’s investigation, are flirted with and abandoned. Nishad Singh (Karan Soni), SBF’s childhood friend turned employee, tells us that Sam’s Stanford Law professor parents Joe (Paul Reiser) and Barbara (Robin Weigert) are the skeleton key to his need to prove himself. “They already love you,” Nishad says of the scholars. “They just don’t fucking like you.” It’s a great line, just not one backed up in any way by the show’s portrayal of that relationship, which is fairly minimal and fails to lay the groundwork for head-scratching decisions like Joe and Barbara’s total credulity toward their son, both before and after his arrest.

It’s not like “The Altruists” lacks time to explore the Bankman-Fried household dynamics. (The resources to convincingly render far-flung locations like Macau and Malta do, however, seem scarce.) At eight hourlong episodes, “The Altruists” is padded out with detours into Nishad’s office romance and the backstory of SBF’s college pal Sam Trabucco (Alex Lawther), who left FTX before things hit the fan. The space would be far better spent building out the crypto universe, shading in Sam and Caroline outside one another’s orbit or even outlandish incidents like FTX’s Larry David-starring Super Bowl ad. Without a stronger center, though, these satellite plots feel like they’re orbiting a vacuum.

All eight episodes of “The Altruists” are now streaming on Netflix.

1irhlaq.title: Anthropic провела крупнейшее IPO в истории
1irhlaq.content: Время чтения3 минОхват и читатели2.5KПостКомпания Anthropic установила цену своего IPO на уровне $83 за акцию — выше первоначального диапазона в $70–78. Это свидетельствует о высоком интересе инвесторов к одной из ключевых компаний в сфере бума искусственного интеллекта, несмотря на рыночную нестабильность, возникшую после ухода генерального директора Nvidia Дженсена Хуанга. В ходе размещения разработчик чат‑бота Claude продал 980 млн акций вместо изначально запланированных 825 млн, выручив $81,3 млрд. Таким образом, это IPO стало крупнейшим в истории по объему привлечённых средств, превзойдя рекорд SpaceX в $75 млрд.Исходя из цены размещения, оценка Anthropic составляет примерно $1,5 трлн. Это значительно выше показателя в $965 млрд, зафиксированного в мае в ходе последнего раунда частного финансирования, когда компания привлекла $65 млрд, однако ниже отметки в $2 трлн, на которую, по сообщениям, компания рассчитывала несколько месяцев назад.Anthropic начнёт торги на бирже Nasdaq под тикером «ANT». Ожидается, что результаты компании зададут ориентиры для других частных ИИ‑фирм, включая главного конкурента — OpenAI. Последняя, ​​по имеющимся данным, оценивалась в $1,25 млрд, однако пока не объявляла о планах выхода на биржу.Хотя ни один из венчурных инвесторов Anthropic не владеет долей более 5%, для многих из них это IPO стало источником огромной прибыли. Среди инвесторов, владеющих примерно 1% акций, называют фонд Sequoia и бывшего генерального директора Google Эрика Шмидта. По словам источника, около 1% компании также принадлежит сингапурскому суверенному фонду GIC. Среди других инвесторов, которые могут заработать миллиарды, — Iconiq, Menlo Ventures, Coatue и Sound Ventures (фонд, основанный Гаем Осеари и актёром Эштоном Катчером). Компания Spark Capital — единственный венчурный фонд, представленный в совете директоров Anthropic. Он был первым институциональным инвестором компании и возглавил раунд финансирования серии C на сумму $450 млн в 2023 году, в ходе которого Anthropic была оценена в $4,5 млрд.Некоторые из действующих инвесторов Anthropic — Sequoia, Iconiq, Lightspeed, Accel и Altimeter Capital Management — настолько уверены в будущем компании, что, по имеющимся данным, планируют приобрести её акции на миллиарды долларов в ходе IPO.Впрочем, доли этих инвесторов меркнут по сравнению с долями стратегических партнеров Anthropic: Amazon владеет почти 15% компании, а Google — около 14%. Кроме того, группа крупных технологических компаний, в которую входят AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia и TSMC, договорилась о покупке акций без права голоса на сумму $26 млрд в рамках частного размещения, проводимого параллельно с IPO. Согласно форме S-1, каждый из семи соучредителей Anthropic, включая генерального директора Дарио Амодеи, продал в ходе IPO около 3,4 млн акций, выручив примерно по $282 млн.Ранее СМИ писали, что в проспекте эмиссии для IPO Anthropic компания сделала масштабную ставку на масштабное преобразование мировой экономики с помощью искусственного интеллекта. В 2025 году чистый убыток Anthropic составил $42 млрд, а в ближайшие годы компания планирует потратить $518 млрд на облачные сервисы, вычислительные мощности и развитие инфраструктуры. В документе подробно описывался стремительный рост компании за последний год, сопровождавшийся при этом увеличением убытков.

1tgc2lf.title: Hearst Canvas Launches Frontier Collective Brand for Adventurers
1tgc2lf.content:
Hearst Canvas, the creator-led media arm of U.K.-based Hearst Networks, has launched its latest digital native brand with Frontier Collective, an effort to harness the YouTube and social media followings of top outdoor adventure content creators.

The effort has quietly bowed over the past few weeks starting with a roundtable-style talk show, “Expedition HQ,” featuring four prominent U.K. explorers at the core of Frontier Collective: Aldo Kane, Alex Bescoby, Levison Wood and Lucy Shepherd. The foursome come together swap stories about explorations and derring-do in their efforts to explore the natural world and far-flung exotic locales. “Expedition HQ” bowed Nov. 1 on the Frontier Collective YouTube channel, with new episodes released weekly. Clips are spread widely around Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat.

Hearst Canvas hopes to tap into the heat of the adventure content community on YouTube. The Hearst Canvas division is set up to find top-tier creators who can contribute to strong verticals as Hearst Networks develops new content and formats designed to roll out on YouTube. Dean Possenniskie, managing director, Hearst Networks, Europe, Middle East and Africa and managing director Hearst Networks U.K., is overseeing the Canvas venture that was launched in October 2025.

“We’ve now built a dedicated creative team that is going to originate formats in a different style that are designed to work as creator-led content on YouTube,” Possenniskie told Variety. “A format like Frontier Collective is unique in the fact it brings together four very strong talents in the space. It’s not an audience that we traditionally reach here in the U.K. through pay TV or DTC or broadcast channels. It’s a global audience, and it’s a much broader audience for us to reach now as well. So that’s a really exciting opportunity.”

Hearst Canvas is headed by Danny Baggot as creative director and Sam Pearson as executive producer. The pair unveiled the venture’s first commission on Oct. 29, the unscripted business revitalization series “Pitch, Please.”

“Frontier Collective offers a compelling opportunity to build something unique in the adventure space — a network of remarkable individuals whose passion drives them to explore the far reaches of our globe and share what they’ve experienced with the world,” Pearson said. “And with ‘Expedition HQ,’ we’re launching a returning format that delivers on this promise through fascinating and insightful conversations.”

The roundtable series is produced by Grammar Productions, co-founded by Bescoby. It’s produced shows for BBC, Channel 4, Apple TV, Amazon Prime, Discovery, Sky HISTORY and Canal+, in addition to custom work for brands.

As a veteran of the adventure genre, Bescoby said he sees demand for Frontier Collective as a concept.

“Some of the best adventure storytellers I know have spent years asking for a proper home for their work,” Bescoby said. “Traditional television has stepped back from the genre, even as audiences are clamoring for more. It’s hugely exciting that Hearst Canvas is building that home with Frontier Collective, and it’s amazing to be a part of it.”

Kane invoked the importance of the YouTube channel as serving as a hub for adventure content fan communities. “This new YouTube channel allows us to bring directly to our community the real story that goes on behind the scenes on these adventures,” he said.

Wood added that every major adventure yields its own unique experiences, and inevitably, there is more color than can be included in the final program. “So much never makes it into the finished documentaries. I’m looking forward to sharing more of those experiences and unseen footage on my own channels as part of Frontier Collective,” Wood said.

Shepherd added her enthusiasm for the push to build a hub for top digital-native explorers and adventurers.

“I’m only sorry this didn’t begin sooner. There’s something very special about sitting around a table with people whose adventures inspired me to set out on my own,” Shepherd said. “Life is an expedition, and I hope our stories inspire others to find a little adventure in their lives, wherever they are.”

(Pictured: “Expedition HQ” hosts Alex Bescoby, Lucy Shepherd, Levison Wood and Aldo Kane)

101y7n.title: ‘The Altruists’ Review: Anthony Boyle and Julia Garner Make a Toxically Perfect Match in Netflix’s Intriguing but Unsatisfying Crypto Love Story
101y7n.content:
As FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried (Anthony Boyle) begins his very public downfall, one salacious detail starts to go viral: That Caroline Ellison (Julia Garner), CEO of sister firm Alameda and his ex-girlfriend, was a prolific writer of smutty Harry Potter fanfiction.

The fact that her private hobby has nothing to do with the financial crimes they’re in hot water for is beside the point. “What gets more clicks than a complicated financial scandal? A young professional woman who’s into kink,” shrugs Constance (Madison Hu), FTX’s loyal-to-the-end COO. “I mean, that’s the story. The whole world didn’t care about Caroline until they realized that she was horny.”

The Altruists

The Bottom Line

All heart and not enough head.

Airdate: Thursday, Nov. 19 (Netflix)Cast: Julia Garner, Anthony Boyle, Alex Lawther, Karan Soni, Madison Hu, Eugene Young, Naomi Okada, Matt Rife, Robin Weigert, Paul Reiser, Terry ChenCreator: Graham Moore

Sam, who knows better than anyone how mortified Caroline must be, seems troubled by the notion. But it more or less appears to be the impulse driving Netflix’s The Altruists. The eight-hour series chronicles the rise and fall of FTX and Alameda through the tumultuous relationship between its leaders — and in doing so, deepens the saga’s emotional relatability while also diminishing its stakes.

For most of the season, creator Graham Moore (The Imitation Game) cuts between two timelines. In the halcyon days of 2016, captured by director James Ponsoldt in the warm bright tones and slightly grainy texture of an indie rom-com, Caroline meets Sam on her first day at a New York hedge fund. The two recognize each other almost immediately as kindred spirits, matched in their intelligence (high), their interests (math and winning) and their taste in jokes (charmingly dorky).

In no time, they’re falling into bed, though not quite into a relationship — Caroline prefers to keep it caszh, reasoning that non-monogamy is more “mathematically optimal” for getting off. Instead, they tie their fates together via their careers. Sam first founds Alameda and then FTX, and in short order brings Caroline on board as an exec.

The businesses are rooted in the couple’s shared principle of effective altruism. In theory, EA is a rationalist moral framework that prioritizes doing the greatest good. In practice, like most guiding philosophies, it’s easily twisted into whatever a self-interested devotee wants it to be.

Betraying a colleague, conning oblivious business partners, stealing customer money — why, any of it might be justifiable, noble even, so long as it’s done with the intention of making more money to definitely for sure donate to some worthy cause someday. And so it is that in the show’s other, grayer timeline, it’s 2022 and Sam and Caroline find themselves scrambling to cover up all the grave financial misdeeds they’ve committed in service of some vague higher purpose.

How one timeline could lead into the other is The Altruists’ central concern, though the answer isn’t really much mystery (and not only because it was all headline news a scant four years ago). The differences between the Caroline and Sam we meet in 2016 and the ones we’ll part with in 2022 are ones of degree, not kind. These two have always been aggressive about taking risks, arrogant about their ability to outplay them, skeptical of the rules and gifted in justifying their own bullshit to themselves as perfectly rational, and therefore objectively correct, decisions.

Add in the fact that they tend to augment each other’s worst impulses — backing each other’s wildest moves, one-upping each other for spite or for fun, treating every office disagreement like a proxy for the conversations about commitment or exclusivity they’re supposedly too evolved to need — and FTX/Alameda’s meltdown starts to look almost inevitable. As ex-colleague and ex-friend Trabucco (a very good Alex Lawther) puts it, “Sam was a block of sodium. Caroline was a rushing river.” Put those ingredients together, the MIT graduate explains, and you’ve got an instant fireball.

If the journey contains few surprises, however, it does offer some worthy features. Karan Soni brings much-needed sweetness as FTX engineer Nishad, whose cute will-they-won’t-they with a coworker (Naomi Okada) becomes collateral damage in the implosion. Paul Reiser and Robin Weigert are fun in supporting roles as Sam’s parents, though their appearances are so brief that another character has to explain that while they love their son, they don’t like him. On the other end of the lovability spectrum, Terry Chen drinks up the part of possibly mob-affiliated rival crypto founder CZ with as much gusto as his character does his fancy health tonics.

The real (vegan) meat of the story, of course, is the bond between Sam and Caroline. That, the series understands inside and out. Boyle disappears into the part of Sam, whose boyish arrogance is somehow both his most alluring quality and his most repugnant. He’s outdone only slightly by the chameleonic Garner, who plays the mousy but mighty Caroline like she might see all the gears turning just underneath the surface of reality if she only stares hard enough.

When the two are across a room from one another, even editing a spreadsheet can turn into an act of thrilling flirtation. I hesitate to describe their chemistry as irresistible only because that might suggest we want to see them together. In actuality, the questionably effective but not entirely unpleasant experience of watching The Altruists is to simultaneously believe with your whole heart that these crazy kids are meant for each other and that we’d all have been better off if they’d never met.

The show’s intense focus on their love story distinguishes it, somewhat, from the increasingly crowded field of dramas about scammy and scummy tech founders. The usual rise-fall arc is emotionally complicated by the ménage à trois between Sam, Caroline and FTX/Alameda: The lovers might insist they always put the work first, but The Altruists know well how vulnerable even billionaire geniuses can be to whims of their hearts or loins. (Ahem.)

But as a way into what is still ultimately the story of a tech scam, the romantic angle doesn’t entirely work. Amid all the whirlwind drama, a sense of perspective gets lost. The number $8 billion, as in the amount of money FTX has stolen from its customers, gets lobbed about in every episode. But who those clients are, what impact the crime has in the larger world, what cultural forces allowed SBF’s FTX to get so big so fast to begin with, what consequences are left in the wake of its collapse — all these factors are barely mentioned at all.

You come away with the sense that the real lesson of the whole FTX debacle is what a tragedy it is when two people so intelligent are too caught up in their own heads to simply say what’s in their hearts, to the point that it’s easier to perpetrate financial crimes on a historic scale than it is to simply say “I love you.” In a vacuum, I suppose it’s a worthy lesson. In a broader context, however, it seems an unreasonably expensive one.

3dio3q.title: Netflix Unveils Penélope Cruz & Juan Diego Botto’s Domestic Violence Drama ‘Patricia’ As Production Gets Underway
3dio3q.content:
EXCLUSIVE: Netflix has announced the start of production on Juan Diego Botto‘s domestic violence drama Patricia starring Penélope Cruz, who also produces under the banner of her audiovisual company Moonlyon.

The news comes as Cruz enjoys a buzzy awards season thank to her roles in Best International Feature Film Oscar frontrunner La Bola Negra and Bunker.

It is the second feature film for Argentinian-Spanish actor and director Botto, who previously worked with Cruz on his directorial debut, the 2022 social thriller On The Fringe.

Patricia marks the first narrative feature for Cruz’s Moonlyon, which has been developing a number of projects since its launch in 2022 as part of the Barcelona-based sports and entertainment group Imagina, which was rebranded from Grup Mediapro in September.

Cruz will play the titular Patricia, a woman who escapes the hell of a twelve-year abusive relationship only to face another hell in the courts, where she fears for the wellbeing of her children.

The cast also includes Goya Toledo (Amores Perros, Marsella), Ramón Barea (Lullaby, Everybody knows) and Dylan Radley among others.

Cruz, whose career has also been defined by her longtime collaboration with Pedro Almodóvar on films such as Volver and Pain and Glory, revealed she was psyched to be getting Patricia into production.

“After more than two years developing what will be the first narrative feature from my production company, Moonlyon, and just about to start shooting, I feel enormous excitement,” she said.

“It has been a beautiful and intense journey alongside my dear Juan Diego Botto. Juan has written a wonderful script, and it is an honor to tell this story with him. It is a very necessary story, and an immense privilege to play this character. Patricia represents so many other women who, like her, suffer this kind of violence every day,” she continued.

“I am also very grateful for the incredible response from Netflix in Spain since they read the script. This is my first film with them, and we couldn’t be happier with the care and attention they have shown us.”

Argentinian Spanish actor and director Botto is a celebrated actor with close to 80 features to his name, with recent credits including The Suicide Squad, The Room Next Door and Breaking Falls. His feature directorial debut On The Fringe premiered in the Venice Film Festival’s Horizons sidebar in 2022.

“After two years of writing and a long research process, which included hours of interviews with women who trusted us with their stories, it is a privilege for me to tell this story with this cast and this creative team,” he said.

Netflix launched in Spain in 2015, where it has since established its biggest European production hub dedicated to non-English-language production. To mark the 10th anniversary of its arrival in the country, it pledged more than €1B ($1.1B) in investment into Spanish production between 2025 and 2028.

“Some stories matter to us for what they tell and how they are told, and Patricia is one of those rare and unforgettable stories: brave and courageous, brought to life by an extraordinary team,” said Diego Ávalos, Netflix’s vice president originals for Spain, Portugal, Turkey and Middle East.

“I’m truly honored to join Juan Diego Botto and Penélope Cruz in their first film for Netflix in Spain, and for a story born at home to move audiences here and around the world.”

itaoew.title: Siegfried & Roy Series ‘Wild Things’ Gets Spring Release; Apple TV Teases Jude Law & Andrew Garfield As “Masters Of The Impossible”
itaoew.content:
Apple TV‘s upcoming Siegfried and Roy series starring Jude Law and Andrew Garfield has landed a spring premiere date.

Wild Things will debut on April 16, 2027, the streamer revealed Thursday, alongside a very fitting promo outside the Las Vegas Sphere. The video gives a first look at the actors playing the renowned Vegas entertainers and “masters of the impossible.”

Based on an Apple Original podcast, Wild Things tells the wild ride relationship tale of two of the greatest showmen-magicians in history who, along with their white tigers, are tasked with turning Sin City into a family-friendly destination. The duo push the concept of illusion versus reality to the extreme, personally and professionally, until tragedy reframes and opens a mystery surrounding their last fateful Las Vegas show.

Also executive producers, Law stars as Siegfried and Garfield stars as Roy. The ensemble cast also includes Jessica Madsen, Brett Gelman, Justin Theroux, Cameron Britton, Darius Fraser, Bill Heck, Justin Bartha, Jason Butler Harner and Wanda Opalinska.

The series is created, written, directed, showrun and executive produced by eight-time Emmy Award nominee John Hoffman. Three-time Emmy Award nominee and DGA Award nominee Matt Shakman directs and executive produces, and Brian Grazer executive produces for Imagine Entertainment.

Tony Leondis serves as executive producer for Another Hoffman Story and Kathy Ciric also serves as an executive producer. Will Malnati, who conceived the podcast Wild Things: Siegfried & Roy, executive produces the project alongside Emmy Award-winning documentary filmmaker Steven Leckart, who wrote, narrated and executive produced the podcast for At Will Media. Joe Wright also directs and serves as a producer. Lulu Dillon serves as a producer for Foolscap.

Wild Things: Siegfried & Roy premiered in 2022 and was the first in-depth podcast series about the most famous and controversial magicians in history, who were widely misunderstood, frequently satirized and feverishly criticized. The podcast goes behind the velvet curtain to examine the pop culture icons, lionized by a global fan base for more than 40 years, to deconstruct the illusions they created, the empire they constructed and what really happened on the night that a tiger attack ended their reign.

16ci4p0.title: Clavicular allegedly told 17-year-old to call vodka ‘water’ to avoid Twitch ban before assault
16ci4p0.content:
Streamer Clavicular is accused of instructing a 17-year-old girl to lie about her age and pretend she was drinking water instead of vodka to avoid getting his Twitch livestream banned before an alleged sexual assault.

The 20-year-old influencer, whose real name is Braden Peters, has been indicted on two counts of rape and one count of providing alcohol to a minor in Massachusetts.

According to a police report detailed by Fox News, the allegations stem from an encounter on May 23, 2025, at his family’s home in Chatham, Cape Cod.

The teenager told investigators that she had connected with Peters through Instagram before he invited her to the property to create looksmaxxing content.

Peters allegedly arranged an Uber to bring her to the home, where he was livestreaming on Twitch.

Clavicular accused of telling teen to lie about age on Twitch

According to investigators, Peters knew the girl was 17 but instructed her to tell viewers she was 18. He also allegedly told her to refer to the vodka she was drinking as “water” to prevent his Twitch account or livestream from being banned.

The teenager claimed Peters supplied her with vodka throughout the evening, leaving her increasingly intoxicated.

Instagram: Clavicular

Police subsequently reviewed footage from the Twitch broadcast, including a moment when the girl said, “Wait, I’m so drunk though,” before the two kissed.

She alleged that Peters later had sex with her while she was heavily intoxicated. She also told investigators that she woke up the following morning to Peters having sex with her without her consent.

On November 18, Boston 25 News reported that Peters had been indicted on two rape counts and one count of providing alcohol to a minor.

Peters pleaded not guilty to the original charges at an October 22 court appearance and was released after posting $10,000 cash bail.

His representative, Mitchell P. Jackson, told Fox News on November 18 that the influencer denies all charges and allegations against him.

The criminal proceedings are separate from a Florida civil lawsuit filed by his accuser. As Dexerto previously reported, she removed the sexual assault claim from that lawsuit in October, with her attorney explaining that the decision was made to avoid interfering with the ongoing criminal case.

e0z9uk.title: Ex Cineworld Boss Mooky Griedinger Leads Showcase Cinemas Acquisition
e0z9uk.content:
Mooky Greidinger, the former CEO of cinema giant Cineworld who stepped away from the company in 2023 as it emerged from post-pandemic bankruptcy, is back in the U.K. exhibition space.

The Israeli businessman, who oversaw Cineworld’s acquisition of Regal Cinemas in the U.S. in 2018, has now led the acquisition of Showcase through his company Global City U.K. Showcase has 16 sites around the U.K.

“Global City U.K. is delighted to confirm that it has completed the purchase of Showcase Cinemas UK,” a spokesman said in a statement. “The Showcase circuit in the U.K. s an exceptional operation of sixteen multiplex cinemas, with a brand embedded in the appeal of the big screen, bringing people together through a shared love of film.”

News of the acquisition was initially revealed in an announcement from Imax, which said that Showcase, under leadership from “longstanding Imax supporter” Greidinger, had signed the single largest deal for new Imax locations in the U.K.

Under the agreement, Showcase has ordered 13 new Imax and laser systems, 12 across locations in the U.K. and one additional European location.

“I’ve been in the Imax business for decades and the value of its technology, brand, and strategic partnership to exhibitors have grown exponentially in that time,” said Greidinger.

“There is no doubt that Imax plays a significant role in the results of the industry and I am sure it will continue to grow and attract new audience and become even more significant in the coming years. I look forward to working with Rich and his team and making the Imax experience a cornerstone of the new Showcase Cinemas in the U.K..”

1en821.title: Россияне так ждали GTA VI, что начали массово арендовать PlayStation 5 — а заодно вызвали скачок интернет-трафика
1en821.content:
Подготовка к релизу Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) заметно повлияла на российский рынок игровых консолей и нагрузку на сети операторов связи. В октябре спрос на аренду PlayStation 5 вырос на 73 % в годовом выражении, а в день старта предзагрузки игры трафик через соединения «МегаФона» с контент-провайдерами увеличился на 58 % относительно среднего уровня октября.
Источник изображения: Rockstar Games

В преддверии выхода игры на «Авито Услугах» зафиксировали увеличение спроса на аренду PS5 на 40 % в период предзаказов. По итогам октября число обращений за этой услугой оказалось на 73 % выше, чем годом ранее. Аренда приставки обходится в среднем в 900 рублей за сутки.
Интерес к игровому оборудованию отразился и на продажах. По данным «Авито», в октябре продажи новых консолей выросли на 17 % год к году, а подержанных — на 23 %. Устройства на вторичном рынке в среднем стоят на 35–40 % дешевле новых. За девять месяцев 2026 года россияне приобрели на 29,4 % больше приставок Sony PlayStation, чем за аналогичный период прошлого года, следует из данных аналитической компании ICMR.

При этом российский рынок консолей в целом продолжил сокращаться. За январь–октябрь было продано 1,13 млн устройств на 21 млрд рублей. В количественном выражении продажи снизились на 2,8 %, в денежном — на 1,9 % год к году. Наиболее заметный рост продаж приставок Sony пришелся на июль и август, когда выручка от их реализации увеличилась на 43,7 %.
Массовое скачивание GTA VI также увеличило нагрузку на сети операторов. Владельцы предзаказов получили доступ к файлам игры 10 ноября. В этот день объем трафика через соединения «МегаФона» с серверами контент-провайдеров вырос на 44 % относительно предыдущих суток. Уже 11 ноября показатель достиг максимума за два месяца, а за неделю с 10 по 16 ноября превысил результат предыдущей семидневки на 22 %.
Источник изображения: Sony

Однако у других операторов существенного скачка не произошло. В сети широкополосного доступа «ВымпелКома» трафик увеличился примерно на 6 % относительно среднесуточных значений октября. В МТС сообщили лишь о незначительном росте пользовательской активности. Перегрузок сети компания не зафиксировала.
Подготовка к релизу повлияла и на расходы геймеров. По данным Т-Банка, в октябре–ноябре объем пополнений PlayStation Network удвоился относительно предыдущего месяца и вчетверо превысил среднемесячный показатель за год. Для Xbox рост составил 34 % и 2,5 раза соответственно.
«Исторически больше пользователей предпочитают PlayStation, поэтому основной всплеск спроса и предзаказов пришелся именно на эту платформу», — пояснили в Т-Банке.
На «Авито» с 1 по 17 ноября зарегистрировали почти 400 тыс. поисковых запросов, связанных с GTA VI. Это в 7,1 раза больше, чем у Resident Evil Requiem. Количество объявлений о продаже цифровой версии GTA VI за тот же период увеличилось в 2,3 раза относительно аналогичного промежутка октября, достигнув 3,1 тыс.
Гендиректор Организации развития видеоигровой индустрии Василий Овчинников считает, что выход GTA VI способствует росту спроса на игровые приставки. При появлении компьютерной версии, по его мнению, аналогичный эффект может затронуть рынок игрового оборудования для ПК. Однако дату выхода GTA VI на компьютерах Rockstar Games пока не объявила.
Исполнительный директор проекта «Игропром» Юлия Тишина связывает перспективы мирового консольного рынка с успешным запуском GTA VI. Согласно приведенному ею прогнозу, в 2026 году выручка этого сегмента увеличится на 5,1 %, до $46,9 млрд. При этом эксперт допускает, что без ноябрьского релиза игры рынок мог бы завершить год снижением. Ограничение стартового выпуска версиями для PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X/S также стимулирует продажи приставок текущего поколения.
Основатель и управляющий партнер Indie GO Fund Владимир Вареник ожидает, что коммерческие результаты GTA VI могут повлиять на инвестиционную активность в игровой индустрии. Он напомнил о рекордных показателях предыдущей части серии, вышедшей в 2013 году. По его оценке, если новая игра оправдает финансовые ожидания, крупные инвесторы могут вновь проявить интерес к финансированию игровых разработок после охлаждения рынка в постпандемийный период.

Предзагрузка GTA VI уже вызвала рекордный скачок интернет-трафика за пределами России. В частности, международная сеть точек обмена трафиком DE-CIX впервые зафиксировала показатель свыше 33 Тбит/с. Сама игра вышла 19 ноября на PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X/S, спустя 13 лет после релиза GTA V.

1x4u8w5.title: Кушнер підтвердив, що США розглядають гарантії безпеки для України за зразком статті 5 НАТО
1x4u8w5.content:
Сполучені Штати готові розглядати надання Україні гарантій безпеки за зразком статті 5 Північноатлантичного договору, однак вони мають відповідати американським інтересам і бути частиною ширшого пакета безпекових заходів.

Про це заявив зять президента США Джаред Кушнер у четвер на спільній пресконференції за підсумками саміту Коаліції охочих у Берліні, передає власний кореспондент Укрінформу.

«З погляду Америки, надання гарантій безпеки за зразком статті 5 – це справді дуже серйозний крок. Я думаю, президент Трамп відкритий до цього, але, очевидно, це має відповідати інтересам Сполучених Штатів», – зазначив Кушнер.

За його словами, американській стороні вдалося переконати Росію сприймати таку модель як можливу основу майбутніх домовленостей.

«Будь-які гарантії безпеки для України ґрунтуватимуться на статті 5, і, як стверджують росіяни, вони мають намір після завершення цієї війни не допустити нової в майбутньому», – сказав він.

Кушнер визнав, що в Росії багато хто скептично ставиться до таких заяв, однак наголосив на необхідності відновити діалог між Європою та Росією, щоб сторони могли безпосередньо обговорювати питання безпеки.

Водночас він вказав, що майбутні домовленості не можна будувати лише на довірі чи запевненнях сторін. Необхідно створити систему стимулів і взаємних інтересів, яка передбачатиме контроль за виконанням угоди, потужне стримування та серйозні наслідки в разі її порушення.

Кушнер також високо оцінив зміни, яких зазнали Збройні сили України за час повномасштабної війни.

Читайте також: Європа співпрацюватиме зі США щодо миру в Україні, доки їхні цілі збігаються - Мерц

«Сьогодні Україна вже не та країна, на яку напали тоді. Вона продемонструвала стійкість і силу, надзвичайно розвинулася і тепер має одну з найкращих армій у світі», – сказав він.

За його словами, важливими складниками майбутньої системи безпеки мають стати не лише гарантії та стримування, а й дієві канали комунікації між сторонами, які допоможуть запобігати новим конфліктам.

Відповідаючи на запитання журналіста стосовно заяви Трампа, що США заробляють на війні великі гроші, спецпосланець президента Стів Віткофф наголосив, що американський лідер послідовно підтримує мирне завершення війни.

Він нагадав, що Трамп направив його та Кушнера до Берліна для участі в саміті Коаліції охочих і доручив зробити все можливе для припинення війни.

За словами Віткоффа, Трамп по телефону повідомив, що виклав ті самі принципи двом  лідерам, з якими зустрічався.

«Він зробив Україну та мирне завершення цієї війни однією з головних тем сьогоднішньої тристоронньої зустрічі, і я вважаю, що за це його слід відзначити», – наголосив спецпосланець.

Кушнер, зі свого боку, зазначив, що оборонна промисловість становить незначну частину економіки США, а Трамп, за його словами, найбільше хотів би, щоб ця галузь скорочувалася завдяки встановленню миру в усьому світі.

«Війна – це гра з від’ємною сумою: від неї програють усі. Мир – це гра з додатною сумою», – сказав Кушнер.

Він наголосив, що президент США прагне припинити страждання, спричинені війною, і вважає, що мир принесе світу значні переваги. За словами Кушнера, питання можливих прибутків від продажу зброї жодним чином не впливає на мотивацію Трампа домагатися миру.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, президент США Дональд Трамп заявив, що не ухвалюватиме рішень щодо України без участі української сторони.

aws3ch.title: GTA 6 Bigfoot explained: How to find ‘Bigfoot’ in GTA 6
aws3ch.content: GTA 6 players have already encountered something that they are calling “Bigfoot”.In this GTA 6 Bigfoot explained guide, we’ll explain what it actually is players have seen, and how they can start the lengthy quest line to track him down. This guide will be split into parts, with this part of the guide focussing on finding “bigfoot” and starting the quest. Then, we’ll have a separate guide for the questline, as it contains some spoilers.Our GTA 6 Guides Hub is now live, full of walkthroughs, tips for beginners and much more. We reccomend you check it out, and bookmark it for your adventure across Leonida.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Bigfoot ExplainedThe clip that has been widely circulating online of players running into Bigfoot, isn’t Bigfoot. It’s a character that the locals refer to as Skunkape. You may have seen posters of this creature around Key Lento at the beginning of the game, well, before too long you’re going to be on the trail of the Skunk Ape.The Skunk Ape can appear to players in a few different ways, but it most commonly happens as players are driving towards the Kingfishers camp near the water south of Hamlet. You’ll be sent to investigate this camp, but it’s not a main story mission, so it’s possible you run across this event naturally.The other way to begin this questline is to examine enough of the Skunkape posters than can be found around town. After this, the game puts a marker on your map in the general area of the first Skunkape sighting, so you can then go and do it yourself.GTA 6 Bigfoot Explained: What happens next?After you see the Skunkape for the first time, let a few days pass and then you’ll get a from Kirk. He’s the world’s leading expert on the creature, and he wants to enlist you in tracking him down. This will add a marker to your map.You can only start the Skunkape questline with Kirk as Jason, and only at night. That’s everything you need to know about GTA 6’s Bigfoot.

jzkqce.title: Keltie Knight on 'Superfan' in New Book 'The F--- Them Theory'
jzkqce.content:
Keltie Knight is a three-time Emmy–winning television personality, New York Times bestselling author, and People’s Choice Award–nominated podcast host (“LadyGang”). She currently hosts “E! Live From the Red Carpet” and is widely known for her work on “Entertainment Tonight,” “The Insider,” and CBS’s “Superfan,” which she also created and executive produced.

In this excerpt from her latest book, “The F*ck Them Theory: Self-Help For People Who are Done Being the Bigger Person” (available Nov. 24 from Blackstone Publishing), Knight recounts the trials she faced after creating “Superfan” — including a lawsuit from rival producers — and what she learned from surviving all the drama.

I use all that rage to fuel my next big idea, but what happens when the haters are right? I swear, every time something incredible happens to me, the universe immediately follows it with a slap across the face. I don’t even like to celebrate my wins anymore; I just start bracing for the chaos that’s about to roll in. It’s like the universe can’t stand to see me strut for more than twenty-four hours before serving me a fresh slice of humble pie.

That’s exactly what happened when I sold my first primetime TV series, “Superfan.”

I’d been in the television business long enough to know that no one was ever going to hand me a dream gig. I watched as my friends all got auditions to host new game shows, competition series, and did on-screen tests for shows like “The View” and “Today.” There was always something new and exciting going on in the hosting world, but I rarely got called in, and in the end Mario Lopez usually ended up booking it.

As frustrating as it was, if I wanted to be at the top of someone’s list, I was going to have to build my own damn list. So I did. I created, pitched, and sold my own primetime network show. (Author’s note: This would be a great thing to put on my epitaph if you want me to truly rest in peace.)

This is something that statistically almost never happens for women. A 2022 study by Women in Film found that in 2018, women-owned production companies received 18.6 percent of studio-subsidized film deals and 35.7 percent of studio-subsidized television deals. A 2024 report noted that women accounted for just 23 percent of creators employed across broadcast and streaming television programs. The numbers are beyond dismal. And on this project I even had a female business partner. Picture us: two women with solid résumés, zero hit shows, no famous last names, and definitely no family money.

The idea had lived in my brain for years. A shiny floor musical competition show where superfans of the biggest artists all competed to be named the number one fan, winning an insane prize package like the chance to sing on stage with the artist. I even paid $11 to register it with the Writers Guild back in 2016. (That’s Hollywood’s version of a patent. It’s cheap, hopeful, and usually useless.) I’d filed that paper away, secretly proud but mostly convinced it would never matter. But this time, it did. The thing I dreamed up actually sold.

When Variety printed the announcement, my face next to “CBS Orders Musical Competition Series,” I could barely breathe. It was one of the proudest moments of my entire career. I’d done it. After years of hosting other people’s dreams, I had finally built my own.

And then, the phone rang.

Business Affairs. Cold tone. Legalese. A group of men (of course it was men) believed the network had stolen their pitch and handed it to us instead. They were threatening to sue.

I laughed when I first heard the accusation. Really? If the network was going to steal a format, don’t you think they’d give it to someone who created “Survivor” or “The Amazing Race”? Not to the girl from the LadyGang podcast? But logic doesn’t matter in Hollywood. What matters is drama.

And just like that, my dream was now a liability.

Every email came with an asterisk. Every call ended in “we’ll see.” I woke up every morning thinking, My show is getting made, followed by I’m getting sued.

I knew the idea was mine. I had the timestamped deck, the registration, and the receipts. But if you’ve ever been threatened with a lawsuit, you know that facts don’t keep you calm, especially when your husband once managed Robin Thicke and Pharrell through the “Blurred Lines” musical lawsuit. A case where the jury sided with vibes and personality over facts. (None of the notes were the same, guys! Not a single one!) Truth and justice don’t always RSVP to the same meeting.

Still, I kept going. What else was I supposed to do?

For two years we worked. We waited. We developed. We prayed. We pushed through, hoping it would all work out.

While we waited for the pending lawsuit to get cleared up and an air date for the show, we started pitching “Superfan” internationally. We flew to MIPCOM in France, the global TV marketplace. I thought: This is it. The rebirth.

Except my producing partner got sick the second we landed. I walked into the pitch rooms alone. Foreign buyers. Language barriers. Me smiling, sweating, hustling like I was twenty-five again. And it worked. France wanted it. Other countries did too. We were finally building momentum, and we were all set to become the next global sensation!

When we got back from France, the network started discussing shutting it all down. They might just never air “Superfan” at all. They said the potential lawsuit meant we couldn’t sell internationally. The worldwide deals vanished. The enthusiasm faded. We weren’t the fresh new hit anymore. We were the problematic project.

“Superfan” did finally air, but it was eighteen months late. That’s a lifetime in television. By the time it dropped, most people had forgotten we’d even filmed it. All our celebrities were singing year-old hits. Some had even dropped entirely new albums. The network didn’t really promote it. It was dropped like a half-empty water bottle on a hot day, technically delivered, but with no care.

To everyone else, this was the end. A quiet burial for a show no one believed in. But I wasn’t about to let that happen. I’d worked too hard. I had poured years of my life into this project, and even if the powers that be had already moved on, I hadn’t.

So I did what I always do: I made something out of nothing. I manufactured my own miracle.

I begged my husband, who had connections from working with a billboard company at the time, to help me throw a splashy premiere in Times Square. I invited everyone: network heads, influencers, friends. I convinced Getty Images to shoot it like it was the Grammys. I even paid for LL Cool J’s private jet out of my own pocket (!!) because he was our debut episode’s star, and I knew we needed star power if we were going to make anyone pay attention to our dead-on-arrival series. I was praying that my evil genius plan would turn “Superfan” into the next “Seinfeld.”

Did you know “Seinfeld,” one of the most successful sitcoms in TV history, was originally considered a total flop by test audiences and network focus groups? When NBC first piloted the show, the focus group results were brutal. Viewers described it as “too New York,” “too Jewish,” and “too self-indulgent.” One network report labeled it “weak” and said it would “not be a success.” NBC executives joked that it was “a show about nothing, and maybe should stay that way.” The original pilot scored so low with test audiences that NBC nearly didn’t order any episodes at all. The only reason “Seinfeld” survived was because a few network champions believed in Jerry Seinfeld and Larry David’s unique voice and fought for a limited four-episode order.

Those four episodes led to nine seasons, ten Emmy Awards, and billions in syndication revenue. The data said no. The suits said no. They were all wrong.

But the focus groups weren’t wrong about “Superfan.” The reviews were brutal. Headlines called us a “superflop.” Ouch. We underperformed and never recovered.

And then, while I was having dinner in the backyard with my husband and father-in-law, a stranger walked up and handed me a manila envelope. I’d been served. Those men sued us anyway.

Six more months. Stress. Embarrassment. Anxiety. All over a show the world didn’t even want.

But I know the universe wasn’t punishing me. It was preparing me.

When people ask, “How do you stay so motivated?”

I don’t. I stay defiant.

Every rejection is fuel. Every derailment? A redirection. I learned so much from my flop; it was a masterclass.

Rejection isn’t a dead end. It’s a test. It’s the universe making sure you’re strong enough for what’s next. The only real rejection that matters is the one where you reject yourself. Don’t do that.

If winning were easy, everyone would be doing it. If staying in the game didn’t require total ego death, none of us would evolve. If rejection stings? It means you cared enough to try.

Rejection isn’t failure. Every no proves you’re brave enough to show up. Every almost-great flop says: You took a risk.

Fuck rejection. Keep going. Keep showing up. Keep becoming.

PS We won the lawsuit.

18daiu6.title: CBS And Paramount+ To Air Next Kennedy Center Honors
18daiu6.content:
CBS will broadcast this year’s Kennedy Center Honors, which will be held offsite amid the closure of the main facility.

The network’s rights deal for the ceremony expired last year, and is said to have signed a one-year agreement for this year’s ceremony. CBS has broadcast the honors since it started in 1978.

The ceremony will be held on Dec. 7 at Capital One Arena, but CBS will air the ceremony on Dec. 27. It also will stream live on Paramount+ Premium.

The ceremony will honor Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia, David Mamet and Barbara Mandrell. The ceremony will be produced by Den of Thieves, with Jesse Ignjatovic and Evan Prager as executive producers and Barb Bialkowski executive producer and showrunner. Micah Bickham will direct, and Cheche Alara will serve as music producer and music director.

The center largely ended all major performances ended amid plans to renovate the complex. The plan has been challenged by Rep. Joyce Beatty (D-OH), and a federal judge issued an injunction prohibiting a full-scale closure, albeit center officials have shuttered the main building since September for what they say is for safety reasons. Donald Trump, who serves as chairman of the center, hosted last year’s ceremonies, but no announcement has been made on whether he will return.

1k608ca.title: Chris Kattan Launches Production & Distribution Company Kattan Films
1k608ca.content:
November 19, 2026 10:20am

Chris Kattan
Getty Images

EXCLUSIVE: Chris Kattan is opening the doors to Kattan Films, an independent production and distribution company focused on acquiring films for theatrical release while developing its own slate of original productions.Kattan Films will pursue a theatrical-first distribution model. Its production operation will develop original feature films and television series, with plans to shoot projects in Hollywood and throughout the greater Los Angeles area.Matt Dugan, Kattan’s manager, has been named President and will oversee the company’s business operations, acquisitions and distribution strategy. Kattan Films will be based in Hollywood. The company’s first original feature is an untitled comedy currently in development and is slated to begin production in mid-2027. The initial lineup of theatrical releases for Kattan Films is also eyed for 2027. “There’s a story, a dream, a vision in all of us. At Kattan Films, I want creatives to have that opportunity to bring their dreams to life. There’s an audience out there that needs to hear your stories. That door is now open for you,” said Kattan.Kattan Films will also operate a boutique physical media label, releasing catalog titles on Blu-ray and DVD.

The Groundlings alum was a cast member on Saturday Night Live from 1996 to 2003 known for his recurring characters including Mr. Peepers, Mango, Azrael Abyss, and Kyle DeMarco from The DeMarco Brothers among many others. His feature canon includes House on Haunted Hill, Corky Romano, Night at the Roxbury, Undercover Brother, and a long-running supporting actor turn on the ABC sitcom The Middle.

dpw9zs.title: E. Lockhart, Gotham Group Tackling Fantasy Novel ‘The Curse Workers’ for 20th Television (Exclusive)
dpw9zs.content:
Logo text

20th Television is in development on The Curse Workers, the best-selling fantasy books from Holly Black, with a plan to adapt it for a TV series to stream on Disney+.

E. Lockhart, the author turned showrunner behind Prime Video’s hit We Were Liars, will adapt the trilogy into a series, serving as writer and executive producer.

Also exec producing are Ellen Goldsmith-Vein and Jeremy Bell for The Gotham Group. The project marks a reunion for Gotham Group and Black; the company produced the 2023 series adaptation of The Spiderwick Chronicles, based on the children’s series that Black co-wrote with Tony DiTerlizzi.

Curse Workers is set in a world where magic is illegal and controlled by the Mob. The story centers on Cassel Sharpe, the youngest son of a criminal family and the only one without magic. When his mother returns from prison, his brothers start acting strange, and his own memories are no longer making sense, forcing him to rely on his knowledge of con artistry to uncover the truth.

Lockhart is the New York Times bestselling author who wrote the book sensation We Were Liars, and then was intimately involved in the book’s translation to mystery thriller series, which reached No. 1 on Prime Video and was quickly renewed for a second season, now in production. Lockhart wrote the season one finale, participated in casting and location scouting, and continues as an executive producer on season two, which incorporates the story of her prequel novel, Family of Liars.

In addition to Liars, Lockhart is adapting her own novel Again Again for Wayfarer Entertainment while novel Genuine Fraud is in development as a series at Prime Video, with Rain Spencer attached to star and Sinead Daly writing the pilot.

One of the biggest names in fantasy, Black is known for her New York Times best-sellers including Novels of Elfhame, The Coldest Girl in Coldtown and The Charlatan Duology, as well as an Arthurian picture book called Sir Morien. She has been a finalist for an Eisner Award and a Lodestar Award, and the recipient of a Mythopoeic Award, a Nebula Award and a Newbery Honor. Her books have sold over 40 million copies and been translated into 32 languages worldwide.

Working in both film and television, Gotham is one of the entities behind Disney+ hit Percy Jackson and the Olympians and exec produced the Apple TV+ and Skydance Animation series The Search for WondLa as well as the Hulu limited series Washington Black. It’s most recent movie was the 20th Century Studios release Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere, written and directed by Scott Cooper.

Lockhart is repped by Verve, Anonymous Content, and Elizabeth Kaplan Literary Agency. Black is repped by CAA and New Leaf Literary & Media.

5arqzh.title: Russia and Georgia Resume Direct Dialogue With Official Meeting in Minsk, Moscow Says
5arqzh.content:
A Russian deputy foreign minister and a Georgian special representative for relations with Moscow met in Minsk on Thursday, marking the resumption of direct dialogue between the two countries, the Russian Foreign Ministry said.
The neighbors have had no diplomatic relations since fighting a brief war in 2008. Tbilisi rejects Moscow's recognition of the breakaway regions of South Ossetia and Abkhazia, which Georgia considers parts of its territory.
Mikhail Galuzin, a Russian deputy foreign minister, met on Thursday in the Belarusian capital Minsk with George Zurabashvili, Georgia's first deputy foreign minister, who was appointed the prime minister's special envoy for relations with Moscow last month.

"A thorough exchange of views took place on current issues of bilateral cooperation, with an emphasis on trade, economic, cultural and humanitarian cooperation," the Russian Foreign Ministry said in a statement.
The two officials discussed regional security, the statement said, adding that "a number of practical agreements were reached."
Once the former Soviet Union's most democratic and pro-Western successor state, Georgia has drawn closer to Russia under the ruling Georgian Dream party, government critics say.
With a population of some 3.7 million, Georgia is officially an EU candidate country, but Brussels says it has backslid so far on democratic reforms that its candidacy exists "in name only."
Authorities have cracked down on opposition politicians and former members of the ruling elites alike, jailing several key figures. The country's Constitutional Court is currently hearing a lawsuit filed by the government seeking to ban the main opposition parties outright.

A Message from The Moscow Times:
Dear readers,
We are facing unprecedented challenges. Russia's Prosecutor General's Office has designated The Moscow Times as an "undesirable" organization, criminalizing our work and putting our staff at risk of prosecution. This follows our earlier unjust labeling as a "foreign agent."
These actions are direct attempts to silence independent journalism in Russia. The authorities claim our work "discredits the decisions of the Russian leadership." We see things differently: we strive to provide accurate, unbiased reporting on Russia.
We, the journalists of The Moscow Times, refuse to be silenced. But to continue our work, we need your help.
Your support, no matter how small, makes a world of difference. If you can, please support us monthly starting from just $2. It's quick to set up, and every contribution makes a significant impact.
