9s1pop.title: В Шанхае задержали 13 человек за подпольное производство фигурок Тифы из Final Fantasy 7
9s1pop.content:
Китайская полиция арестовала 13 человек в Шанхае, предположительно причастных к подпольному бизнесу по производству контрафактных фигурок Тифы из Final Fantasy 7. Расследование началось после жалоб потребителей, а изъято товаров на сумму около $300 тыс.
Как сообщает Gamespark, полиция пресекла операцию, в ходе которой было конфисковано товаров примерно на $300 тыс. Расследование началось в мае после обращений обеспокоенных граждан. Выяснилось, что фигурки сделаны из других материалов, чем официальная продукция. После подтверждения незаконности товаров у правообладателя Square Enix полиция установила, что эти компании не имеют разрешения на производство такой продукции.

Внешне подделки были признаны идентичными настоящему мерчу, из-за чего предполагаемое преступление квалифицировали как нарушение прав на официальные товары. Контрафакт выпускался в разных размерах, а некоторые экземпляры стоили дороже оригиналов и были кастомизируемыми.

На фотографиях, сделанных местным изданием Shangguan News (и сопоставленных Automaton), можно увидеть официальную фигурку Тифы рядом с подделкой. Обе изображают Тифу в синем платье, хотя использованные материалы явно различаются.

af58m1.title: 13 arrested in Shanghai as police crackdown on bootleg Final Fantasy 7 Tifa figurine operation
af58m1.content:
More than $300,000 of goods seized.

Image credit: Eurogamer / Square Enix

Chinese police have arrested 13 individuals in Shanghai allegedly involved in a bootleg Final Fantasy 7 Tifa figurine business, after consumers reported the operation. They are currently being investigated on suspicion of selling infringing reproductions.
Reported by Gamespark, the police cracked down on the operation which involved the seizure of around $300,000 of goods related to the figurines.

Here's a Final Fantasy VII: Revelation combat trailer.Watch on YouTube

The investigation started in May, after police received reports from concerned members of the public about the Tifa figurines. They were made from different materials than official figurines, and after confirming the illegitimacy of these products with the rights holders, Square Enix, police determined these businesses were not authorised to be producing such goods and went to work.The appearance of these counterfeits were deemed identical to the real merch, and therefore the alleged crime was deemed infringement of official goods. These counterfeits also came in different sizes, some of which were more expensive than the originals and customisabile.
Looking at pictures taken by local outlet Shangguan News (and put side-by-side by Automaton), you can see the official Tifa figurine (right) next to the counterfeit version (left). Both show Tifa in a blue dress, though the materials used are clearly different.

Original images from Shengguan News, side-by-side comparison by Automaton. | Image credit: Shangguan News / Automaton

If you fancy some insight on something officially tied to Final Fantasy 7, Eurogamer's Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth review praised the game for its playful spin on the classic RPG. The third entry in the remake trilogy, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is coming in April 2027, and is looking good judging from early previews.

qmuonf.title: Lili Reinhart Circling Amazon MGM Studios & Mattel’s ‘Polly Pocket’ After Lily Collins Exit
qmuonf.content:
Lili Reinhart is in talks to star in and executive produce Amazon MGM Studios and Mattel Studios’ Polly Pocket, we understand.

The news follows Emily in Paris star Lily Collins departure from the project a while ago due to a scheduling conflict. She remains an executive producer on the project.

Clea DuVall boarded Polly Pocket as director over the summer. The pic is being shot for Prime Video.

Producers also include Mattel Studios’ Robbie Brenner, and Hello Sunshine’s Reese Witherspoon and Lauren Neustadter. Mattel Studios, Hello Sunshine’s Emily Ferenbach, Jeff Waxman, and Jennifer Madeloff are EPs.

Sweethearts scribes Jordan Weiss and Dan Brier wrote the script, inspired by Mattel’s popular micro-doll line.

Polly Pocket was first introduced in 1989. In 2018, Mattel reintroduced the micro-doll line with a product offering that pays homage to the brand’s origins, with updates for a new generation.

Riverdale star Reinhart most recently headlined The Love Hypothesis for Amazon MGM Studios. The romantic comedy, which is Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes, debuted at #2 on Nielsen’s movies chart with over 400M minutes streamed on Prime Video and held the #1 spot on Prime Video’s weekly rankings for three weeks. Her edgy horror comedy Forbidden Fruits world premiered at SXSW back in March.

Amazon didn’t respond to request for comment on today’s news.

dcyqep.title: Дания заявила о предотвращении покушения на рэпера Kyivstoner и заподозрила в этом РФ
dcyqep.content:
Спецслужбы Дании заявили о предотвращении покушения на украинского рэпера. Убийство гражданина Украины и США планировалось совершить в сентябре во время концерта в Копенгагене с привлечением местной преступной группировки, сообщила в пятницу, 20 ноября, заявила в пятницу, 20 ноября, датская разведывательная служба PET.

В организации покушения датская разведслужба подозревает Россию. "По нашей оценке, этот случай свидетельствует о том, что российские спецслужбы предприняли попытку осуществить заказное убийство в Дании", - заявил на пресс-конференции глава PET Расмус Киффер-Кристенсен.

В подготовке покушения на рэпера подозревают двух датчан

Как отмечает датская общественно-правовая телерадиокомпания DR со ссылкой на материалы судебного заседания, речь идет о подготовке покушения на рэпера и видеоблогера Альберта Васильева, известного также как Kiyvstoner (Киевстонер).

В подготовке убийства незадолго до концерта Kyivstoner, который должен был состояться 25 сентября в пригороде датской столицы Шарлоттенлунд, подозреваются два гражданина Дании. Они отрицают свою вину.

По данным DR, их задержали в Хеллерупе близ Копенгагена. В автомобиле вместе с ними находились еще двое мужчин, однако им не предъявлены обвинения в подготовке убийства. В машине также было обнаружено оружие. Все четверо с тех пор находятся под арестом. Концерт в Шарлоттенлунде в итоге был отменен. На судебном заседании 20 ноября шла речь о продлении срока содержания подозреваемых под стражей. Оно проходило в закрытом режиме.

Kiyvstoner сообщал об отмене концерта из-за предупреждений спецслужб

Рэпер Kiyvstoner, помогающий украинской армии, сам сообщал об отмене концерта в Дании в своем Instagram. По его словам, проводить концерт ему запретили спецслужбы. В августе сообщалось, что на исполнителя готовили покушение в Польше.

В июле ФСБ РФ обвинила Киевстонера в организации атаки украинских беспилотников на стратегическое предприятие в жилом секторе Подмосковья. По утверждению российской спецслужбы, атака была предотвращена. Украинский рэпер обвинения отверг.

English

Projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos. Spawn é marca registrada da Todd McFarlane Productions; o jogo Spawn: Armageddon foi publicado pela Namco; este projeto não tem relação com a Todd McFarlane Productions nem a Bandai Namco. Este repositório não contém o jogo: você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD (a versão europeia, SLES-52326).

ImportantPara jogar, baixe o Otavix Launcher. Ele baixa este port, pede a sua ISO, gera o jogo no seu PC e o mantém atualizado. Para relatar um problema ou pedir algo, use "Reportar problema" na página do jogo no launcher: o relatório já vai com o log e as configurações, e é por ele que as correções saem mais rápido.
To play, download the Otavix Launcher. It downloads this port, asks for your ISO, makes the game on your PC and keeps it updated. To report a problem or ask for something, use "Report a problem" on the game's page in the launcher: the report carries the log and the settings, and that is how fixes come out fastest.

English summary below
O que é
Um port nativo do Spawn: Armageddon (PlayStation 2, 2003) para Windows. Não é um emulador: o código do jogo é traduzido para C++ e compilado para x86-64 (recompilação estática), com o motor PS2 próprio do projeto (Otavix).
Como o código do jogo não pode ser distribuído, o seu PC gera e compila a parte do jogo a partir da sua ISO. Um comando só faz tudo.
Estado atual: em desenvolvimento
Já dá para ver o jogo: inicia, carrega os módulos do IOP e os sons, passa pela escolha de idioma, pela checagem do cartão de memória e pelo menu principal (com a arte e o logo originais) e entra na primeira fase em 3D, com a cidade, a catedral, o Spawn e as cenas texturizados como no PlayStation 2. Agora roda a 60 FPS, inclusive nas cenas mais pesadas (testado num Ryzen 7 9800X3D; usa uns 6 núcleos e mantém 60 FPS mesmo limitado a 8 threads lógicas). Os microprogramas de geometria do VU1 são traduzidos para C++ na sua máquina, a partir do executável do seu disco (a etapa "VU1" do gerador; o repositório só traz onde eles ficam: offsets e tamanhos), e a rasterização usa AVX2 em várias threads. Agora com som (o chip de som SPU2 é emulado: música, efeitos e ambiente) e com os vídeos (abertura, história e demonstração). A jogabilidade já foi testada (andar, pular, atacar, tutorial da primeira fase; 15 minutos seguidos sem travar); falta testar salvar e as fases seguintes. Por enquanto, só para testes.
Teclado e mouse
O teclado e o mouse funcionam junto com o controle. As teclas são trocadas na página Controles do
Otavix Launcher, que também liga ou desliga o teclado e o mouse e ajusta a sensibilidade. Teclas padrão:

Como jogar
pelo launcher, ou gerar.cmd e jogar.cmd
só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta) por enquanto

Requisitos

Windows 10/11 64 bits, com o Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (C++ e CMake; o comando está em Como gerar). O launcher confere isso para você.
A sua ISO do Spawn: Armageddon, na versão europeia (PAL) (SLES-52326). O gerador confere o executável e, se não bater, diz se é outra edição (outra região ou versão) ou o mesmo disco com o executável modificado.
Memória: o gerador usa uns 3 GB de RAM por compilação em paralelo e escolhe o paralelismo pela memória livre; com pouca RAM funciona, só demora mais.
Disco: alguns GB livres para os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação (um jogo desta família usa uns 5 GB; o seu pode variar com o tamanho do disco).
AVX2 não é obrigatório: o gerador detecta a CPU e usa as bibliotecas AVX2 ou SSE4.

Desempenho medido
FPS de jogo, no motor publicado, sem a resolução interna (1x). Só colocamos o que foi medido; as demais máquinas ainda não foram testadas com este jogo.

Como medimos: Ryzen 7 9800X3D + RTX 5080, 1080p, com o jogo preso a menos núcleos pelo Windows (afinidade), média do começo do jogo (uma rodada). Isso dá uma boa ideia, mas um processador fraco de verdade (menos cache, clock menor) pode render menos que um 9800X3D limitado. Entre rodadas há variação de 3 a 5 FPS.
Problemas conhecidos

No motor publicado, o jogo pode cair por volta dos 25 s ao pular os vídeos. Já não acontece na build de 09/11 que estamos testando; a correção ainda não foi publicada.
Esta é a versão europeia (PAL) apenas (SLES-52326); outras regiões e versões são recusadas pelo gerador, com o motivo.

Como gerar
Pelo Otavix Launcher
O Otavix Launcher lista este port como em desenvolvimento: ele baixa o port, pede a ISO, gera o jogo e abre.
À mão
1. O que você precisa ter: a sua cópia do Spawn: Armageddon europeu (SLES-52326, "Spawn - Armageddon (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)") como imagem .iso do DVD. O gerador confere o executável do jogo pelo hash: outras versões não servem, porque o mapa de funções é o da europeia.
2. Instale as ferramentas (uma vez só), num terminal:
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.CMake.Project --includeRecommended"

O resto o gerador baixa sozinho: o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256) e o FFmpeg (LGPL). Não precisa de Python nem de Git.
3. Baixe este repositório (botão Code > Download ZIP, ou git clone) e extraia numa pasta sem espaços no caminho, por exemplo C:\spawn-armageddon-pc. Deixe uns 5 GB livres nesse disco (os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação).
4. Clique duas vezes em gerar.cmd e escolha a ISO. Ele:

confere a ISO e extrai os arquivos do disco para trabalho\disc;
baixa o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256);
traduz o código do jogo para C++ (só no seu PC);
compila o código do jogo (de 5 a 30 minutos, conforme o PC; precisa de 16 GB de RAM ou mais).

5. Jogue com jogar.cmd. O jogo lê os arquivos de trabalho\disc e a ISO no lugar onde ela estava na geração (se mudar a ISO de lugar, rode gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 2).
Depois de atualizar o port, gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo. Com o componente "C++ Clang tools" do Visual Studio instalado, a geometria compila com o clang-cl e fica um pouco mais rápida (sem ele, usa o MSVC).
Perguntas frequentes
Este repositório tem o jogo? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD; o gerador monta o port no seu PC a partir da sua ISO.
Roda no Linux ou no SteamOS? Ainda não: só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta). Este roda no Windows.
O gerador disse "executável modificado" ou "edição diferente". E agora? "Edição diferente" é outra região ou versão do disco; "executável modificado" é o mesmo disco com um executável alterado (patch, tradução, hack ou outra tiragem). Use uma cópia original sem modificações (SLES-52326).
Saiu uma atualização do port. O que faço? Atualize pelo launcher e gere de novo (gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 à mão): ele baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Onde relato um problema? No launcher, em "Reportar problema" na página do jogo.
Como funciona

O motor (tradutor MIPS R5900 → C++ e runtime: GS, VU1, DMA, IOP, áudio SPU2, cartão de memória) é próprio do projeto e vem pronto (bibliotecas compiladas); o seu PC só traduz e compila o código do jogo.
O mapa de funções (jogo\ghidra_funcoes.csv) veio de uma análise com o Ghidra e a extensão ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded: são só endereços e nomes, nada do código do jogo. jogo\entradas_extra.txt lista funções chamadas só por ponteiro e alvos de tabelas de salto que a análise não marcou, e jogo\stubs_extra.txt as funções trocadas por respostas fixas; jogo\stubs_tirar.txt as que voltam a rodar o código do jogo (o som fala com o driver de som de verdade).

Licença e créditos

O nosso código (gerar.ps1, gerar.cmd, ferramentas\): MIT.
O motor do port (pacote otx-motor-ps2, baixado pronto pelo gerador) não é coberto pela licença MIT; os avisos de terceiros dele (raylib e glfw: zlib; FFmpeg: LGPL, DLLs à parte) estão no TERCEIROS.txt do pacote.

Num notebook com processador de 4 núcleos (i5 de 8ª geração), use o modo 30 FPS, que segura o ritmo estável. A parte gráfica do console (GS) roda na placa de vídeo (OpenGL 4.3). Sem o launcher, as mesmas opções são variáveis de ambiente: PS2X_QPS=30, PS2X_TELA_CHEIA=1, PS2X_JANELA_TAM=1920x1080, PS2X_RESOLUCAO=1|2|4, PS2X_ESCALA=nenhum|bilinear|fsr|nis, PS2X_NITIDEZ_PCT=0..100, PS2X_FXAA=1, PS2X_ASPECTO=4:3|16:9|21:9|32:9|tela|nativo.

Memória: o gerador usa uns 3 GB de RAM por compilação em paralelo e escolhe o paralelismo pela memória livre; com pouca RAM funciona, só demora mais.
Disco: alguns GB livres para os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação (um jogo desta família usa uns 5 GB; o seu pode variar com o tamanho do disco).

Desempenho medido

Como medimos: Ryzen 7 9800X3D + RTX 5080, 1080p, com o jogo preso a menos núcleos pelo Windows (afinidade), média do começo do jogo em duas rodadas. Isso dá uma boa ideia, mas um processador fraco de verdade (menos cache, clock menor) pode render menos que um 9800X3D limitado. Entre rodadas há variação de 3 a 5 FPS.
Com 4 núcleos ou menos no 1x a diferença entre rodadas chega a 14 FPS: depende do trecho do jogo.
Problemas conhecidos

Em alguns PCs o vídeo de abertura pode travar de vez em quando (feche e abra de novo).
Uma faixa verde fina aparece nas últimas linhas da imagem em algumas telas.

Esta é a versão americana (NTSC-U) apenas (SCUS-97481); outras regiões e versões são recusadas pelo gerador, com o motivo.

Como gerar
Pelo Otavix Launcher
O Otavix Launcher lista este port: ele baixa o port, pede a ISO, gera o jogo e abre.
À mão
1. O que você precisa ter: a sua cópia do God of War II americano (SCUS-97481, "God of War II (USA)") como imagem .iso do DVD. O gerador confere o executável do jogo pelo hash: outras versões não servem, porque o mapa de funções é o da americana.
2. Instale as ferramentas (uma vez só), num terminal:
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.CMake.Project --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Llvm.Clang --includeRecommended"

O resto o gerador baixa sozinho: o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256) e o FFmpeg (LGPL). Não precisa de Python nem de Git.
3. Baixe este repositório (botão Code > Download ZIP, ou git clone) e extraia numa pasta sem espaços no caminho, por exemplo C:\god-of-war-2-pc. Deixe uns 15 GB livres nesse disco (os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação).
4. Clique duas vezes em gerar.cmd e escolha a ISO. Ele:

confere a ISO e extrai os arquivos do disco para trabalho\disc;
baixa o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256);
traduz o código do jogo e os microprogramas do VU1 para C++ (só no seu PC);
compila o código do jogo (de 5 a 30 minutos, conforme o PC; precisa de 16 GB de RAM ou mais).

5. Jogue com jogar.cmd. O jogo lê os arquivos de trabalho\disc e a ISO no lugar onde ela estava na geração (se mudar a ISO de lugar, rode gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 2).
Depois de atualizar o port, gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo. Com o componente "C++ Clang tools" do Visual Studio instalado (já incluído no comando acima), a geometria compila com o clang-cl e fica mais rápida.
Perguntas frequentes
Este repositório tem o jogo? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD; o gerador monta o port no seu PC a partir da sua ISO.
Roda no Linux ou no SteamOS? Ainda não: só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta). Este roda no Windows.
O gerador disse "executável modificado" ou "edição diferente". E agora? "Edição diferente" é outra região ou versão do disco; "executável modificado" é o mesmo disco com um executável alterado (patch, tradução, hack ou outra tiragem). Use uma cópia original sem modificações (SCUS-97481).
Saiu uma atualização do port. O que faço? Atualize pelo launcher e gere de novo (gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 à mão): ele baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Onde relato um problema? No launcher, em "Reportar problema" na página do jogo.
Como funciona

O motor (tradutor MIPS R5900 → C++ e runtime: GS, VU1, DMA, IOP, áudio SPU2, cartão de memória) é próprio do projeto e vem pronto (bibliotecas compiladas); o seu PC só traduz e compila o código do jogo.
O mapa de funções (jogo\ghidra_funcoes.csv) veio de uma análise com o Ghidra e a extensão ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded: são só endereços e nomes, nada do código do jogo. jogo\entradas_extra.txt lista funções chamadas só por ponteiro e alvos de tabelas de salto que a análise não marcou.
A receita do VU1 (jogo\vu1_receita.json) diz onde os microprogramas de geometria ficam no executável (offsets e tamanhos, conferidos por SHA-1) e como montar a memória de código do VU1; o único trecho que não vem do executável é uma instrução de 8 bytes que o próprio jogo monta enquanto roda.
O modo 30 FPS usa o limitador do próprio jogo (um remendo de memória no endereço 2D80B8, como os que os jogadores usam no PCSX2), aplicado pelo runtime quando PS2X_QPS=30.

Licença e créditos

O nosso código (gerar.ps1, gerar.cmd, ferramentas\): MIT.
O motor do port (pacote otx-motor-ps2, baixado pronto pelo gerador) não é coberto pela licença MIT; os avisos de terceiros dele (raylib e glfw: zlib; FFmpeg: LGPL, DLLs à parte) estão no TERCEIROS.txt do pacote.
O NIS vem do NVIDIA Image Scaling SDK (MIT) e o FSR 1 do AMD FidelityFX FSR (MIT).
God of War II e God of War são marcas da Sony Interactive Entertainment. Este é um projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos, sem relação com a Sony Interactive Entertainment nem o Santa Monica Studio nem endossado por eles.

nlorqt.title: Исследователь Anthropic: ИИ может навсегда лишить работы почти всех, а сверхчеловеческий ИИ появится к концу 2027 года
nlorqt.content:
Исследователь компании Anthropic Тао Лин выступил с тревожным прогнозом относительно будущего искусственного интеллекта. По его мнению, ИИ со временем может сделать практически всех людей невостребованными на рынке труда, вынудив правительства взять на себя их финансовое обеспечение.
Лин, занимающийся разработкой защитных механизмов для моделей Claude, поделился своими прогнозами в интервью Palisade Research, опубликованном 15 ноября. Он считает, что уже к концу 2027 года может появиться сверхчеловеческий ИИ, способный сравниться с ведущими мировыми специалистами или превзойти их практически во всех областях — от программирования до кинопроизводства.
По личным оценкам исследователя, до появления подобных систем осталось приблизительно 1,3 года. Однако это не означает, что массовая безработица наступит в те же сроки.
Практически все люди на Земле навсегда станут невостребованными на рынке труда,
— заявил Лин.
По его мнению, сначала искусственный интеллект начнёт вытеснять работников из существующих профессий. Люди будут переходить в другие сферы деятельности, однако со временем ИИ сможет заменить их и там.
Главным препятствием на пути к практически полной автоматизации исследователь считает робототехнику. Если интеллектуальный труд можно автоматизировать с помощью программных систем, то для замены людей в физической экономике потребуются передовые роботы, автоматизированные предприятия и соответствующая инфраструктура. Поэтому Лин не называет конкретных сроков наступления практически всеобщей безработицы.
Ещё более тревожным оказался его прогноз относительно безопасности ИИ. Исследователь оценивает примерно в 20% вероятность сценария, при котором передовой искусственный интеллект в конечном итоге полностью исключит человечество из происходящих процессов.

При этом собственные исследования Anthropic пока не подтверждают неизбежность массовой безработицы. Согласно опубликованным в марте 2026 года данным, с конца 2022 года систематического роста безработицы среди специалистов, наиболее подверженных влиянию ИИ, не наблюдалось.
Однако компания обнаружила предварительные признаки замедления найма молодых сотрудников в некоторых профессиях. Кроме того, исследование показало, что 68% наблюдаемого использования Claude приходится на задачи, теоретически выполнимые исключительно искусственным интеллектом. Это, впрочем, не означает фактического вытеснения работников.

В июле Anthropic также объявила о создании исследовательского фонда объёмом 200 миллионов долларов для изучения экономических последствий развития ИИ, включая реформирование страхования по безработице и механизмы долгосрочной финансовой поддержки населения.
Сам Лин считает, что искусственный интеллект развивается слишком быстро, не оставляя обществу достаточно времени для безопасной адаптации. Он предлагает замедлить исследования передовых систем ИИ примерно до четверти нынешних темпов, чтобы успеть разработать необходимые защитные механизмы и меры государственного регулирования.
Исследователь также признал, что у людей есть вполне обоснованные причины злиться на разработчиков искусственного интеллекта, включая его самого, поскольку они создают технологии, способные коренным образом изменить будущее общества без его согласия.

Впрочем, пока прогнозы Лина остаются исключительно предположениями. Даже появление сверхчеловеческого ИИ не обязательно приведёт к всеобщей безработице, учитывая технические, экономические и законодательные препятствия на пути к полной автоматизации труда.

English summary below
O que é
Um port nativo do God of War (PlayStation 2, 2005) para Windows. Não é um emulador: o código do jogo é traduzido para C++ e compilado para x86-64 (recompilação estática), com o motor PS2 próprio do projeto (Otavix).
Como o código do jogo não pode ser distribuído, o seu PC gera e compila a parte do jogo a partir da sua ISO. Um comando só faz tudo.
Estado atual: beta
O jogo roda do começo, com som, vídeos e gráficos como no PlayStation 2. Roda a 60 FPS em PCs atuais (testado num Ryzen 7 9800X3D). Num notebook com processador de 4 núcleos (i5 de 8ª geração), use o modo 30 FPS, que segura o ritmo estável. A parte gráfica do console (GS) roda na placa de vídeo (OpenGL 4.3). Os microprogramas de geometria do VU1 são traduzidos para C++ na sua máquina, a partir do executável do seu disco (a etapa "VU1" do gerador).
Problemas conhecidos: em alguns PCs o vídeo de abertura pode travar de vez em quando (feche e abra de novo). Relate o que encontrar pelo launcher.
Opções
Pelo Otavix Launcher, no menu de opções do jogo: 30 ou 60 FPS, janela ou tela cheia (no jogo, F11 ou Alt+Enter alternam), tamanho da janela, resolução interna (1x, 2x ou 4x), escalonador (bilinear, AMD FSR 1 ou NVIDIA Image Scaling) e a nitidez dele, anti-serrilhamento FXAA, proporção 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 e 32:9 (ultrawide) e predefinições (Notebook / PC fraco, Equilibrado, Qualidade). Sem o launcher, as mesmas opções são variáveis de ambiente: PS2X_QPS=30, PS2X_TELA_CHEIA=1, PS2X_JANELA_TAM=1920x1080, PS2X_RESOLUCAO=1|2|4, PS2X_ESCALA=nenhum|bilinear|fsr|nis, PS2X_NITIDEZ_PCT=0..100, PS2X_FXAA=1, PS2X_ASPECTO=4:3|16:9|21:9|32:9|tela|nativo.
Teclado e mouse
O teclado e o mouse funcionam junto com o controle. As teclas são trocadas na página Controles do
Otavix Launcher, que também liga ou desliga o teclado e o mouse e ajusta a sensibilidade. Teclas padrão:

Sem o launcher: PS2X_TECLADO=0|1, PS2X_MOUSE=0|1, PS2X_MOUSE_SENS=5..200 e PS2X_TECLAS="cross=space;square=mouse1 j;lstick_up=w" (botão=teclas, separados por ;).

Situação

não suportado no momento

Como jogar
pelo launcher, ou gerar.cmd e jogar.cmd
só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta) por enquanto

Requisitos

Windows 10/11 64 bits, com o Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (C++ e CMake; o comando está em Como gerar). O launcher confere isso para você.
A sua ISO do God of War, na versão americana (NTSC-U) (SCUS-97399). O gerador confere o executável e, se não bater, diz se é outra edição (outra região ou versão) ou o mesmo disco com o executável modificado.
Memória: o gerador usa uns 3 GB de RAM por compilação em paralelo e escolhe o paralelismo pela memória livre; com pouca RAM funciona, só demora mais.
Disco: alguns GB livres para os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação (um jogo desta família usa uns 5 GB; o seu pode variar com o tamanho do disco).
AVX2 não é obrigatório: o gerador detecta a CPU e usa as bibliotecas AVX2 ou SSE4.

Desempenho medido

Como medimos: Ryzen 7 9800X3D + RTX 5080, 1080p, com o jogo preso a menos núcleos pelo Windows (afinidade), média do começo do jogo em duas rodadas. Isso dá uma boa ideia, mas um processador fraco de verdade (menos cache, clock menor) pode render menos que um 9800X3D limitado. Entre rodadas há variação de 3 a 5 FPS.
Problemas conhecidos

Um trecho de cerca de 25 s fica a 30 FPS: é do próprio jogo, igual no PlayStation 2.
Esta é a versão americana (NTSC-U) apenas (SCUS-97399); outras regiões e versões são recusadas pelo gerador, com o motivo.

Como gerar
Pelo Otavix Launcher
O Otavix Launcher lista este port: ele baixa o port, pede a ISO, gera o jogo e abre.
À mão
1. O que você precisa ter: a sua cópia do God of War americano (SCUS-97399, "God of War (USA)") como imagem .iso do DVD. O gerador confere o executável do jogo pelo hash: outras versões não servem, porque o mapa de funções é o da americana.
2. Instale as ferramentas (uma vez só), num terminal:
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.CMake.Project --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Llvm.Clang --includeRecommended"

O resto o gerador baixa sozinho: o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256) e o FFmpeg (LGPL). Não precisa de Python nem de Git.
3. Baixe este repositório (botão Code > Download ZIP, ou git clone) e extraia numa pasta sem espaços no caminho, por exemplo C:\god-of-war-pc. Deixe uns 15 GB livres nesse disco (os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação).
4. Clique duas vezes em gerar.cmd e escolha a ISO. Ele:

confere a ISO e extrai os arquivos do disco para trabalho\disc;
baixa o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256);
traduz o código do jogo e os microprogramas do VU1 para C++ (só no seu PC);
compila o código do jogo (de 5 a 30 minutos, conforme o PC; precisa de 16 GB de RAM ou mais).

5. Jogue com jogar.cmd. O jogo lê os arquivos de trabalho\disc e a ISO no lugar onde ela estava na geração (se mudar a ISO de lugar, rode gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 2).
Depois de atualizar o port, gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo. Com o componente "C++ Clang tools" do Visual Studio instalado (já incluído no comando acima), a geometria compila com o clang-cl e fica mais rápida.
Perguntas frequentes
Este repositório tem o jogo? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD; o gerador monta o port no seu PC a partir da sua ISO.
Roda no Linux ou no SteamOS? Ainda não: só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta). Este roda no Windows.
O gerador disse "executável modificado" ou "edição diferente". E agora? "Edição diferente" é outra região ou versão do disco; "executável modificado" é o mesmo disco com um executável alterado (patch, tradução, hack ou outra tiragem). Use uma cópia original sem modificações (SCUS-97399).
Saiu uma atualização do port. O que faço? Atualize pelo launcher e gere de novo (gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 à mão): ele baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Onde relato um problema? No launcher, em "Reportar problema" na página do jogo.
Como funciona

O motor (tradutor MIPS R5900 → C++ e runtime: GS, VU1, DMA, IOP, áudio SPU2, cartão de memória) é próprio do projeto e vem pronto (bibliotecas compiladas); o seu PC só traduz e compila o código do jogo.
O mapa de funções (jogo\ghidra_funcoes.csv) veio de uma análise com o Ghidra e a extensão ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded: são só endereços e nomes, nada do código do jogo. jogo\entradas_extra.txt lista funções chamadas só por ponteiro e alvos de tabelas de salto que a análise não marcou.
A receita do VU1 (jogo\vu1_receita.json) diz onde os microprogramas de geometria ficam no executável (offsets e tamanhos, conferidos por SHA-1) e como montar a memória de código do VU1; o único trecho que não vem do executável é uma instrução de 8 bytes que o próprio jogo monta enquanto roda.
O modo 30 FPS usa o limitador do próprio jogo (um remendo de memória no endereço 29C654, como os que os jogadores usam no PCSX2), aplicado pelo runtime quando PS2X_QPS=30.

Licença e créditos

O nosso código (gerar.ps1, gerar.cmd, ferramentas\): MIT.
O motor do port (pacote otx-motor-ps2, baixado pronto pelo gerador) não é coberto pela licença MIT; os avisos de terceiros dele (raylib e glfw: zlib; FFmpeg: LGPL, DLLs à parte) estão no TERCEIROS.txt do pacote.
O NIS vem do NVIDIA Image Scaling SDK (MIT) e o FSR 1 do AMD FidelityFX FSR (MIT).
God of War e God of War são marcas da Sony Interactive Entertainment. Este é um projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos, sem relação com a Sony Interactive Entertainment nem o Santa Monica Studio nem endossado por eles.

English summary
A native PC port of God of War (PlayStation 2, 2005) made by static recompilation with the project's own PS2 engine. Beta. It runs from the start with sound, videos and PS2-accurate graphics, at 60 FPS on current PCs; on 4-core laptops use the 30 FPS mode. The console's graphics chip (GS) runs on your GPU (OpenGL 4.3). Options in the launcher: 30/60 FPS, window or fullscreen (F11 / Alt+Enter), window size, internal resolution (1x, 2x or 4x), upscaler (bilinear, AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA Image Scaling) and sharpness, FXAA, aspect ratio 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and 32:9 (ultrawide).
Platforms: Windows 10/11 only for now (Linux is not supported yet; only the God of War: Ascension port has a Linux beta). Performance: measured on two PCs (Ryzen 7 9800X3D + RTX 5080, and Core i5-11400F + RX 9060 XT), see the table above; the laptop is not measured yet. Easiest: the Otavix Launcher. Per CPU core count (engine 0.1.13, 9800X3D limited by affinity): at 4x it holds ~50 FPS with any core count, even 2; the GPU is the limit there.
Bring your own game: no game code or data here, only the function map (addresses), translation settings and the VU1 "recipe" (offsets and sizes in your executable). You need the US release (SCUS-97399, Redump "God of War (USA)") as an .iso. Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with C++, CMake and Clang (commands above), download this repository to a path without spaces with about 15 GB free, double-click gerar.cmd (it checks your ISO, extracts the disc files, downloads the prebuilt engine package (no Git needed), translates the game code on your PC and builds it, in 5 to 30 minutes; 16 GB of RAM needed), then play with jogar.cmd.
License: our scripts are MIT; the engine package is not covered by it, and its third-party notices are in its TERCEIROS.txt. God of War and God of War are trademarks of Sony Interactive Entertainment; this is a non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment or Santa Monica Studio.

mgm1uz.title: Миллионы смотрели, миллиарды пакетов летели: GTA VI устроила интернету стресс-тест, взвинтив трафик до рекордных 33 Тбит/с
mgm1uz.content:
Опрос

3DNews Новости Software игры Миллионы смотрели, миллиарды пакетов лет...

реклама

Новости Software

Самое интересное в обзорах

20.11.2026 [19:26],

GTA VI испытывает интернет-инфраструктуру на прочность, привлекая миллионы зрителей. В первые часы после выхода игры прямые трансляции на Twitch, YouTube и других платформах набрали почти 8 миллионов просмотров. По данным оператора точек обмена интернет-трафиком DE-CIX, глобальный релиз GTA VI на игровых консолях PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X и S, привёл к установлению нового рекорда по объёму трафика.
Источник изображения: Rockstar Games

Новые рекорды трафика были зафиксированы на прошлой неделе во время предварительной загрузки игры. В среду вечером показатели по всему миру вновь превысили средние значения: в Чикаго — 1,22 Тбит/с, Нью-Йорке — 2,44 Тбит/с, Мадриде — 1,43 Тбит/с, Лиссабоне — 79,9 Гбит/с, Дубае — 1,25 Тбит/с, Сингапуре — 627 Гбит/с и Франкфурте — 22,15 Тбит/с.
Выход GTA VI вызвал беспрецедентный интерес к прямым трансляциям. Вечером 18 ноября пропускная способность сетей DE-CIX по всему миру достигла рекордного уровня — 33,03 Тбит/с, а объём передаваемых данных в период запуска GTA VI оказался на 25 % выше обычных показателей.

Во время запуска игра установила рекорды по количеству зрителей: в пиковый момент число одновременно смотрящих трансляции на различных платформах достигло 7,91 миллиона человек. Согласно предварительным данным, на отдельных площадках были зафиксированы следующие пиковые показатели: 3,31 миллиона зрителей на Twitch, 3,22 миллиона на YouTube и 1,50 миллиона на Kick. Свой вклад в общую аудиторию внесли и другие платформы.
По информации сервиса Stream Charts, GTA VI обошла League of Legends, установив рекорд по количеству одновременных зрителей за всю историю Twitch. По данным стримингового сервиса Twitch всего через шесть часов после выхода игры в Новой Зеландии количество зрителей трансляций по GTA VI на платформе превысило предыдущий рекорд, установленный в 2020 году игрой Valorant (1,7 миллиона одновременных зрителей).

В целом, показатели просмотров на Twitch выросли на 111 % по сравнению с предыдущей неделей. Всего за несколько часов после начала трансляций общее время просмотра GTA VI исчислялось «десятками миллионов часов» — по оценке Twitch, это «эквивалентно более чем 1500 годам непрерывного просмотра».

2et5aw.title: Франція нагадує про необхідність відновити дискусію щодо вступу України в НАТО - джерело
2et5aw.content:
Франція знову порушує питання членства України в НАТО у зв’язку з прискоренням переговорного процесу щодо завершення війни та необхідністю визначити довгострокові гарантії безпеки для України та Європи.

Про це кореспондентові Укрінформу розповіли джерела в колі радників президента Франції.

«Президент ніколи й не змінював своєї позиції щодо України та НАТО. Але ми сьогодні знову повертаємося до цього питання, тому що вважаємо, що переговорний процес прискорився. Зараз ми перебуваємо на етапі структуризації переговорів. І робимо це за повноцінної участі наших європейських партнерів, у тісній взаємодії з американцями та за повної підтримки України», - зазначив співрозмовник.

За його словами, на цьому етапі важливо мати максимально чітке розуміння майбутніх гарантій безпеки, зокрема тих, що передбачені статтею 5.

«Оскільки НАТО досі не поверталося до питання членства України, президент сьогодні нагадує про необхідність відновити цю дискусію. І на нашу думку, в наших спільних інтересах просуватися вперед та детально опрацьовувати умови цього вступу», - заявили в оточенні Макрона.

Співрозмовник нагадав, що під час саміту НАТО у Вільнюсі США та Німеччина виступили проти підтвердження можливості вступу України до Альянсу, тоді як Франція вже тоді чітко підтримувала таку перспективу, «бо це найкращий спосіб надати гарантії».

За його словами, після завершення війни Україна матиме найбільш досвідчену, ефективну та боєздатну армію, що, безумовно, стане надзвичайно важливим активом для Альянсу.

Читайте також: Україна має бути членом НАТО та не повинна віддавати за це території - глава міноборони Естонії

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, президент Франції Еммануель Макрон за підсумками засідання Коаліції охочих у Берліні заявив, що переговори про мир мають відбуватися за участю України, Росії, США та Європи. Він також закликав повернутися до питання членства України в НАТО як складової довгострокової європейської безпеки.

1q5kgko.title: How ‘I Play Rocky’ Star P.J. Byrne Became One of Hollywood’s Go-To Character Actors
1q5kgko.content:
Logo text

Ever since P.J. Byrne had a literal meltdown in the most showstopping scene of Damien Chazelle’s Babylon, his career as a scene-stealing character actor has reached a new high.

The New Jersey native’s 2026 alone has brought eight credits, including the conclusion of his recurring character on The Boys, Coyote vs. Acme, The End of Oak Street and a series-regular role on USA’s basic cable hit The Rainmaker. Most notably, he now stars in his biggest film role to date as Oscar-winning Rocky producer Irwin Winkler in Peter Farrelly’s biographical Oscar contender, I Play Rocky.

In 1975, Winkler and his producing partner Robert Chartoff were developing Martin Scorsese’s New York, New York at the same time as the underdog story from a then-unknown Sylvester Stallone. The former would become the first of a half-dozen films Winkler collaborated on with Scorsese, including 2013’s The Wolf of Wall Street. It’s fitting, then, that Byrne is now playing the celebrated producer, given that his own career turning point came with his role as Rugrat in Scorsese and Leonardo DiCaprio’s unhinged take on the life of former stockbroker Jordan Belfort. (Byrne would later reunite with Scorsese on his 2016 series Vinyl.)

Byrne’s turn as a founding member of Belfort’s Stratton Oakmont is probably best remembered for one particularly rambunctious trading-floor scene in which his character shaves a female sales assistant’s head. The opportunity also allowed Byrne to put his unused finance degree from Boston College to work, albeit in a fictionalized version of a career path he had quickly abandoned because of his aversion to boiler-room culture.

In the mid-’90s, one of his Boston College professors encouraged him to try his hand at drama school instead, leading him to DePaul University in Chicago. Byrne’s time in the Windy City seems to have left a lasting impression. He often speaks about acting in the same terms that Chicago Bulls legend Michael Jordan once used to describe his record-setting 3-point barrage against the Portland Trail Blazers in Game 1 of the 1992 NBA Finals. When Byrne acts, he strives to enter a flow state, or “the zone,” as Jordan called it, where he’s so locked in to the task at hand that distractions fade and he can achieve peak performance.

Byrne’s Wolf of Wall Street video audition featured a monologue he reimagined from the ground up. Channeling his brief experience in the financial world, he portrayed his stockbroker character emotionally manipulating a widow into forking over $100,000 during a sales call. Scorsese appreciated the creative risk so much that he recited part of the speech back to Byrne during their eventual in-person callback. Byrne’s improvisational instincts and willingness to take creative leaps through punch-ups and alternative dialogue are muscles he first developed during his early days in Los Angeles.

At the turn of the century, Byrne put himself through the wringer of commercial auditions. With a talent pool far deeper than most people might expect, he knew he needed to find a way to stand out. That meant arriving with his own variations on the material or improvising in the moment. To pay the bills between sporadic acting jobs, he provided script coverage and handled other development duties at the production company of family friend and fellow Boston College alum Chris O’Donnell.

Eventually, he left his VP position to focus solely on acting. The nameless parts soon gave way to small but named roles, though there were milestones along the way that reinforced his greater pursuit. One came when he made Will Ferrell and Stephen Colbert laugh during a table-read scene in Nora Ephron’s Bewitched (2005). Byrne played a TV writer in the film, an early example of the showbiz-affiliated roles that would become a calling card throughout his career. He speculates that his time working in development may have influenced that pattern.

Byrne’s road to I Play Rocky can also be traced back to commercials cast by casting director Rick Montgomery. It further involved producer Toby Emmerich’s tenure as head of New Line, during which Byrne made memorable appearances in the label’s Horrible Bosses and Final Destination 5. Above all, Byrne won a major fan in Farrelly when he played a record executive in the best picture-winning Green Book, followed by Dear Santa, the Christmas comedy Farrelly co-wrote for his brother Bobby to direct.

“After Green Book, Peter was like, ‘You need your Paul Giamatti [in Sideways] part. You need a bigger part in a movie,’” Byrne tells The Hollywood Reporter.

The role of Irwin Winkler still didn’t come easy. In the behind-the-scenes narrative, Winkler and Chartoff desperately want to produce Stallone’s Rocky screenplay, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to star as the title character. Winkler and Chartoff, ever the pragmatists, try to give the aspiring young actor and screenwriter a reality check about how star power drives the financing and green-lighting of most movies. But Stallone stands his ground despite increasingly lucrative offers for the script.

Eventually, Winkler and Chartoff realize they shouldn’t be producing an underdog story about a small-time boxer named Rocky Balboa if they aren’t willing to practice what they preach. So they risk everything, including their names and their homes, to install Stallone as the star, all while distributor United Artists sets him up to fail at every turn in hopes of replacing him with a proven commodity.

The casting of Byrne’s role also became rather meta because the I Play Rocky brain trust initially sought a name for Winkler. With relative unknown Anthony Ippolito already cast as young Sly, it’s understandable why they would want to shore up the surrounding roles with established, butts-in-seats actors. But the producers of I Play Rocky ultimately arrived at the same conclusion as the producers of Rocky — gamble on talent, not status.

“They wanted to get a name, because there weren’t a lot of names [in this cast]. But they were also living in the world of, If we’re going to cast Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone, then let’s give other people shots too,” Byrne says. “They all knew me from these small parts. Then they just believed in me enough to give me a shot. I want to tell the world that there’s honestly no small parts. Someone will ultimately give you a chance.”

Below, in a conversation with THR, Byrne also discusses the day his improvisational skills resulted in I Play Rocky’s most hilarious scene. He also addresses whether the strained relationship between Winkler and Stallone in recent years influenced his take at all.

***

You’ve had a prolific 2026.

It’s not talent. I just have three children. I have to pay for their lives. That’s all that is. It’s like, Yes, I’ll do that. I have three children.

You’ve still cemented yourself as one of the industry’s go-to character actors.

I love you.

Can you feel that wind in your sail?

I always say ABC: always be classy. So I don’t know if I can admit to that, but I do have repeat buyers, if you will, because they’re buddies. Once I work on anything, I tend to have repeat business. So I’ll meet you halfway. I hate giving myself flowers like that, but I believe in myself to deliver. And if other people see that, then I appreciate it.

When you hear labels like “character actor” or “comic relief” or “scene-stealer,” do you bristle at all? Or do you embrace the lane you’ve carved out for yourself?

It’s funny. I don’t even look at it that way. All ships rise with the tide. I want everyone to score and win. I’m always surrounded by incredible actors in everything I do, so everyone passes the ball nicely. It’s not about being funny or stealing scenes. It’s, How do I make these moments pop more? This sounds so cheesy and trite, but it’s really, How do I service the director or the writer? I’ve been doing this so long that they are often my really good friends.

When someone makes a movie, they’ve put four years of their life into it. They’ve battled producers and studio executives to get this one day of this particular scene, and half their budget is being spent on a goddamn crane shot. So I just want to do everything I can for them. I put in the work, and my brain just naturally looks for moments that can pop. Is there an ability to make this zeitgeisty so that people can relate to it and it can become its own thing?

Where did this mentality come from?

I started out in Los Angeles doing commercials, and I was baptized by fire doing them. Commercials are like street basketball. It’s rough. They’re not nice to you. The rooms aren’t sweet. They’re not kind. But some of the best actors are commercial actors. They just never found the right lane or the right agent. They’re still out there, and they’re extraordinary actors. But adding jokes during commercial auditions is how I trained my brain to find moments to pop. I would think of the fifth funniest joke in my brain because the first four would probably be thought of by someone else.

That mindset succeeds in scenarios where I have fearless directors who’ve proven themselves. It’s usually the great directors like Marty Scorsese or Peter Farrelly or Damien Chazelle who don’t have to worry about notes from everyone. They know I’ve done the work and have their vision in mind, so they’ll take the handcuffs off me. They’ll be like, “Just add stuff. We trust you. Go.” They know that before a job, I’ll literally sit in a hotel room for two weeks and have food sent up while I make sure I’m doing everything I can for them. I don’t want to let anyone down.

You’re also asked to play showbiz people fairly often. The Boys, Babylon, The Big Cigar and A Complete Unknown are only a few examples, as is your current role as Irwin Winkler in I Play Rocky. Do you have any theories why this has become your niche?

I feel like I have a face like that. I also do a lot of period pieces and play a lot of lawyers. That’s just what’s filming now. But I think it’s all because I know those characters well from when I started out in Los Angeles.

I owe a lot to Chris O’Donnell. When he was Robin [in Batman & Robin], he had a production company at Warner Bros. His sisters and my sister are really good friends. And because I had a finance degree from Boston College, I was like, If acting doesn’t work out, I can be an intern with them. To his credit, his company gave me a script and were like, “Hey, do coverage on this script.” So I did, and the coverage was called “brilliant.” But it was only brilliant because I literally just went to grad school where I learned arc and character. I literally just wrote papers for three years.

Chris was like, “Be our story editor.” And I was like, “Chris, I came here to act.” Then he gave me the greatest gift ever when he said, “No, come and go as you please.” So I was able to walk onto the Warner Bros. and work for him, while also doing commercials and small TV jobs. Every time I tried to quit, they were like, “You’re a vice president right now.”

I set up movies. I learned the business. I would walk past The West Wing and ER stages, and I told myself that I wouldn’t set foot on those stages until I was invited. And I did eventually book those jobs. So I became comfortable being in that environment, and it wasn’t so daunting going into those rooms.

It’s because of all those early experiences that I have a lot of friends who are producers, writers and directors. So I know this world well, and when someone says, “Play this showbiz part,” I’m like, “Trust me, I got it.”

You worked with Peter Farrelly on Green Book and Dear Santa. Did he go straight to you for Irwin Winkler?

It wasn’t straight to me, but I love Peter forever. I want to tell the world that there’s honestly no small parts, and you never know what’s going to come around. And that’s why this movie was so super meta for me. They wanted to get a name, because there weren’t a lot of names [in this cast]. But they were also living in the world of, If we’re going to cast Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone, then let’s give other people shots too.

After Green Book, Peter was like, “You need your Paul Giamatti [in Sideways] part. You need a bigger part in a movie.” [I Play Rocky casting director] Rick Montgomery cast me in commercials years ago, and [producer] Toby Emmerich also ran New Line when I had small parts in Horrible Bosses and Final Destination 5.

So they all knew me from these small parts, and they all said, “He’s ready to have a bigger part. Come audition for this.” Then they just believed in me enough to give me a shot. Someone will ultimately give you a chance, just like they once gave it to Sylvester Stallone and now Anthony Ippolito and me.

Everything is driven by the same dozen names now, so it’s nice to hear that Farrelly is looking elsewhere.

Yeah, he’s incredibly loyal. If you look at his movies, the same people always come back. When you go out for drinks with Pete, 32 people show up with him. I love that idea of a family. Working with friends is the best way to go to work, and that’s another reason why I get repeat business.

When it’s four in the morning on a Friday night and you’ve been shooting 12 hours, we’re still cheerleaders for each other. I love those kinds of sets. It kills me when I see people being cancers or want to get off set. Again, I know what my friend went through to be here after four years. So I always say, “Let’s deliver this moment the best way we can because we’re never coming back.”

Toby Kebbell as Chartoff, AnnaSohia Robb as Sasha, P.J. Byrne as Winkler, Anthony Ippolito as Stallone in I Play Rocky.

Claire Folger/Amazon Content Services

What went through your mind when you first witnessed Anthony Ippolito’s take on Sly?

It was at a table read, and while everybody does a version of Sylvester Stallone, I was like, We’re living and dying on this kid. This is the moment. And as soon as he opened his mouth, it was so subtle and soulful and full of heart. It honestly surpassed what my expectation was going to be. I have been doing this a long time, and this is the biggest part I’ve ever gotten in a movie. It’s so beautiful for me, personally. But I can’t help but get so psyched for this kid because he’s so spectacular.

I’ve been around some incredible performances. I watched Leo just destroy on The Wolf of Wall Street. And Margot Robbie, I still wish she got her flowers for Babylon. There’s even a scene with me and Laura Dern on Big Little Lies. When you’re an actor in a scene with them and the camera’s not on you, there’s just a moment when you become an audience member. And you’re like, Oh shit, it’s happening. You can feel it in the room and you want to deliver for them and be there for them. And that’s what happened with Anthony.

Did he stay in character?

He was in the zone. That’s what basketball players say when the net looks like the size of an ocean and they can’t miss. That’s what it felt like watching Anthony. He was so good that I kept thinking, Did Sylvester Stallone travel through space and time to possess this kid’s body? That’s how special it was. Then Pete would call cut, and Anthony would come back online and say, “Hey, what are we getting for dinner tonight?” And I was just like, “What is going on right now?” Peter and I were like, “Is he the world’s greatest actor?” He also played Rocky and Sylvester Stallone, and it was just crazy to watch him play two different characters.

I also watched Timothée Chalamet be Bob Dylan, and that was another time where I was like, “Holy shit.” But Timmy would stay in character, unlike Anthony. So everyone has their own method, and there is no right way.

P.J. Byrne and Irwin Winkler

SARAH ORBANIĆ

There’s no love lost between Stallone and Winkler in recent years. Sly resents the fact that Winkler retains full ownership of the Rocky franchise and that he doesn’t have a piece of the pie to leave for his family. Did you and Farrelly ever discuss planting that seed of acrimony for where their relationship would end up?

Producers are observers. They are there to eliminate risk, put out fires and make sure that the art happens. Sometimes, they have to guide it and have their influence, but that’s what they are. Bob Chartoff and Irwin Winkler were the greatest producers and the ultimate backstop to any ball getting past the catcher. So that’s what I had to deal with in my role.

The first time you meet my character, he’s all business. He’s not mean to Sly, but he just doesn’t look the part for the role being cast. But then he’s intrigued by this smart guy sitting in front of him, and then they eventually read his scripts to see that there’s talent there. At first, Winkler believes in the project, and then he learns to believe in the person behind it.

The end of the movie shows the real-life clip of when Rocky won best picture at the 1977 Oscars. Bob Chartoff and Irwin Winkler stood up, and Irwin Winkler immediately grabbed Sylvester Stallone to join them on stage, which is rare. It’s usually just the producers who accept the best picture award.

But Winkler grabbed Sylvester Stallone and put his arm around him with such love. It was like, This is my son. I believe in you so much. I mortgaged my house for you. I didn’t just bet on a movie. I bet on a child that I love. It’s the idea that you would do anything for your kids, and like I said, I literally work for my children. The money comes in the door, and it goes right to give them every opportunity to succeed in life.

Whatever the extraneous stuff is between them now, I was meant to portray that period of time in the late ‘70s. I was there to share the message that if you really fucking do the work and you believe in yourself — and then you surround yourself with like-minded people who truly believe in you as well — then anything is possible. Maybe you too will one day win an Oscar. That was a special moment in all of their lives, and that’s what I needed to play and had to play.

In a perfect world, a clause would kick in after x amount of years so that the original creator receives at least a sliver of the pie. But like you said, Winkler and Charthoff risked their homes on a complete unknown. They also gave him profit participation on the first film, as well as most, if not all, of the future films. So I hate to both-sides the issue, but I really do see both sides here.

Of course, I thought about all of that and who these people are today and yesterday. But my job was to play that moment in time in which greatness happened. It was a beautiful thing, even if you’re always battling for what you want and going at it. That’s why I have that moment after Winkler found out that Sly and Carl Weathers had never boxed before.

In the screening room?

Yeah, Winkler went out and got the world’s greatest boxing choreographer, but then Sly kicked him out. All the script had was Winkler saying, “It’s a boxing movie!” So I said to Peter, “The producer’s job is to put out fires, so he would lose his mind right now. This is a handcuffs-off moment. Let me riff and play a little bit here.” It was a scary moment because it was late at night right before Thanksgiving, and everybody wanted to go home for Thanksgiving. But here I was adding a lot to the scene.

To Peter’s credit, he let me go. I made that line up about The Godfather: “It’s not about the mafia. It’s about a nice Italian family that loves pasta.” Then, because he’s angry, he has to get the fuck out of the room. So I went up the stairs toward the door, and I added the lines about how this “happens to be” a set of stairs and how this “happens to be” a door as he walks out. So you do go at it when you’re making films because you’re passionate about the product.

Yeah, the “happens to be” scene is your “hello, college!” scene of this movie. Winkler’s meltdown is rooted in director John G. Avildsen’s position that Rocky isn’t a boxing movie. He mad

1xv1xhs.title: ‘Lanterns’ Star Aaron Pierre On DCU Future After Safran & Gunn’s DC Studios Exit: “I’m Very At Peace”
1xv1xhs.content:
Aaron Pierre starred as John Stewart in the HBO & DC Studios series Lanterns and was set to play him across the DC Universe.

However, with Peter Safran and James Gunn no longer co-heads of DC Studios, the future of the world they were building seems uncertain. In a new interview, Pierre reacted to Safran and Gunn’s exits and shared his thoughts on what happens next.

“I haven’t had very much time at all to process the enormity of that news,” Pierre said on the November 19 episode of the IndieWire: Screen Talk podcast about finding out that day that Safran and Gunn were leaving DC Studios. “But what I can say is that my relationship with James and my relationship with Peter is a beautiful relationship.”

He continued, “I’ve really loved every moment, collaborating with them and working with them and getting to know them. And I’m excited to, beyond this point, in a different context, collaborate with them again. And I’m also excited to see what happens next for DC.”

Pierre was to reprise his Lanterns role in Gunn’s Man of Tomorrow, which releases in theaters July 9, 2027. With the DC Studios head changing, it’s unknown what future they are planning and could eventually make edits to the Superman sequel to keep it contained.

RELATED: Skyler Gisondo On The Future Of ‘The People V. Gorilla Grodd’ After James Gunn’s DC Exit: “There’s A Lot Of Questions”

The actor was asked if his character could possibly get edited out of the film, to which he said, “I think for me, we did the film, and we really loved every moment of doing the film. And what happens beyond this point is not my decision. So I’m very at peace.”

“I’m very at peace, and what will be will be,” he continued. “But what I do know is that those friendships will last beyond this point. And also those artistic, creative, working collaboration relationships will live beyond this point as well. And as I say, I’m excited to see where DC goes from here.”

RELATED: ‘Constantine’ Director Feels “More Hopeful” For Sequel Following James Gunn & Peter Safran’s DC Studios Exit

Amid the administration change at DC Studios following the Paramount and Warner Bros. merger, there has been a lot of speculation about Man of Tomorrow and the changes incoming executive Jeremy Latcham would make to the movie.

Gunn took to social media to debunk the rumors, posting on Threads, “No one from Skydance has even seen the movie – the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. So any stories around this narrative are false.”

nbmhik.title: David Fincher Defends Use Of AI Amid ‘Cliff Booth’ Criticism: “Well, It Exists. Should We Not Use It?”
nbmhik.content:
Although The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is steeped with nostalgia for Hollywood’s past, David Fincher claims to represent the future.

While many have criticized the Quentin Tarantino-penned sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019) for the apparent onscreen use of Gen AI, the 3x Oscar-nominated director recently shared his thoughts on the rapidly growing tech.

“I’m not a Luddite, so I don’t fear the unknown,” Fincher told the Los Angeles Times.

“Is everyone satisfied that we have figured this art form out enough that what we really need to do is go back to celluloid?” he continued. “How long have people painted? 40,000 years? We’re talking about a thing that’s a hundred years old and everyone’s going, ‘Stop. Pencils down. No more iterating. It’s not necessary to have at your fingertips the ability to change the color of that person’s eyes.'”

Fincher added, “Well, it exists. Should we not use it?”

The comments come after several fans have taken to social media to criticize the apparent use of AI in the film as “astounding to an absurd degree,” with one viewer saying they “walked out of Cliff Booth completely gutted.”

Set in 1977, eight years after Once Upon a Time…, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth follows Brad Pitt’s eponymous stuntman, now a projectionist who moonlights as a Hollywood fixer, getting caught up in a conspiracy that involves a Filipino gang and a stolen Oscar.

Premiering Thanksgiving on Imax, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth premieres Dec. 23 on Netflix.

gh-1465953889.title: GitHub - dkorunic/Anarch-Bit: Anarch, the public domain Doom-style raycasting shooter, as standalone ESP-IDF firmware for the CircuitMess Bit (ESP32-S3): HD textures, mods, DMA display, buzzer SFX, persistent quicksave
gh-1465953889.content:
Standalone ESP-IDF firmware that runs only Anarch on a CircuitMess Bit
(all revisions; Bit 3.0 = hardware revision 3/4, read from efuse).
Install from your browser: desktop Chrome, Edge
or Opera, a USB-C cable, one click. Nothing to install.

What the Bit's 128x128 screen shows, at 2x size and 20 FPS: rendered on the PC by
tools/make_demo.sh from the same patched sources and settings as the firmware, playing
a scripted run (tools/demo.cpp).

anarch/: git submodule, szymor/anarch, kept unmodified.
mods/: Anarch mods (NN-name.diff). At build time the Anarch sources are copied to
build/esp-idf/main/anarch/ and every mods/*.diff is applied in name order, with no
fuzz: a mod that doesn't fit exactly fails the build instead of landing in the wrong place.
The next idf.py build after any change re-patches and recompiles.

Mods 01-11 are from Anarch's mods/ (the author's "consoomer edition" set, minus crt
and terminal_messages), rebased onto the submodule's commit so they stack exactly; the
original upstream diffs conflict with each other. 12 is ours.

Mod
Does

01 smooth_monsters
monsters move smoothly instead of square by square

02 smooth_text
rounder font

03 better_hud
nicer HUD bar with a compass

04 floor_texture
textured floor (the most common floor height in each level)

05 full_zbuffer
sprites no longer show through walls

06 sprite_flipper
some sprites flip to look animated

07 weapon_swing
weapon sways while walking

08 particle_effects
particles from shots and explosions

09 quicksave
qsave / qload in the game menu

10 hd
64x64 textures instead of 32x32

11 movement_inertia
smoother acceleration / stopping

12 quicksave_store
quicksaves survive power-off (see below); quickload keeps current unlocked levels and settings

A new or updated mod must apply on top of the previous ones: make it against the output of
tools/patch_anarch.sh <dir>, number it after the others, and run tools/smoke_test.sh.
Flash a prebuilt release
The easiest way is the browser installer (ESP Web
Tools, built on Espressif's esptool-js; needs desktop Chrome, Edge or Opera for Web Serial).
It always flashes the latest release's complete image, which erases saved progress.
Every v* tag also gets a release with
two files built by CI:

anarch-bit-merged.bin: the complete image for a first install, written at 0x0. It also
erases saved progress (unlocked levels, settings).
anarch-bit.bin: the app alone, written at 0x10000, to update an earlier release while
keeping saved progress. A quicksave is discarded by any different build either way.

With esptool (pip install esptool) and
the Bit connected over USB:
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 -p /dev/ttyACM0 write_flash 0x0 anarch-bit-merged.bin # first install
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 -p /dev/ttyACM0 write_flash 0x10000 anarch-bit.bin # update
The port is COMx on Windows and /dev/cu.usbmodem... on macOS. To update while keeping
saved progress without installing esptool, use Espressif's generic
esptool-js flasher: Connect to the Bit, add
anarch-bit.bin at 0x10000, Program.
Build and flash
Needs ESP-IDF 5.x (tested to build with v5.4.1) and patch. LovyanGFX 1.2.36 is
fetched from git automatically by the IDF component manager.
git clone --recursive <this repo> # or, in an existing clone: git submodule update --init
. ~/esp/esp-idf/export.sh
idf.py build
idf.py -p /dev/ttyACM0 flash monitor
This replaces the stock firmware. To go back, flash the stock image from the
Bit-Firmware releases.
Controls

Bit button
Anarch key
Does

D-pad
arrows
move / turn, menu navigation

A
A
fire, confirm

B
B
hold + left/right = strafe, hold + up/down = look up/down, cancel

Menu
C
hold + up = jump, hold + left/right (or A/B) = switch weapon, hold + down = game menu

Saves (unlocked levels, settings) go to NVS flash. Quicksaves (game menu qsave, one slot)
go to their own quicksave flash partition and survive power-off, auto-sleep and battery
shutdown. A quicksave is only loaded by the same firmware build that wrote it (it holds
pointers into the firmware), so reflashing a different build discards it.
Not ported

Music (a buzzer can't play the sampled tracks). Sound effects are short frequency
sweeps like the stock firmware's chirps; tweak them in the sounds table in main/main.cpp.

Taken from the stock firmware

Boot: CircuitMess splash (main/Splash.bmp, from Bit-Firmware's spiffs_image),
backlight fade-in and the stock boot jingle; the splash stays 2 s, then fades into the game.
Jingles from the stock firmware: item pickup ("good" chirp), level won, player died.
They follow Anarch's own sound on/off setting.
Backlight fades out before sleep/shutdown. Brightness is Brightness (0-100,
default 100 like stock) in main/main.cpp; lower it to save battery.

Performance
Renders at full 128x128 (SFG_RAYCASTING_SUBSAMPLE 1), 45 FPS, frames sent to the panel by
DMA while the next one renders; flash runs in QIO mode with enlarged caches (the HD textures
are read from flash every frame). With all mods, 60 FPS measured 93-131% CPU load in play on
a Bit 3, hence 45. idf.py monitor prints CPU load: N% every 16 frames (share of the
frame time budget). If it stays above 100%, set SFG_RAYCASTING_SUBSAMPLE 2 and/or a lower
SFG_FPS in main/anarch_settings.h.
Auto-sleep
Like the stock default, after 2 minutes without any button held the Bit goes to deep
sleep (SleepMs in main/main.cpp). 10 s before that the screen dims as a warning;
any button brings it back. Toggle the power switch to start again. Progress
inside the current level is lost; unlocked levels are kept.
Low battery
Below 15% a small red battery blinks in the top-right corner (as stock blinks its empty
battery icon). Otherwise same as stock firmware: below ~5% at power-on the Bit goes straight to deep sleep;
while playing, at ~1% it shows "Battery critical, shutting down" for 6 s, then
deep-sleeps. Charge it and toggle the power switch to start again.
Development
PC tools, needing a C++20 compiler, patch and (for the GIF) Python with Pillow, but not
ESP-IDF. Run them from a normal shell: the ESP-IDF shell's Python has no Pillow.

tools/patch_anarch.sh <dir>: writes the patched Anarch tree the firmware is built from
(the build runs it too).
tools/smoke_test.sh: plays all 10 levels of the patched game with random input under
ASan/UBSan (deaths, a forced win per level, level transitions) and checks the quicksave
behaviour of mod 12; about a minute.
tools/make_demo.sh: regenerates demo.gif. The run is scripted in frames, so changes
that affect movement or aiming may need tools/demo.cpp retuned.
web/build.sh <dir> <anarch-bit-merged.bin> <version>: assembles the browser installer
site (page, manifest, firmware, and ESP Web Tools checked against a pinned hash and served
from the site itself, no CDN).

CI (.github/workflows/build.yml) runs the smoke test on every push and pull request,
then builds the firmware in the espressif/idf:v5.4.1 image; on v* tags it attaches
both images to a release and deploys the browser installer to GitHub Pages.
License
CC0 1.0 (public domain), like Anarch itself, for everything in this repository
except main/Splash.bmp: the CircuitMess logo, taken from
Bit-Firmware and remaining CircuitMess's.
Dependencies keep their own licenses: Anarch and its mods (submodule, CC0) and
LovyanGFX (fetched at build time, FreeBSD license).

Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision or Toys for Bob.

Can I use my real portal and figures? Yes. Plug it in: the game finds it by itself (F4 > Portal is Automatic), reads your figures and saves their progress on them, as on the console, and the portal menu still has the figures you don't own. Every figure you put on gets a backup file. Real USB portal only leaves the menu out. The PS3, Wii and PC portals work as they are, also with the WinUSB driver a Dolphin or Cemu setup gives them; an Xbox 360 portal needs WinUSB (Zadig), as for Xenia. If yours doesn't work, F4 > Game > Report a problem: its log says what the game saw.
Can I play without figures? Yes: without a real portal, a menu with every figure opens when the game asks for a Skylander. Their progress is kept in files in Documents\Skylanders\Figures, and one button swaps back to the Skylander you played before.
Can I play with a friend? Yes, two players on one PC, as on the console: the second player opens the portal menu on their controller (Guide, or Back + Start) and puts their Skylander on. L3 + R3 sorts out which controller plays which player. Online play isn't there yet.
Which game do I need? Does my Wii or PS3 copy work? Your own copy of Imaginators on Xbox 360: for now the European Xbox 360 disc (which one exactly), as an ISO or an extracted folder. Does it run on Linux, Steam Deck, Mac or Android handhelds? It's made for Windows (64-bit) and tested there. Wine / Proton may work but isn't tested much; Mac, Android and ARM handhelds aren't supported.

Was AI used? Yes, almost all of the code was written with Claude; see How it was made.
Getting started
The easy way: install Core of Light
and show it your disc. It downloads this game, sets it up and keeps it up to date, and does the same
for the other five games. It can also switch the game to English, German or French
(below).
On its own:

Download ImaginatorsRecompSetup-<version>.exe from the Releases page.
Run it and pick your disc, as an ISO file or an extracted folder. It checks the version and takes
what it needs.
Start the game from the desktop or the Start menu.

What you need:

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a graphics card with DirectX 12
your own Xbox 360 disc of the game (which one)
a controller (Xbox or compatible); keyboard and mouse work too. A real Portal of Power is optional.

The setup isn't signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then
Run anyway. No admin rights needed.

What you get

A sharper picture: 1x, 2x or 3x the console's 720p, the 3D scene drawn at the full 720p instead
of the console's smaller size, sharpening (AMD CAS, or FSR 1 when the window is bigger) and 16x
texture filtering, with the presets Performance, Quality, Best and As on the console.
Bloom and motion blur can be turned down.
60 FPS, or 30 as on the console, or 144 and more. The game keeps its normal speed.
Ultrawide: a wider window shows more to the sides, and the HUD moves out to the edges.
No portal needed: when the game asks for a Skylander, a menu with every figure opens by itself,
in the game's own look, creation crystals sorted by class. A real USB portal should work too
(not tried with this game yet).
A shorter Skylander intro when a figure comes in, if you like (in the settings).
Your figures keep their progress (level, gold, hats, upgrades) in files you can back up, and
each one is backed up before the game first saves over it: the portal menu puts an older version back.
Quick swap: one button puts the Skylander you played before back on the portal.
Skip any movie: Start ends the movie that is playing (F4 > Game: off, or A instead).
A settings menu in the game: graphics, frame rate, language, portal, controls, and Extras
(no health loss, full gold, always crit, elemental power everywhere, gold and XP multipliers; off
by default, and Show cheats hides the lot).
Achievements.
A Discord status: the game, your Skylander and the level, while the Discord app runs. F4 > Game turns it off.
HD texture packs work too (how).
Languages: the disc has Spanish and Italian; English, German or French come from your PS3
disc (below).

Controller

please tell me.

Which disc). If you have another one, open an issue with the message (it names the disc's title, region and hash).

English, German or French.

new PC.

of this game come in language pairs). Its SHA-256 is in
docs/game/default.xex.sha256; the setup, the game and the launcher
check it. A 360 disc with English and German isn't known to this port yet; if it has the same
code it works as well: the check also compares the code part of the file (docs/game/default.xex.code).

pick English, German or French, then the PS3 disc. It puts that language's texts, voices and movies

what you did and what happened. It helps a lot to attach the report from Core of Light (LB, the
launcher's settings, > Report a problem, or the question it asks after a crash). That's one text
file on your desktop with the latest logs and settings, your Windows user name taken out. Without
the launcher, the logs are in the logs folder next to the game's exe.

I wanted to play the Xbox 360 Skylanders games on my PC with just a controller, no emulator, and
with a nicer picture. That's really all it is: a private fan project. It's public in case someone
else wants the same.

To be upfront about it: almost all of the code here was written by Claude in
Claude Code, the recompile setup, the fixes, the portal menu, the launcher and the installer, and
most of the docs too. I decided what to build, said what was broken and played the games a lot. If
AI-made projects aren't your thing, that's fair.

For developers
The game's Xbox 360 code is recompiled to x86-64 with ReXGlue
(no CPU emulation); the graphics go through Xenia's D3D12 path. This repository holds only our own
code: the recompiled game code is made on your PC from your disc's default.xex when you build.
Building needs Windows, Visual Studio 2022 (C++ workload and C++ Clang tools), CMake, Ninja, just,
Git and Python 3, and the extracted disc in rom/ (rom/README.md). Steps:
docs/development.md, then just play-release. just package-installer builds
the setup. All docs: docs/README.md.
The banner and the button at the top are drawn by Core of Light's tools/make_banner.ps1.
Credits

The players who report bugs and bring ideas: many of them are in the games now. Who brought
what: Made with the players.
GiantsRecomp, SSARecomp
and SwapForceRecomp: this project is scaffolded
from them; app, portal, menus and tooling come from there.
GiantsRecomp by TheBiemGamer brought
Skylanders Giants to PC first and is the template these ports started from.
ReXGlue, the static recompilation SDK, here in a
fork with our fixes on top.
skylanders-portal by TheBiemGamer:
the portal (software and USB), its overlay and the figure catalog, here in a fork with the
shared portal and settings menus on top.
morpheus284: the stone frame around the menus, cut from his Core of
Light artwork, and the banner at the top, made from it (CC BY 4.0).
Laytonator2: the PlayStation button prompts, drawn in the PS3's
style (CC BY 4.0).

among others SkyReader.
extract-xiso is included (prebuilt, unmodified)
for the installer (installer/extract-xiso.LICENSE.txt).

Skylanders is a trademark of Activision. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by
Activision.
License
The code and documentation in this repository are released under the MIT license. That
doesn't cover the game or its data, which you need to own and supply yourself, or the third-party
components in thirdparty/, which keep their own licenses.
