1ochw7r.title: ‘Real Time’: Bill Maher Jokes ‘GTA VI’ Has Caused “More Workplace Absences Than ICE,” Notes He’s Glad James Bond Cast “Very Heterosexual Male”
1ochw7r.content:
After Grand Theft Auto VI and James Bond took over social media this week, Bill Maher has added his two cents to the discourse before going on hiatus.

On Friday’s Season 24 finale of Real Time, the comedian expressed his fascination with the “giant cultural phenomenon” following GTA VI‘s multi-billion dollar opening. “No movie ever did that,” he noted.

“Grand Theft Auto came out yesterday, and about a fifth of the young men in America stayed home and didn’t go to work, to play a game,” said Maher in his opening monologue. “This thing has caused more workplace absences than ICE.”

Thursday marked the release of Grand Theft Auto VI from Rockstar Games, the first GTA installment since 2013. Following a record-breaking launch, the highly-anticipated video game has already amassed $3.79B in its first 48 hours.

Later in the episode, Maher said, “I am intrigued by it. But again, you are criminals, and you’re doing criminal activities—not all criminal activities, and not unmotivated criminal activities. But it is something disturbing about so many people wanting to do this.

“I heard … you can either choose to be a good boyfriend or a bad boyfriend,” he added. “And the guy said, ‘Why would you choose in a video game to be a good boyfriend?’ You know, people wanna smack the hooker with the car antenna. There’s just something a little disturbing about it.”

Pivoting to Robert Pattinson’s casting as James Bond in Denis Villeneuve’s 007, Maher praised Amazon MGM Studios for the casting choice.

“I think he’s great. I don’t understand what all this hoopla is about it,” he said. “What, is he too millennial, he’s too gay, he’s too fake? He’s great, he’s perfect … He’s 40. Perfect! You need a grown ass man to be James Bond. James Bond’s not a boy.”

Maher added, “And also, I would have been happy with Black James Bond, because you can be James Bond and be Black. I wouldn’t have been happy with a woman or a lesbian James Bond, that’s a different character. James Bond is a very heterosexual male, that’s too essential to not have that be a part of James Bond.”

Real Time‘s Season 24 finale comes after HBO gave the show another two-season renewal earlier this year, with its Season 25 return set for Jan. 15.

1bfn805.title: Device that measures strawberry skin's strength will aid breeders
1bfn805.content:
The prototype will help strawberry breeders rate berries’ skin strength. Credit: The University of Queensland

Resilient strawberry varieties will be more easily identifiable thanks to a tool developed by University of Queensland engineering students. The prototype measures the strength of strawberry skin, a key breeding consideration for the Australian Strawberry Breeding Program at Queensland's Department of Primary Industries.

Queensland Alliance for Agriculture and Food Innovation chemical engineer and food scientist Dr. Jaqueline Moura Nadolny said the industry needed a more objective system for measuring commercial strawberries' susceptibility to abrasion.
"Limiting bruising helps reduce food waste and ensures strawberries meet growing, harvesting and transportation demands," Moura Nadolny said. "Before strawberry varieties are chosen to breed and sell at a commercial level, multiple traits of the crop are tested.
"Strawberry skin resilience is currently measured by a field officer rubbing a finger along a berry once the strawberries are ripe. Although the scale runs from 1 to 9, most strawberries are rated at the higher end of the scale from 7 to 9, which means breeders have very little differentiation between strawberry varieties.
"Being able to broaden this differentiation more would be beneficial to the breeding program."
Moura Nadolny said QAAFI Center for Nutrition and Food Sciences master's student Yen‑An Chen initially assessed abrasion characteristics.
"These included skin toughness, susceptibility to abrasion, resistance to bruising, firmness, surface discoloration and shelf life," Moura Nadolny said. "These characteristics were systematically tested from simple physical manipulation to controlled mechanical tests to see what impact they had on strawberries. This included measuring the force required to damage or break the fruit surface and assessing the degree of tissue damage after impact or compression."

Final-year students at UQ's School of Mechanical and Mining Engineering then used these abrasion parameters to design the measurement tool.
Mechanical engineering lecturer Dr. Tristan Vanyai said the tool measured how a strawberry was impacted by abrasion. "It works by spinning a rubber wheel against the strawberry's skin, measuring force and torque, which is how much pressure they can take," Vanyai said.
DPI senior plant breeder Dr. Katie O'Connor said the tool was promising. "It allows us to identify potential commercial strawberry varieties for our breeding program," O'Connor said. "These varieties could be better suited to new tabletop growing systems or harvesting systems, like robotic harvesting.
"The new device takes a bit longer than the manual way of testing but is so much better and simple to use. It's still a prototype but once we iron out some wrinkles, we have a device we can use."
Vanyai said the tool was proof of the importance of cross-industry partnerships. "Working with external clients gives students a perspective on how their work can really help," Vanyai said.

1ury5v.title: Bill Maher Mocks ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’-Playing Young Men With Awful ICE Joke
1ury5v.content:
The Season 24 finale of “Real Time with Bill Maher” aired Friday night — it’s been renewed for two more seasons through 2028 — and the crabby comic’s monologue tackled everything from the spate of tech outages to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s infidelity to “Grand Theft Auto 6.”

“It’s getting a little scary out there,” offered Maher. “Last week, it was Microsoft and the airlines that went down. This week: Apple — whew that’s a big one — four of the big banks, the National Security Agency. My god, for several hours, we had no idea who Jensen Huang was fucking.”

He continued: “This is just AI doing its thing: finding vulnerabilities. They’re fixing shit by breaking shit. Didn’t we try this with DOGE? Wasn’t that the same thing? OK, but here’s my question: If these are not cyberattacks, why yesterday did they fire the top official in charge of cybersecurity? It’s like your wife saying, ‘You know, I’m definitely not having an affair, but I fired the pool boy yesterday.’”

Then, the 70-year-old political pundit took aim at the cultural phenomenon that is “GTA 6,” which hit a whopping $3.79 billion in first-day sales and led to tons of people calling out of work to play it on their PlayStation 5 or Xbox.

“Apple? Oh my gosh. I mean, I worry for young men. Really, without the phone, anyone hoping to see tits will have to talk to an actual girl,” he joked. “And if you think that joke is stereotypical or unfair, I will just remind you that ‘Grand Theft Auto’ came out yesterday, and about a fifth of the young men in America stayed home and didn’t go to work to play a game. This thing has caused more workplace absences than ICE.”

askat8.title: FT: Трамп пытается добиться "сделки" по Украине до прихода демократов к власти в обе палаты Конгресса США
askat8.content:
В администрации президента США Дональда Трампа стремятся успеть заключить мирное соглашение между Киевом и Москвой до конца 2026 года, поскольку в начале января 2027-го Демократическая партия США согласно результатам промежуточных выборов получит контроль над обеими палатами Конгресса, что значительно снизит влияние республиканцев Трампа. Об этом в ночь на субботу, 21 ноября, пишет британская газета Financial Times (FT) со ссылкой на четыре осведомленных источника. "Администрация Трампа сообщила европейским и украинским чиновникам о своем желании", - говорится в публикации.

По словам одного из европейских чиновников издания, американцы "усиленно давят" и "есть опасения", что Украине "придется пойти на серьезные уступки". При этом по мнению другого источника, "американцы торопятся, а Путин - нет". В свою очередь, украинские официальные лица истолковали очередную волну ограничений скорости Starshield - военной версии спутниковой системы связи Starlink, наряду с показательными задержками поставок ракет для ЗРК Patriot - как часть усилий Вашингтона по ослаблению позиций Киева и усилению давления на него с целью получения территориальных уступок России.

Так, высокопоставленный украинский чиновник назвал действия администрации Трампа "явным выбором", направленным на то, чтобы помочь России добиться выгодных условий на так называемых "мирных переговорах". Еще один источник FT заявил, что "Трампу нравится Путин, и он хочет завершить все до января".Трамп: Путин хочет, чтобы война закончилась дипломатическим путем

Президент США Дональд Трамп заявил, что после двусторонних переговоров с главой Кремля на полях саммита Азиатско-Тихоокеанского экономического сотрудничества (АТЭС) в китайском Шэньчжэне ему стало ясно, что тот якобы хочет завершения войны против Украины путем переговоров. "Я провел двустороннюю встречу с президентом России Путиным, который четко выразил свое желание завершить войну между Россией и Украиной дипломатическим путем", - сказал Трамп на пресс-конференции 20 ноября по итогам саммита, цитирует его телеканал CNN.

Глава Белого дома в очередной раз повторил, что проблема на пути к достижению мирного соглашения заключается в "огромной ненависти" между Путиным и президентом Украины Владимиром Зеленским. При этом свои отношения с главой Кремля Трамп считает "фантастическими". "Он хотел бы положить конец войне. Честно говоря, это очень трудно сделать", - заявил президент США на пресс-конференции. На встрече в Китае Трамп назвал Путина "своим другом".

По информации агентства Bloomberg, глава Белого дома после саммита в Китае позвонил с борта президентского самолета европейским лидерам, которые собрались в Берлине на встречу "коалиции желающих" вместе с Зеленским. Он сказал им, что Путин якобы хочет закончить войну.

В Москве не разделяют оптимизма Трампа по поводу скорого заключения сделки с Киевом

Судя по последним заявлениям Москвы, в окружении Путина идти на принципиальные уступки по-прежнему не готовы. Так, недавно замглавы МИД РФ Сергей Рябков подчеркнул, что для РФ недопустимы предлагаемые США Украине ни принятие ее в НАТО, ни гарантии безопасности Киеву по образцу Североатлантического договора, даже с условием полного отказа от Донбасса.

В свою очередь, сам Путин во время пресс-конференции в Китае заявил, что думал над возможным частичным прекращением огня в ходе войны с Украиной, однако отказался от этой идеи после успешных атак ВСУ на Крымский мост. "После ударов по Крымскому мосту договариваться не будем", - сказал он.

Источники издания The Kyiv Independent утверждают, что переговорщики Трампа Стивен Уиткофф и Джаред Кушнер на недавней встрече в Берлине сообщили чиновникам от РФ и Украины, что нынешний раунд переговоров может стать последней реальной возможностью достичь мирного соглашения, прежде чем политическая ситуация в Вашингтоне изменится. По имеющимся данным, с января демократы намерены существенно усилить военную помощь Киеву.

1u1cy0l.title: Everything To Know About ‘Presumed Innocent’ Season 2 As Apple Series Goes Anthology
1u1cy0l.content:
Apple TV+’s Presumed Innocent will be back for a second season, but Season 2 will diverge from the first installment.

The legal drama series was renewed in July 2024 with its final two episodes still to launch on Apple TV+. Starting out as a limited series, the series will take on an anthology style like The White Lotus after becoming Apple’s most-watched show.

Read on for all the plot details, character casting and more about Presumed Innocent Season 2.

When will Presumed Innocent Season 2 come out?

In November, Apple unveiled that the second season of the crime drama will premiere February 19, 2027 with its first two episodes. The rest will follow weekly through April 2.

Who will be in the cast of Presumed Innocent Season 2?

Rachel Brosnahan (The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, Superman) will lead Season 2 of the legal series alongside Jack Reynor (Midsommar, The Perfect Couple, whose casting Deadline reported exclusively. Matthew Rhys (The Americans, Perry Mason)was also cast as a lead in early September 2025, and Fiona Shaw (Bad Sisters, Killing Eve) was cast as a series regular Oct. 1. Still more names include Courtney B. Vance, John Magaro, Michael Hsu Rosen and Lesley-Ann Brandt.

Ji-young Yoo (KPop Demonhunters, Expats) will recur in Season 2 as Deadline revealed in January 2026.

What happened in Presumed Innocent Season 1? Who was in the cast of Presumed Innocent Season 1?

Season 1 of the series was inspired by Scott Turow’s 1987 courtroom thriller novel of the same name. It starred Jake Gyllenhaal in the main role of Rusty Sabich, the character Harrison Ford played in the 1990 film adaptation of Turow’s best-seller.

The cast of Season 1 also included Bill Camp as Raymond Horgan, Renate Reinsve as Carolyn Polhemus, Ruth Negga as Barbara Sabich, O-T Fagbenle as Nico Della Guardia, Peter Sarsgaard as Tommy Molto, Elizabeth Marvel as Lorraine Horgan, Lily Rabe as Dr. Liz Rush, Chase Infiniti as Jaden Sabich and more.

RELATED: ‘Presumed Innocent’ Finale Delivers Double Twist; Does It Set Up Season 2?

A key difference in the series set up following seasons for an anthology-style show was that one character present in the film adaptation, Sandy Stern (Raul Julia), was not present in the television adaptation. Author Scott Turow followed his bestseller that inspired the show with 1990’s The Burden of Proof, which followed Presumed Innocent‘s Sandy.

What will Presumed Innocent Season 2 be about?

As Deadline first reported, Season 2 will be based on Jo Murray’s debut legal thriller Dissection of a Murder, which will publish in 2026. The book centers Leila Reynolds, who is way out of her death when offered her first murder case by a defendant that only wants her. Complicating matters is the fact that her husband is the prosecutor.

Who else is behind Presumed Innocent Season 2?

Presumed Innocent hails from Bad Robot Productions and David E. Kelley Productions in association with Warner Bros. Television. Season 2 will see David E. Kelley return as showrunner on alongside Erica Lipez. J.J. Abrams and Rachel Rusch Rich executive produce for Bad Robot. Kelley executive produces through David E. Kelley Productions alongside Matthew Tinker and Lipez. Dustin Thomason also serves as executive producer.

RELATED: ‘Presumed Innocent’ EP J.J. Abrams On Why Finale Didn’t Set Up Season 2 & Status Of New Installment

Brosnahan will executive produce in addition to starring. Season 1 star Gyllenhaal executive produces under his Nine Stories banner. Turow and Jo Murray, author of Dissection of a Murder, co-executive produce.

y8tuf8.title: NVIDIA выпустила хотфикс-драйвер 621.35, устраняющий проблему чрезмерной записи данных на SSD
y8tuf8.content:
Компания NVIDIA выпустила исправление 621.35 для драйверов GeForce, устраняющее ошибку, из-за которой накопители SSD подвергались интенсивной записи данных даже в режиме простоя системы. В данный выпуск вошло лишь одно исправление: устранена проблема, приводившая к чрезмерной записи данных в файл nvlog.nvlgstg в фоновом режиме — именно это требовалось исправить в срочном порядке.
Ранее на этой неделе пользователи NVIDIA сообщили о постоянной и избыточной записи данных на SSD (проблема наблюдалась, в частности, в версиях драйверов 621.14 и 621.24). Процесс NVDisplayContainer.exe продолжал выполнять запись даже тогда, когда компьютер находился в состоянии покоя, а причиной тому был файл «nvlog». В отдельных случаях объем записываемых данных в режиме простоя достигал 30 ГБ в час, тогда как в более ранней версии драйвера (621.01) за 5 минут простоя записывалось лишь около 2 МБ.
Данное исправление базируется на новейшем драйвере NVIDIA Game Ready (версия 621.24 от 12 ноября). Установка этого обновления является необязательной: поскольку оно прошло сокращённый цикл контроля качества (QA), распространяется оно только через сайт службы поддержки NVIDIA.
Ранее для решения проблемы с записью на SSD предлагалось либо вернуться к версии драйвера 621.01, либо временно остановить службу NVIDIA Display Container LS. Пользователям, столкнувшимся с этой неполадкой, рекомендуется установить исправление как можно скорее; остальные могут дождаться выхода следующей версии драйвера, сертифицированной по стандарту WHQL.
Примечательно, что незадолго до этого с аналогичной проблемой — чрезмерной записью данных на SSD — столкнулась и компания AMD; она также оперативно выпустила необязательное обновление драйверов Adrenalin для ее устранения.

1hxotly.title: Quantum software matches classical benchmark for a molecular interaction
1hxotly.content:
Section of a DNA strand. Enlarged: two stacked bases whose interaction (dispersion, "pi-stacking") stabilizes the structure. Credit: Kvantify

Predicting how molecules interact is central to drug discovery: it offers important information about how a new drug might work in the human body, the side effects it can cause and more. Computationally modeling these interactions can reduce the need for lengthy and expensive lab work, but some interactions still remain beyond the reach of classical computers.

The Danish quantum software company Kvantify has taken a significant step toward overcoming this challenge by accurately capturing an interaction relevant to biomolecular stability using a novel computational model tested on Quantinuum's System Model H2 quantum computer.
The study focuses on dispersion interactions. These interactions are individually small but collectively make a big difference in helping stabilize, for instance, biological structures such as DNA and proteins, as well as influencing how molecules bind to each other. Accurately describing these interactions is difficult because it involves predicting how electrons behave. Modeling this behavior requires enormous computational resources.
Using a pair of molecules derived from a DNA structure, Kvantify investigated how the interaction changes as the molecules move apart. The team applied its quantum algorithm, BEAST-VQE, combined with exact quantum circuit simulation through Qrunch's optimized integration with NVIDIA cuTensorNet, and compared the results with the established quantum chemistry method CCSD(T).

Relative interaction energy as a function of the distance between the two rings. Kvantify's OO-BEAST-PT2 method (green) comes close to the classical CCSD(T) reference with 236 orbitals (black) using only 53 orbitals. Credit: Kvantify

Key findings:

More efficient calculations. Kvantify obtained results matching the accuracy of the CCSD(T) method while reducing the required count of active orbitals from 236 to only 53, thus making the calculation less computationally demanding.
Consistency between simulation and hardware. The team ran calculations at two representative molecular geometries on Quantinuum's System Model H2 quantum computer and produced results almost identical to ideal simulations. This supports the feasibility of studying this subtle interaction on current quantum devices.
A step towards practical relevance for drug discovery. The problem of molecular stacking helps test novel computational methods on their way to becoming relevant in real-world quantum chemistry workflows related to molecular recognition and binding.

The result is a molecular benchmark, demonstrating how to test the accuracy of computational predictions rather than claiming commercial quantum advantage. The study uses a simplified model, with hardware calculations covering two geometries rather than the full interaction curve.
However, it is significant because it shows the value of integrating quantum and classical methods when investigating molecular interactions—even with quantum computers that are available today. The work also highlights the next developmental challenge: reducing classical computational bottlenecks as higher-quality quantum hardware becomes available.

1xpapjs.title: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Album Boasts 29 Songs; Releases Ahead Of Film
1xpapjs.content:
UPDATED, Nov. 20: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is finally here, full of both bleak torturous scenes and also hopeful ones.

With a full companion album complete with many original songs inspired by the film and some “Arena Remixes” of certain artists’ hits, the songs in the film narrow down to a sparse five. Find them below:

“The Raven” Words by Edgar Allen Poe, Music by Dave Cobb, Performed by Whitney Peak

“The Goose and the Common” Lyrics Traditional/Music by Dave Cobb, Performed by Whitney Peak

“The Old Therebefore” Written by Suzanne Collins and Dave Cobb, Performed by Scot Greenan (who plays Burdock Everdeen in the film) – Previously sung by Rachel Zegler’s Lucy Gray Baird in The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes (2023)

“Deep in the Meadow (Lullaby)” Lyrics by Suzanne Collins, Music by T Bone Burnett and Simone Burnett, Performed by Jennifer Lawrence

“Draw You Out” Written by Noah Kahan and Aaron Dessner, Performed by Noah Kahan

PREVIOUS, Nov. 13: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) is now available to stream and for purchase a week ahead of the film’s arrival in theaters Nov. 20.

The full tracklist on the soundtrack double album for the upcoming prequel, based on Suzanne Collins’ fifth book in the series, was unveiled at the start of November.

Along with the three already-announced tracks — Noah Kahan’s “Draw You Out,” Gigi Perez’s “Favor” and The Smashing Pumpkins’ “Black Stars” — The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) from MCA Records also features the likes of Stevie Nicks, Ella Langley, The Cure, Depeche Mode, actressJennifer Lawrence and others. See is the full tracklist below:

1. Whitney Peak: “The Raven I”2. Noah Cyrus: “Ash and Snow”3. Stephen Wilson Jr: “First in Line”4. Bella Kay: “See It Coming”5. Lizzy McAlpine: “The Wheel”6. Whitney Peak: “The Raven II”7. Sydney Rose: “Dove Song”8. Ella Langley: “Here Then We’re Gone”9. Madeline Edwards: “Wrestle with God”10. Kacey Musgraves: “Ruthless (Arena Mix)”11. Billy Vincent: “No Destination”12. Whitney Peak: “The Raven III”13. Gigi Perez: “Favor”14. Hudson Freeman: “But You Wanted More”15. The Smashing Pumpkins: “Black Stars”16. Mckenna Grace: “Half Alive”17. Stevie Nicks: “Doing The Best That I Can (Arena Mix)”18. Whitney Peak: “The Goose and The Common”19. Depeche Mode & KÁRYYN: “Survive (Arena Mix | KÁRYYN Rework)”20. Emelie Trahan: “Same Blood”21. Kashus Culpepper: “May Brings Flowers”22. Scot Greenan: “The Old Therebefore”23. Carter Faith: “Can’t Let You Go”24. Tyler Childers: “Old Money”25. Madison Cunningham: “Show Me Where The Ending Starts”26. Jennifer Lawrence: “Deep in the Meadow”27. Noah Kahan: “Draw You Out”28. Violet Grohl: “Metal Birds”29. The Cure: “Alone (Live in Berlin 2022)”

Star Mckenna Grace, who portrays the fierce Maysilee Williams in the film, has contributed to the soundtrack, and previous star Jennifer Lawrence’s rendition of “Deep in the Meadow” is on the album as well. Some songs have been remixed for the arena, like Kacey Musgraves’ “Ruthless” and Stevie Nicks’ “Doing the Best That I Can.” Still more artists like Noah Cyrus and Ella Langley have written new songs for the companion album.

RELATED: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ To Play On Meta VR Glasses Post-Theatrical; Lionsgate Teams With Mark Zuckerberg’s Tech Giant On Pic’s 3D Conversion

PREVIOUSLY, OCTOBER 30: Gigi Perez is the latest artist to contribute a single to the companion album for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.

Perez’s new single, “Favor” is now out as of Thursday night.

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) is executive produced by Grammy-winning producer Dave Cobb (Chris Stapleton, Sturgill Simpson) and brings together 29 cross-genre artists.

“It is truly an honor to have created a song for The Hunger Games. I’ve been greatly impacted by stories told through The Hunger Games since I was 12 years old,” the Cuban-American singer said in a statement. “Writing this song allowed me to share another part of who I am, drawing from my own experiences with grief and the longing to reconnect with the ones I love who are no longer on this earth. It is a privilege to share something so personal within a story that has meant so much to me for so long.”

The Smashing Pumpkins’ song “Black Stars,” came out October 15.

The band’s frontman Billy Corgan was working on a solo album when The Smashing Pumpkins were invited to contribute an original song to the film. Corgan tapped producer Butch Vig to help pick the song that best fit into the world of Panem during the 50th Hunger Games and second Quarter Quell, in which Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) competes.

The music video that accompanies the song contains purple smoke, which corresponds to the purple and yellow smoke that fill the arena in the trailers for Sunrise on the Reaping.

“Black Stars” joins Noah Kahan’s “Draw You Out,” the first single announced off the album.

RELATED: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Red Carpet Photos: All Of Joseph Zada & Mckenna Grace’s Looks From Press Tour

The album compilation for the latest Hunger Games film comes as no surprise to readers, viewers and fans who have kept track of the musical movements in the franchise since the original trilogy of books was published and served as the basis for a quartet of films starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth and more.

Taylor Swift wrote “Safe and Sound (feat. Civil Wars)” featured in the first film which came out in 2012 as well as “Eyes Open” for the companion soundtrack. Lorde wrote “Yellow Flicker Beat” for Mockingjay Part 1. Olivia Rodrigo wrote “Can’t Catch Me Now” for The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes. Coldplay also wrote “Atlas” for Catching Fire.

1h1jmfd.title: Samsung might copy the iPhone’s Dynamic Island soon, but it actually looks good [Video]
1h1jmfd.content:
A new leak suggests that Samsung is preparing to copy the iPhone’s Dynamic Island feature in the not-too-distant future, to an extent that not many other Android brands have even done thus far.

Copying the Dynamic Island was briefly like a rite of passage for some Android brands, with many wasting almost no time in delivering their own version of the feature. But, on many of those devices, it’s a surface-level ripoff at best. The feature is primarily limited to music apps and timers, rarely working with any third-party apps in meaningful ways. Android has a built-in feature similar to Apple’s but not in the same styling.

Samsung is now preparing its own version of the Dynamic Island, and it seems this one has a bit more meat on its bones.

SamMobile on Twitter/X posted a video and two still images of what appears to be a Dynamic Island clone coming to Galaxy devices. It’s mentioned as potentially coming to the Galaxy S27 series (so, One UI 9.5) and being called “Moment Effects.” A portion of the software explicitly mentions integration with Google Sports, the leak claims, while it seems Samsung is using Live Notifications here, which already support a number of third-party apps.

The kicker from a UX perspective is that Samsung’s interpretation allows you to swipe between activities, similar to Apple, but the core premise is similar with the island showing around the selfie camera cutout.

When this feature might surface does remain unclear, but a One UI 9.5 debut would make plenty of sense. That update is in beta now and due to launch on the Galaxy S27 series early next year.

What do you think of Samsung’s alleged Dynamic Island clone? Personally, I’m on board as long as it proves useful, and it seems to be on the right track compared to most other copycats.

e69mip.title: Volkswagen T-Roc R: горячий кроссовер на пороге премьеры

8yxene.title: 'Godavari' Director Nikhil Mahajan Sets Carjacking Neo-Noir 'Mongoose'
8yxene.content:
Nikhil Mahajan, the Indian National Film Award-winning director of “Godavari” and the Netflix series “Betaal,” is bringing “Mongoose,” a Marathi-language neo-noir thriller about a cab driver and the con man who steals his taxi, to the Co-Production Market at WAVES Film Bazaar.

Set in the hardscrabble town of Malegaon, the film follows Abhimanyu, a hardworking driver whose hopes of owning his own taxi are wrecked when he is carjacked on the highway. The thief, Shahrukh, is a debt-ridden hustler who crashes the stolen cab, killing pilgrims traveling in a van, and the two men’s lives become violently entangled. As Abhimanyu chases justice and Shahrukh tries to stay free, it emerges that Abhimanyu’s own boss ordered the hit.

Mahajan says that, particularly since “Raavsaaheb,” he has been drawn to subjects that let him examine Indian society through a social lens, and that “Mongoose” digs into the gap between ambition and reality for one section of the population. “I choose to lend my genre sensibility to these social subjects to create a more wide appealing introspection of the Indian living condition.”

Suhrud Godbole and Mahajan’s Coquelicot Pictures is producing with Sydney-based Photoplay Films. The budget is $1.1 million, with $650,000 in place. The project is in advanced development and the team aims to start prep in the second quarter of 2027. In Goa, they are looking for co-producers, sales agents and “early-stage festival programmers.”

“At Coquelicot Pictures we are very driven and passionate about creating and supporting modern and cutting-edge storytelling. ‘Mongoose’ is a story we believe will cut across languages and demographics, and Nikhil is one of the finest genre-makers we have in the country today,” says Godbole, who has worked with Mahajan since 2011. “In Karen Radzyner we have the perfect partner to collaborate and take this film to the world.”

Radzyner leads Photoplay’s film and TV arm. The company’s films and series have competed at Berlin, Venice, Toronto, CanneSeries and SeriesFest, and its executive producer credits include “Goldstone,” “Berlin Syndrome” and “Sweet Country.”

“Nikhil’s storytelling blew me away at our first meeting in Goa two years ago and watching his festival-darling, award-winning films cemented that he’s a writer/director with soul, who alongside his impressive producer Suhrud (at Coquelicot Pictures), opens windows of insight into India for a global audience,” Radzyner says.

Mahajan’s features also include “Pune 52” and “Baji.” “Godavari” premiered at the Vancouver International Film Festival and won him the Indian National Film Award for best direction as well as a special jury award for best director at IFFI. “Betaal” was produced by Blumhouse Television and Red Chillies Entertainment. Coquelicot released “Tighee” in theaters in March.

Mahajan says he hopes audiences unfamiliar with these issues get “a ringside view of reality,” and that international viewers see “a side of India which is seldom seen.” Next up for him is a horror musical, which starts filming soon.

WAVES Film Bazaar runs as the market component of the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa.

gh-1465251964.title: GitHub - chayuto/generals-rust: Bit-exact deterministic Rust port of the Zero Hour (SAGE) 30 Hz game logic engine across macOS, Linux, and Windows, verified frame-for-frame via replay XferCRC.
gh-1465251964.content:
generals-rust is an incremental, bit-exact Rust port of the 30 Hz deterministic simulation engine (GameLogic and Common) from Command & Conquer: Generals – Zero Hour (SAGE engine), verified frame-for-frame against real game replays across macOS (aarch64), Linux (x86_64 / aarch64), and Windows (x86_64).
ImportantNon-Official Community Project & Zero Proprietary Assets Policy

This project is an independent open-source engineering effort and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Electronic Arts Inc.
No proprietary game data or retail assets (.big, .map, .w3d, .tga, .dds, .bik, .csf, audio, or executables) are included in or accepted by this repository. Running full game replays requires a legally acquired retail installation of Command & Conquer: Generals – Zero Hour (e.g., Steam App 2732960 or EA App) mounted externally via -assetPath.
Distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later with Electronic Arts Section 7 Additional Terms; see LICENSE.md for full terms and the Notice of Modification.

1. Project Goals & Two-Stage Roadmap
The SAGE engine in Zero Hour contains ~330,000 lines of C++ across GameLogic and Common (833 source/header files mapped into 463 atomic translation packets). Unlike a ground-up rewrite that approximates gameplay mechanics, generals-rust uses the engine's built-in multiplayer lockstep checksum pipeline (XferCRC / GameLogic::getCRC()) as a mathematical verification oracle:

Stage 1 — Bit-Exact Headless Simulation (Phase 0 – Phase 7):

Incrementally replace C++ subsystems in GameLogic and Common with idiomatic, deterministic Rust crates (zh_common, zh_logic, zh_ffi) using a Strangler-Fig C-ABI FFI bridge against the cross-platform reference build (fbraz3/GeneralsX at pinned commit 84a7a20769aa5749f388b1f49bd542c79b3c33e8).
Run headless replays at 30 logic frames per second (LOGICFRAMES_PER_SECOND = 30) and match the C++ reference engine's per-frame GameLogic::getCRC() bit-for-bit across all replay frames.

Stage 2 — Native Rust Client & Renderer:

Replace the headless ClientSink no-op adapter with a native wgpu rendering and audio frontend reading .big, .map, and .w3d assets directly.

2. Architecture & Verification Highlights

flowchart LR
subgraph SimContext["Rust SimContext (Three-Layer Split)"]
RR["1. RulesRegistry (&RulesRegistry)\nImmutable INI Templates:\nThingTemplate, WeaponTemplate,\nLocomotorTemplate, ScienceStore"]
SW["2. SimWorld (&mut SimWorld)\nDeterministic Frame State (XferCRC):\nObjectArena + ModuleArena (64-bit FacetMask)\n+ SleepyUpdateHeap + GameLogic RNG"]
CS["3. ClientSink (&mut dyn ClientSink)\nWrite-Only Visual/Audio Event Sink\n(Zero-Op in Stage 1 Headless Mode)"]
end

subgraph VnV["4-Gate V&V Verification Funnel"]
V1["Gate V1: Static Determinism Linter\n(DET001..DET011) + cargo check"]
V2["Gate V2: 1,000-Seed In-Process C++/Rust\nDifferential Fuzz & Golden Vectors"]
V3["Gate V3: Lockstep Shadow-Verify\nPer-Call Live Replay Assertion"]
V4["Gate V4: 6-Replay Cross-Platform\nCorpus CRC Matrix + Bisection"]
V1 --> V2 --> V3 --> V4
end

RR --> SW --> CS
SW --> VnV

Loading

Key Technical Pillars

Borrow-Split Generational Arenas (ObjectArena & ModuleArena): Replaces C++ deep inheritance hierarchies (Object + 222 BehaviorModule subclasses with diamond virtual inheritance) with cache-friendly generational handles, a 64-bit FacetMask replacing dynamic dynamic_cast / vtable queries, and a Take-and-Restore dispatch protocol (SimWorld::with_module_dispatch) that safely supports deep re-entrant damage/death/spawn callbacks without RefCell or unsafe aliasing.

Bit-Exact SleepyUpdateHeap & Determinism Rules: Preserves the exact (wake_frame.min(0x3fff_ffff) << 2) | phase priority key, strict > comparator with left-child tie-breaking, in-place root sifting, and reverse-heap-index destruction order from GameLogic.cpp.

Cross-Platform Determinism Enforcement (Gate V1): Static linter (scripts/lint_determinism.py) rejects HashMap/HashSet, std::collections::BinaryHeap, standard library f32 transcendentals, fused multiply-add (mul_add), pointer-keyed maps, platform-sized usize/c_long/c_char in serialized or FFI code, and locale-sensitive float parsing.

3-Pattern FFI Strangler Seam & Runtime Desync Bisection: Supports leaf function replacement (Pattern 1), opaque Rust-owned sub-structs (Pattern 2), and per-class RustBehaviorModuleAdapter swaps (Pattern 3) with runtime ZH_RUST_BYPASS_MODULES bisection to isolate any CRC divergence in $O(\log N)$ steps without recompiling.

3. Repository Map & Documentation

Description

Master architectural blueprint, 3-layer SimContext design, FFI strangler patterns, and Work Packages WP-0.1..WP-7.3.

Contributors & multi-agent constitution, V&V Golden Rule ("Never build something you cannot verify"), 2D task classification (tier:* $\times$ env:*), and GitHub Issue claiming protocol.

Technical reference for fbraz3/GeneralsX at 84a7a20 (48-singleton init sequence, 16-step GameLogic::update() loop, m_sleepyUpdates heap rules, and XferCRC pipeline).

4. Quick Start: Bootstrap & Verification Suites
Run the idempotent bootstrap script on macOS or Linux to configure .githooks, verify local toolchains (git, gh, python3, cargo, cmake, ninja), and execute the automated V&V self-test suites:

syp2cs.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 is now so far away that light takes 24 hours to reach it
syp2cs.content:
NASA's Voyager 1 has achieved another extraordinary milestone, becoming the first spacecraft to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth. After more than 49 years of traveling through space, humanity's most distant spacecraft is now approximately 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers) from home. At that distance, even a signal moving at the speed of light needs an entire day to make the journey.
The historic moment occurred on November 18 at 2:16 a.m. PST (5:16 a.m. EST). Scientists and engineers at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Southern California, which is managed by Caltech, received a signal from Voyager 1 early Thursday, exactly 24 hours after the spacecraft reached the milestone.
The achievement marks another remarkable chapter for a probe that has traveled farther than any other human-made object, survived decades beyond its original mission, and continues to explore a region of space that no spacecraft had previously entered.
Voyager 1 Is Now 24 Light-Hours From Earth
Astronomers often describe enormous cosmic distances in terms of how long light takes to travel them. A light-day represents the distance light covers in 24 hours, or roughly 16.1 billion miles.
Light moves through a vacuum at approximately 186,000 miles (299,000 kilometers) per second. To put Voyager 1's distance in perspective, sunlight passing Earth takes only about 1.3 seconds to reach the Moon. Reaching Neptune takes roughly four hours, while traveling from Neptune to Voyager 1 requires another 20 hours.
Even these enormous distances are small compared with those separating stars. A single light-year, the distance light travels in one year, measures approximately 5.88 trillion miles (9.46 trillion kilometers).

Voyager 1's extraordinary distance also creates a major challenge for mission controllers. Sending a command to the spacecraft now requires 24 hours, and receiving a response takes another 24 hours. A complete exchange therefore spans two full days, even though the signals travel at the fastest speed possible.
The milestone comes as engineers investigate a communication problem. NASA has not received scientific or engineering data from Voyager 1 since November 14. However, the probe continues transmitting a carrier signal, the radio signal that normally carries information back to Earth. By tracking this signal and calculating the spacecraft's trajectory, mission specialists were able to verify that Voyager 1 had crossed the one light-day mark. Engineers are continuing to investigate why the expected data is not coming through.
A Historic Journey Beyond the Solar System's Planets
Voyager 1 and its twin, Voyager 2, were launched in 1977 to take advantage of an unusual arrangement of the outer planets. The alignment allowed the spacecraft to use planetary gravity to travel from one destination to another, making an ambitious exploration mission possible.
Managed by JPL, the Voyagers became the third and fourth spacecraft to visit Jupiter and Saturn. They also delivered the first high-resolution images of these distant planets, revealing extraordinary new details about their atmospheres, rings, and moons. Voyager 2 continued farther, becoming the first spacecraft to explore Uranus and Neptune up close.
Today, both probes are traveling through interstellar space, making them humanity's only spacecraft to have crossed into the region beyond the Sun's protective bubble. Their instruments continue monitoring changes in the Sun's magnetic field across immense distances, providing scientists with measurements that cannot be collected from Earth.

"Traveling a light-day is a singular feat for a spacecraft, but Voyager is so much more than a distant traveler. The Voyager mission would be remarkable just for what it contributed to planetary science with the Grand Tour of the outer planets," said Joe Westlake, director, Heliophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington. "But it went on to become central to NASA's fleet of heliophysics missions offering insights into the star that we all revolve around, the Sun."
"Voyager 1 crossing the light-day threshold is yet another historic feat on an extraordinary voyage of discovery," said Dave Gallagher, JPL director. "Above all, this milestone stands as a testament to the exceptional teams who built, programmed, and fly these spacecraft today, and who have overcome countless challenges to keep them connected to Earth across the vastness of space. As NASA pushes toward new frontiers in human and robotic exploration, Voyager and the people behind its success continue to inspire us to reach farther and dream bigger."
Voyager's Golden Record Carries a Message From Earth
The Voyager spacecraft carry more than scientific instruments. Each also holds a Golden Record, a gold-plated copper phonograph record containing images and sounds representing life on Earth. These recordings were designed as messages that an advanced extraterrestrial civilization might discover someday.
The records give the mission a purpose extending far beyond its scientific discoveries. Even after the spacecraft eventually lose the ability to communicate with Earth, they will continue traveling through space with a small collection of sights and sounds from the planet that launched them.
"Nearly half a century after leaving Earth, the Voyager mission continues to push the boundaries of human exploration. Its epic journey reflects the vision of Ed Stone, the Caltech physicist and JPL director who guided the mission for decades, and the curiosity and tenacity of generations of scientists and engineers who have carried that vision forward," said Ray Jayawardhana, president, Caltech. "Beyond its immense contributions to science, Voyager also captures something profound about the human spirit. We may never know where its journey will ultimately lead, but it will venture on, an enduring affirmation that humanity was here and we yearned to explore."
Exploring the Mysterious Region Beyond the Sun
Voyager 1 is currently moving through space at approximately 38,000 mph (61,155 kph). In 2012, it became the first spacecraft to cross the boundary of the heliosphere, a vast region surrounding the Sun that is filled with particles and magnetic fields generated by our star.
This protective bubble helps shield the solar system from cosmic radiation arriving from elsewhere in the galaxy. Beyond its outer boundary lies interstellar space, where particles and magnetic fields from the broader galaxy become more dominant.
Voyager 2 followed a different route and crossed into interstellar space in 2018. Together, the probes are providing the first direct observations of conditions beyond the heliosphere.
One of their most intriguing discoveries is that the Sun's effects do not simply disappear at the boundary. Its influence appears to extend much farther into interstellar space than scientists once understood, raising new questions about where the environment shaped by our star truly gives way to the surrounding galaxy.
"The Voyagers are revolutionizing our understanding of interstellar space, a previously unexplored region outside the heliosphere," said Linda Spilker, Voyager project scientist at JPL. "One big surprise is the extent to which our Sun continues to affect interstellar space, all the way out to Voyager 1. Where does the Sun's influence end and pristine interstellar space begin? Perhaps Voyager may endure long enough to answer that question."
How NASA Is Keeping Voyager 1 Alive After Nearly 50 Years
Operating spacecraft built nearly half a century ago requires increasingly inventive engineering. Both Voyagers have experienced problems as their equipment ages, including clogged thrusters and a malfunctioning computer. NASA engineers have repeatedly developed solutions that allow the probes to continue working despite these setbacks.
Electricity has become one of the mission's greatest limitations. Earlier in 2026, engineers took a calculated risk by switching off three devices aboard Voyager 1 and replacing them with three alternatives that consume less power. This change was intended to help the spacecraft stretch its remaining energy supply.
Voyager 1 depends on a radioisotope thermal generator that is now approximately 50 years old. Often described as a nuclear battery, the device produces electricity by converting heat released during the radioactive decay of plutonium.
As the radioactive material continues to decay, the available power gradually decreases. Both Voyager spacecraft lose approximately four watts of electrical output every year, forcing engineers to make difficult decisions about which systems can remain operational.
The latest conservation measures are expected to provide enough power to operate the spacecraft's current scientific instruments until at least the summer of 2027, when both probes will celebrate their 50th launch anniversaries.
One Day, Voyager 1 Will Become a Silent Messenger to the Stars
Maintaining contact across such staggering distances requires some of NASA's most powerful communications equipment. The agency relies on its Deep Space Network, a worldwide system of large radio antennas located at three facilities, to communicate with Voyager and other spacecraft traveling to and beyond the Moon.
Despite the enormous communication delay and the spacecraft's aging systems, engineers continue monitoring Voyager 1 daily and transmitting instructions every week. The mission remains an extraordinary demonstration of what long-term spacecraft engineering can achieve.
"We listen to Voyager 1 every day and send commands to the spacecraft weekly. It just takes a little longer to communicate than it used to," said Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager at JPL. "Even traveling at the speed of light, signals now take 24 hours to reach the spacecraft and 24 hours to reach us. One day in the future, when it can no longer communicate with Earth, Voyager 1 will become humanity's silent ambassador to the stars."

1ox2o3g.title: After 8 years in space, a groundbreaking X-ray telescope finally opens its eyes
1ox2o3g.content:
After eight years in space and a journey covering 10 billion kilometers, a pioneering X-ray telescope traveling to Mercury has captured its first observations of a distant cosmic object. The instrument, built in the UK, successfully detected X-rays from the Crab Nebula, one of the brightest X-ray sources in the sky, marking an important milestone for the European Space Agency (ESA) and Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency's BepiColombo mission.
Scientists at the University of Leicester are now evaluating the Mercury Imaging X-ray Spectrometer (MIXS), which is traveling aboard the two-spacecraft mission. Their initial results are highly encouraging, arriving just as BepiColombo prepares to enter orbit around Mercury on November 21.
The telescope has spent eight years traveling through space, making it essential to confirm that its delicate components are still working properly. Although engineers monitored MIXS throughout the journey, the instrument could not look directly into space until September. That opportunity came after the Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) separated from the two science orbiters, the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) and Mercury Magnetosphere Orbiter (MMO) or Mio.
With its view finally unobstructed, MIXS could begin the critical tests needed before the spacecraft enters its planned orbit around the solar system's smallest planet.
A Telescope's First Look Across 6,500 Light-Years
For its first astronomical target, the team selected the Crab Nebula, located approximately 6,500 light-years from Earth. This well-studied remnant of an exploded star produces a strong, predictable X-ray signal, making it an ideal reference for testing the telescope's performance.
By examining how MIXS observes this distant object, researchers can determine whether the instrument still performs as expected after its lengthy journey. They can also compare the results with laboratory measurements collected in 2015, when the telescope was last tested on Earth.

The main observation campaign took place on September 11 and 12. Over 39 hours, the spacecraft carried out 55 carefully controlled changes in orientation to collect the data.
One important measurement was the telescope's angular resolution, which describes its ability to distinguish small details in an image. Scientists determined this by examining how widely the Crab Nebula's X-ray signal spread across the detector. Remarkably, MIXS delivered slightly sharper resolution than it had during its laboratory tests in 2015.
That improvement is particularly encouraging because the instrument will eventually use its X-ray vision to investigate the composition of Mercury's surface.
Better Than Expected After Eight Years in Space
Professor Emma Bunce, Principal Investigator (PI) for MIXS and Director of the Institute for Space at the University of Leicester, welcomed the results as a major achievement for the international team responsible for developing the instrument.
Professor Bunce said: "We have waited a long time to make measurements with MIXS and it is fantastic to see it operating brilliantly in space. This is testament to our engineering and technical team, and our international partners who we have worked with over many years to build this incredible instrument. 80% of the technology on MIXS is new!

"During our calibration observations we have determined that MIXS is generally performing fantastically well in space! We have no effects in our images that are associated with 'stray light' (optical photons getting in when they should not). We continue to see effects of galactic cosmic rays as we did during cruise, but we understand these and can filter them out. We see some self-fluorescence which appears when the Sun is illuminating the optic, but this won't affect our dayside observations of Mercury's surface. And the detector has suffered no radiation damage after 8 years in space.
"We see some effects in the instrument that we are still studying and expect to undertake some optimization procedures during the Mercury commissioning phase to fine tune MIXS in preparation for the science phase."
The results suggest that the telescope has weathered its long exposure to the harsh space environment exceptionally well. Engineers have found no unwanted visible light interfering with its images, and the effects of high-energy cosmic rays are understood well enough to be removed during data processing.
The team has also identified a small amount of X-ray emission originating within the instrument itself when sunlight strikes its optics. However, this effect is not expected to interfere with observations of Mercury's sunlit surface. Most importantly, the detector shows no signs of radiation damage after eight years in space.
Some remaining effects still require investigation, and scientists expect to make further adjustments after the spacecraft reaches Mercury to ensure that MIXS is ready for its full scientific mission.
How X-Rays Will Reveal Mercury's Hidden Chemistry
BepiColombo is designed to investigate Mercury in unprecedented detail. As the smallest and one of the least explored rocky planets in our solar system, Mercury offers scientists a rare opportunity to understand how planets form and change under the extreme conditions found close to a star.
One of the mission's major goals is to uncover the planet's chemical composition and geological history. These findings could help explain Mercury's unusual characteristics while providing broader insights into the formation and evolution of the solar system.
MIXS, carried aboard the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), will play a central role in this investigation. Developed by a European consortium led by the University of Leicester, it draws on the university's long history of X-ray astronomy research.
It is the first imaging X-ray telescope to operate on a planetary science mission. Working alongside other scientific instruments, MIXS will help produce a global map showing the elements that make up Mercury's surface, revealing its atomic composition in greater detail than ever before. It is also the only UK-led scientific instrument aboard BepiColombo and receives support from the UK Space Agency.
The instrument works by detecting fluorescent X-rays released by rocks on Mercury's surface. When powerful X-rays from the Sun strike these rocks, they can cause atoms within the material to emit X-rays of their own. Different elements produce characteristic X-ray signals, allowing scientists to identify what the surface is made of without collecting physical samples.
MIXS will make these measurements with assistance from the Solar Intensity X-ray and particle Spectrometer (SIXS), which monitors the solar radiation and particles reaching Mercury.
The telescope will also examine X-rays emitted from Mercury's nighttime surface when charged particles associated with the planet's magnetic environment strike it. These measurements could reveal important connections between Mercury's surface and the surrounding space environment.
A 10 Billion Kilometer Journey With a Personal Legacy
For Dr. Adrian Martindale, MIXS Instrument Scientist at the University of Leicester's School of Physics and Astronomy, the successful observations represent the culmination of more than two decades of work.
Martindale joined the project in 2003 while still an undergraduate student and has been involved in nearly every aspect of the instrument's development.
Dr. Martindale said: "BepiColombo, and MIXS in particular, are like part of my family. I've been involved since I was an undergraduate and touched almost every part of the instrument before it was launched.
"This first data is mind-blowing to me. The last time we could see through this telescope it was in the basement under the School of Physics and Astronomy in Leicester, but after a rocket launch, eight years in space and 10 billion kilometers traveled it looks just the same. I can't wait to see the science data it produces when we get into orbit."
The milestone also carries special meaning for the team because MIXS represents the scientific legacy of Professor George Fraser. Fraser was the instrument's original Principal Investigator and the driving force behind its innovative optical design before his death in March 2014.
Professor Bunce added: "We are thinking of George as we operate MIXS fully in space for the first time and know that he would be very, very proud of the team and delighted at our first light observations."
BepiColombo Prepares for Its Final Arrival at Mercury
BepiColombo began its arrival phase on September 3, when the Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) separated from the spacecraft assembly.
The remaining connected spacecraft are scheduled to enter orbit around Mercury on November 21. The two science orbiters, MPO and Mio, are then expected to separate on December 9 to 10, allowing them to prepare for their respective scientific operations.
The mission's primary science phase is scheduled to begin in April 2027. Once underway, BepiColombo will investigate Mercury's surface, internal structure, magnetic field, and surrounding environment, helping scientists piece together the history of a planet that remains surprisingly mysterious despite its proximity to the Sun.
For the MIXS team, the successful first observations of the Crab Nebula offer an early indication of what the instrument may accomplish when it finally turns its attention to Mercury.
International Collaboration and Funding
MIXS was developed through a partnership involving research institutions and technology companies across Europe. Participating organizations include: United Kingdom: University of Leicester, The Open University, RAL, and Magna Parva Finland: University of Helsinki, FMI, Patria, SSF, Oxford Instruments, and Beneq Spain: INTA, CAB, Lidax, and Crisa Germany: MPS, MPG-HLL, MPE, and PNSensor France: PHOTONIS (now Exosens)UK funding for the BepiColombo MIXS instrument comes from the UK Space Agency, which serves as the lead funding organization, along with STFC, the European Space Agency, and the University of Leicester.

1i7m661.title: Марк Цукерберг откровенно смеётся над GTA 6
1i7m661.content:
Миллиардер Марк Цукерберг довольно забавно и цинично отреагировал на геймплей GTA 6, опубликовав ироничный мем, высмеивающий игру на своей странице в соцсети X.
Вместо криминальных разборок и угонов спорткаров миллиардеру досталась «семейная» версия игры с миссией по покупке продуктов для его супруги Присциллы. Пост моментально стал вирусным и за считанные часы собрал миллионы просмотров, а пользователи в комментариях окрестили такую версию игры «симулятором идеального мужа»:

Кое кто не оставил этот стёб без внимания:

А волна негатива продолжает увеличиваться. Скорее всего сайту Metacritic скоро придётся включать бот-систему, что бы как то "сгладить" оценку. Если конечно это уже не произошло, так как многие из комьюнити игры уже говорят о "чистке" отзывов...

zl5thn.title: The call of the seamount: Two new armored tardigrades described in the Atlantic
zl5thn.content:
At Senghor Seamount off the Cape Verde Islands in the Atlantic Ocean, the research team has identified two new species of tardigrades; shown here is Megastygarctides hekatae sp. nov. under a scanning electron microscope. Credit: Trokhymchuk

An international team led by researchers from Senckenberg am Meer in Wilhelmshaven has described two new species of marine tardigrades. The tiny marine organisms were discovered in the sediment of the Senghor Seamount off the coast of Cape Verde. According to the researchers, the discovery underscores the role of undersea mountains as oases of biodiversity. The study, which includes comprehensive taxonomic descriptions of the new species, has been published in the journal "ZooKeys."

Tardigrades are tiny organisms, usually only a few tenths of a millimeter in size. Their stocky build and "clumsy" manner of movement are vaguely reminiscent of bears, which gave rise to their vernacular name "water bears." Yet, tardigrades are among the most resilient animals in the world and can survive under extreme environmental conditions. They are found both on land—where they live in mosses, for instance—and in freshwater and marine environments. There, they form part of the meiofauna—microorganisms up to one millimeter in size—on the seafloor.
In a new study, a team led by Dr. Alexander Kieneke and Dr. Roman R. Trokhymchuk from Senckenberg am Meer in Wilhelmshaven has described two new species of marine tardigrades (Tardigrada). "We detected the two new species—Megastygarctides hekatae sp. nov. and Parastygarctus potercha sp. nov.—in sediment samples collected during an expedition aboard the research vessel Meteor at Senghor Seamount," says lead author Trokhymchuk, who conducts research at the Dutch Naturalis Biodiversity Center in Leiden and at Senckenberg.
"Our study thus provides the first systematic investigation of the marine tardigrade fauna at this seamount. We identified a total of 20 different taxa. This supports our hypothesis that such undersea mountains also represent particularly species-rich habitats for marine tardigrades. In contrast, at a deep-sea reference site about 100 kilometers (62 miles) farther north, we only found two tardigrade taxa."

The discovery of these two new species—here, Parastygarctus potercha sp. nov.—is further evidence that seamounts can serve as veritable oases of biodiversity. Credit: Trokhymchuk

A summit rich in tardigrades
The Senghor Seamount is an underwater mountain in the eastern tropical Atlantic off the Cape Verde Islands. Its summit lies only about 100 to 130 meters (330 to 430 feet) below the ocean surface, while the seafloor in the surrounding area is at a depth of several thousand meters. The sediment at the seamount's summit consists primarily of coarse, calcareous material of biological origin, mainly fragments of corals, sea urchins, bryozoans, bivalves and snails. In contrast, the deep-sea floor samples consist primarily of fine, mudlike sediment.
As part of their study, the researchers examined a total of 219 individual tardigrades from samples collected during the 2009 expedition. Of these, 212 specimens came from the summit plateau of the seamount, whereas only seven specimens were found at the deep-sea reference site.
"The marked difference in the number and diversity of tardigrades we found on the plateau and on the deep-sea floor is further evidence that seamounts can be veritable oases of biodiversity—even for organisms that are barely visible to the naked eye," explains marine scientist Kieneke.
"On the Faroe Bank, another plateau in the Atlantic, as many as 35 species of tardigrades have been documented. However, the deep sea remains largely unexplored. It is therefore reasonable to assume that biodiversity in other regions has been underestimated to date."

Rare spines and juvenile traits
Both newly described species belong to the armored tardigrades and exhibit distinctive external characteristics. "Megastygarctides hekatae sp. nov. possesses so-called genital spines—a feature that is extremely rare in tardigrades. These are short, hollow projections with small hooks that are connected to the internal reproductive organs," reports Trokhymchuk. "Moreover, the species was found at a depth of about 100 meters (330 feet), making it the deepest discovery to date of a tardigrade of the genus Megastygarctides."
"Parastygarctus potercha sp. nov., on the other hand, exhibits what is known as pedomorphism. This means that adult individuals retain certain physical characteristics from an earlier developmental stage. In the case of Parastygarctus potercha sp. nov., these include a particularly small body size and a reduced number of claws."
In addition to detailed taxonomic descriptions of the two newly discovered tardigrade species, the study also includes updated identification keys for the genera Megastygarctides and Parastygarctus. This will make it easier to distinguish between them in the future, based on their physical characteristics. With the addition of these two new species, the genus Megastygarctides now comprises seven known species, while Parastygarctus comprises eight.

Publication details
Roman Ruslanovych Trokhymchuk et al., Marine tardigrades (Heterotardigrada) from Senghor Seamount, Eastern Tropical Atlantic, with the description of two new species from the taxon Stygarctidae, ZooKeys (2026). DOI: 10.3897/zookeys.1295.205902

gh-1455706823.title: GitHub - MatyMeatBoy/ShiningSource: Shining Soul II (GBA) as a native program, built from its matching decompilation: widescreen, online for 2-4 players, achievements. Windows, Linux, Android. Bring your own ROM.
gh-1455706823.content:
ShiningSource is a native port of Shining Soul II for Windows, Linux and
Android, built from the matching C decompilation.
It runs the game's own code on modern hardware, with real widescreen, online co-op
for 2–4 players, crossplay, achievements and configurable controls. The original
pixel art and game timing are preserved; no emulator or static recompilation is used.

Game
Source
Status

Shining Soul II (Europe, AU2P)
SS2Decomp: 100% matching C
Playable, in active development

Shining Soul
SS1Decomp: decompilation in progress
Joins the port when its decomp is ready (games/ss1)

No ROM, BIOS or game data is included, here or in the releases. You supply
your own cartridge dump (Shining Soul II Europe, SHA-1
aa1288be9257337abdfe3034898cf6c7aa778fbc); graphics, text and music are read
from it when you play.

The launcher, drawn in the port's own "Soul" look.
Project showcase

These are illustrated feature summaries; see the sections below for current platform and feature details.
Download
Releases: Windows x64
(.zip: unpack it and start ShiningSource.exe), Android (.apk,
armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a and x86_64, Android 5 or later) and Linux x64 (.tar.gz, started
from a terminal: see LINUX.txt inside). The launcher asks for your ROM the
first time and checks it.
With a release that includes recomplauncher.json, you can also install
through RecompLauncher on Windows or Linux. Choose your European .gba in
Easy Setup. Display and audio settings are available on the game's page.
0.9.2 (Windows, Android and Linux) adds in-game co-op rooms, an updated
Game Link screen, redesigned Windows and Android launchers, Wide Pro artwork,
GameCube adapter support and fixes to the port's equipment and link handling.
See the release notes.
0.9 (Windows, Android and Linux) releases cancelled Archer arrows and
preserves enemy deaths received during initialization in online co-op. Windows
and Linux add RecompLauncher setup and settings. Online rules remain 7.
See the release notes.
0.8.14 (Windows, Android and Linux) expands Restored Multiplayer Audio
(Audio Multijugador Restaurado): companion enemy hits, critical markers,
breakable-object impacts, ability cues and hurt/falling voices share the existing
toggle. Android and Linux also include the narrow-map fading fixes from 0.8.13.
See the release notes and
audio source audit. Online rules remain 7.
0.8.13 (Windows) shortens narrow-map edge fading from 32 to 8 game pixels,
covers world sprites at the edge, and keeps the faded world behind menus without
darkening their colours. Translucent menus and HUD sprite bounds are handled
separately. See release notes and verification limits.
Android and Linux remain on 0.8.11; online rules remain 7.
0.8.12 (Windows) replaces the custom port achievements with the official
52-achievement RetroAchievements catalog and badges, included for offline play.
Local progress, the achievements tab and unlock popups use the same definitions.
See release notes and verification limits.
Android and Linux remain on 0.8.11; online rules remain 7.
0.8.11 fixes garbled item descriptions opened with Select and adds automatic
Android crash reports with a persistent outbox and previous-session logs.
See release notes and
report details. Online rules remain 7,
compatible with 0.8.10; 0.8.8/0.8.9 clients must update.
0.8.10 fixes portable multiplayer scene callbacks between Windows, Android
and Linux. Everyone in the room must update to 0.8.10 (online rules 7).
See release notes.
0.8.9 adds companion combat sounds under Experimental: remote sounds,
on by default, and fixes menu font access on rebased hosts. See the
release notes and verification.
Android 0.8.8 improved startup compatibility with relocatable game images,
movable stacks and shareable diagnostics. Thanks to RobNick for the Android
bug report. Windows and Linux 0.8.8 share the corrected online room identity;
all players should update together. See the release and verification notes.
0.8 is the first public release; the versions before it were test builds.
Each release's notes say what was checked and, just as plainly, what was not.
What it does
The game

Every function of the cartridge is the decompilation's C, compiled unchanged.
The port is the layer underneath: memory, the task scheduler, interrupts,
video, sound, saves, input and the link cable.
64-bit hosts on Windows, Linux (x64 and ARM64) and Android run the game's
32-bit code inside one process. The same scripted 32,000-frame play-through
ends in the same frame hash on the builds that are tested with it.
Saving works as on the cartridge, with a backup of the previous save kept
beside it.

Picture

Two screen modes. Classic: the console's picture at a whole scale
inside an adjustable border. Enhanced: the picture takes the width of your
window at a whole scale, always pixel-exact.
Real widescreen. In the field the extra columns show more of the map the
game already has (up to twice the console's width), not a stretched picture.
Characters, enemies and objects stay visible beside the console's columns.
The status display follows the screen: HP, SP and Soul sit at the left
edge, the L and R menus at the left and right edges; full-screen pages and
menus keep their composition in the middle and are always drawn whole.
Real transparency. The cartridge fakes transparency by showing a sprite
every other frame (shadows, ghosts, markers, a character that was just hurt),
which a modern display shows as hard blinking. Those sprites are drawn at
half strength in every frame instead; fast blinking drawn any other way is
smoothed the same way.
Where a map ends beside the view, the picture fades into black; around a
dark screen (a fade, a loading screen) the sides darken with it.
VSync, variable refresh (G-Sync / FreeSync) or neither.
Experimental, off by default: the status display drawn larger on a big
window.
A machine that cannot draw every picture in time leaves pictures out, never
game time: the game and its sound keep their speed.

Classic (the console's 240 columns)
Enhanced (here 427 columns)

Full-screen pages keep their composition in the middle; the HP, SP and Soul
display stays at the left edge.

Online, 2 to 4 players

Open Multiplayer from the title to browse the lobby, create a room, or
select an open room. ShiningSource Server lists rooms from the public relay
by default. The launcher’s Online tab can instead select a custom relay.
Built around what the game's link code really does (see
GBANoCable, chapter 8):
each player's state is handed over the moment it arrives, nobody waits for a
slow player, and the game's one-time events (an enemy appears, an item is
dropped or taken, a change of map) travel whole on a reliable channel instead
of step by step. A message measured 16 ms between players on one machine.
A player who leaves or crashes stays as a standing character and the others
play on. (When player 1 leaves, the session ends: the game gives player 1
the enemies and the items.)
A connection that drops comes back. A player whose connection is gone
for a while (up to two minutes; the host, up to one) is taken in again and
receives everything it missed, in order, as long as the game is still
running. Relaunching after a crash starts a fresh game process.
Crossplay between Windows, Linux and Android.

Comfort

Skip scene. Start during the introduction or a story sequence offers to
skip it; it stops at any question instead of answering for you. Online it is
a vote of all players, and the game's own exits are used so nothing runs
fast.
Launcher: verifies your ROM (and finds one that sits beside it), screen
mode, sound, every key and controller button reassignable, online, dated copies of your
save, language
(English / Spanish). It closes when the game starts.
Touch controls on Android.
Reports: a crash or a hang on Windows writes shiningsource_crash.log,
and an online session writes shiningsource_net.log, beside the program.

Achievements

The RetroAchievements set of your ROM is followed while you play, with a
notice and the achievement's badge when one unlocks. Sending unlocks to your
account is off by default: this port is not a client RetroAchievements
has approved, and an unlock cannot be taken back.
Local achievements use the official RetroAchievements definitions and
badges. Windows includes the 52-achievement catalog for offline play;
signing in refreshes it. Unlocks are kept on this PC.
Rebel mode: cheats (full HP, full SP, no defeat, gold), with their own
record and their own save file. Nothing of a Rebel run reaches
RetroAchievements, and cheats stop while the link is running.

Platforms

Platform
State

Windows x64
Released; the main test platform

Android (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86_64)
0.8.8 compatibility work: Android 5/14/15 emulators, 4/16 KiB pages, save/restart and relocated Android/Windows online; physical-device confirmation pending (verification)

Linux x64, ARM64
x64 released (.tar.gz, no launcher yet); x64 passes the reference run, an online session and a lost connection that returns in a virtual machine (Debian 12, 0.8.4; ARM64 last run with 0.8); not tried with a window on a desktop

Browser (WebAssembly)
Builds from source and plays from your ROM file, saves kept in the browser; offline only; no hosted page

PS Vita
Untested alpha package from 0.8.5: built with the Vita SDK, never run on a console (docs/CONSOLES_NX_VITA.md)

PS4, PS5, Switch
In progress: designed, not built yet

Honest state
This is a port in development, tested mostly by scripted runs on one machine
and by a small group of players. Known and open at the time of writing:

Online has been played by three and four people, and each release answers
what they found; several of those fixes come from reading the game's code and
have not been confirmed in a real session yet. The release notes say which.
Players reported areas without music. A survey of all 399 songs
(tools/tests/m4a_survey.py) found none silent and no command the sound
engine lacks, so the cause is in when the game asks for a song, not in how
it is played. One likely cause is changed in 0.8 (a song asked for
again while it was still fading out stayed silent); it was never seen
happening in a test, so tell us where the music is missing.
Returning after a lost connection, a player that is gone, and the changes
of map around them are tested on one machine with a relay that cuts a
player off, not yet on a real network.
Joining a game that is already in progress is an experiment, off by default
(docs/JOIN_IN_PROGRESS.md).

The order of work is in docs/ROADMAP.md; the design and its
reasons in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; measurements of
memory, frame pacing and crash handling in docs/OPTIPORT.md.
Controls
Keyboard: arrows, X = A, Z = B, C = L, V = R, Enter = Start, right
Shift = Select, F11 full screen, Escape (or Select + Start) opens the
port's options in the game. A controller works when plugged in. All of it can
be changed in the launcher.
GameCube. The GameCube profile maps the physical A and B buttons to GBA A
and B, Z to Select, and the L/R clicks to the GBA shoulders. Both the D-pad and
main stick move the character. If an adapter in PC mode exposes only analog
triggers, a firm pull acts as a click. Recognized GameCube adapters select this
profile automatically. For a compatible adapter that SDL reports as a generic
pad, choose GameCube under Controls and remap any buttons that differ.
On Windows, the original Nintendo WUP-028 and compatible adapters in Wii U
mode require a WinUSB-compatible driver and the SDL3 package with libusb.
An adapter already working in another program may be held open by it. The
Dolphin adapter guide
explains Windows driver setup.
Building (developers)
Requirements: Python 3, git, llvm-mingw
(SHININGSOURCE_LLVM_MINGW) and SDL3 development files (SHININGSOURCE_SDL3).
For a Windows build with native Nintendo adapter support, run
python tools/build_gamecube_sdl.py --sdl-source PATH with the SDL 3.4.18
source, CMake and Ninja. Set SHININGSOURCE_GAMECUBE_SDL to the output directory
when building the host, building the launcher and packaging the Windows release.
The regular SDL paths and builds continue to work with the standard runtime.
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/MatyMeatBoy/ShiningSource
cd ShiningSource
python3 tools/build.py prepare # the game's C, with the port's patches (games/ss2/port/patches.json)
python3 tools/build.py compile
python3 tools/link.py # 32-bit development program: build/dev32/ss2/ss2_dev32.exe
python3 tools/build_win64.py # 64-bit host + game image: build/win64/ss2/
python3 tools/build_launcher.py # the launcher: ShiningSource.exe
Other targets: tools/build_linux64.py, tools/build_arm64.py,
tools/build_android.py, tools/build_web.py. After changing
games/ss2/port/patches.json run prepare and compile again before linking.
The port is tested without a window: SS_FRAMES=N SS_INPUT_FILE=script ss2_dev32.exe rom.gba plays a scripted run and prints a hash of the video
state per frame; tools/net_test.sh runs several players through a local
relay. The decompilation itself is never edited from this repository: what the
port needs changed in the game's C is a list of small patches, each with its
reason.
Layout

Path
Content

games/ss2/decomp
submodule: the Shining Soul II decompilation

games/ss2/port
what this game needs to build natively: modules the runtime replaces, source patches with their reasons

runtime/
the port: core (video, sound, saves, scheduler, link), hosts, platform code, achievements

launcher/
the Windows launcher

android/
the Android package

relay/
the online relay

tools/
build drivers, generators and tests

docs/
architecture, roadmap, release notes

Credits and license
Built on the Shining Soul II decompilation and its contributors, including
emmkay440, author of the original Shining Soul
decompilation. Sister projects: ReKHCoM
and GBANoCable.
The port's code is MIT (LICENSE); SDL3, Dear ImGui and rcheevos keep
their own licenses. The games belong to their owners. This project distributes
none of their data: without your own cartridge dump it does nothing. The
pictures of the game on this page are there to show what the port does.
