1626bzv.title: GTA 6 Dealer’s Choice walkthrough: Should you choose Cut or Pure?
1626bzv.content: Dealer’s Choice is the thirty-seventh mission in GTA 6Do you need help completing Dealer’s Choice in GTA 6? Here’s how to complete the mission, and all you need to know about how to get the best outcome from the Cut or Pure choice.The Dealer’s Choice mission involves collecting product from a dealer called Tyrone and selling it to buyers in Vice City. You’ll also have to make an important decision about which product to take. This mission also introduces Tyrone as someone Jason and Lucia can eventually sell their stash to.Here’s how to complete Dealer’s Choice in GTA 6 and which option you should choose.Check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub for dozens of walkthroughs, guides and much more.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Dealer’s Choice walkthroughDealer’s Choice becomes available after completing Welcome to Vice City, the first mission in Chapter 3 of GTA 6. Head back to the Jack of Hearts club near the house and make your way upstairs to the recording studio. Here you’ll find Jason’s friend Dre’Quan in the recording studio at the top of the stairs.Go in and wait for him to finish recording. He’ll be working with The Dimez, a pair of rappers that will become bigger characters as the game goes on. During this session, Jason can choose which lyric he prefers in the song.Walk with Dre’Quan to Boobie, who is in the office at the club. Boobie explains that Jason owes him a favour for providing the his old apartment. Once the conversation ends, get into Dre’Quan’s car and follow him to the pickup location.Drive to the apartment complex and follow Dre’Quan up the stairs to meet Tyrone. After a short chat introducinng the character, Tyrone will offer you two different products: Cut or Pure. This is the main choice in Dealer’s Choice and determines how the subsequent drug deal plays out.Should you choose Cut or Pure in Dealer’s Choice?I recommend choosing Pure, as it allows you to complete the deal without complications.Here’s what happens in the mission Dealer’s Choice with each option:Pure: The buyers test the product and accept it without any problems. You can collect the money and continue the mission.Cut: The buyers test the brick and discover that the product has been mixed. You can offer it to them at half price to complete the transaction peacefully, or you can start  blasting.There is no lasting impact on the overall story of GTA 6 based on this choice alone.Here’s how the mission plays out with both choices:Drive to the marked location south of the Jack of Hearts and follow Dre’Quan towards the buyers.Pure: When prompted, hand over the bag to the client and wait while the buyer checks the product. You can ask him to hurry up if you don’t want to wait. Once the inspection is complete, collect the backpack containing the money.Cut: You’ll hand over the bag like before, but once you hand over the bag, they’ll notice that the stuff has been stepped on, and a fight will break out.Once you’re free from the cops or the gang members, drive Dre’Quan towards the marker on the map. A cutscene will trigger before you reach your destination, bringing Dealer’s Choice to an end.The end of this mission will also transition from Jason to Lucia, to see an old friend turn up at the new apartment.

1730cg.title: Классическую The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion нативно запустили на Android методом статической рекомпиляции
1730cg.content:
Энтузиаст Тоби Томкинсон, известный под ником ttom795, опубликовал исходный код и первые сборки Oblivion_Android. Это неофициальный нативный порт оригинальной ПК-версии The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion 2006 года для смартфонов и консолей на базе Android. В отличие от эмуляторов среды Windows, проект основан на статической рекомпиляции оригинального кода игры под архитектуру ARM64. За перевод графики DirectX 9 на Vulkan 1.1 отвечает модифицированная библиотека dxvk-native, а вывод окна, звука и управление реализованы через SDL2.
По словам разработчика, за основу инструментария был взят его предыдущий порт The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. В опубликованной демонстрации игра запускается на бюджетной портативной консоли Retroid Pocket Duo Lite с процессором Snapdragon 665 и графическим ускорителем Adreno 610. Даже на таком слабом железе ролевая игра выдает от 20 до 38 кадров в секунду на открытых пространствах Сиродила и разгоняется до 60 кадров в секунду в подземельях и меню.
Это первая публичная версия, но пространство для улучшений еще есть, так что обновления обязательно выйдут. Сборка должна быть довольно стабильной, поскольку создавалась по схожему принципу с портом Skyrim.- Тоби Томкинсон, разработчик Oblivion_Android
Вскоре после релиза энтузиаст выпустил обновление до версии 0.1.3, которое исправило серьезный графический баг на смартфонах с ускорителями Mali в чипах Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor и Kirin, где ранее геометрия растягивалась в длинные полосы из-за отсутствия аппаратной поддержки отсечения по дистанции. Кроме того, апдейт сократил время выделения и освобождения небольших блоков памяти с 34 до 5 миллисекунд, перевел базовое копирование памяти на нативные функции Android и переключил игровые таймеры на прямое чтение аппаратного счетчика процессора.
Встроенный лаунчер Oblivion Recompiled позволяет гибко настроить игру перед запуском. Пользователям доступны выбор системного или кастомного драйвера Turnip и Adreno, все оригинальные видеопараметры вроде дальности прорисовки, качества теней, отражений на воде и эффектов HDR, а также ограничитель частоты кадров на уровне 60 fps. Управление поддерживает как сенсорную раскладку, так и геймпады с гироскопическим прицеливанием и переключением кнопок в стиле Nintendo.
Сам репозиторий Oblivion_Android на GitHub не содержит игровых ресурсов. Для запуска потребуется собственная лицензионная копия игры из Steam или с диска версии 1.2.0.416, файлы которой вместе с библиотеками d3dx9_27.dll и binkw32.dll нужно перенести на устройство или использовать для самостоятельной сборки. При этом порт изначально поддерживает официальные дополнения и обычные модификации с возможностью настройки порядка загрузки плагинов.
При всех успехах проект остается на ранней стадии разработки и сохраняет ряд технических ограничений. Статический транслятор отклонил 271 функцию из 48 462 обнаруженных в исполняемом файле, из-за чего в игре все еще возможны внезапные вылеты. Сборка также не поддерживает расширитель скриптов OBSE, патч на 4 ГБ оперативной памяти и вибрацию контроллера, а приближение камеры работает только с физической мышью. Минимальными требованиями для запуска заявлены Android 9, 64-битный процессор ARM64 и поддержка Vulkan 1.1.

exsrri.title: В GTA 6 сыграли более половины активных пользователей консолей - в среднем по 8 часов за день
exsrri.content:
В день запуска GTA 6 в игру зашло более половины активных пользователей консолей. По данным аналитика Circana Мэта Пискателлы, игроки провели в новинке в среднем около восьми часов.
Пискателла, занимающий должность старшего директора Circana и консультирующий игровую индустрию, уточнил, что речь идёт именно о пользователях, которые были активны 19 ноября, а не обо всех владельцах консолей.
«Среди игроков, активных 19 ноября, в GTA 6 сыграли 61% пользователей PlayStation 5 в США и 56% пользователей Xbox по всему миру. Игроки на PS5 провели в игре в среднем 513 минут за день, а на Xbox - 494 минуты. Показатели ежедневной активности и времени игры просто невероятные», - написал аналитик.
Таким образом, среднее время в GTA 6 составило примерно 8 часов 33 минуты на PS5 и 8 часов 14 минут на Xbox. Пискателла признался, что не располагает точными данными за все предыдущие годы, поскольку восстановить показатели ежедневной активности непросто, однако за время его работы в Circana он не припоминает ничего сопоставимого.
На втором месте по активности в день запуска GTA 6 оказалась Fortnite. В неё сыграли около 10% активных пользователей обеих платформ.
Пискателла также поделился статистикой самых популярных игр за период с 6 по 19 ноября — до выхода GTA 6. В пятёрку лидеров вошли Fortnite, Call of Duty, ремастер GTA 5, Roblox и NBA 2K27.
Ранее сообщалось, что GTA 6 принесла около 3,7 миллиарда долларов за первые 24 часа и стала крупнейшим запуском в истории индустрии развлечений. По данным статьи, за первые дни игра разошлась тиражом 32,5 миллиона копий, войдя в число самых продаваемых игр в истории.

y7vkc5.title: На фронті 116 зіткнень, найбільше ворог тиснув на Покровському та Костянтинівському напрямках
y7vkc5.content:
На фронті 116 бойових зіткнень, на Покровському та Костянтинівському напрямках росіяни здійснили майже 25 штурмів позицій ЗСУ.

Про це повідомляє Укрінформ з посиланням на оперативну інформацію Генштабу ЗСУ станом на 22:00 21.11.2026 у Фейсбуці.

«Від початку доби відбулося 116 бойових зіткнень. Противник завдав одного ракетного удару та здійснив 51 авіаційний удар, скинув 162 керовані авіабомби. Також застосував 4445 дронів-камікадзе та 1599 разів обстріляв населені пункти й позиції наших військ», - йдеться у публікації.

За даними Генштабу, на Північно-Слобожанському та Курському напрямках від початку доби відбулося три бойові зіткнення. Окупанти завдали двох авіаударів, скинули п’ять керованих авіабомб та здійснили 45 обстрілів позицій наших військ і населених пунктів.

На Південно-Слобожанському напрямку противник два рази намагався просунутися в бік Охрімівки.

На Лиманському напрямку противник п’ять разів атакував у бік населених пунктів Зелена Долина, Лиман та Діброва.

На Слов’янському напрямку точилося одне боєзіткнення поблизу Миколаївки.

На Костянтинівському напрямку українські воїни відбили десять атак окупантів у районі Костянтинівки та в бік Новопавлівки. Одне зіткнення триває досі.

Читайте також: Зеленський: До операції проти Керченського мосту Путін атакував українські мости 109 разів

Тринадцять атак здійснив ворог на Покровському напрямку. Окупанти намагалися просунутися неподалік населених пунктів Вільне, Добропілля та в бік населених пунктів Кучерів Яр, Чернігівка, Святогорівка, Мирне, Сергіївка, Новопавлівка. Три ворожі штурми тривають.

За попередніми підрахунками, на цьому напрямку ліквідовано 49 окупантів, поранено 17. Знищено 11 одиниць автомобільної техніки, чотири одиниці спеціальної техніки, чотири пункти управління БпЛА та 30 укриттів ворога. Пошкоджено 11 одиниць автомобільної техніки, три артилерійські системи, п’ять одиниць спеціальної техніки, три пункти управління безпілотними літальними апаратами та 120 укриттів противника. Крім того, знищено або подавлено 230 безпілотних літальних апаратів різних типів.

На Гуляйпільському напрямку ворог сім разів атакував наші позиції в бік населених пунктів Нове Запоріжжя, Злагода, Добропілля, Воздвижівка, Гуляйпільське, Новоселівка.

На Оріхівському напрямку противник один раз атакував у бік Новоданилівки.

Читайте також: Спецпризначенці «Альфи» за тиждень знешкодили понад 4300 російських військових

На Куп’янському, Краматорському, Олександрівському та Придніпровському напрямках ворог наступальних дій не проводив.

На інших напрямках суттєвих змін в обстановці не відбулося.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, Сили оборони України 20 листопада та в ніч на 21 листопада уразили міст, склад боєприпасів та пункти управління армії РФ.

محرك Reforged الحقيقي كاملًا على هاتفك — لعبة Command & Conquer: Generals — Zero Hour بنسخة
Reforged 4.0.0 تعمل أصلًا (Native) على أندرويد:

ودعم عربي كامل داخل اللعبة، وطبقة رسوم بمستوى نسخة الويندوز على الهواتف القوية.

هذا ليس مود بيانات فوق محرك آخر: محرك Reforged نفسه مُترجَم ومبنيّ خصيصًا لأندرويد (arm64).

⬇️ تحميل أحدث إصدار

التثبيت

حمّل ZeroHourReforged.apk من صفحة الإصدارات.
ثبّته — التثبيت فوق أي إصدار سابق يحافظ على بياناتك وإعداداتك.
افتح التطبيق واختر مجلد لعبة Zero Hour الأصلية على هاتفك (التطبيق يبحث عنه تلقائيًا أيضًا).
تحتاج نسختك القانونية من ملفات اللعبة — هذا المشروع لا يتضمّن أي أصول من اللعبة.
اختر اللغة ومعيار الرسومات من المشغّل، واضغط «تشغيل اللعبة».

بياناتك تعيش في مجلد خاص بالتطبيق ZeroHourReforged/ على ذاكرة الهاتف — حفظك وإعداداتك تبقى حتى لو حذفت التطبيق وأعدت تثبيته.
المزايا

المحرك الحقيقي — Reforged 4.0.0 مبنيّ أصلًا لأندرويد 64-بت؛ محاكاة 60 تحديثًا/ثانية مثل الويندوز تمامًا، ومباريات كاملة حتى النصر مُختبَرة على هواتف ضعيفة مثل Redmi 14C.
تحكّم لمسي كامل — تحديد باللمس والسحب، كاميرا بإصبعين، أوامر بالضغط المطوّل، أزرار أوضاع (هجوم قسري، نقاط مسار، انتشار، تشكيلات)، وعمود جيش: مجموعات تحكّم 0–9 واختيار الكلّ حسب النوع (الشاشة / الخريطة / الطائرات / الحوّامات / القوات البرية).
رسوم بمستوى الويندوز — على الهواتف القوية: توهّج (Bloom)، تنعيم حواف (FXAA)، حدّة (Sharpen)، إطباق محيطي (AO)، ضباب (Haze) وإضاءة لكل بكسل. من المشغّل بأربعة معايير: ضعيف / متوسط / قوي / خارق. الهواتف الضعيفة (مثل Mali-G52) تأخذ ملفًا خفيفًا تلقائيًا كي تبقى اللعبة سلسة.
عربي كامل داخل اللعبة — ترجمة كاملة تشمل إضافات Reforged نفسها، بخط «ثمانية» — إضافة إلى الإنجليزية والتركية والألمانية والأوكرانية والروسية والفرنسية. واجهة المشغّل بـ13 لغة.
لعب شبكي محلي (LAN) — مكدّس شبكة اللعبة الأصلي بين أجهزة أندرويد. (اللعب عبر الإنترنت واللعب المشترك مع الويندوز هدف الإصدار 1.31.)
مشغّل نظيف — ثلاث صفحات (الرئيسية / الإعدادات / المساعدة وحول)، سجلّ تشغيل تلقائي مع مفتاح إيقاف، وتنبيه عند توفّر تحديث. مجاني وبلا إعلانات.

الحالة
المشروع قيد التطوير النشط، واللعبة قابلة للعب من البداية إلى النهاية. كل إصدار يُبنى آليًا ويُختبَر على جهاز حقيقي قبل نشره. أحدث إصدار دائمًا في صفحة الإصدارات.

Zero Hour Reforged — on Android (English)
The real Reforged engine, in full, on your phone — Command & Conquer: Generals — Zero Hour
running Reforged 4.0.0 natively on Android:
the same engine, the same 60-updates-per-second simulation as Windows, the same data — with touch
controls designed for the game from scratch, full in-game Arabic, and a Windows-level graphics
layer on strong phones.

This is not a data mod on top of someone else's engine: the Reforged engine itself is compiled
and built specifically for Android (arm64).

⬇️ Download the latest release
Install

Download ZeroHourReforged.apk from the Releases page.
Install it — installing over any previous version keeps your data and settings.
Open the app and pick your original Zero Hour game folder on the phone (the app also auto-scans for it).
You need your own legally owned copy of the game files — this project ships no game assets.
Choose the language and a graphics preset in the launcher, and press Play.

Your data lives in the app's own ZeroHourReforged/ folder on shared storage — saves and settings
survive even an uninstall/reinstall.
Features

The real engine — Reforged 4.0.0 built natively for 64-bit Android; 60 updates/second simulation exactly like Windows, with full matches played to victory on weak phones such as the Redmi 14C.
Full touch controls — tap and drag selection, two-finger camera, long-press orders, mode buttons (force attack, waypoints, scatter, formations), and an army column: control groups 0–9 plus select-all-by-type (screen / map / planes / helicopters / ground).
Windows-level graphics — on strong phones: bloom, FXAA, sharpen, ambient occlusion, haze and per-pixel lighting, via four launcher presets (Low / Medium / High / Ultra). Weak GPUs (e.g. Mali-G52) automatically get a light profile so the game stays smooth.
Full in-game Arabic — a complete translation including Reforged's own additions, in the Thmanyah typeface — plus English, Turkish, German, Ukrainian, Russian and French. The launcher speaks 13 languages.
LAN multiplayer — the game's original LAN stack between Android devices. (Online play and cross-play with Windows are the goal of v1.31.)
A clean launcher — three pages (Home / Settings / Help & About), an automatic run log with an off switch, and update notifications. Free, no ads.

Status
Actively developed, and playable end to end. Every release is built automatically and tested on a
real device before it ships. The newest build is always on the
Releases page.

12bte3j.title: GTA 6 Slim Jim Location: How to Get It and Unlock Cars Quietly
12bte3j.content: Looking for the GTA 6 Slim Jim location? The Slim Jim is an essential tool for Jason and Lucia, allowing them to break into locked vehicles without smashing windows or triggering car alarms.It wouldn’t be Grand Theft Auto 6 without a bit of Grand Theft Auto. In this guide, we’ll take you through the steps of stealing cars in the early game of GTA 6. You might read that and think “I know how to steal a car in a GTA game,” but things are pretty different this time.One of the biggest changes to GTA 6 when compared to other games is that many of the cars you try to steal in Leonida are alarmed, and when you try to break into them early in the game, they’ll alert the police, and surrounding pedestrians.If you’re curious as to how to break into cars with a slightly more stealthy approach, then this guide is for you. Below, we’ll explain the types of security measures cars have in GTA 6, and how to get around the early-game barrier of car alarms going off, or having to smash car windows.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Slim Jim Location: How to steal carsTo steal a car with an alarm in GTA 6, without setting off the alarm, you need a Slim Jim. This is a tool that allows you to break into standard cars without having to break the window, or car jacking someone. By getting the Slim Jim, you can steal cars without alerting police.It’s worth noting that the Slim Jim will only work on standard cars. Supercars and Hypercars require a later-game tool in order to break into them without causing a scene. You will get the option to clone keys later in the game, but that’s far off if you’re just starting your journey.Where to find the Slim Jim in GTA 6The Slim Jim is obtained during the Chapter 2 story mission called Moses (Take a Vehicle to Moses).To unlock this mission, you’ll first need to complete the Girls’ Trip mission, where Lucia meets Vicky. She’ll introduce you to Moses, a mechanic who can help you get a new vehicle. After this point in the story you can also sell cars to Moses, if he wants them.Once the Moses mission becomes available, head to his garage in Port Gellhorn and follow the mission objectives. You can find out complete guide on the Moses mission here. After this, you’ll have access to the Slim Jim, and when Jason is playable again, he’ll also have access to the tool.Can the Slim Jim unlock every car?No. Although the Slim Jim works on many standard vehicles, it won’t unlock and start cars with keyless ignition.For those vehicles, you’ll need the Key Cloner, which becomes available later in Chapter 3.You can also use the WAiNK app to check a vehicle’s security features before attempting to steal it.

11qslk5.title: Where to Watch the NWSL Championship: Washington Spirit vs. Kansas City Current
11qslk5.content:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.

The National Women’s Soccer League final is set, with Kansas City Current traveling to Washington Spirit’s Audi Field. It’ll be the Spirit’s third consecutive visit to the NWSL final, and they’ll be seeking their second title. Kansas City Current will be seeking their first title, having visited the finals in 2022.

The Spirit will enjoy home field advantage, a rarity for the NWSL — like the Super Bowl, the venue is set in advance, meaning the field is typically neutral. Because the Washington Spirit are playing in front of a hometown crowd, tickets sold out quickly on primary marketplace Ticketmaster, although resale tickets are still available.

At a Glance: How to Watch Washington Spirit vs. Kansas City Current

When: Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026, 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET

TV Channel: CBS

Stream Online: DirecTV, Paramount+, YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV

Kansas beat Angel City and the top-seeded Gotham FC to reach the championship, while D.C. beat the Portland Thorns and Utah Royals to earn their spot. NWSL playoffs are seeded by standings, and the league is not split into Eastern and Western conferences.

The Spirit’s Trinity Rodman has been a top-five scorer across the league during the regular season, notching 14 goals. The Current’s Croix Bethune, meanwhile, led the league in assists during the regular season.

Where to Stream the NWSL Championship Game

If you’re watching from home, the game will air in a primetime slot on CBS. Kick-off is at 8 p.m. ET, 5 p.m. PT on Saturday. You can stream CBS with a live-TV service that carries it, such as DirecTV or Fubo, which both offer free trials. The game will also be available to stream on Paramount+ with the Premium plan. Paramount+ does not offer a free trial.

Here’s what to know about each option.

DirecTV CBS is included in a number of DirecTV packages, including the Entertainment plan and above, plus the MySports Genre pack. A five-day free trial is available to new subscribers once you remove the optional Gemini Air device from your plan. DirecTV also offers other channels that regular season NWSL games air on, such as ESPN.

Paramount + Paramount+ carries the NWSL final for subscribers on the Premium plan. During Black Friday, the Paramount+ Premium plan is available for $2.99/mo. for the first two months, before returning to the regular price of $13.99/mo. While it doesn’t have a free trial, it’s a more affordable option for streaming the NWSL championship.

YouTube TV YouTube TV offers a variable free trial that typically starts at five days, making it a solid option for catching sports events. The Sports + News plan starts at $49.99/mo. for the first six months and is $71.99/mo. thereafter. The full YouTube TV plan starts at $59.99/mo. for the first two months and is $82.99/mo. after that. Both packages include CBS, as well as other local channels like NBC, FOX, and ABC.

Hulu + Live TV Hulu + Live TV is available with a three-day free trial, and it includes Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN Select. The service is available with either the ad-supported or ad-free versions of Disney+ and Hulu. Hulu + Live TV includes CBS, getting you live access to the game. You also get other channels that carry regular season games, including ESPN and ESPN2.

1yd1poe.title: Jeff Goldblum Reflects on Career in Cinema at Marrakech Film Festival
1yd1poe.content:
Jeff Goldblum was honored with a tribute award at the Marrakech Film Festival on Saturday, delighting the audience with a surprise piano performance before reflecting on more than half a century in cinema, giving a heartfelt speech in which he thanked his many on-screen collaborators and insisted that “the stories that we tell matter.”

The Hollywood legend was introduced by actress Tilda Swinton, who praised her “Grand Budapest Hotel” co-star as a “unicorn” and an “incomparable presence in cinema.”

After a tribute video showcased iconic Goldblum performances across his career, including roles in “Invasion of the Body Snatchers,” “The Fly,” “Jurassic Park” and “Independence Day,” the curtain rose to reveal the actor — an accomplished pianist and jazz musician — seated behind a grand piano, from which he performed a medley of songs before a rapt crowd.

Accepting the award after a lengthy standing ovation, Goldblum thanked the many screenwriters, directors and actors who showed faith in him through the years and insisted that moviemaking remains as vital an art form as ever.

“I believe that the stories that we tell matter,” the actor said. “At their best, films let us sit in the dark beside strangers and see the world through somebody else’s eyes. They remind us that we lucky creatures have an unfathomable measure of commonality, and they put to shame all those petty things which seem to divide us.

“Movies also help us imagine something better — a world that works for everyone,” he continued. “That’s a planet toward which I want to keep working for as long as I have breath in my body, and with every story that I might still have the privilege to tell.”

As well as Saturday’s honors, the Marrakech Film Festival is screening four films from the actor’s decades-spanning career: Lawrence Kasdan’s ’80s ensemble comedy-drama “The Big Chill,” David Cronenberg’s classic body horror “The Fly,” Roland Emmerich’s alien-invasion blockbuster “Independence Day” and Steven Spielberg’s “Jurassic Park,” the first installment in the dinosaur franchise juggernaut.

The Marrakech Film Festival kicked off Friday night with a star-studded gala screening of Jesse Eisenberg’s “The Debut,” starring Oscar frontrunner Julianne Moore. Goldblum, who hammed it up on the red carpet outside the Palais des Congrés alongside wife Emilie Goldblum, spent several minutes working the crowd, at one point stopping to autograph a hand-drawn portrait of the actor that was presented to him by a boisterous fan.

Among the other celebrities in attendance were Swinton and Oscar winner and jury president Marion Cotillard, who heads a jury that includes “Sex Education” star Emma Mackey, “Phantom Thread” actress Vicky Krieps, “All of Us Strangers” filmmaker Andrew Haigh and “The Voice of Hind Rajab” director Kaouther Ben Hania.

Also being honored with a tribute award this week are Moroccan actor Younès Mégri and American screen star John Turturro, whose most recent film, “The Only Living Pickpocket in New York,” will screen at the festival. He and Goldblum will both take part in the festival’s Conversation series, along with “Knives Out” director Rian Johnson, “Call Me by Your Name” Oscar nominee Luca Guadagnino, “Fjord” Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, Italian screen icon Monica Bellucci and more.

The Marrakech Film Festival runs Nov. 20-28.

12izgoj.title: Генсек НАТО пообещал защиту Польши после падения трех российских объектов на ее территории
12izgoj.content:
НАТО будет защищать "каждый дюйм польской территории". Такую позицию озвучил генеральный секретарь альянса Марк Рютте в ходе визита в Варшаву в субботу, 21 нобря, на следующий день после того, как Польша заявила о падении на территории страны трех российских летательных объектов.

По словам Рютте, НАТО установит все обстоятельства инцидента, который он назвал "явно опасным", и оценит возможные уязвимости. Верховный главнокомандующий Объединенными вооруженными силами НАТО в Европе, американский военачальник Алексус Гринкевич "постоянно оценивает наши силы сдерживания и обороны" и сделает все необходимое для выявления угроз и внесения корректировок в случае необходимости, сказал глава НАТО.

В Брюсселе пройдет заседание Североатлантического совета НАТО

Вторжение летательных объектов - предположительно, двух ракет и реактивного беспилотника - произошло в то время, когда Польша проводила военные учения с участием "коалиции желающих". Польские официальные лица охарактеризовали совпадение как неслучайное.

В Брюсселе 23 ноября состоится заседание Североатлантического совета НАТО, на котором будет обсуждаться вопрос о нарушении воздушного пространства Польши, сообщило агентство PAP.

Падение трех российских объектов в Польше

В ночь на 20 ноября в Польше зафиксировали падение обломков неизвестных объектов в трех локациях. В населенном пункте Новы-Липовец, расположенном примерно в 60 км от польско-украинской границы, обнаружили обломки крылатой ракеты X-101. Еще один летательный объект упал вблизи населенного пункта Рудник-над-Саном. Министр обороны Польши Владислав Косиняк-Камыш заявил, что, скорее всего, это также была крылатая ракета. В деревне Молодич в 37 км от границы с Украиной, вероятно, упал беспилотник.

В конце июля летательный объект уже проникал в воздушное пространство Польши и упал вблизи населенного пункта Тарнава-Колоня. Пострадавших тогда тоже не было. По данным польского правительства, это была российская крылатая ракета X-101.

1rwtf6h.title: К большому сожалению, "Одиссея" Кристофера Нолана не получит расширенную версию - зрители не увидят вырезанные сцены
1rwtf6h.content:
Поклонникам творчества Кристофера Нолана, надеявшимся на выход расширенной версии «Одиссеи», придётся смириться с театральным монтажом картины. Оскароносный постановщик официально исключил возможность выпуска режиссёрской версии своего масштабного исторического эпоса, несмотря на наличие вырезанных сцен.
В интервью изданию The Independent, приуроченном к выходу фильма на домашних носителях, Нолан признался, что существует немало исключённых из картины сцен, которые зрители никогда не увидят.
Я не очень верю в режиссёрские версии,
— заявил постановщик.
По словам Нолана, он предпочитает отстаивать именно ту версию фильма, которая выходит в кинотеатрах. Будучи одновременно сценаристом и режиссёром, он старается избавляться от лишнего материала ещё на этапе написания сценария, благодаря чему относительно небольшое количество отснятых сцен впоследствии оказывается за пределами окончательного монтажа.
Режиссёр объяснил, что в случае столь масштабного и сложного проекта, как «Одиссея», он предпочитает не тратить целый съёмочный день на вершине горы, под дождём или на борту корабля ради сцены, которая в конечном итоге не попадёт в фильм.
Нолан также подчеркнул, что считает своей профессиональной обязанностью отстаивать собственное видение картины и её монтаж вплоть до выхода в кинотеатрах. Именно этого принципа он придерживался на протяжении всей своей карьеры.
Напомним, что «Одиссея» стала самым кассовым фильмом в карьере Кристофера Нолана, собрав более 1,8 миллиарда долларов в мировом прокате. Продолжительность картины составляет почти три часа, однако даже столь впечатляющий хронометраж не мешает поклонникам надеяться на появление дополнительных сцен.
Цифровой релиз «Одиссеи» состоялся 18 ноября. Судя по категоричной позиции постановщика, именно театральная версия фильма останется единственной и окончательной.

gh-1441934743.title: GitHub - Lucas-blip-png/dkb-pc-recomp: Static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) to native Windows and Linux with Vulkan. 0.5.1 out: NVIDIA shader cache fix, player 2 rumble; one-file Windows launcher, presets, local co-op, 16:10, Thai. Requirements: docs/requirements.md. Roadmap: #10. No game files included.
gh-1441934743.content:
DKB Recomp is a static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Nintendo Switch 2, 2025) into a native Windows x86-64 application with a Vulkan renderer. There is no emulator at run time: the game's ARM64 code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled into one executable, and its graphics calls are answered by a host implementation of NVN 2. It is built on TotK Recomp, which does the same for Tears of the Kingdom on the original Switch. As far as we know, no other static recompilation of a Switch 2 game is public. ImportantNo game files are included, and none ever will be. You need your own copy of Donkey Kong Bananza, dumped from your own console. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided. The game itself is never downloadable: the release carries the installer, and everyone builds the game from their own dump. Status Playable on recent NVIDIA cards, well past the first level. Players report runs through layer -101, sublayer 200, the Glacier layer, Snow World (Layer 500), the Resort and the Tempest layer. The current release is 0.5.1 (20 November), a fix for 0.5.0's NVIDIA shader cache on Windows (#437). The latest release carries DKB-Launcher.exe, one small Windows file that installs the build tools, builds the game from your own dump (.nup, .nx or folders) and updates in place with one click. It also has the setup zip, a Linux AppImage and tarball, and a macOS preview: docs/installer.md. New in 0.5.0: Performance presets (preset = 1..5 or recommended, F1 menu "Preset") and expected frame rates per hardware tier: docs/requirements.md. dlss_mode picks the DLSS and FSR quality mode by name. The setup can fetch NVIDIA's DLSS DLL or AMD's FSR 4 after you accept their licenses. Local co-op with a second gamepad as Pauline (#240), Thai on 3.2.0 (#180), and 16:10 screens (#249). Prompts follow your button swaps (#416, #440), and a start-up screen shows progress (#430). Entering a level stalls about half as long on Windows with NVIDIA (#442). 4 to 7 thread CPUs stall less: draws cost about 14% less to record, and level transitions no longer starve the replay. replay_threads is on by default on every discrete AMD card on the proprietary driver. Crash fixes: a 1.0.0 banana pickup crash (#428), a layer-change crash (#443, #204), and EmeraldRush with realtime = 1 (#411). Setup and launcher work: RomFS in place (#305), the packed shader cache, Uninstall, --set, --play, and every cache kept inside the install folder (#402). The full list, with credits, is in the release notes. What still fails: GPU hangs under RADV on Linux (#99, #122, #198, #204), and a driver fault on Intel Arc (#3). Black shards where salt, acid or muck meets slime (#139, #266, #387, #439). Guest crashes without a reproduction here (#126, #148), and a device loss on an RTX 5080 at B1000 (#336). Hitches in the Resort and Tempest layers on 4 GB cards (#437; preset = 1 or astc_bc = 1). Heavy scenes stay around 40 to 45 fps on CPUs with 4 to 6 threads (docs/dkb-lowend.md). Text is soft above 1080p unless scene_res = full (#214). Earlier releases: 0.4.0 fixed the Snow World and Glacier device loss on NVIDIA and the AMD Windows device loss. 0.4.1 added the FSR 3.1 and FSR 4 upscalers, frame generation, CRT and window filters, and Polish. 0.4.2 cut stalls in heavy scenes, on first runs and on CPUs with few threads. RecompLauncher on Linux and macOS: docs/recomp-launcher.md. Progress, day by day: docs/devlog.md. Last updated: 20 November 2026. Phase State F0 CPU ✅ main and sdk (180,061 functions) lift with no unsupported instruction (ARMv8.3 pointer authentication and LDAPR added). Differential tests against Unicorn pass. F1 OS ✅ Boots on TotK Recomp's Horizon host with the Switch 2 differences: RomFS, save, audio, controller. F2 NVN 2 ✅ 700 NVN 2 entry points answered; the game loop runs. 51 new command buffer calls (mesh shaders, VRS, DLSS, push constants…) are accepted but not recorded yet. F3 Shaders ✅ All 4,820 Ampere shader stages of the first 3D scene go through Eglantine's Ampere-to-Maxwell lowering and TotK Recomp's translator to SPIR-V. F4 Vulkan ✅ The title screen and the tutorial's 3D scene render. F5 Playable ✅ Controller, guide movies (VP9), push constants, installer and releases 0.1.0 to 0.4.0. F6 Stability 🚧 Device lost on NVIDIA and AMD, RADV hangs and guest crashes in later areas. F7 Performance 🚧 A heavy scene runs at about 58 fps on bananza, with a stall of about 0.45 s on area loads. F8 Image 🚧 Missing effects, some textures and terrain details. F9 Platforms 🚧 Linux and macOS preview packages, RecompLauncher, audio and DLC. The plan, phase by phase: docs/bananza-plan.md. What is open right now: Roadmap to playable. How it works flowchart LR subgraph offline["At build time, on your PC"] exefs["Your dump: main + sdk
(ARM64)"] --> lifter["Lifter
recomp/"] --> c["C code"] --> clang["Clang"] --> exe["dkb.exe"] end subgraph runtime["At run time"] exe --> host["Horizon host
threads, files, audio, input"] exe --> nvn["NVN 2 front end
runtime/nvn_*"] --> vk["Vulkan back end"] sass["Ampere shaders"] --> lower["Eglantine lowering
Ampere → Maxwell"] --> xlate["Translator
tools/xlate"] --> spirv["SPIR-V"] --> vk end Loading The longer version is in docs/architecture.md (shared with TotK Recomp) and docs/bananza-shaders.md (the NVN 2 shader work). How to help Each open problem is a separate, well-bounded job with its own issue. Pick one, say in the issue that you are on it, and keep each pull request to one topic. Issues labelled in progress are already taken, and the top of the roadmap says what is being worked on right now. No code needed, only your PC and your own copy of the game: #3 Test on your GPU. Everything so far was checked on one NVIDIA card. Runs on AMD, Intel and other NVIDIA cards, with logs, show what breaks there. Play as far as you can and report where it stops, with the crash form. #9 The GPU fault after the first guide movie: seen on three NVIDIA drivers (617.14, 617.42, 621.01); runs on AMD and Intel would show whether it is NVIDIA's. Code (help wanted): #5 Checkerboard textures on some rock surfaces. The Switch 2 GOB layout (f4f7b17) fixes the gold rock in the tutorial cave; the other surfaces still need a check. #6 NVN 2 calls not recorded yet: mesh shaders, VRS, DLSS and others. Symbols. Function names help debugging. They come from GRAnimated/DKBananza, which welcomes contributions too. Your first contribution, step by step: Build from your own dump (Building from source). Run it as in docs/dkb-testing.md and note how far it gets on your machine. Report it on #3 or #7, or pick an issue above. Before you open a pull request, read CONTRIBUTING.md. Its hard rule: nothing that came out of the game goes into the repository, not in commits, issues or pull requests. Run python tools/check_content.py --staged before committing; CI runs the same check. Questions go to Discussions. Everyone taking part follows the code of conduct. Support the project If you want to support the work without writing code, tips go to ko-fi.com/lucasblippng. A tip pays for time on the project; it buys no game files, builds or early access, and everything stays open source here. Starring the repository and sharing it with people who know GPUs, ARM64 or the Switch also helps. Building from source The toolchain is TotK Recomp's (docs/building.md): MSYS2 UCRT64 Clang, Ninja, Python 3.12 and the .NET SDK for the shader translator. With the Bananza ExeFS and RomFS from your own dump: .venv\Scripts\python tools\build_xlate.py .venv\Scripts\python recomp\gen.py --exefs --out generated\dkb100 --modules main,sdk --patches recomp\patches-dkb100.txt .venv\Scripts\python tools\dkb_expected.py --exefs --name dkb100 --display 1.0.0 .venv\Scripts\python tools\dkb_pack_romfs.py --dir --out build\extracted\dkb100\romfs .venv\Scripts\python tools\build_game.py --version dkb100 --expected tools\data\expected-dkb100.json --exefs --romfs build\extracted\dkb100\romfs Everything the build writes stays under build\ and generated\, which git ignores. The game commits about 14 GB (13.5 GiB at the start and 13.75 GiB after 40 minutes, rising about 6 MB per minute; longer sessions are untested), so 16 GB of RAM plus a large page file is the minimum for now and 32 GB is comfortable. System requirements and measured frame rates: docs/requirements.md. Running and testing: docs/dkb-testing.md. FAQ Can I play it? Partly. One hand-played run went from the title screen through the tutorial, its cutscene and the first stage to its end on an RTX 5060 Ti, with drops while a new area loads; other cards are untested and it can still crash. Follow the roadmap or the devlog. Is there a download? Of the installer, on the release page. The executable is made from the game's own code, so it cannot be shared. Everyone builds it from their own dump; the installer does this for you (docs/installer.md). How do I install and update on Windows? From the first release that carries it, download DKB-Launcher.exe once, put it in a folder of its own and start it. It downloads the build tools (checked by SHA-256) into DKB-Recomp beside itself, asks for your dump and the install folder, and builds the game. After that it opens on Play, looks for a new release at each start, shows what is new and updates with one click: the new tools are downloaded and checked, the old version stays until the new one has started, and only the steps whose inputs changed run again; saves (profile/) and dkb.ini are kept. A tick box on that screen (or DKB_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1) turns the check off; the only request is to GitHub's release API. The setup zip keeps working as before (docs/installer.md, "Launcher and updates"). Which version of the game? Base 1.0.0 and update 3.2.0 (title version 458752, the newest). The installer takes either a .nup file (the container Eglantine and Eden load; with the 3.2.0 update inside it builds 3.2.0) or ExeFS and RomFS folders. Other updates are refused by their hashes. The 3.2.0 build installs and boots, and holds 60 fps for 150 s at the start on an RTX 5060 Ti, but nobody has played it yet. Add-on content (DLC) has a reader (an aoc- folder beside the executable, docs/dkb-testing.md) checked against synthetic packs and a real one, but it has not been tried in the game. Linux? Preview. The release page carries DKB-Setup--linux-x86_64.tar.gz: the sources and a setup script, not a binary. You install the system packages and it builds the game from your dump. The build from source is verified on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs (docs/installer.md, "Bananza Linux and macOS packages"). macOS? Preview. DKB-Setup--macos-arm64.zip is the same kind of package. It builds and boots on Apple Silicon with MoltenVK: the game reaches the mode select (docs/building.md, "macOS"). It is not verified beyond that, and the destructible terrain is missing until the geometry stages have a vertex-stage replacement. Why GPL? The shader lowering comes from Eglantine (Eden Emulator Project), which is GPL. Files that came from TotK Recomp keep their MIT terms. How is AI used? Most of the code and documentation is written by AI coding agents (Claude Code), as in TotK Recomp, and checked by running the game and the differential tests. AI-assisted pull requests are welcome; you are responsible for having read and run them. Credits and origin DKB Recomp is built on TotK Recomp (Tears of the Kingdom, Switch 1) by valentderah and its contributors (MIT, kept in LICENSE-MIT). It uses Eglantine's Ampere shader lowering (GPL-3.0-or-later, runtime/third_party/eglantine/) and Ryujinx's shader translator (MIT, vendored with MacNativeGames' patches), plus the other projects in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The whole is under LICENSE. TotK Recomp by valentderah, the base of everything here, and the projects it builds on: LAS Recomp, MacNativeGames, nxnative, SavageWindRecomp, Ryujinx, deko3d, hactool and the rest listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. GRAnimated/DKBananza for the game's symbols and research. Eglantine (Eden Emulator Project) for the Ampere-to-Maxwell shader lowering and its Switch 2 notes, and Mesa NAK for the SM70+ encodings both build on. libvpx for the movies. Switchbrew for the Switch 2 GetInfo ids, and the Switch homebrew community. License DKB Recomp as a whole is under the GNU GPL v3 or later, because it includes Eglantine's GPL Ampere shader lowering (runtime/third_party/eglantine/). The files that came from TotK Recomp keep their MIT License; third-party code keeps its own license (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The license grants nothing for Nintendo's game. DKB Recomp is an independent, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. Donkey Kong Bananza and Nintendo Switch 2 are trademarks of Nintendo.

gh-1396842451.title: GitHub - ChupathingyCE/chupathingyce: Halo CE: Ported for Everyone. Windows, Mac, Linux, Steam Deck, Android and FreeBSD, with online play and stats. Bring your own copy of the game.
gh-1396842451.content:
Chupathingy
Halo CE: Ported for Everyone.

In testing

Community ports

Download ·
chupathingy.org ·
Games online now ·
Discord

Play Halo: Combat Evolved on your PC, Mac, Steam Deck or phone. Campaign, split screen, System Link, and online games with players on every platform.
It plays like the Xbox game. Everything extra is a setting.
You need your own copy of the game. Chupathingy never includes or downloads Microsoft's files.
New: Halo MCC maps
Own Halo: The Master Chief Collection on Steam? Its Halo CE Workshop maps now play in Chupathingy, on Windows, Mac and Linux.

Browse the Workshop in the Delta Guide, with each item's picture and page.
Link Steam once by scanning a QR code with the Steam app. The game never sees your Steam password.
Maps download straight from Steam, with no Steam client needed. Once they're in, they play offline or online.
MCC maps show in every map screen, with search, next to your Xbox and PC maps.
Host and join MCC games, on your own machine or a dedicated server.

How it works, and what you need: docs/mcc.md.

Get it
Download the latest release from the Releases page.

System
Download

Windows 10 or later
chupathingyce-windows64-release.zip

Mac, Apple silicon or Intel
chupathingyce-macos-release.zip

Linux
chupathingyce-linux64-release.AppImage

SteamOS
chupathingyce-linux64-release.AppImage

Android 9 or later, 64-bit
chupathingyce-android64-release.zip

FreeBSD
chupathingyce-freebsd64-release.zip

Step-by-step setup for each system, including the Steam Deck, is in docs/install.md. Older 32-bit PCs and the Linux zip are there too.
The game checks for updates when it starts and asks before installing one. It only installs updates we've signed. On a Mac, it opens the download page instead.
First start on Windows. If Windows warns about an unknown publisher, choose More info, then Run anyway.
First start on a Mac. Move ChupathingyCE to Applications and open it. If macOS won't open it, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. You only do this once.
Set it up

Start Chupathingy.
Pick your Halo: Combat Evolved disc image (.iso or .xiso) from the original Xbox. Any region works.
Wait while it copies the maps (about 2 GB). Then you're in.

Have Halo PC or Custom Edition? The same screen takes the Halo PC disc and the Custom Edition installer too. See docs/maps.md.
On Android, copy the disc image to your phone first.
Where your maps, settings and saves go: docs/install.md.

Join a game. Open Multiplayer > Online Games, pick a game and press A. Or press Join on stats.chupathingy.org.
Host a game. In Online Games, press Y to create one. Everyone can see it on the list.
Invite a friend. Send them your game's invite link.
Play the campaign together. Host it online from Create Game. Here's how.

Chupathingy players on every platform play together. They also play with players on other Halo CE builds when the versions match.
Friends can't get into your game? See docs/online.md.

Features
Playing together

An Online Games list in the Multiplayer menu
Our servers around the clock, plus the community's
Split screen for up to four, and System Link with no internet or account
Online co-op through the campaign
Friends, parties and clans in the Delta Guide (F3), with party links you can paste in Discord
Text and voice chat, and host tools to kick or ban

Maps

Every Xbox map from your disc
Halo PC, Custom Edition, HaloMD and MCC Workshop maps, side by side with the Xbox ones
Missing maps download when you join, and each one is checked before it's used
Community Xbox map packs, like Halo CE+
Stubbs the Zombie, an early work in progress, from your own Xbox maps (off by default)

Your stats

A carnage report with medals for every finished game
Service records and leaderboards on stats.chupathingy.org
Your Delta profile, right in the game

How it looks and feels

The Xbox menus, with Halo PC's settings added
High-res HUD and text, and widescreen
Controller layouts, Bumper Jumper included, with button prompts for Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo pads
5.1 and 7.1 surround, and a headphone 3D mode
The intro and cutscene movies from your disc

Every setting, and the config.toml file behind them: docs/settings.md. What each platform has: docs/builds.md.
Consoles
Chupathingy also runs as homebrew on consoles, in the same online games as everyone else. Most are test builds for now.

Console
Get it

Original Xbox
warthog-xbox, test builds

Xbox 360
warthog-360, test builds

Wii U
warthog-wiiu, test builds

Nintendo Switch
warthog-switch, by thelinkin3000

PlayStation 3
warthog-ps3, by Mayo1970. Work in progress, no release yet.

Other developers have ported it to the PSP, PS Vita, PS4, PS5, Xbox Series (UWP), the Steam Link, and the iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. They play in the same games.

Run a server
The dedicated server runs a playlist of games around the clock. It runs on Linux (x86, x64 or arm64, Raspberry Pi too), on 64-bit Windows, or in Docker, and needs no port forwarding. It can host MCC Workshop maps too. Start with server/README.md.
Builds
Releases are the stable builds, and the game updates itself from them. Want the newest changes early? Pick an update channel in Settings > Network Setup > Updates, or on the setup screen's Updates tab:

Release (the default) gets releases only.
Testing gets test builds first, and may have bugs.
Nightly gets a build of main every night, and the test builds too.

Testing and Nightly still get each release. You can switch back to Release anytime. The game never installs an older build, so after a test build you stay on it until the next release comes out. More in docs/install.md.
Help
Ask on the Discord. It's also where people find games and report bugs. You can file bugs in issues too.
Fixes for common problems, and how to send your logs, are in docs/help.md.
Build it yourself
You need Python 3, ninja and clang. You don't need the Xbox SDK.
python3 configure.py
ninja
Every target and option is in docs/building.md.
Generative AI
The decompilation this project is built on, and the port it began as a fork of, were made with heavy use of generative AI. Chupathingy has its own code and releases now, but a lot of that earlier work is still in it.
We use AI tools the way developers use any other tool. A person decides what to build, reviews every change, tests it, and is responsible for it. Nothing is handed to an AI to build from start to finish without a person involved. We're also working through the code we inherited to clean up what reads as machine-written: comments that only repeat the code, unclear names, and changes nobody can explain.
If you contribute, the same applies to you: see CONTRIBUTING.
License
Chupathingy is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. It comes with no warranty. Releases up to 0.7.5d stay under CC0. The details, and the permission for console SDKs, are in docs/license.md.
The license covers Chupathingy's code only. It gives no rights in Halo or anything else Microsoft owns.
Support
Chupathingy is free and always will be. Support through
Ko-fi or Patreon
goes to running the site and the servers. If there's a specific developer or
port you'd like to support, ask them: they may not be part of our community.
Credits

Chupathingy: Milenko and contributors.

Contributors
Fixes from other people's pull requests and forks, taken into Chupathingy
with their authors credited in each commit.

Tyberious: Xbox ADPCM decoding
without the 344 Hz buzz, vertex constant serials that never wrap, pose
snapping for frame interpolation, and the clip-space position kept on the
desktop (no more first-person vertex spikes).
thelinkin3000: the motion sensor for
three and four local players (a split screen crash), and split screen
dividers where the views meet on a wide screen.
xshxdex98 (DamnationCE):
the pause menu's QUIT by mouse or keyboard, and lens flares out of view no
longer tested.
zimm3rmann: visibility test slot 0 kept
apart from the scratch query (lens flares sharing a result).
nsafran1217: no hang
where the visibility results buffer cannot be mapped.
saulob: the first menu frame's colors.
natsu-anon: the cursor hidden during play.
lantos1618: no ghosting in the zoom effect
at high resolutions; on macOS, Command-W does not quit and Command-Q asks
twice.
pfista: projectile trails
ready before a weapon's first shot.
JoshRob297: hosts that run their own games
(the dedicated servers) no longer refuse every join after one arrived as a
game ended.
HiIAmMoot (Mootjuh): the Android menus by
touch, and starting a multiplayer game alone (game.start_with_one_player,
first debug.solo_game), now on by default.
oatkrs: crisp windowed rendering and no
audio cut-outs on macOS, and a corrupted script thread dropped instead of
halting the game.
Renkoto: the FreeBSD port (port/unix,

JizzyRivers: the iOS port (port/ios),
Custom Edition maps and the Map Browser on the original Xbox, and the
consoles' start-up screens and updates.
startupfoundry and
pastudan (OpenH1): camera shake, particle
streams, change colors and camo smoothed between ticks, a faster audio
resampler and limiter, a lighter scope zoom at high resolutions, and a
map's first frame drawn through every shader, which lists the stock maps'
shaders and makes bgfx's pipelines before play.
goatbutt and the OpenH1 team: the high-res text drawn from distance
fields (sharp at any size), the fixed benchmark, the variable refresh
cap and the camouflaged weapon fix.
hkmodd (OpenCE): HDR (display.hdr): the
OpenGL half-float path and the tone mapping curves, from his OpenCE pull
request 280 as it stood before OpenCE's license change. The glows past
white and the brightness in nits follow goatbutt's and the OpenH1 team's
HDR.
chestahh (GulchCE): lens flares and light
glows back on AMD graphics, less stutter the first time a texture is drawn
on Windows, host cheat and shadow setup fixes, and the Halo MCC map
loader: MCC Workshop and MCC install maps, their scripts, HUDs, effects
and campaigns.
PeterRichardsonGolf and the other GulchCE contributors: the Steam
Workshop catalog with its items' titles and collections, and the MCC
sharing rules.
mOTA-lEV (OpenCE-Faber):
projectiles and damage that forget objects deleted under them.
bitmoda (mastercheese's OpenCE fork): the
clock read only when something needs it.
theLlamaNet: the Android on-screen touch
controls, through JoshRob297's halo-ce-touch.
Guven (GuvenHuso) and hispanorum (OpenCE): the debug camera flown by
mouse and keyboard, and its saved spot kept for the player in view
(written from a description of their work).

Fonts: Cyborg Interface Gothic, the font of the game's text and of our
own screens, by fizzy, made to match Halo's interface font from Overpass
and glyphs of their own (SIL OFL); the menus' titles in Chupathingy

Halo's titles do (SIL OFL);
Overpass (SIL OFL);
Noto Sans (SIL OFL), for the letters
Cyborg lacks, and
Kenney's Input Prompts (CC0); the
scoreboard's platform logos are one-color marks from
Simple Icons (CC0) and Wikimedia Commons (public
domain), plus our own Xbox 360 ring and Wii U GamePad; the names and logos
are their owners' trademarks, used only to identify platforms. The same
marks make the platform badges at the top of this page. BSD Daemon used with permission.
The service record is our own (on the site since September, and in the
Delta Guide's SERVICE RECORD). The Guide's local career totals and top
medals (port/linux/src/service_record.c) follow the career record in
mOTA-lEV's OpenCE-Faber,
used under GPL-3.0 with his permission.

Where it came from
Chupathingy is a port of the Halo: Combat Evolved decompilation (punpckhdq/halo and bnunu/halo-1). It began as a fork of OpenCE, an earlier port of that decompilation (the code is theirs up to October 9, 2026), and has had its own code, releases and community since.

The decompilation: punpckhdq/halo and
bnunu/halo-1, of the Xbox build 2342.
The port Chupathingy began as a fork of: OpenCE and its contributors, up to
October 9, 2026.
Later fixes taken from OpenCE (CC0), with their authors kept in the
history: startupfoundry, xshxdex98, hkmodd, eltanschauung, justinfilip,
bertoaldo, addisonbair, thelinkin3000, bmanturner, chestahh, FDervish,
frankyfife, actes2, crowtrx and MrBruh (by their GitHub handles). The
wire format tool (tools/network_format.py) is addisonbair's and MrBruh's.

findings from the custom-edition-maps branch, credited in the commits they
led to, and the larger texture cache for Halo PC maps, which that branch had
first.

Edition loader, from DamnationCE's work by
xshxdex98): maps that need OpenSauce refused
with a clear reason, the missing-map message when joining, and the
custom_maps\<name> naming our hosts and clients share with OpenCE.

Chupathingy is an unofficial fan project. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios, Bungie or Halo Studios. Halo is a trademark of Microsoft. No game files are included: you bring your own copy. The code is released under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later (see License).

3mqy8d.title: Современный McLaren в обличье легенды гонок — подробности об уникальном проекте
3mqy8d.content: Дебют необычного суперкара Game Over состоялся на выставке SEMA 2026 в Лас-Вегасе. По сути, перед публикой предстал McLaren 750S, которому полностью перекроили внешность под современную версию гоночного Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR. Интерес к машине проявил рэпер 2 Chainz.McLaren 750S Game OverРаботала над проектом американская компания S Klub LA вместе с автолюбителем Slang500. Серийный 750S взяли за базу, однако кузов переделали почти целиком: машина обрела узнаваемые черты CLK GTR – модели, которая гремела в чемпионате FIA GT в конце 1990-х годов.McLaren 750S Game OverЦвет – красно-белый. Спереди появились четыре круглые фары, массивный сплиттер и расширенные колесные арки; на крыше – воздухозаборник, сзади – крупное фиксированное антикрыло. Дополняют образ белые диски HRE и покрышки Toyo.Что осталось от McLaren и каким вышел салонКое-что от исходной машины уцелело. Поднимающиеся двери, фирменная примета McLaren, остались на месте – как и современная передняя панель с цифровыми дисплеями и центральным экраном мультимедийной системы.А вот салон переработали целиком. Красная и белая кожа с ромбовидной прострочкой, контрастные вставки, декоративные элементы из углепластика – от заводского интерьера здесь мало что осталось.McLaren 750S Game OverТехника – от 750S. Это 4,0-литровый бензиновый V8 с двумя турбинами, 740 л.с. и 800 Нм крутящего момента. В стандартном исполнении модель разгоняется до 100 км/ч за 2,8 секунды и достигает 331 км/ч. Впрочем, сохранились ли заводские характеристики после переделки, создатели Game Over не уточнили.История CLK GTR и дальнейшая судьба проектаОригинальный Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR создавали для гонок класса GT1. В 1997 году автомобиль помог немецкой марке взять чемпионские титулы в зачете пилотов и команд. Для омологации выпустили дорожную версию с атмосферным 6,9-литровым V12 мощностью около 604 л.с. Всего собрали 26 дорожных экземпляров – 20 купе и шесть родстеров.Рэпер 2 Chainz на SEMA познакомился с проектом лично. А вот стоимость переделки и планы на дальнейшую судьбу единственного экземпляра Game Over пока не раскрываются.О том, как дизайн превращает автомобиль в легенду, «За рулем» уже рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в MAX

1defyua.title: Broadway’s Cure For The Post-Holiday Blues? Stars, Stars & More Stars, Coming This Winter
1defyua.content:
With Thanksgiving almost here, it’s not too early for Broadway to start thinking about…March?

In case you’ve noticed a lot of big, starry announcements in recent weeks for shows that will open this spring – and not just spring proper like the Tony-heavy month of April, but the chillier weeks just after the December holidays but before the Easter thaw.

Why announce now? The better to entice potential ticket-buyers into surprising their beloveds with gift-wrapped tickets (or printed payment confirmations) to see Julia Roberts, Paul Rudd and Sarah Paulson this early March, or Steve Carell and John C. Reilly a week or two later. Merry Christmas, Happy Hanukkah and Happy Easter all rolled into one.

Broadway’s upcoming winter season comes as a very star-packed fall is raking up strong weekly grosses. Last week, the critically-blessed Much Ado About Nothing starring Tom Hiddleston and Hayley Atwell grossed a whopping $2,352,287, while Crystal’s 860 broke the house record for a play at the Imperial Theatre with a big $1,720,253. Other Desert Cities, starring Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris, Allison Janney, Joe Keery and Lily Rabe, grossed $2,570,589, a common enough occurrence for that show to place it week after week alongside such a $2M+ stalwart as Hamilton.

But Broadway won’t be resting on its pine-scented laurels for long: A week after the holidays, Manhattan Theatre Club’s Awake and Sing! revival starring West Wing‘s Richard Schiff, Jessica Hecht, Will Pullen, Danny Burstein and others opens January 7 (previews start December 15), and in short order the much anticipated Dolly: A True Original Musical (St. James Theatre) opens January 19 (previews start December 7) and Mix and Master, the Dominique Morisseau play starring Ruben Santiago-Hudson and Kara Young, begins previews January 5 at the Todd Haimes Theatre ahead of an opening night on January 27, 2027.

The March openings begin with Three Days of Rain, the Broadway revival of Richard Greenberg’s Pulitizer-finalist play with a big-name cast of François Arnaud, David Corenswet and Yvonne Strahovski. Performances begin Saturday, January 30, 2027, at the Longacre Theatre, with a March 1 opening night. It’s a 16-week engagement.

The Amish Project starring Jonathan Groff is a one-person play written Jessica Dickey, directed by Sarna Lapine, about an Amish community coming together in the wake of tragedy. Previews begin at the Broadhurst Theatre on February 10 ahead of an early March opening.

The starry month continues with Small Mouth Sounds, and, at least in terms of celebrity names, is the winter show to beat: Julia Roberts, Paul Rudd and Sarah Paulson lead the cast of Bess Wohl’s play that also includes Martin Freeman, Greta Lee and Isaac Powell. Joe Mantello directs, with Scott Rudin and Barry Diller producing. Previews begin February 10 at the Ethel Barrymore Theater, with an opening on March 11.

Next comes Dirty Dancing The Musical, starring Annalese Starzec and Blake Zelesnikar, both Broadway newcomers, but no matter: The star power of this one is the title itself, a name certain to stir nostalgia for fans of the Jennifer Grey and Patrick Swayze classic film romance. The new stage production based on the 1987 film will arrive on Broadway this winter for a limited seven-month engagement. Performances begin Friday, February 12, 2027, at Broadway’s Lena Horne Theatre with a “gala celebration” on Sunday, March 14.

Birthright, beginning previews February 23 at the Hudson ahead of a March 15 opening, carries the imprimatur of a very successful and acclaimed Off Broadway run last summer, along with the reputation of the playwright – Jonathan Spector – who scored a major Broadway success last year with the Tony-winning Eureka Day. Casting for the play hasn’t been announced, but the Off Broadway production starred such New York stage favorites as Molly Ranson, Nate Mann, Liz Larsen, Eli Gelb, Molly Bernard, Zoë Winters and Hale Appleman.

March’s final weeks will continue the celebrity appeal with The Odd Couple, starring Steve Carell, who will play the persnickety Felix Ungar, and John C. Reilly, as the slob Oscar Madison. Hamilton‘s Thomas Kail directs at the Stephen Sondheim Theatre, with performances for the 15-week engagement beginning March 3, 2027, and an opening on March 23.

And March goes out like a lion with Evita, director Jamie Lloyd’s revival of the Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber musical starring Rachel Zegler reprising her Olivier Award-winning performance as Eva Perón. Previews start February 27 at the Winter Garden – currently the home of Lloyd’s magnificent Much Ado – with an opening night of March 25.

Evita will be the final opening before the spring crunch of Tony-qualifying last minute arrivals goes full swing, and, yes, those shows will have plenty of stars as well – Jessica Chastain, Bryan Cranston, Laura Linney, Neil Patrick Harris and more. Those April openers include Gloria (April 5), Warriors (April 8), Purple Rain (April 12), All My Sons (April 13), The Sound of Music (April 15), Paddington The Musical (April 18), Montauk (April 19), Damn Yankees (April 20), Lost Lear (April 23) and Rhinoceros (April 25).

9qjepf.title: Представлен SSD от Phison на 488 ТБ для космических дата-центров
9qjepf.content:
Компания Phison анонсировала Pascari Space - новую линейку твердотельных накопителей, предназначенных для космических аппаратов, спутников и дата-центров, работающих на орбите. Компания подтверждает, что ее технология хранения данных будет использоваться в орбитальном центре обработки данных, запуск которого запланирован на первую половину 2027 года.

Phison готовит твердотельные накопители для космических дата-центров. В 2027 году на орбиту отправятся накопители емкостью 488 ТБ
Проект называется StarVault-001 (SV-001) и разрабатывается компанией Lonestar Data Holdings. Он будет оснащен 488 ТБ SSD Phison, из которых примерно 370 ТБ будут доступны после развертывания на низкой околоземной орбите. Это совокупная емкость системы, а не одного твердотельного накопителя.
Линейка Pascari Space от Phison включает три категории продуктов: критически важные для полетов, основные системы хранения данных и орбитальные дата-центры. Первые две категории используют интерфейсы PCIe 4.0 и предлагают емкости от 40 ГБ до 4 ТБ. Линейка орбитальных ЦОД (центр обработки данных) поддерживает PCIe 5.0 x4 и включает модели SP-C200 емкостью до 128 ТБ, SP-C250P емкостью до 32 ТБ и SP-C250E емкостью до 25,6 ТБ. В моделях для ЦОД используются форм-факторы E3.S или E3.L.

В отличие от обычных корпоративных SSD, продукты Pascari Space можно адаптировать для конкретных миссий с помощью инженерных услуг IMAGIN+ от Phison. Это включает в себя модификацию встроенного программного обеспечения, радиационные испытания, обработку ошибок и настройку хранения данных. На накопителях также используются технологии коррекции ошибок LDPC, SmartECC и SmartRefresh. Компания Phison заявляет, что при использовании pSLC вместо стандартных конфигураций TLC срок службы накопителей Flight Critical и Main Storage увеличивается в 60 раз.
Диапазон рабочих температур зависит от назначения. Модель Flight Critical SP-F100 поддерживает температуру от - 40 °C до 105 °C, а модель Main Storage SP-M100 от - 40 °C до 85 °C. Модели Orbital Data Center с большей емкостью работают при температуре от 0 °C до 70 °C. Компания Phison также предлагает услуги по определению характеристик и проверке радиационной безопасности для отдельных миссий.

Это не первый опыт Phison в области хранения данных в космосе. Ранее компания поставляла технологии для марсоходов и работала с Lonestar над оборудованием для дата-центров, отправленным на Луну в 2025 году. Pascari Space расширяет эту работу, создавая более крупные орбитальные системы хранения данных. По словам Phison, линейка твердотельных накопителей уже доступна, хотя выход StarVault-001 ожидается не раньше первой половины 2027 года.

1dg18bj.title: Watermelon Expands Production Ambitions As It Seals Partnership With Qatar’s Film Committee
1dg18bj.content:
Watermelon Pictures and the Film Committee at Media City Qatar have announced a planned strategic partnership to develop and co-produce a slate of films telling stories from the Global South.

For Watermelon, the partnership marks a significant expansion into larger-scale, mainstream production.

Badie Ali and Hamza Ali launched their Chicago-based production and distribution company in 2024, with a mission to amplify Palestinian and other under-represented voices.

Until now, the company has focused mainly on distribution, with recent releases including The Voice of Hind Rajab, El Sett, Who Killed Alex Odeh? and American Doctor.

Its cofounders recently signaled to Deadline that they were working on a development slate, without going into detail.

The strategic partnership aims to combine Qatar’s infrastructure and resources as it seeks to grow the film and TV sector at home and regionally, and Watermelon’s access to leading talent, established distribution infrastructure, and understanding of what resonates with audiences.

“When we founded Watermelon Pictures, our vision was to bring powerful stories to the big screen with an unwavering commitment to authenticity,” said Watermelon Pictures cofounder Badie Ali.

“Our partnership with the Film Committee at Media City Qatar is a major step toward realizing that promise, allowing us to tell these stories on a larger scale while remaining true to the people and places at their heart.”

Under the partnership, the parties would aim to shoot projects substantially in Qatar or structure them as Qatari co-productions.

They would also seek to involve Doha-based post-production companies and help eligible projects access the Qatar Screen Production Incentive (QSPI), creating opportunities for local crews, businesses, and creative talent while strengthening Qatar’s position as an international production hub.

“Through this partnership, we want to give filmmakers the resources to tell stories rooted in their communities and bring them to audiences around the world. We also want the films we support to create work for crews and businesses in Qatar and give them experience they can carry into their next production,” said Hassan Al Thawadi, Chairman of the Film Committee at Media City Qatar.

The Film Committee and Watermelon Pictures will jointly identify projects for the initial slate. The proposed partnership is subject to definitive agreements and the required approvals, with projects to be considered individually. More details on specific projects are soon to be announced

“Too many compelling stories and perspectives, including those of Arab and Muslim communities, have historically been underrepresented in mainstream cinema. We see an enormous opportunity to change that. Our planned slate will span genres, challenge perceptions, and, above all, entertain. Our ambition isn’t simply to create space in the industry. It’s to compete at its highest level,” said Watermelon Pictures cofounder Hamza Ali.

The announcement of the planned partnership was made during the Film Committee’s Doha Industry Days, running from November 19 to 21 within the framework of the Doha Film Festival.

hc47tl.title: CAA’s Bryan Lourd Urges Congress To Pass AI Legislation To Protect Americans “Famous Or Not”
hc47tl.content:
CAA chief Bryan Lourd is urging the full Congress to pass the No Fakes Act and deliver it to President Trump for signature, a move Lourd says would protect everyone, famous or not, from nonconsensual digital replicas of their voices and likenesses.

In a guest essay published in today’s New York Times, Lourd writes, “The Senate and House should move quickly and deliver the bill to President Trump for signature. That would ensure Americans retain control of their images and voices in the A.I. era.”

The No Fakes Act was approved unanimously by the Senate Judiciary Committee in June, and, Lourd contends, there “is momentum to pass it through the full Congress before the end of the year.” He calles it “one of the few A.I. bills with true bipartisan support.”

Hollywood, Lourd writes, “is not afraid of new technology.”

“The objection from actors, musicians and other creators is to a world in which anyone can use their face or voice without permission,” he writes. “In fact, many artists are already embracing A.I. on their own terms. Some of them are making deals with companies that are creating their A.I. likenesses, with their consent.”

Lourd poses the issue as not just for Hollywood. “A content creator learned on her honeymoon that a YouTube ad was using an A.I. version of her to sell erectile dysfunction supplements,” he writes. “Is all this legal? Right now, it’s an open question. But it shouldn’t be.”

“Hollywood doesn’t need America’s leaders to devise a new concept for new circumstances,” writes the chief executive and co-chairman of Creative Artists Agency. “We need them to extend and enforce the rules that already exist. The use of Americans’ faces, voices, performances and creative works is already subject to rules at the federal or state level that say, in short: You need to get permission, and you need to pay for the use.”

“This principle has guided the entertainment industry for more than a century,” he continues. “Whether it can continue to protect Americans may be decided in the coming weeks. The No Fakes Act would create a federal prohibition on creating nonconsensual digital replicas of any person’s voice or likeness — famous or not.”

The No Fakes Act, Lourd says, “would apply a tried-and-true formula to the A.I. era: control, consent and compensation. It would set a uniform federal standard to replace outdated, ill-fitting state laws, many of them written with an analog world in mind. Its supporters include all sides of the table: SAG-AFTRA, the union representing actors and other performers; the Motion Picture Association, representing the studios; and tech companies including IBM, Google and OpenAI.”

Earlier this month, Lourd told Deadline’s Dominic Patten, that the issues around AI are “about the fundamental relationship between technological progress and creative rights, and who determines the value of creative work, who decides how that work is used, and whether creators will share in the opportunities AI creates.”

Read Deadline’s exclusive interview with Lourd here.

6pb7fu.title: Russell Crowe’s ‘A Beautiful Mind’ Request Added $1 Million to Budget
6pb7fu.content:
“A Beautiful Mind” director Ron Howard recently called Russell Crowe’s suggestion to shoot the film in order, which cost the studio an additional $1 million, was “the right kind of investment.”

The 2001 film follows mathematician John Forbes Nash Jr. (Crowe) through his academic career as he struggles with schizophrenia. Although many films shoot out of sequence, Crowe believed “A Beautiful Mind” would benefit from filming sequentially.

“I am convinced it was the right kind of investment,” Howard told People magazine. “Russell certainly carried his part of the bargain with a brave and consistently detailed performance.”

The director likened the approach to George Lucas’ on “American Graffiti,” where the “Star Wars” helmsman shot in sequence to highlight the “wear and tear” of night shoots on screen. Filming “A Beautiful Mind” in order could help Crowe develop a natural progression in his role.

“Russell had, in passing, requested that we shoot the movie in sequence because the psychiatric journey and the way it would be revealed in the movie would be difficult to calibrate shooting the third act first and the first act second, which is typical for most movies,” Howard said.

Shooting in sequence meant two separate trips to Princeton, N.J., adding about $1 million to production costs. But Howard stood by the approach.

“I came to believe Russell was 100% right and had to dig in with the studio because it was about $1 million more to shoot in sequence,” Howard said.

The sequential approach paid off. “A Beautiful Mind” went on to win four Oscars at the 2001 Academy Awards. The film took home best picture, alongside a best director win for Howard, best adapted screenplay and best supporting actress for Jennifer Connelly, who played Nash’s wife Alicia.

A new 4K remastering of “A Beautiful Mind” hits theaters Sunday for its 25th anniversary.

98mmn.title: Hollywood’s Biggest Watch Nerds Are Obsessing Over These Indie Brands
98mmn.content:
De Bethune

De Bethune

Courtesy of Brand

Watchmaker Denis Flageollet founded De Bethune in 2002 with art collector David Zanetta. The DB25 Digitale reimagines digital time, with the hour individually displayed above minutes on a rotating disc, while a spherical moon-phase function is positioned in the center of a dial crafted in blued titanium, all set in a 42mm titanium case. At The 1916 Company, Manhattan Beach.

Urwerk

Urwerk

Courtesy of Brand

Watchmaker Felix Baumgartner and chief designer Martin Frei co-founded Urwerk in 1997, naming the brand for the Mesopotamian city of Ur, where Sumerians pioneered timekeeping. The UR-300 Time Quantum employs a sculptural approach to time via a T-shape metal frame, on which numbers rotate and rearrange to display hours and minutes. At Urwerk USA, Beverly Hills.

Biver

Biver

Courtesy of Brand

A legend in watch circles, Jean-Claude Biver launched his eponymous brand in 2023 — his latest, the 38mm Biver AB, blends brushed and polished steel, while the dial is crafted of solid 18-karat gold beneath a dark gray treatment. Exclusively at Material Good, New York City.

Czapek & Cie

Czapek & Cie

Courtesy of Brand

Named after watchmaker François Czapek, who founded his firm in 1845, the Geneva-based brand was revived in 2015 to honor his legacy. The latest model, the 40.5mm Antarctique Tourbillon Victory Green, got its start as a bespoke order and now is available in a limited series of 10 numbered pieces, each one produced on demand. At Cellini Jewelers, New York.

Parmigiani Fleurier

Parmigiani Fleurier

Courtesy of Brand

Master watch restorer Michel Parmigiani founded his firm in Fleurier, Switzerland, in 1996. This month, he won the Chronograph Prize at the 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève, the Oscars of watchmaking, for the Tonda PF Chronographe Mystérieux — its styling is similar to this Toric Petite Seconde Platinum Morning Blue, which debuted in October. At Feldmar Watch Company, Los Angeles.

MB&F

MB&F

Courtesy of Brand

Geneva’s MB&F debuted in 2005 as a concept house, in which founder Maximilian Büsser would partner with independent watchmakers and artisans. Limited to 33 pieces, the LM1 EVO offers two separate time displays and an oversized flying balance wheel suspended above the movement. At MB&F Lab at Westime, Beverly Hills.

Ressence

Ressence

Courtesy of Brand

Industrial designer Benoît Mintiens founded Ressence in 2010 in Antwerp, Belgium, crafting pieces that tell time using a system of orbiting, rotating discs. Weighing just 82 grams, the Type 10 DN is seamlessly crafted of two independent sections, allowing the movement to function while the display above is filled with oil. At Feldmar Watch Company, Los Angeles.

H. Moser & Cie

H. Moser & Cie

Courtesy of Brand

Heinrich Moser founded his namesake brand in 1828; 174 years later, his great-grandson relaunched it in northern Switzerland. This Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso Fumé honors the early 20th century moment when wristwatches became the preferred timekeeping device over pocket watches. At Westime, Rodeo Drive.
