lbh4tf.title: Появился открытый инструмент RageForge для изучения 3D-карты и файлов GTA VI на ПК
lbh4tf.content:
Разработчик под ником nullbrik представил на GitHub открытый инструментарий RageForge для реверс-инжиниринга файлов Grand Theft Auto VI. Написанная на базе .NET 10 утилита работает под Windows x64 в графическом режиме и через командную строку, позволяя владельцам консольных дампов изучать ресурсы движка RAGE нового поколения. Программа появилась на фоне распространения в сети консольного образа для Xbox версии 1.0.2.1 объемом 209 ГБ вскоре после недавнего релиза игры на PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X|S.
Главной особенностью RageForge стал полноценный 3D-просмотрщик окружения во вкладке World, открывающий свободный полет над картой Вайс-Сити и штата Леонида. Блоки мира динамически подгружаются вокруг камеры с использованием родной иерархии уровней детализации HD, LOD и SLOD1-3 на дистанции до 6 км, при этом рендер учитывает небо, время суток, туман и водную гладь. Утилита также позволяет открывать полноценные интерьеры зданий и экспортировать отдельные помещения или участки карты радиусом до 1500 м в формат .glb для дальнейшей работы в Blender.
Кроме локаций, инструментарий умеет собирать в 3D сюжетных героев, персонажей кат-сцен, уличных прохожих и животных во вкладке Peds. Программа объединяет модульные части вроде головы, глаз, одежды, базовых кистей рук и ступней в общей позе привязки и накладывает родную текстуру лица или подходящий пресет того же типа тела и этнической принадлежности. Одежда пока отображается в сером цвете с фактурой ткани из-за привязки ее оттенков к материалам времени выполнения игры, а волосы и бороды не рендерятся по причине отсутствия отдельных мешей. Собранные модели персонажей также экспортируются в .glb.
Доступ к файлам Grand Theft Auto VI оказался нетривиальной задачей из-за защиты архивов RPF9. Поскольку таблица оглавления с именами файлов и структурой каталогов зашифрована алгоритмом AES-CBC без публичного ключа, RageForge извлекает данные методом карвинга в обход стандартного дерева папок. При этом хранилища текстур TTPF декодируются полностью: программа выполняет деттайлинг под архитектуру AMD Gfx10 и RDNA2, работает со сжатием от BC1 до BC7, декодирует потоки Xbox BCPack BC1 и восстанавливает уровни мип-маппинга из структуры хранилища.
Функционал инструмента выходит за рамки графики и 3D-сцен. RageForge читает звуковые банки AWC с кодеком Opus для прослушивания и сохранения в WAV, извлекает видеоролики Bink 2 в формате .bk2 с поддержкой воспроизведения через binkplay из пакета RAD Video Tools, а также разбирает кэш шейдеров RDNA2 с дизассемблированием в инструкции GFX10.3 ISA и читаемый код pseudo-HLSL. Все типы ассетов можно выгружать пакетно по категориям, архивам и папкам как через графическую оболочку, так и через CLI.
Исходный код RageForge распространяется под открытой лицензией LGPL-3.0 и служит исключительно инструментом исследования ассетов.

dtdvju.title: Энтузиаст выпустил WinRust - быструю замену Проводника, панели задач и диспетчера задач Windows на языке Rust
dtdvju.content:
На GitHub вышел открытый проект WinRust от разработчика под ником Lemxy - набор нативных утилит на языке Rust, предназначенных для полной замены ключевых компонентов оболочки Windows 10 и Windows 11. Программа собрана в 1 исполняемый файл WinRust.exe без использования тяжелых фреймворков вроде Electron или .NET и уже привлекла свыше 1200 звезд от пользователей, недовольных производительностью стандартного интерфейса Microsoft.
Центральное место в составе WinRust занимают альтернативная панель задач topbar, файловый менеджер с вкладками rust-explorer, система мгновенного поиска по NTFS rust-search и диспетчер задач rtaskmgr-win32. Вместе с ними установщик добавляет приложение параметров rust-settings, чистильщик диска rs-du, карту занятого пространства WinRust Disk и быстрый просмотрщик изображений photoview. При этом интерфейс переведен сразу на 4 языка, включая русский, английский, японский и бразильский португальский, а сама оболочка умеет работать поверх или вместо штатного процесса explorer.exe.
Для геймеров и энтузиастов в диспетчере задач rtaskmgr-win32 предусмотрена отдельная вкладка Ускорение с профилями Игра и Работа, позволяющими в 1 клик останавливать фоновые службы и временно закрывать лишние лаунчеры или клиенты синхронизации. Там же реализованы очистка резервного кэша памяти, добавление исключений Microsoft Defender для игровых библиотек, настройка еженедельного обновления софта через winget, отключение устаревших параметров NTFS и мониторинг задержек драйверов. Отдельно через командную строку доступны модули debloat и purge: если debloat обратимо отключает телеметрию, Copilot, Recall и рекламу в меню Пуск, то purge безвозвратно вырезает встроенные приложения по аналогии с Tiny11, включая Clipchamp, Teams, Skype и оверлеи Xbox. При этом разработчик оставил активной службу PcaSvc, отвечающую за совместимость старых игр, и журнал буфера обмена cbdhsvc.
Замена штатных компонентов дала заметный выигрыш в скорости и расходе памяти. Согласно замерам автора на системе с Windows 11 IoT Enterprise и видеокартой RTX 4060 Laptop, новая оболочка потребляет 46 МБ оперативной памяти против 366 МБ у стандартного Проводника, а с учетом загруженного индекса MFT расход составляет 99 МБ. Окно папки открывается за 60 мс вместо 420 мс, поиск по всему диску занимает 45 мс, собственный многопоточный копировщик переносит 5000 мелких файлов в 7 раз быстрее за 2.3 секунды, а встроенный движок упаковывает их в ZIP в 64 раза быстрее за 0.75 секунды. Исполняемые файлы при этом похудели на 64-84% и весят 1179 КБ для файлового менеджера и 954 КБ для диспетчера задач.
Помимо производительности WinRust предлагает широкие возможности кастомизации. Панель задач topbar можно закрепить у нижнего, левого или правого края экрана, переключить в режим плавающего дока или тайлинга окон, а также настроить ее прозрачность, собственные цвета и сетку Alt+Tab с живыми миниатюрами. Пользователям доступны темы оформления Normal, Terminal, White road, Ruby и экспериментальные стили в духе классической Windows 98 и стеклянной Windows 7, тогда как сочетание Win+R перехватывает встроенная строка запуска с историей и подсказками команд.
WinRust отключает Windows Search, скрывает панель задач и может отключать Проводник в качестве оболочки. Исполняемый файл не подписан цифровой подписью, поэтому SmartScreen выдаст предупреждение. Перед установкой создается точка восстановления, однако сначала программу лучше опробовать на запасном ПК или в виртуальной машине.- Lemxy, разработчик WinRust
Для снижения рисков в установщик встроен механизм отката: перед внесением правок в реестр и службы утилита сохраняет исходные значения в журнал изменений, а кнопка Удалить все полностью возвращает систему к стандартному Проводнику и Windows Search. Единственным необратимым инструментом остается консольный плагин purge, который отключен по умолчанию и требует явного подтверждения перед запуском.

127aadf.title: Todd Boehly Dissects How How Daniel Katz’s Trading Desk Acumen Fed Into A24 Success: “Very Few Entertainment People Understand Math”
127aadf.content:
Todd Boehly gave an insight into his no nonsense approach to investing in sports and entertainment in the concluding fireside chat of the Qatar Film Committee’s Doha Industry Days over the weekend.

The billionaire investor’s holding company Eldridge holds some $75B in assets including stakes in Backrooms distributor A24, and Fulwell Entertainment as well as the Los Angeles Lakers, the Los Angeles Sparks, the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Trent Rockets among many more.

The holding is also a partner with Deadline owner Penske Media in the Penske Media Eldridge unit encompassing live TV entertainment specialist Dick Clark Productions as well as events such as the Golden Globes and SXSW.

Boehly first connected with A24 cofounder Daniel Katz, when the latter headed Guggenheim Partners’ film finance group in New York, while he was president of the global investment firm before leaving to create Eldridge.

“One of the things I believe is that there’s very few entertainment people that understand math… the math of entertainment is really about understanding how are you taking risk and then how are you distributing risk,” he said in the chat entitled “Playing to Win”.

“It’s no different than any other industry, if you’re thinking about what amount of risk you are willing to take and then how are you going to feed that risk,” he added.

Boehly said Katz had impressed him from the start for his ability to identify and work with risk during his time with Guggenheim Partners.

“Daniel’s real magic, when he worked on our trading floor from, let’s call it like 2008 to 2012, he didn’t take a lot of risks, but he said ‘no’ a lot,” he said.

“There was a slate that was done by a group called Stark Investments, and one of their big films was Poseidon. I remember it showed up on our desk. And Daniel was immediately like, this is a disaster. It’s going to cost so much money, you know, they’re not going to be able to make any return on it.”

The $160M disaster movie by Wolfgang Petersen went down in film financing folklore after it faltered at the box office and failed to gross enough to cover its P&A costs.

Boehly provided $19M in seed money for A24 as Katz launched the company in 2012 with David Fenkel and Joh Hodges. It was last publicly valued at $3.5 billion in June 2024.

“Everyone told me in Hollywood that there’s no room for another distribution company,” recalled the businessman. “His early successes with Spring Breakers and The Bling Ring were really structured finance trades.”

“You’re not really allowed to talk about that in the entertainment world because everything’s creative and creator driven… what Daniel was really good at, because he sat on a trading desk and he understood risk and he understood math, he was really good at figuring out how am I going to get my money back using different windows.”

Starring James Franco, Selena Gomez, Vanessa Hudgens, Harmony Korine’s Spring Breakers premiered in competition in Venice and went on to gross $31M.

“Spring Breakers cost a couple million bucks to buy, and he ended up making 10 million bucks or so very quickly on, because he really understood that it’s a structured finance straight,” said Boehly.

He added that beyond Katz’s business savviness, the company had also understood how to tap into social media to generate audience engagement as well as how to plug into trends of the moment.

“One of the things that A24 has done an amazing job at is being able to read the cultural zeitgeist. I think Civil War was really well timed; Marty Supreme was very well timed with Timothée Chalamet and his ascension as probably one of the top actors for the next couple of decades.”

Boehly also highlighted A24’s strategy of growing a cohort of directors and actors, who returned to work with the company on a regular basis.

“He wants repeat customers. He wants the directors coming back… he wants the actors coming back… because then it’s not a transaction, it becomes a recurring business with enterprise,” said Boehly.

“So many people think about the film business, ‘Oh, it’s a transaction’. But if you’re really thinking about how to build an enterprise, then you need to make sure that you have a recurring revenue base. And the way you do that in this industry is you get repeat users.”

He also gave insight into how Katz constructs A24’s slate in a way that enables it to work with established names and newcomers and turn a profit, suggesting that over a portfolio of 15 films, nine would be “the core bread and butter”.

“It’s a budget of 25 to 40 million bucks. It’s the expectation that he’s going to make 1.35 times,” he explained. “And if you think about the math of it again, you get 0.8 times your money back right away or very quickly. So, when you think about the risk that you have, you’re in for 0.2. If you make 1.35 and your risk capital is 0.2, but you’re going to make six, seven times that 0.2.”

“And then he’ll take three big swings and make something that has the capacity to become multiple films out of the content… he’ll take 1.2 times. So, he’ll modify his expectations on the rate of return to achieve something that might have more enterprise value or longevity on the back of it.”

Boehly suggested the final three films would be by up-and-coming young directors, and would require time, energy and effort rather than big financial investments and risk.

“He’s always thinking about how do I build that portfolio in order to have my bread and butter, have the opportunity to have something that’s got longevity and then find someone who’s going to be special in the industry,” he said.

8n6i82.title: ЕС вновь раскритиковал Таджикистан после визита Путина вопреки ордеру МУС на его арест
8n6i82.content:
Европейский Союз выражает сожаление, что Таджикистан не выполнил обязательства в рамках Римского статута Международного уголовного суда (МУС) и вновь принял президента РФ Владимира Путина во время его визита 19-20 ноября, несмотря на выданный в отношении него ордер на арест. Об этом говорится в заявлении Европейской службы внешних связей (EEAS), опубликованном в воскресенье, 22 ноября.

"ЕС напоминает, что преступления, подпадающие под действие Римского статута и угрожающие миру, безопасности и благополучию всего мира, не должны оставаться безнаказанными", - подчеркнули в Брюсселе. Евросоюз призывает все государства обеспечить полное сотрудничество с МУС, в том числе путем оперативного исполнения ордеров, а также заключать с судом добровольные соглашения.

ЕС поддерживает расследования МУС в Украине

В заявлении отмечается, что ЕС твердо привержен обеспечению полной ответственности за все международные преступления, нарушения и злоупотребления в области прав человека, вытекающие из агрессивной войны России против Украины. Кроме того, Брюссель выступает за соблюдение прав жертв на правосудие, возмещение ущерба и гарантии недопущения подобных преступлений в будущем.

Евросоюз продолжает поддерживать расследования, проводимые прокурором МУС в Украине, и призывает все государства - участники Римского статута к полному сотрудничеству. "ЕС вновь заявляет о своей непоколебимой поддержке МУС, а также независимости, суверенитета и территориальной целостности Украины в пределах ее международно признанных границ", - указали в EEAS.Визит президента России в Таджикистан

Путин прибыл с рабочим визитом в Таджикистан после саммита Азиатско-Тихоокеанского экономического сотрудничества (АТЭС), сообщила 20 ноября пресс-служба Кремля. По данным издания Asia-Plus, среди тем переговоров были деятельность 201-й российской военной базы, ситуация на таджикско-афганской границе, вопросы трудовой миграции и инвестиционного сотрудничества.

Евросоюз уже критиковал Таджикистан за невыполнение обязательств, связанных с ордером МУС на арест российского президента, в октябре 2025 года. Тогда, накануне визита Путина для участия в саммите "Центральная Азия - Россия" и заседании Совета глав государств СНГ, международная правозащитная организация Human Rights Watch призвала Душанбе отказать политику во въезде либо арестовать по прибытии.

Ордера МУС на арест Путина и Львовой-Беловой

МУС выдал ордер на арест Владимира Путина в марте 2023 года. Российского президента подозревают в в незаконной депортации и незаконном похищение детей с оккупированных ВС РФ территорий Украины. Одновременно ордер был выдан и уполномоченному по правам ребенка в РоссииМарии Львовой-Беловой.

В сентябре 2024 года Путин прилетал в Монголию, которая является государством -участником МУС и ратифицировала Римский статут. Однако власти страны не предприняли шагов по исполнению ордера на арест российского лидера.

gh-1455130148.title: GitHub - schuler-ph/nsmbw-switch: New Super Mario Bros. Wii (NSMBW) as a native Nintendo Switch homebrew (.nro): static recompilation, no emulator, up to 4-player local multiplayer with Joy-Cons, ~60 fps docked with sys-clk. Build it from your own disc. Fork of WitherBlitz's NSMB Wii recompilation.
gh-1455130148.content:
A native Nintendo Switch homebrew port of New Super Mario Bros. Wii (NSMBW), made with static
recompilation: the game's PowerPC code is translated to C++ and compiled for the Switch's ARM CPU
ahead of time. No emulator, no interpreter, no JIT. It runs as an .nro from hbmenu on a Switch 1
with Atmosphère, with local multiplayer for up to four players on Joy-Cons and Pro Controllers.

preview.mp4

This is a fork of WitherBlitz's
NSMB Wii Multiplayer Recompilation,
which this Switch port builds on.
ImportantThere are no game files and no downloads here: no disc image, no levels, music, graphics or
sounds, and no prebuilt .nro. You build it yourself from your own copy of
New Super Mario Bros. Wii (USA, SMNE01, revision 1), extracted with
Dolphin. The .nro you build contains the game's translated code, so
do not share it.

Features

Native on the Switch: the whole game is compiled to AArch64 code; graphics run through
aurora on Dawn's deko3d backend, the Switch's own GPU API.
Local multiplayer: up to four players on Joy-Con pairs, single sideways Joy-Cons, Pro
Controllers or the console in handheld mode (measured with two players so far).
Switch button layout and motion controls: jump on A/B, run on Y/X, spin on the triggers, tilt and
shake with the controller's motion sensors (see Controls).
Full speed docked: 59-60 fps at 98-99.8 % game speed in the measured levels, docked with the CPU
at 1785 MHz (see Performance).

Performance
Measured on one Switch 1 (Erista, Atmosphère), docked, with the CPU at 1785 MHz set by sys-clk
(GPU 768 MHz, memory 1600 MHz), two players, builds from November 2026 with no options set:

Levels 1-1, 4-1 (water), 2-3 (spotlights), 1-4, 4-37 (airship), castle 1 (lava) and 5-3 (poison):
59-60 fps in the level, 98.1-99.8 % game speed, audio at or above 99.6 % speed.
The first visit to a level compiles new GPU pipelines; while that happens, some objects can be
missing for a moment instead of the game stalling.
At the stock docked CPU clock (1020 MHz) the game thread was the limit: about 43 fps and 72 % game
speed, measured before later speed-ups and not measured again since.

Not measured so far: other levels and a full playthrough, handheld mode with the current build, and
other Switch models (Mariko, Lite, OLED). Reports are welcome. Raising clocks with sys-clk is at your
own risk.
Requirements

A Switch 1 with Atmosphère and hbmenu. Start hbmenu through a title override (hold R while
starting a game), not from the album: the game needs the memory of a full application.
sys-clk with a docked CPU profile of 1785 MHz, for full
speed. sys-clk sees the game you start hbmenu through, not the .nro, so set the profile on that
game (or as the global profile).
Your own USA SMNE01 revision 1 disc of New Super Mario Bros. Wii, as a disc image (.iso
or .wbfs) or extracted with Dolphin. Other regions and revisions are rejected: the port hooks the
game at exact addresses.
To build: Docker on Linux or in WSL2 on Windows (tested: Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL2), about 20 GB of free
disk and enough memory for 4 jobs (about 5 GB at the peak; tested with 16 GB). Everything else
comes in a Docker image with pinned versions (docker/Dockerfile).

NoteNobody here will tell you where to get the game. Dumping your own disc is on you, and links to
game files won't be provided or tolerated.

Getting the game files
Dump your own disc as an .iso or .wbfs (for example with CleanRip on a Wii). build.sh checks
the game ID and revision before it does anything else.

An .rvz or .wia from Dolphin: right-click the game in Dolphin, Convert File..., format
ISO. (projects/nsmbw/tools/unpack_game.py reads them directly with
nodtool on PATH, but the Docker build doesn't ship it yet.)
A folder works too: in Dolphin, Properties → Filesystem, right-click the disc, Extract
Entire Disc. You get a folder with files and sys in it.

Build
Clone the repository (in WSL2: inside the Linux file system, not under /mnt/c) and run one
command:
git clone https://github.com/schuler-ph/nsmbw-switch.git
cd nsmbw-switch
./build.sh "<your disc image or extracted game folder>"

build.sh builds the Docker image, checks your game, translates its code, builds the graphics
libraries (Dawn with deko3d, libuam) and the .nro, and puts the SD card folder into
out/switch/nsmbw/. The first run took 20 minutes with 4 jobs on a Ryzen 7 5800X3D (32 minutes when
it builds Dawn and libuam itself); a second run takes about 2 minutes. Options:

Dawn and libuam come prebuilt from the release
switch-deps-1 (3.6 MB,
checked against the SHA-256 pinned in build-switch.sh; its source is attached there too). If the
download fails, build.sh builds them itself (about 10 minutes more). --build-deps always builds
them; --deps <file or URL> takes another archive from build-switch-deps.sh --pack.
--jobs N (default: from the free memory, about 1 GB per job), --out DIR, --clean.

Your game never goes into the image. What is made from it stays on your machine: generated/,
out/ and the Docker volume nsmbw-work-<id> (docker volume rm removes it).

Without Docker
You need devkitPro (devkitA64, libnx, deko3d, switch-mesa, switch-tools; tested: the
devkitpro/devkita64:20260219 image), the .NET 8 SDK, Python 3, CMake, Ninja and Clang
(projects/nsmbw/BUILDING.md, sections 1-3 and 6), plus meson,
bison, flex and python3-mako for Dawn. Then:
python3 projects/nsmbw/tools/unpack_game.py <disc image or extracted game folder>
python3 projects/nsmbw/tools/prelink_rels.py
projects/nsmbw/tools/build-linux.sh --game <extracted game folder>
source /etc/profile.d/devkitpro.sh
projects/nsmbw/tools/build-switch-deps.sh ../switch-deps
D=../switch-deps
projects/nsmbw/tools/build-switch.sh --dawn-src $D/dawn --dawn-build $D/dawn-build-switch \
--uam $D/uam/build-switch/libuam.a --stage ../sd-stage

A disc image is extracted next to the repository (../disc-SMNE01); that is the folder for
--game and for the SD card. build-switch.sh --deps <archive> replaces the Dawn and libuam options.
Optional: --cmake-arg -DMKW_SWITCH_NRO_ICON=/path/to/icon.jpg (a 256×256 JPEG) gives the .nro,
and forwarders made from it, an icon instead of libnx's default one.

Install
Copy out/switch/nsmbw/ to sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/ on the SD card. If you built from a disc image,
the game is already in it as game/; if you built from a folder, add that folder as
sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/game/ (with files/ and sys/ in it):
sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/
nsmbw.nro
dsp_coef.bin
initial_pipeline_cache.db
wii_bootstrap/
game/files/ ...
game/sys/ ...

Start nsmbw from hbmenu. The first start compiles about 1 700 shaders (about 10 minutes, with a
counter in the top left); later starts reuse the cache.
To start it from the HOME menu instead, create a forwarder for sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/nsmbw.nro with
sphaira (Install Forwarder, address space 39-bit); this
needs signature patches on the console.
Controls
Player 1 is the console's player-1 controller, or the attached Joy-Cons in handheld mode. Players 2-4
join as their controllers connect, in the console's own order. A single Joy-Con held sideways counts
as one controller (pair it with SL+SR).

Switch
Game

A, B
jump (2)

Y, X
run, pick up (1)

ZL, ZR, R (SL, SR on a sideways Joy-Con)
shake: spin jump

L (stick click on a sideways Joy-Con)
bubble in multiplayer (A)

+
pause

- (holding + on a sideways Joy-Con)
the remote's -

In menus, A and B confirm and Y and X go back, as 2 and 1 do on the Wii Remote.
Tilting and shaking the controller works as on a Wii Remote. NSMBW_SWITCH_MOTION in env.txt
(below) chooses which controllers do that: on (default), nohandheld (not the console itself) or
off.
Logs and options

sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/log.txt and stderr.txt are written on every start; attach them to issues.
sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/env.txt sets runtime options, one NAME=value per line (# starts a
comment). The Switch defaults are built in; you only need this file for experiments.
sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/gfx_flags.txt sets AURORA_GFX_FLAGS (for example validate) for graphics
debugging. Delete it afterwards: it slows the game down.

Where the Switch code lives

Path
What

runtime/src/platform/switch/
entry point, file system, logging, memory and thread setup

aurora-main/lib/switch/
window/surface, controller input, GL entry points for switch-mesa

aurora-main/cmake/patches/*-nintendo-switch-platform.patch
Switch support for Dawn (with the deko3d backend), SDL3, Abseil, SQLite and Tracy, taken unchanged from DriftDroid

projects/nsmbw/tools/patches/
fixes on top of Dawn and libuam

projects/nsmbw/tools/build-switch-deps.sh, build-switch.sh
build steps 2 and 3 above

projects/nsmbw/, runtime/, aurora-main/, translator/
the recompilation project, runtime, renderer and translator from upstream

The Android app (android/) and the Windows/Linux launcher (Launcher/) are upstream's and are not
part of the Switch build.
FAQ
Is this an emulator?
No. Everything is compiled to native code before you start it. At runtime nothing emulates a Wii CPU
or GPU.
Is it a decompilation?
No, a static recompilation. WiiCompiled's translator turns the game's PowerPC code into C++
automatically, and that is compiled for the Switch. The runtime around it (graphics, audio, input,
the Wii's system software) is source code.
Do you provide the game or an .nro?
No.
Which consoles does it run on?
It is a homebrew program for a Switch 1 with Atmosphère, built and measured on one Erista console so
far. It does not run without custom firmware.
Will you fix original bugs?
No, behaving like the real game is the goal. Only report things where this port differs from the
original game on a Wii or in Dolphin.
The game crashed or shows something wrong.
Open an issue with your Switch model, docked or handheld, the clocks you set, what you did, and
log.txt and stderr.txt from sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/.
AI usage
Like the upstream port, the Switch port was coded with Anthropic's Claude models, directed and tested
on the console by schuler-ph.
Credits

WitherBlitz - the
NSMB Wii Multiplayer Recompilation
this fork is built on: WiiCompiled's runtime moved to NSMBW, with its hooks and fixes.
WiiCompiled by patchzyy and contributors - the
static recompiler and runtime underneath.
DriftDroid by dorPXP - Mario Kart Wii on Switch; the
Switch platform patches for Dawn (with the deko3d backend), SDL3, Abseil, SQLite and Tracy and parts
of the Switch runtime come from it (GPL-3.0).
WiiCompiled-Switch by yashin-sh - the
recipe and patcher scripts for building Dawn for the Switch, fetched at build time (GPL-3.0).
aurora - the GX rendering backend. MIT licensed.
Dawn - Google's WebGPU implementation, here with a
deko3d backend.
devkitPro - devkitA64, libnx, deko3d and the Switch tools;
libuam - the shader compiler for deko3d.
Dolphin Emulator - the reference for Wii hardware
behavior, the free DSP coefficient ROM and the default WiiConnect24 tree bundled with the runtime,
and the tool you extract your game with.
The NSMBW reverse-engineering community - RootCubed's
NSMBW symbols, the NSMBW decompilation and the
NSMBW address maps, which the function map is built from.

Bundled third-party components and their licenses live in
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
Changes in this fork
Modified from upstream 2ff64f5 (2026-11-05) by schuler-ph, November 2026, as required by
section 5 of the GPLv3. The full list is git diff 2ff64f5; in short:

A Nintendo Switch platform layer: runtime/src/platform/switch/, aurora-main/lib/switch/, the
Switch patches under aurora-main/cmake/patches/ and projects/nsmbw/tools/patches/, and the build
scripts build-switch-deps.sh and build-switch.sh.
A one-command build: build.sh with docker/, disc images in unpack_game.py (WiiDiscExtract
as a host tool, nodtool for compressed images) and prebuilt Dawn/libuam archives (--pack, --deps).
Speed-ups for the Switch's CPU and GPU: a flat guest memory path, a separate GX thread, faster FIFO
and pipeline handling, a native reverb, a high-level path for water effects, particle shortcuts, and
Switch defaults for these.
Switch controls: button layout, Joy-Con and Pro Controller motion as Wii Remote tilt and shake, and
a launch option for texture replacements.
Measurement and diagnostics: a frame/game-speed monitor, a guest profiler and a development link
for test runs (the link stays off unless sdmc:/switch/nsmbw/devhost.txt exists).
Changes to disc reading (read cache), Wii Remote input and the runtime build files for the Switch.
This README, rewritten for the Switch; upstream's covers Android, Windows and Linux.

75sxiv.title: Энтузиаст перенес карту GTA VI из утекшего билда для Xbox в FiveM на ПК
75sxiv.content:
Разработчик и моддер под ником arkari опубликовал в соцсети X ролик с демонстрацией карты из Grand Theft Auto VI, запущенной на ПК внутри мультиплеерной платформы FiveM на базе Grand Theft Auto V. По утверждению автора, в основу порта легли файлы из недавней утечки консольной версии игры для Xbox. Энтузиаст не ограничился закрытым тестом и открыл публичный сервер, предложив всем желающим самостоятельно прогуляться по перенесенным локациям.
Конвертировал карту GTA VI для Xbox в файлы, совместимые с GTA V, и запустил ее в FiveM. Проект все еще дорабатывается, однако исследовать локацию можно уже сейчас.- arkari, автор порта
На опубликованных кадрах запечатлен запуск проекта в оконном режиме со стандартным интерфейсом GTA V, колесом выбора оружия и счетчиком производительности в верхней панели, показывающим от 73 до 185 кадров в секунду при потреблении 6.4 ГБ видеопамяти. Из-за технических особенностей переноса на мини-карте и в правом нижнем углу экрана продолжают отображаться названия районов из оригинального Лос-Сантоса вроде Del Perro Beach, Rockford Hills и Grand Senora Desert.
Ранее arkari уже демонстрировал нативный рендеринг этих же ассетов на ПК через собственный просмотрщик с базовыми шейдерами, а перенос геометрии в движок GTA V позволил походить по карте в привычном игровом окружении.
Публикация вызвала оживленную дискуссию среди пользователей X. Часть комментаторов поблагодарила автора за работу и попросила выпустить проект в виде отдельной модификации для одиночного режима или объединить его с картой GTA V, а также предложила перенести миссии ради создания демейка GTA VI до выхода официальной ПК-версии. В то же время скептики усомнились в подлинности утекших исходников для Xbox, называя проект фейком.
Наиболее частым замечанием в обсуждении стали предупреждения о неизбежной реакции со стороны Rockstar Games и Take-Two Interactive. Платформа FiveM принадлежит самой Rockstar с 2023 года, а правила площадки Cfx.re прямо запрещают импорт ассетов из других игр и использование любых утекших материалов. За подобные нарушения серверы сначала получают блокировку на 14 дней, а при повторном инциденте отправляются в бессрочный бан, из-за чего публичный доступ к перенесенной карте едва ли продержится долго.

1wkyxmt.title: Ina Garten Turned Down ‘Dancing With the Stars’
1wkyxmt.content:
Celebrity chef Ina Garten will not be cooking up a freestyle for “Dancing with the Stars” in the near future.

Garten told Rose Byrne on a recent episode of her “Happy Hour” podcast that she would be too nervous to compete. She opened the floor by asking Byrne if she had ever “not done something because it was too scary,” before answering her own question.

“Somebody asked me to do ‘Dancing with the Stars,’” she said. “I thought, ‘Nobody needs to see that. That’s not happening.’” “The closer I got to the day when I had to do it, the more I’d have nightmares,” Garten added.

Garten may be shying away from the ballroom, but she is still dancing around the kitchen. Her Food Network show “Be My Guest with Ina Garten,” where she hosts guests at her house in East Hampton for food and conversation, entered its ninth season in October.

While it wasn’t Garten, “Dancing with the Stars” still welcomed a celebrity chef this season. Giada De Laurentiis joined Season 35 with Alan Bersten as her partner. The couple competed two dances before being eliminated on Sept. 22 during “Viral Hits Night.”

“Dancing with the Stars” will host its live finale on Tuesday on ABC and Disney+. The remaining competitors include podcaster and comedian Connor Wood partnered with Rylee Arnold, singer and actress Tatyana Ali partnered with Jan Ravnik, model Maura Higgins partnered with Mark Ballas, Olympic figure skater Amber Glenn partnered with Pasha Pashkov and Paralympic track star Ezra Frech partnered with Daniella Karagach.

oj2x63.title: Silver briefly forms a rare crystal structure seen in radioactive polonium
oj2x63.content:
Silver nanoparticles produced from the decomposition of silver iodide using an electron microscopy grid. Credit: Megha Kalra

How atoms are arranged in a material shapes many of its properties. The same carbon atoms, for example, can form diamond and graphite depending on how they are arranged, giving rise to materials with vastly different chemical and physical properties. Now, researchers at Hokkaido University have discovered a new crystal structure of silver with unusually high chemical reactivity. The findings, published in Nano Letters, could open new avenues for exploring materials with desirable properties.

Silver normally forms a repeating cube-shaped structure, with atoms located at each of the cube's eight corners and at the center of each face. This arrangement is known as a face-centered cubic crystal structure and is common among metals, including aluminum, copper and gold. In the new study, researchers observed that under certain conditions, silver atoms can adopt a simple cubic structure, in which the atoms occupy only the eight corners of a cube that repeats in three dimensions.
Simple cubic structures are exceptionally rare among elements. One other example is the radioactive element polonium.
In this study, researchers used an electron beam to trigger the decomposition of silver iodide, observing the newly formed silver atoms arrange themselves into a previously unreported simple cubic structure.
At the nanoscale, where materials measure just a few billionths of a meter, structures that are unstable in larger materials can sometimes emerge temporarily. Studying these structures gives researchers an opportunity to discover materials with unique properties that are not found in their conventional forms.
Under high-vacuum conditions, the new simple cubic silver behaved differently from ordinary silver. While conventional face-centered cubic silver remained stable, simple cubic silver gradually oxidized to form silver oxide. This indicated unusually high chemical reactivity in the new structure.
"It was surprising to find that such a low-density structure could form in a pure metal crystal," says first author Dr. Masaya Sakakibara. "We expected silver nanoparticles to form when silver iodide decomposes under electron beam irradiation, but we didn't expect them to adopt a simple cubic structure."

Credit: Nano Letters (2026). DOI: 10.1021/acs.nanolett.6c03635

The team used a transmission electron microscope (TEM) both to trigger the chemical transformation of silver iodide and to observe the process at the atomic scale. A TEM uses a beam of electrons with wavelengths shorter than those of visible light, allowing it to reveal individual atoms. By combining the ability to induce chemical change with real-time atomic-scale imaging, the researchers could directly observe how the new silver crystal structure emerged. "Within 100 seconds of its formation, it began to transform into silver oxide," adds Sakakibara.
"This is a new approach to discovering previously unknown crystal structures, which could also help us develop materials with novel properties in the future," says professor Yuki Kimura, co-author of the study and head of the Low Temperature Nanomaterial Science Laboratory at Hokkaido University. "Going forward, we will continue investigating the physical and chemical properties of simple cubic silver in greater detail and extend this approach to other elements and compounds."

Publication details
Masaya Sakakibara et al., Electron-Beam-Assisted Formation of Simple-Cubic Silver, Nano Letters (2026). DOI: 10.1021/acs.nanolett.6c03635

Who's behind this story?

Lisa Lock

BA art history, MA material culture. Former museum editor, paramedic, and transplant coordinator. Editing for Science X since 2021.

Bachelor's in mathematical biology, Master's in creative writing. Well-traveled with unique perspectives on science and language.

1hpcip8.title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Crosses $100 Million at Global Box Office
1hpcip8.content:
“You Can See Everything” has surpassed $100 million globally, a rare box office milestone for a documentary.

So far, the zeitgeist-capturing look at Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes has generated a staggering $93.4 million at the domestic box office and $9 million overseas for a worldwide tally of $102.4 million. It continues to mint money for A24, which produced the film in secret for roughly $7 million.

Over the weekend, “You Can See Everything” opened in the United Kingdom with $3.2 million from 596 locations. Those ticket sales register as A24’s second-largest debut in the territory behind “Backrooms” ($5.7 million). Similar to in the United States, around 70% of the audience in the U.K. was under 35 years old. Australia and New Zealand are currently the top-grossing markets with $3.8 million.

Elsewhere, the film is getting a staggered rollout at the international box office: it’s also playing in Turkey, Poland, the Czech Republic, Russia, the United Arab Emirates and Greece (contributing around $2 million in total), and it’ll debut over the next few weeks in other territories including Mexico, Brazil and Argentina (Nov. 26 and 25), Germany, Austria and Hong Kong (Dec. 3 and 4), Spain (Dec. 25), France (Dec. 30) and Japan (March 12). A24 is handling the release in select territories, with Sony distributing in markets including Denmark, Norway, Sweden and the Middle East.

Already, “You Can See Everything” is one of the biggest theatrical documentaries in years. It’ll rely on overseas audiences to topple the genre’s all-time record. Michael Moore’s seminal 2004 film “Fahrenheit 9/11” is the highest-grossing non-concert documentary in history with $222 million globally, including $119 million domestically and $103 million overseas; followed by “March of the Penguins” with $127 million globally, including $77 million domestically and $50 million overseas — neither adjusted for inflation.

Directed by comedian Nathan Fielder and filmmaker Lance Oppenheim, “You Can See Everything” became a word-of-mouth smash after a surprise world premiere at Telluride Film Festival. The movie opened to $15 million domestically in mid-October and, with sensational reviews, remained a big-screen draw throughout the fall. The nearly three-hour-long doc takes place over three years and begins as Holmes, the founder of the health technology company Theranos, is preparing for her 11-year prison sentence for defrauding investors.

hpcf61.title: GTA 6 Bad Luck, I Guess trophy guide: How to rob the Payday Loans store
hpcf61.content: How to unlock the Bad Luck, I Guess trophy/achievement in GTA 6One of the hidden trophies/achievements in GTA 6 asks players to revisit a familiar crime and finish a job that Lucia previously failed to complete.The Bad Luck, I Guess trophy requires you to rob the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba and escape from the police on foot.Here’s how to unlock the Bad Luck, I Guess trophy in GTA 6, including where to find the store and how to escape without getting caught.Do you need more GTA 6 guides? Then check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.How to unlock Bad Luck, I Guess in GTA 6The Bad Luck, I Guess trophy description reads “Second time’s the charm”, referencing Lucia’s return to the Payday Loans store from the game’s opening sequence.While you can revisit the store before Chapter 3, before attempting the actual robbery, you’ll need to complete the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check. This unlocks Payday Loans robberies and provides access to the equipment needed to deal with marked bills. Before that point, you won’t be able to do anything with them.The most vital things about this trophy is that you must complete this robbery as Lucia without Jason accompanying you and you must escape on foot.Find the Payday Loans storeOpen your map and travel to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, located in Vice City. We’ve marked it on the map above.Make sure you’re playing as Lucia alone before entering the building.Rob the Payday Loans storeEnter through the Check Cashing entrance and draw your weapon to initiate the robbery. Take out the security guard before heading through the Staff Only door at the back of the building. Because you’re doing this alone, you can’t keep your weapon trained on both security guards, this means one of them will always attack you. I incapacitated both guards before going behind the desk via the door on the right.Once inside, search the office and empty all three cash drawers to collect the marked bills. If you’re struggling with this part, you can enter the payday loans building via the garage at the back of the store. There’s one security guard there, and another in the corridor leading up to the main part of the payday loans place.Escape the police on footThis is the most important part of the Bad Luck, I Guess trophy.After collecting the money, leave the building and escape through the streets of Little Cuba. Do not get into a vehicle. The trophy requires you to lose the police while remaining on foot.Keep moving until your Wanted Level disappears completely. You will trigger a three-star wanted level by doing this robbery, which means police helecopters will be involved leave the area before they get to you or you won’t be able to outrun them.Once you’ve successfully escaped, the Bad Luck, I Guess trophy/achievement should unlock.

4mxgqh.title: GTA 6: Arthur Morgan’s hat location from Red Dead Redemption 2
4mxgqh.content: The Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption games are set in the same strange universe, and this is just one of the small things that proves it.Arthur Morgan was the protagonist of Red Dead Redemption 2, and his iconic hat is now obtainable in GTA 6. It looks brand-new, so it might be a replica, but either way, it suits protagonists Jason and Lucia nicely.In this guide, we’re breaking down exactly where you need to get it and how much you need to spend to get Arthur Morgan’s hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 in Grand Theft Auto 6.How to find Arthur Morgan’s Hat in Grand Theft Auto 6If you want to wear Arthur Morgan’s hat in GTA 6, you simply need to buy it from a yard sale. There’s just one thing to note here: each item at the yard sale – hat included – can only be purchased by one of your protagonists. Decide which character you’d most like to see wear the hat before you go any further.Now you’ve decided, you’ll need to head to the yard sale location during the day. The yard sale is available from Chapter 2 or later, so if you haven’t made enough story progress, do that first.The hat is a short distance South of Moses’ chop shop. A blue house will be hosting a yard sale during the daytime on the Southern edge of Port Gellhorn, and the hat will be among the items on sale. It’ll be titled the Genuine Cowboy Hat. You can buy it for just $35.Once purchased, it’ll be available in your wardrobe with the rest of your clothing items.

19w5ru0.title: Croteam официально вывела Serious Sam Fusion из бета-теста спустя почти 10 лет
19w5ru0.content:
Студия Croteam неожиданно прервала многолетнее молчание вокруг Serious Sam Fusion и официально вывела единый игровой хаб из бета-тестирования. По случаю 15-летия шутера Serious Sam 3: BFE, вышедшего в 2011 году, разработчики выпустили масштабный патч и символически стерли приписку 2017 (beta) из названия проекта. В свежем трейлере знаменитый подзаголовок буквально взрывается под реплику самого Сэма Стоуна о том, что давно пора было это сделать. Для поклонников серии релиз стал настоящим сюрпризом, поскольку сборник находился в статусе раннего доступа еще с 2017 года и за более чем 9 лет успел заработать репутацию заброшенного.
Долгое время сообщество считало, что Croteam окончательно прекратила поддержку Serious Sam Fusion, объединяющего Serious Sam HD: The First Encounter, Serious Sam HD: The Second Encounter, Serious Sam 3: BFE и их VR-версии на базе проприетарного движка Serious Engine. Крупных обновлений хаб не получал свыше 7 лет, а переход команды на Unreal Engine 5 лишь подкреплял слухи о том, что работать со старой технологией в студии уже некому. Тем не менее игроки продолжали присылать отчеты об ошибках в Discord, и в итоге авторы все же вернулись к проекту.
Приписка 2017 (beta) наконец-то исчезла! Но это не значит, что мы покончили с Fusion раз и навсегда. Мы по-прежнему планируем вернуться к игре в будущем - в частности, чтобы улучшить поддержку моддинга и дать творцам из Мастерской еще больше свободы для создания самых безумных вещей.- команда разработчиков Croteam
Вышедший патч устраняет десятки давних проблем, на которые годами жаловались пользователи. Разработчики исправили вылеты при кроссплее между обычными версиями и шлемами виртуальной реальности, починили сломанные спавнеры врагов в The Second Encounter и BFE, а также убрали баг со снарядами Пушки и Опустошителя, которые на близкой дистанции улетали в сторону и не наносили урон боссам при критическом запасе здоровья. Отдельное внимание уделили поведению противников: Клиры, Биомеханоиды-быки, Камикадзе и Гнаары получили усиленное торможение, чтобы перестать скользить по аренам на уровне сложности Крутой. Кроме того, в игру вернулась вибрация геймпадов, обновилось освещение на большинстве карт, появились настройки камеры от третьего лица в меню, а русская локализация получила крупную переработку.
Не обошлось и без спорных правок, которые уже вызвали бурные дискуссии в Steam. В Serious Sam 3: BFE разработчики открыли прицел для Опустошителя всем владельцам Deluxe Edition и восстановили оригинальное звучание пещерных демонов с хнумами, но при этом отключили у врагов особые атаки уровня сложности Hard+ ради избавления от случайных элементов. Часть хардкорной аудитории раскритиковала это изменение, отметив, что такие приемы делали сражения динамичнее. Одновременно Croteam полностью обнулила таблицы лидеров ради равного старта для всех участников и предупредила авторов модов, что крупные переработки кампании BFE могут вылетать до тех пор, пока создатели заново не запекут освещение и не пересохранят уровни.
Выход из бета-теста сопроводили крупной распродажей всей франшизы в Steam перед релизом Serious Sam: The Third Encounter - следующей части серии, сюжетно продолжающей события The Second Encounter. В комментариях игроки тепло встретили внезапный патч, хотя часть фанатов по-прежнему надеется, что в будущем студия интегрирует в Serious Sam Fusion дилогию Serious Sam 2, Serious Sam 4 и дополнение Siberian Mayhem, а также исправит сетевые проблемы в сборнике Serious Sam Classics: Revolution.

m77gj4.title: Noah Kahan Should Have Gotten Multiple Grammy Noms — Why Didn't He?
m77gj4.content:
In previous eras of less pervasive social media, we usually could only guess at just how disappointed music and film personalities were when they didn’t fare well with Grammy or Oscar nominations. But lately, more and more major and minor figures have been up-front and honest in sharing with their fans that, hey, yes, they’re feeling the apparent lack of industry love, too. As long as these reflections come off as more bummed out and philosophical than bitterly entitled or peevish — here’s looking at you, John Summit — they can make for a moment of connection between artists and their fan base. And so it is that, this past week, I followed one of our most likably candid superstars through what I came to refer to as the Five Stages of Noah Kahan Grammy Grief.

Kahan himself skipped over the anger phase, though his fans certainly felt that one, when it turned out that their hero got passed over for everything but one relatively modest nom, in defiance of all expectation. There were other stages they went through together. First came uneasy anticipation: The day before nominations came out, Kahan issued a whatever-will-be-will-be-type tweet, almost as if he’d gotten a hint that things were not going to go well for him. (“Whatever happens tomorrow I love you all and I have done everything I’ve ever needed to do in my career because of YOUR support.”) Then came resignation and premature acceptance: “Life goes on.” Then came gallows humor, as he took a fake phone call on stage from the Grammys and quipped, “Wrong number.” And finally, there was real acceptance, as he admitted in an affecting stage monologue that he was having a teachable moment as, without mentioning the awards, Kahan said he was assessing why he had hoped too much for something and put the value of his worth in the wrong place.

Undoubtedly, some would say he should have just put himself above it all and not even referenced the seeming snub, but my admiration is always going to go more toward people who address elephants in rooms. So maybe now he could move forward with his usual good humor… while, sure, having the fact that he just sold out his next 24 U.S. stadium shows to keep him warm at night.

But maybe us Grammy prognosticators aren’t yet ready to move on, because like pollsters in 2024, we want to figure out how we got Kahan’s chances wrong. And really, he was the only significant thing we forecasted incorrectly, since virtually everything else in the top three categories went as predicted, for once. Kahan seemed to have almost everything going for him, being the only artist who consistently had not just one but two albums in the top 10 all year long, on top of having recently become one of the biggest ticket-sellers in the business… and, lest the predictions be based only on popular appeal, he’d also gotten mostly great reviews lately, although he hadn’t started out his career as a critical favorite.

Professional prognosticators nearly all had Kahan’s “The Great Divide” album landing one of the eight open slots for album of the year, and most entertainment news outlets predicted the same for the title track in the fields of record and/or song of the year. The forecasters lining up to say he was close to a sure thing included those at Billboard, Rolling Stone, the Hollywood Reporter, Hits and, yes, Variety. Over at the awards site Gold Derby, “Great Divide” was seen as all but locked in for an album nomination no matter which of their columns you looked down — industry experts, their editors, or the site’s active followers. Instead, he wound up with a lone nod for… best contemporary folk recording, which was rather like the Recording Academy setting a bull down in a china shop instead of at the rodeo.

There was one obvious stumbling block on the path to considering him a shoo-in for one of more big nods: the fact that he’d only gotten two nominations before, and only one as the primary person nominated. Kahan was nominated as best new artist for the 2024 Grammys (and lost to the empirically less popular Victoria Monet); his only other prior nom was in a country category as the featured duet partner on a Kelsea Ballerini single. But surely we were past the point now — we thought — where anyone still had to dude-splain Noah Kahan to the Grammy elite.

Of course it shouldn’t matter if “The Great Divide” spent most of 2026 in the top 10 hovering just above the continued presence of the four-year-old (!) “Stick Season.” if these albums blew chunks… which is the kind of thing that’s been known to sink a Grammy nomination. But “The Great Divide” demonstrably does not fall into the realm of suckage. If anything, it represents the kind of perfect storm the Grammys have traditionally loved to reward, where somehow, some way, songwriting that is idiosyncratic and qualitatively strong and unique captures the imagination of the masses who might usually be stereotyped as tending toward less distinctly personal fare. Kahan could have been seen as having it all…

Except for having a natural constituency among Recording Academy members.

Therein lies a rub. It did nag at me, even as I was making my own forecast that he’d get into the top categories, that I couldn’t picture in my mind’s eye which subset of voters would be putting their support behind him. In terms of either genre or geography, he did not and does not have the wind at his back.

The Recording Academy has 12 chapters spread across the U.S. This may come as a shock, but none of them are in Burlington. There’s a Pacific Northwest chapter, but good luck looking for a corresponding Atlantic Northeast chapter. Surely Kahan would be the first to laugh at the idea of his New England industry homies colluding as a voting bloc to ensure vindication for Vermont.

The genre thing looms as an even bigger problem. Leaving aside the general field at the top of the ballot, where does a Kahan rightfully belong among the 90+ stylistically divided categories that follow? You could consider him rock. Billboard certainly does; he has two songs in the top 10 of the rock airplay chart right now (“Orbiter” and “Draw You Out”). But are the voters who choose to vote in the rock categories — and as you probably know, they don’t get to vote in all 100 — really going there to vote for a guy like Kahan, as opposed to the harder stuff? He would seem like a closer fit for the Americana and American roots categories. But the Americana community hasn’t really fully embraced him, even though he has shown up to their events. He didn’t come up through their farm system, and in a genre that deliberately favors underdogs, he might’ve simply gotten too popular too fast. So, “contemporary folk recording” it is, even if that is one oddball catch-all category. (But as has been pointed out, there are people nominated in that every year who have the nom as a highlight of their professional careers, so there should be no shame in it for Kahan, and he’d undoubtedly agree.)

If you really want to know why we all should have seen Kahan’s near-shutout coming, anyway, consider the ongoing case of Zach Bryan, who also falls between genres, despite also being one of the biggest recording and touring artists in the universe at the moment. I thought of Bryan as I was wondering whether Kahan would face the same problem with the Grammys, but at the time, I thought Bryan might have been snubbed most of all because of his surlier personality, whereas Kahan being an overtly personable guy would make the difference. Turns out they’re probably just in the same ballpark after all.

And then there is the issue of white guys with guitars, and how they’re doing, generally, in the culture, or with the Grammys specifically. The demographics the Recording Academy has been courting in expanding and diversifying its membership do not suggest they’re bringing in vast amounts of people who are going to put a Kahan at the top of their ballot, any more than they’re going to vote for Paul McCartney (whose critically hailed “Boys of Dungeon Lane” would have been a shoo-in for top noms with the Grammy voters of the 2000s, but not the 2020s). When the Grammys invited 3,600 pros to join as voting members in the class of 2025, 56% were people of color and 60% were under 40. You don’t look at those stats and imagine that any of the various waning subgenres of rock are suddenly going to be overrepresented among the biggest Grammy nominees.

But here’s the other thing to take into account: all those new voters, along with the older ones the Academy has not aged it out, are getting it right more often than not. As much as I like “The Great Divide,” when I look at the album of the year lineup to see which nominee I would personally knock out to make room for it, there are only a couple of the eight that seem even remotely expendable. Most forecasters would probably say that Phoebe Bridgers’ “Lost Weekend” took a slot that was expected to go to Kahan, and maybe she knocked him down to ninth place, although we’ll never know for sure where he ended up. There’s absolutely nothing regrettable about her making it in, or the utterly deserving Rosalía or Raye or most of the others… and obviously no shame in women earning seven out of eight noms in some of the top categories, after the “step up, girls” era, and on merit. Of all the years for any sense of overriding Grammy outrage to take hold, this is not one of them.

But I can think of other artists besides Kahan I think got “robbed” in the top categories, like Sienna Spiro, who should have been up for all four top general-field trophies but is only in for best new artist. A year this solid and action-packed makes the case that the Academy should considering reupping the number of finalists in the top four categories from eight to 10, as was the case in 2022 and 2023 before tjeu dropped it back down again. If the Oscars can stick with 10 nominees at the top of the ballot, so could the Grammys.

In the meantime, as Kahan fans lick wounds, they ought to be able to take some comfort in the hundred factors that make even a worthy contender get shut out, or nearly ignored. It’s not him, it’s them — in all sorts of ways — and there are real reasons to believe that, not just the delusional ones hardcore stans come up with to justify more negligible artists being slighted. And if the reasons for being left out have to do with being the kind of artist who snuck up completely between the cracks, and who’s thriving beyond belief, even as he continues to be a little bit stepped over, that’s a triumph that might finally be even better than a Grammy.

s6vnf0.title: Мировые сборы приквела "Голодные игры: Рассвет жатвы" составили $225 млн за дебютный уик-энд
s6vnf0.content:
Франшиза «Голодные игры» официально возглавила список самых прибыльных активов студии Lionsgate, опередив «Сумерки» ($3,3 млрд) с общим результатом $3,43 млрд в мировом прокате. Исторический рекорд стал возможен благодаря успешному дебюту приквела «Голодные игры: Рассвет жатвы», который в первые выходные собрал $120 млн в США и еще около $105 млн на зарубежных территориях, доведя стартовую кассу до $225 млн.
Фильм стал лишь пятым релизом 2026 года, преодолевшим стомиллионный рубеж в домашнем прокате на старте. Уверенные сборы выглядят особенно показательно на фоне релиза Grand Theft Auto 6, оттянувшего на себя значительную часть внимания аудитории. Новинка уверенно обошла предыдущий приквел 2023 года «Баллада о змеях и певчих птицах» ($44 млн на старте) и вплотную приблизилась к показателям основной квадрологии.
При бюджете более 150 миллионов долларов без учета расходов на маркетинг фильму необходимо собрать около $375 млн, чтобы окупить затраты — цель, которой он должен достичь без особых трудностей. Этот прогноз подкрепляется теплым приемом зрителей: картина получила оценку «A-» по итогам опросов CinemaScore.
Фильм, снятый режиссером Фрэнсисом Лоуренсом по книге Сьюзен Коллинз, возвращает зрителей на 50-е Голодные игры и рассказывает о юности Хеймитча Эбернети, которого сыграл Джозеф Зада.

gh-1440329873.title: GitHub - 0xd34db8/LF2-decomp: A true 1:1 C++20 source decompliation and modernization of the original Little Fighter 2 (lf2.exe, version 1.9c / 2.0a, x86-32 MSVC++).
gh-1440329873.content:
Little Fighter 2 | Binary Reverse Engineering, Decompilation & Source Lift
A complete binary reverse engineering, forensic decompilation, and modern C++ source lift of the original Little Fighter 2 (lf2.exe, versions 1.9c / 2.0a, x86-32 MSVC++).

This project is a systems programming and binary reverse engineering exercise designed to extract, lift, and preserve the authentic game logic (state machines, frame-accurate timings, hitbox collision mathematics, and data-driven file loading) while shedding legacy DirectDraw 6 and Win32 dependencies in favor of a modern cross-platform architecture.

Project Scope
The primary objective of this repository is the complete reverse engineering and forensic decompilation of the original closed-source x86-32 MSVC++ executable (lf2.exe). By combining NSA Ghidra & historical assembly mapping, this project recovers the authentic, byte-accurate algorithms, memory structures, and mathematical logic written by Marti Wong and Starsky Wong between 1999 and 2002.
As a companion system, the repository also tries to provide a modernized C++20 / SDL2 Source Lift in lifted/, freeing the game from deprecated 1990s Win32 and DirectDraw 6 dependencies.

Repository Architecture

The workspace is organized into dedicated, self-contained sub-environments to ensure complete isolation between forensic evidence, compilable legacy code, modern engine code, and project documentation:
LF2/
├── assets/ # Media documentation assets & hero banners
├── decompiled/ # Primary Reverse Engineering Archive
│ ├── RAW/ # Pristine decompiler outputs directly from Ghidra
│ │ ├── app/ # Raw WinMain, WndProc, menu & tournament state machines
│ │ ├── audio/ # Raw DirectSound & WAV buffer loaders
│ │ ├── core/ # Raw PRNG table & coordinate math
│ │ ├── data/ # Raw .dat lexers, cipher decryption & control.txt parsers
│ │ ├── gameplay/ # Raw combat dispatcher, hitboxes, AI & weapon attachment
│ │ ├── graphics/ # Raw DirectDraw blitters, clipping & parallax math
│ │ └── net/ # Raw lockstep network exchange & packet verifiers
│ ├── Compilable/ # Self-contained, compilable legacy C suite (55 translation units + test runner, 100+ routines)
│ │ ├── include/ # legacy_types.h (typed structs), legacy_signatures.h, legacy_globals.h
│ │ ├── app/ # Clean C routines: winmain.c, wndproc.c, battle_mode.c, etc.
│ │ ├── audio/ # Clean C routines: sound_init.c, sound_load_wav.c, sound_play.c, bgm_manager.c
│ │ ├── core/ # Clean C routines: abs.c, random.c, overlap.c, legacy_globals.c
│ │ ├── data/ # Clean C routines: load_dat.c, save_dat.c, decrypt_dat.c, etc.
│ │ ├── gameplay/ # Clean C routines: attack_process.c, teleport.c, ai_process.c, etc.
│ │ ├── graphics/ # Clean C routines: draw_object.c, parallax_calc.c, clip_rect.c, etc.

Prior Art vs. This Project

Over the last two decades, the Little Fighter 2 community has attempted several ambitious projects to modernize or recreate the game. To understand our mission, it is vital to distinguish between modding, clean-room rewrites, and true binary reverse engineering:
What Other Projects Did

Community Approach
Methodology
Why It Differs

External Scripting Rewrites
Building a new engine from scratch and delegating gameplay logic to an external scripting engine (e.g. AngelScript), loosely inspired by original mechanics.
From-scratch recreation that abandons the original compiled execution flow, state transitions, and arithmetic quirks.

Dynamic Memory Patching & DLL Hijacking
Intercepting legacy graphics API calls via proxy wrappers (ddraw.dll) and injecting custom logic hooks directly into the closed-source process at runtime.
Dynamic memory modding. It still depends entirely on running the closed-source legacy executable in the background rather than freeing the source code.

Clean-Room Interpretation Clones
Rebuilding the engine from scratch using modern object-oriented software engineering principles and architectural design patterns.
While architecturally sound, it represents an interpretation of how the game should work, rather than extracting how the shipped binary actually operates.

Open-Source Engine Reimplementations
Modern clean-room clones built with contemporary frameworks and libraries specifically to parse and load legacy .dat assets.
Approximates mechanics from the outside, but lacks authentic assembly state machines, deterministic random generators, and timing quirks.

Manual Disassembly Archives
Manually translating raw disassembly into intermediate scripting languages (e.g. Ruby) or partial C stubs function-by-function.
Massive forensic undertaking that historically stalled before completing a compilable, fully modernized game engine, leaving uncorrected offset errors.

This Project

Extracting, Not Guessing: We do not invent custom OOP hierarchies, we do not guess class offsets, and we do not write high-level approximations. We decompile the compiled x86-32 MSVC++ machine code directly from the original executable and reconstruct the authentic logic in readable, typed C and modern C++.
Byte-Level Mathematical Fidelity: Collision detection, axis-aligned bounding box projections, directional facing mirrors, velocity integrations, deterministic lookup tables, and frame state machines are mathematically identical to the original assembly.
Dual-Track Workflow:

Forensic Decompilation (decompiled/): Pristine Ghidra exports paired with a self-contained, human-readable, compilable C suite that preserves exact memory layouts and calling conventions.
Modernized Source Lift (lifted/): Portable C++20 / SDL2 implementation shedding legacy DirectDraw 6 and Win32 dependencies while retaining 100% gameplay parity.

Core Directives & Verification Standards

Never Guess Offsets: Every struct size and member variable offset is verified against Ghidra decompiler pseudocode and backed by compile-time static_assert statements.
Strict Adherence to Math: Floating-point velocity integrations, hitbox coordinates, and frame timers are mathematically identical to the original x86 disassembly.
Dual-Target Portability: Pointers and struct layouts are designed to maintain byte-offset parity on 32-bit compilation targets while running without memory truncation or segmentation faults on modern 64-bit systems.

Building & Verification

Prerequisites

Compiler: Modern C/C++ toolchain (GCC 13+ / MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC 14.2+ / Clang 15+)
Build Tool: GNU make or mingw32-make
SDL2: MinGW-w64 development libraries are self-contained in lifted/third_party/SDL2/, with SDL2.dll provided for runtime execution.

1. Compilable Decompiled Legacy Suite (decompiled/Compilable/)
Because Little Fighter 2 artwork, sprite sheets, sound effects, and stage backgrounds are proprietary freeware created by Marti Wong and Starsky Wong, they are not distributed in this source code repository.
# Build the legacy static library (decompiled/Compilable/build/liblf2_legacy.a)
mingw32-make -C decompiled/Compilable

# Run the decompiled verification test suite
mingw32-make -C decompiled/Compilable test

# Clean legacy build artifacts
mingw32-make -C decompiled/Compilable clean
Verification Suite (test_legacy.exe) checks:

1:1 Fast integer absolute value computation (0x004034e0)
2D Bounding box overlap arithmetic (0x004171c0)
Deterministic 3,000-byte circular PRNG table lookup (0x00417170)
Exact sizeof and offsetof alignments for all 10 domain structures
Rudolf teleportation gameplay positioning logic (0x00403270)

2. Modernized Source Lift Engine (lifted/)
The modernized source lift builds an independent executable and static engine library:
# Build the modernized game executable (lifted/build/lf2.exe)
mingw32-make -C lifted

# Run all 16 unit test suites and the 30-frame verification test (17 tests total)
mingw32-make -C lifted test

# Clean lifted build artifacts
mingw32-make -C lifted clean
Running the Game:
# Launch from the lifted directory
cd lifted && ./build/lf2.exe

# Launch directly in fullscreen mode
cd lifted && ./build/lf2.exe --fullscreen

Controls & Player Mapping: Player keys are configured via control.txt.
Fullscreen Toggle: Press Alt + Enter to switch between windowed (794x550) and fullscreen.
Secret Cheat Codes:

Type lf2.net on the main menu to unlock Julian, Firzen, LouisEX, and all enemy henchmen.
Type herofighter.com to enable stage debug function keys.
Type ABC to unlock the internal frame and hitbox inspector.

3. Setting Up Authentic Game Assets
Little Fighter 2 artwork, character sprites, sound effects, and stage backgrounds are proprietary freeware created by Marti Wong and Starsky Wong, and are not distributed in this repository.
To run the lifted engine with full audio and visual assets:

Obtain an authentic Little Fighter 2 installation (v1.9c, v2.0, or v2.0a) from lf2.net or LF-Empire.
Copy the authentic game folders (data/, sprite/, bg/, sound/, bgm/) into lifted/build/ (or run lf2.exe directly inside an existing LF2 directory).
All frontend menu and character selection UI images are pre-baked directly into the binary (lifted/src/graphics/embedded_ui.cpp), exactly mirroring the Win32 PE resource architecture of the original binary.

Reverse-Engineered Secrets, Ciphers & Easter Eggs

Ghidra decompilation and binary disassembly revealed several fascinating, historic internal mechanics and easter eggs embedded directly into the machine code of lf2.exe:
1. The Legendary Resource Decryption Key: "SiuHungIsAGoodBearBecauseHeIsVeryGood"

Memory Location: Hardcoded in the .rdata section at virtual address 0x0044892c (file offset 0x4792c).

Origin & Fun Fact: "Siu Hung" (小熊) is the Cantonese pseudonym of Marti Wong (黃小熊), co-creator of Little Fighter 2 alongside Starsky Wong. Translated from Cantonese, it means:

"Little Bear is a good bear because he is very good."

The Cipher Architecture: LF2 encodes all game resources (.dat files) using a byte-wise additive/subtractive variant of the Vigenère cipher operating modulo 256.

The 123-Byte Header Trick: Every .dat file begins with a 123-byte (0x7B) padding header. In FUN_004148a0, the decryptor steps through the key (key_idx + 1) % 37 for each of the 123 dummy bytes before decrypting any payload data. Since 123 % 37 = 12, payload decryption always begins at key index 12 (the character 'G' in "GoodBear..."):
$$\text{plaintext}[i] = (\text{ciphertext}[i] - \text{key}[k] + 256) \pmod{256}$$

Modding Community Nostalgia: For over two decades, this hardcoded string has been celebrated among LF2 modders who reverse-engineered the binary to create data decrypters (e.g. LF2 Data Changer).

2. The Replay (.lfr) Secondary Obfuscation Cipher (0x0043DD60 / 0x0044D7A0)

Two-Layer Protection in LF2 v2.0: While legacy versions saved raw frame records, Little Fighter 2 v2.0 introduced a dual compression and encryption pipeline in 0x0043DD60 to protect replay recordings (.lfr files in recording\) from tampering and desynchronization.

zlib Deflation: The memory buffer containing all recorded battle input frames is first compressed using a statically linked build of zlib 1.1.4 (compress() / deflate() at 0x0043F4B0).

The Obfuscation Pass: Immediately after deflation, the engine loops through the compressed payload byte-by-byte and applies an additive character cipher using a hardcoded 1,345-byte ASCII digit key stored in .data at 0x0044D7A0:
Key = "15456611235456134545631153456894056897..." (1,345 bytes)

Transformation Formula: Each of the first $\min(N, 1345)$ bytes of the compressed stream is transformed using its corresponding key digit:
$$\text{byte}[i] = (\text{byte}[i] + (\text{key}[i] - \text{'0'})) \pmod{256}$$

This custom secondary cipher explains why third-party replay editors from the LF2 1.9c era failed to open or parse replays generated by version 2.0.

3. Secret Cheat Code State Machines in WindowProc (0x0043b3d0)
The original window procedure maintains static state counters that detect sequential keystrokes typed anywhere in the application:

"lf2.net" (Roster Unlock): Typing L -> F -> 2 -> . -> N -> E -> T increments state tracker DAT_0045857c and sets DAT_00455471 = 'd' (ASCII 0x64). This unlocks Julian, Firzen, and LouisEX on the character selection screen along with other enemy characters, which are non playable by default.

"herofighter.com" (Sequel Easter Egg): Typing H -> E -> R -> O -> F -> I -> G -> H -> T -> E -> R -> . -> C -> O -> M advances tracker DAT_00458578 and sets DAT_00455470 = 'd'. Marti Wong embedded this secret domain name in later versions of LF2 as a nod to his next major project, Hero Fighter! It enables the user to use function keys in the Stage mode of the game.

"ABC" (Internal Data Debugger): In FUN_0043e9a0, pressing A -> B -> C sequentially sets DAT_00450bec = 1, unlocking mode switching via keys '1', '2', '3' to access the built-in frame/weapon inspector mode.

4. Window & Platform Identity Artifacts

Window Class Name: The Win32 window class is registered as "Marti" at 0x00447634.

Window Title: Defined as "Little Fighter 2" at 0x00447620.

Authentic Viewport Resolution: Hardcoded in the .data segment at DAT_0044d78c (width = 794) and DAT_0044d790 (height = 550).

5. Deterministic Multiplayer PRNG Table

Standard C library rand() implementations vary across compiler runtimes, which would desynchronize peer-to-peer multiplayer.
LF2 completely avoids rand() during gameplay: at 0x0044FF90 in .data, it embeds a static, precomputed 3,000-byte pseudo-random table.
The PRNG routine (0x00417170) simply advances a circular index:
$$\text{index} = (\text{index} + 1) \pmod{3000}$$
guaranteeing 100% deterministic lockstep synchronization across network clients.

6. Fixed-Step 30 FPS Timing & Spiral-of-Death Protection (0x0043cf40)

Tick Step: In battle (DAT_0044d02c != 0), the step is 33 ms (0x21), yielding ~30.3 FPS. In menus, it steps at 3 ms.

Spiral of Death Clamp: If system lag causes the accumulator to fall behind by more than 100 ms, the game drops excess accumulated time:
$$\text{if } (t[\text{now}] - t[\text{last}] > 100\text{ ms}) \implies t[\text{last}] = t[\text{now}] - 100\text{ ms}$$

CPU Yielding: To prevent 100% CPU core starvation, the timing loop yields via sleep in chunks of at most 5 ms.

Key State Table: A raw 256-byte static array at 0x00455378 is initialized to 'u' (0x75 = up) in WinMain and toggled to 'd' (0x64 = down) on WM_KEYDOWN.

Engine Quirks, Desyncs & Known Binary Bugs

Through Ghidra decompilation and binary disassembly of lf2.exe, we reverse-engineered the exact root causes of legendary Little Fighter 2 engine quirks, multiplayer desync crashes, and long-standing community mysteries:
1. The Anatomy of the Infamous "Synchronisation Error!" (0x0041CAD9 / 0x0041CCB5)
For over two decades, Little Fighter 2 players experienced sudden match freezes with a "Synchronisation Error!" modal dialog. Disassembly of the lockstep network routine in 0x0041C5F0 revealed the exact mechanism:

The 22-Byte Lockstep Packet: At 0x0041CB80, every frame exchange transmits a compact 22-byte packet (net_packet_t) containing 8 packed player controller states (Up 0x02, Right 0x04, Attack 0x08, Jump 0x10, Defend 0x20, Down 0x40, Left 0x80, with 0x01 idle bit), frame sequence counter, version byte, and active HP checksum.

Three-Tier Desynchronization Checks: Disassembly at 0x0041CB50–0x0041CCD0 reveals the exact single-byte checks:

Offset +9 (Sequence Counter): Frame counter modulo 50 (idiv $0x32, DAT_00450bf0). Checked at 0x0041CC27; a mismatch halts with "Connection Lost!" (0x004493B4).

Offset +11 (Version Tag): Game version byte (DAT_0044d03c). Checked at 0x0041CC78; a mismatch halts with "Version not matched!" (0x0044939C).

Offset +13 (HP Checksum): Cumulative active player HP checksum (DAT_00450bf4). Checked at 0x0041CCB5; if remote and local checksums differ by even 1 HP, execution halts with "Synchronisation Error!" (0x00449384).

The 3-Phase Handshake Pipeline:

Phase 1 (14 Bytes): Host transmits "u can connect\0" (hardcoded at 0x00448900).

Phase 2 (77 Bytes): Slot negotiation ("11110000" host slots 1–4 vs "00001111" client slots 5–8) + four 10-byte player name strings delimited with _.

Phase 3 (3,001 Bytes): 1-byte command tag + 3,000-byte precomputed circular PRNG table (0x0044FF90) so both peers share identical pseudo-random sequences.

2. The 400-Slot World Object Array & Screen Overflow Crash (0x0042E100 / 0x004061D0)

Static Allocation Ceiling: Little Fighter 2 manages all entities on screen through a fixed global array in global_t (0x00458B00) capped at exactly 400 object slots (objects[400] at offset 0x194–0x7D4, matching is_object_exists[400] at 0x004–0x194).

Shared Pool Competition: Player characters (slots 0–7), enemy minions, dropped weapons (knives, baseball bats, rocks), projectiles (energy balls, ice swords), and transient particle effects (blood splatters, smoke puffs) all compete for these 400 slots. In object_t, the victim rest array vrest_of_objects is also exactly 400 bytes (0x0F0–0x280).

A native engine for the PC games Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (2001)
and Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002).
macOS, Windows and Linux. The original games, checked against the originals.

HPEngine is an unofficial, open-source replacement for the engine behind the first two Harry Potter games for PC by
KnowWonder / Electronic Arts, both built on Unreal Engine 1:

Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone / Sorcerer's Stone (2001), "HP1" below;
Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002), "HP2" below.

It contains nothing of the games: it reads the maps, UnrealScript code, textures, sounds and music from a copy you own
and runs them on new code. Both games run on the same engine.
A legally obtained copy of the game is required. See Requirements.
Status
Version: beta (0.5.0).

game
status

playable: the full campaign was completed on 0.1.0

Harry Potter 2 (Chamber of Secrets)
first beta, new in 0.5.0: it starts, plays and saves, but its campaign has not yet been played through to the end on HPEngine (see Known issues)

Coming from 0.1.0? See CHANGELOG.md for how to move your saves.
Quick start

Download the package for your system from Releases:

macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel): HPEngine-Launcher-macOS.zip
Windows: HPEngine-win-x64.zip
Linux / Steam Deck: HPEngine-linux-x64.tar.gz

Add your game. Start the launcher (macOS: HPEngine Launcher; Windows: HPEngine Launcher.exe; Linux: HPEngine-Launcher),
pick the game's tab (Harry Potter 1 or Harry Potter 2) and add your copy. The launcher never changes your
files.
Play. Press Play (HP2: New Game or Load Game) in the launcher.

Step by step, with the first-launch warnings of macOS and Windows: Install.
